End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Объединение цветных интервалов сохраняет пропуски и работает без чтения заполненных ячеек.
Private Sub TestSnapshotStatusSpans()
    Dim sheet As Object, app As Object, alerts As Boolean
    Set app = ThisWorkbook.Application: alerts = app.DisplayAlerts
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    Dim target As Object: Set target = sheet.cells(4, 5).Resize(13, 3)
    Dim values(1 To 13, 1 To 3) As Variant, body(1 To 11, 1 To 3) As Variant
    Dim rows(1 To 8) As Long, ids As Variant, row As Long, column As Long, testCase As Long, i As Long, selected As Boolean, same As Boolean
    ids = Array(3&, 4&, 10&, 6&, 7&, 8&, 13&, 12&)
    For i = 1 To 8: rows(i) = CLng(ids(i - 1)): Next i
    For row = 1 To 13
        values(row, 1) = "OK": values(row, 2) = "FAIL": values(row, 3) = "N/A"
    Next row
    values(4, 3) = "Cracked": values(10, 3) = "NotCracked": values(6, 3) = ""
    For row = 1 To 11
        For column = 1 To 3: body(row, column) = values(row + 2, column): Next column
    Next row
    For testCase = 0 To 2
        target.Interior.color = RGB(1, 2, 3)
        If testCase = 0 Then
            target.value2 = values: ApplyTableStatusFills target, rows, Array(1, 2, 3), True, 3
        ElseIf testCase = 1 Then
            target.value2 = CVErr(2015): ApplyTableStatusFills target, rows, Array(1, 2, 3), True, 3, values
        Else
            target.value2 = CVErr(2015): ApplyTableStatusFills target, rows, Array(1, 2, 3), True, 3, body, 2
        End If
        same = True
        For row = 1 To 13
            selected = False
            For i = 1 To 8: If rows(i) = row Then selected = True
            Next i
            For column = 1 To 3
                Dim color As Long: color = RGB(1, 2, 3)
                If selected Then
                    If Not (column = 3 And (row = 4 Or row = 6 Or row = 10)) Then color = StatusFillColor(CStr(values(row, column)))
                End If
                If CLng(target.cells(row, column).Interior.color) <> color Then same = False
            Next column
        Next row
        TestSnapshotCheck "statusSpans.gapsAndPreparedValues." & CStr(testCase), same
    Next testCase
    app.DisplayAlerts = False: sheet.Delete: app.DisplayAlerts = alerts
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    Dim number As Long, description As String: number = Err.number: description = Err.description
    On Error Resume Next
    app.DisplayAlerts = False
    If Not sheet Is Nothing Then sheet.Delete
    app.DisplayAlerts = alerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    Err.Raise number, "TestSnapshotStatusSpans", description
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет прямой строковый IO независимо от кодека: старые байтовые операции служат эталоном.
Private Sub TestSnapshotUTF16Strings()
    Dim path As String: path = ThisWorkbook.path & Application.PathSeparator & "TestUTF16_" & format$(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnnss") & ".bin"
    If Len(Dir$(path)) > 0 Then Err.Raise 5, , "Тестовый файл UTF16 уже существует."
    Dim file As CBinarySnapshotFile: Set file = New CBinarySnapshotFile
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim samples As Variant, sample As Variant, bytes() As Byte, actual As String, count As Long, index As Long
    samples = Array(vbNullString, "ASCII", ChrW$(&H416) & ChrW$(&H3B1), "left" & Chr$(0) & "right", _
        ChrW$(&HD83D) & ChrW$(&HDE00), ChrW$(&HD800), String$(32767, "x"), String$(65536, "z"))
    file.OpenWrite path
    For Each sample In samples: file.WriteSizedUTF16 CStr(sample): Next sample
    file.CloseFile: file.OpenRead path
    For Each sample In samples
        count = file.ReadLong: actual = vbNullString
        If count > 0 Then bytes = file.ReadBytes(count): actual = bytes
        TestSnapshotCheck "utf16.write.matchesBytes." & CStr(index), count = LenB(CStr(sample)) And StrComp(actual, CStr(sample), vbBinaryCompare) = 0
        index = index + 1
    Next sample
    file.CloseFile: file.OpenWrite path
    For Each sample In samples
        file.WriteLong LenB(CStr(sample))
        If LenB(CStr(sample)) > 0 Then bytes = CStr(sample): file.WriteBytes bytes
    Next sample
    file.CloseFile: file.OpenRead path: index = 0
    For Each sample In samples
        actual = file.ReadSizedUTF16(131072)
        TestSnapshotCheck "utf16.read.matchesBytes." & CStr(index), LenB(actual) = LenB(CStr(sample)) And StrComp(actual, CStr(sample), vbBinaryCompare) = 0
        index = index + 1
    Next sample
    file.CloseFile
    Dim testCase As Long
    For testCase = 0 To 3
        file.OpenWrite path
        Select Case testCase
            Case 0: file.WriteLong -1
            Case 1: file.WriteLong 3: file.WriteASCII "abc"
            Case 2: file.WriteSizedUTF16 String$(65537, "z")
            Case 3: file.WriteLong 20: file.WriteByte 7
        End Select
        file.CloseFile: file.OpenRead path
        TestSnapshotCheck "utf16.invalidLength." & CStr(testCase), TestSnapshotUTF16Rejected(file)
        file.CloseFile
    Next testCase
    Kill path
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    Dim number As Long, reason As String: number = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    On Error Resume Next
    file.CloseFile: Kill path
    On Error GoTo 0
    Err.Raise number, "TestSnapshotUTF16Strings", reason
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Перехватывает только ожидаемую ошибку чтения некорректной длины строки.
Private Function TestSnapshotUTF16Rejected(ByVal file As CBinarySnapshotFile) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim text As String: text = file.ReadSizedUTF16(131072)
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    TestSnapshotUTF16Rejected = (Err.number = 5)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Повторное использование writer-а читает новые входные строки, а не массив предыдущей операции.
Private Sub TestSnapshotOneUseSource()
    Dim target As Object, saved As Variant
    Set target = ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersToRange.cells(2, 15)
    saved = target.formula
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim section As CSectionModel: Set section = ReadFormedSectionFromResults(ThisWorkbook)
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader: Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Dim units As CUnitSystem: Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
    Dim provider As CMaterialModelProvider: Set provider = New CMaterialModelProvider: provider.Initialize settings, units
    Dim props As CSectionPropertiesCalculator: Set props = PrepareSectionSnapshot(section, provider)
    Dim writer As CNDMResultsWriter: Set writer = New CNDMResultsWriter
    Dim batch As CBatchSectionCalculator: Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator
    Dim first As CCalculationSnapshot: Set first = New CCalculationSnapshot
    target.value2 = "TestSourceBefore"
    writer.PreparePreservedSnapshotSource ThisWorkbook
    Set writer.CaptureSnapshot = first
    writer.writeResults ThisWorkbook, section, props, batch, units, True
    Dim values As Variant: values = first.table("rngNDMSectionGeometry")
    TestSnapshotCheck "capture.oneUse.initial", CStr(values(2, 15)) = "TestSourceBefore"
    target.value2 = "TestSourceAfter"
    Dim second As CCalculationSnapshot: Set second = New CCalculationSnapshot
    Set writer.CaptureSnapshot = second
    writer.writeResults ThisWorkbook, section, props, batch, units, True
    values = second.table("rngNDMSectionGeometry")
    TestSnapshotCheck "capture.oneUse.newSource", CStr(values(2, 15)) = "TestSourceAfter"
    target.formula = saved
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    Dim number As Long, reason As String: number = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    On Error Resume Next
    target.formula = saved
    On Error GoTo 0
    Err.Raise number, "TestSnapshotOneUseSource", reason
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Повторная проверка сохраняет защиту при изменении даты и добавлении новой части.
Private Sub TestSnapshotValidationReuse(ByVal snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot)
    snapshot.Validate: snapshot.Validate
    Dim run As Double: run = snapshot.runID
    snapshot.runID = run + 1#
    TestSnapshotCheck "validate.changedRunRejected", TestSnapshotValidationRejected(snapshot)
    snapshot.runID = run: snapshot.Validate
    Dim copy As Variant: copy = snapshot.table("rngNDMElementResults")
    copy(2, 1) = run + 2#
    snapshot.Validate
    Dim actual As Variant: actual = snapshot.table("rngNDMElementResults")
    TestSnapshotCheck "validate.returnedArrayIndependent", CDbl(actual(2, 1)) = run
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Возвращает отказ действительного валидатора, не подменяя ожидаемые статусы.
Private Function TestSnapshotValidationRejected(ByVal snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    snapshot.Validate
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    TestSnapshotValidationRejected = True
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Индекс обязан сохранять несмежные группы, регистр, порядок и произвольные позиции колонок.
Private Sub TestSnapshotElementIndex()
    Dim snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot: Set snapshot = New CCalculationSnapshot
    Dim data(1 To 7, 1 To 9) As Variant, row As Long
    data(1, 1) = "RunID": data(1, 5) = "LoadCase": data(1, 3) = "StateType"
    For row = 2 To 7
        data(row, 1) = 1#: data(row, 2) = "Element" & CStr(row)
        data(row, 5) = IIf(row = 4 Or row = 7, "B", "A")
        data(row, 3) = IIf(row = 3 Or row = 7, "CrackedState", "StrengthState")
    Next row
    snapshot.AddTable "rngNDMElementResults", data
    Dim actual As Variant: actual = snapshot.SelectElementResults("a", "strengthstate", False)
    TestSnapshotCheck "index.nonAdjacentOrder", UBound(actual, 1) = 4 And actual(2, 2) = "Element2" And actual(3, 2) = "Element5" And actual(4, 2) = "Element6"
    actual = snapshot.SelectElementResults("", "", True)
    TestSnapshotCheck "index.firstRows", UBound(actual, 1) = 5 And actual(2, 2) = "Element2" And actual(3, 2) = "Element3" And actual(4, 2) = "Element4" And actual(5, 2) = "Element7"
    actual = snapshot.SelectElementResults("missing", "", False)
    TestSnapshotCheck "index.missingHeaderOnly", UBound(actual, 1) = 1
    actual = snapshot.SelectElementResults("", "", False)
    TestSnapshotCheck "index.fullExact", TestSnapshotSameMatrix(data, actual)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет плотные колонки и серии независимо заданных чисел, Unicode и типов.
Private Sub TestSnapshotColumnCodec(ByVal original As CCalculationSnapshot, ByVal store As CCalculationSnapshotStore)
    Dim sample As CCalculationSnapshot: Set sample = New CCalculationSnapshot
    sample.runID = original.runID: sample.ElapsedSeconds = original.ElapsedSeconds
    Dim key As Variant
    For Each key In original.keys(): sample.AddTable CStr(key), original.table(CStr(key)): Next key
    Dim data(1 To 1024, 1 To 8) As Variant, row As Long, negative As TTestSnapshotDouble, bits As TTestSnapshotBits
    bits.high = &H80000000: LSet negative = bits
    For row = 1 To 1024
        data(row, 1) = "Сечение_" & ChrW$(&H3B1)
        data(row, 2) = CDbl(row) / 7#
        data(row, 3) = (row < 513)
        data(row, 4) = 0#: If row > 512 Then data(row, 4) = negative.value
        data(row, 5) = "": If row > 512 Then data(row, 5) = Empty
        data(row, 6) = CDbl(row Mod 23) * 1E-250
        data(row, 7) = IIf(row Mod 2 = 0, "one", "two")
        If row = 1 Then data(row, 8) = "header" Else data(row, 8) = original.runID
    Next row
    sample.AddTable "Test.ColumnCodec", data
    store.SaveFile ThisWorkbook, sample
    Dim loaded As CCalculationSnapshot: Set loaded = store.LoadFile(ThisWorkbook)
    Dim actual As Variant: actual = loaded.table("Test.ColumnCodec")
    TestSnapshotCheck "codec.mixed.bitExact", TestSnapshotSameMatrix(data, actual)
    TestSnapshotCheck "codec.emptyKinds", VarType(actual(1, 5)) = vbString And VarType(actual(1024, 5)) = vbEmpty
    TestSnapshotCheck "codec.booleanKind", VarType(actual(1, 3)) = vbBoolean And VarType(actual(1024, 3)) = vbBoolean
    store.SaveFile ThisWorkbook, original
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Повторяющиеся ElementID сохраняются точно; любое нарушение шаблона включает общий кодек.
Private Sub TestSnapshotRepeatedElementIDs(ByVal original As CCalculationSnapshot, ByVal store As CCalculationSnapshotStore)
    Dim count As Long: count = original.TableRowCount("rngNDMSectionGeometry") - 1
    Dim groups As Long: groups = 2 + 4096 \ count
    Dim expected As Variant: expected = original.table("rngNDMElementResults")
    Dim data() As Variant, row As Long, column As Long, sourceRow As Long
    ReDim data(1 To groups * count + 1, 1 To 9)
    For column = 1 To 9: data(1, column) = expected(1, column): Next column
    For row = 2 To UBound(data, 1)
        sourceRow = 2 + (row - 2) Mod count
        For column = 1 To 9: data(row, column) = expected(sourceRow, column): Next column
    Next row
    Dim testCase As Long, sample As CCalculationSnapshot, loaded As CCalculationSnapshot, key As Variant
    Dim changed As Long, savedID As String
    For testCase = 0 To 3
        changed = 0
        Select Case testCase
            Case 1: changed = UBound(data, 1): savedID = CStr(data(changed, 5)): data(changed, 5) = "TestMismatch_" & savedID
            Case 2: changed = 3: savedID = CStr(data(changed, 5)): data(changed, 5) = data(2, 5)
            Case 3: changed = 2: savedID = CStr(data(changed, 5)): data(changed, 5) = "ElementID"
        End Select
        Set sample = New CCalculationSnapshot: sample.runID = original.runID: sample.ElapsedSeconds = original.ElapsedSeconds
        For Each key In original.keys()
            If CStr(key) <> "rngNDMElementResults" Then sample.AddTable CStr(key), original.table(CStr(key))
        Next key
        sample.AddTable "rngNDMElementResults", data
        store.SaveFile ThisWorkbook, sample: Set loaded = store.LoadFile(ThisWorkbook)
        TestSnapshotCheck "codec.repeatedIDs." & CStr(testCase) & ".exact", TestSnapshotSameMatrix(data, loaded.table("rngNDMElementResults"))
        TestSnapshotCheck "codec.repeatedIDs." & CStr(testCase) & ".sourceUnchanged", TestSnapshotSameMatrix(data, sample.table("rngNDMElementResults"))
        If changed > 0 Then data(changed, 5) = savedID
    Next testCase
    store.SaveFile ThisWorkbook, original
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет текущие читаемые Excel-таблицы, отсутствие архива и неизменность верхнего вывода.
' Внешний runner вызывает метод только в своей частной рассчитанной копии.
Public Function TestExcelCurrentResultsRefresh() As String
    mTestReport = "": mTestPassed = 0: mTestFailed = 0
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim store As CCalculationSnapshotStore: Set store = New CCalculationSnapshotStore
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.storage", store.StorageMode(ThisWorkbook) = "Excel"
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.noArchiveName", Not TestSnapshotNameExists("rngNDMLoadCaseResults")
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.noFileReference", Not store.HasFileReference(ThisWorkbook)
    Dim snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot: Set snapshot = CurrentCalculationSnapshot(ThisWorkbook)
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.noPersistentFullSnapshot", snapshot Is Nothing
    Dim properties As Variant: properties = ReadPhysicalResultTable(ThisWorkbook, "rngNDMSectionProperties")
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.readableLoadCaseProperties", Not TestSnapshotCommonOnly(properties)
    Dim names As Variant: names = Array("rngBatchSummary", "rngStrengthSummaryAnchor", "rngCrackSummaryAnchor", "rngStabilitySummaryAnchor")
    Dim widths As Variant: widths = Array(33, 49, 72, 84)
    Dim before(0 To 3) As Variant, i As Long
    Dim plot As String: plot = TestSnapshotPlot()
    Dim exported As String: exported = Audit02ReadExportSnapshotForTests(ThisWorkbook)
    TestSnapshotCorruptUpper ' Удалённые значения не должны восстанавливаться из скрытого архива.
    For i = 0 To 3: before(i) = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(i))).RefersToRange.Resize(32, CLng(widths(i))).value2: Next i
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader: Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Dim iterations As String: iterations = settings.GetRequiredString("Solver.MaxIterations")
    Dim selectedName As String: selectedName = settings.GetRequiredString("Results.SnapshotName")
    TestSnapshotSetting "Results.SnapshotName", "../this_file_is_not_used_in_Excel"
    TestSnapshotSetting "Solver.MaxIterations", "not_a_number"
    Dim solves As Long: solves = SectionEquilibriumSolveCount()
    UpdateSectionResultsForWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.refresh.noSolver", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = solves
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.refresh.plotExact", TestSnapshotPlot() = plot
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.refresh.exportExact", Audit02ReadExportSnapshotForTests(ThisWorkbook) = exported
    For i = 0 To 3
        TestSnapshotCheck "excel.refresh.keepsUpper." & CStr(names(i)), TestSnapshotSameMatrix(before(i), ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(i))).RefersToRange.Resize(32, CLng(widths(i))).value2)
    Next i
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.refresh.keepsProperties", TestSnapshotSameMatrix(properties, ReadPhysicalResultTable(ThisWorkbook, "rngNDMSectionProperties"))
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.refresh.contextReleased", TestCalculationSnapshotReadReleased()
    TestSnapshotSetting "Solver.MaxIterations", iterations
    TestSnapshotSetting "Results.SnapshotName", selectedName
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestSnapshotCheck "excel.runtime " & CStr(Err.number) & ": " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    TestExcelCurrentResultsRefresh = mTestReport & "TOTAL EXCEL CURRENT RESULTS: passed=" & CStr(mTestPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mTestFailed)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сверяет все шесть технических таблиц Excel с теми же готовыми массивами расчёта.
Private Sub TestSnapshotExcelCurrent(ByVal original As CCalculationSnapshot)
    Dim key As Variant
    TestSnapshotUpper original
    For Each key In original.BaseKeys()
        TestSnapshotCheck "excel.physical." & CStr(key), TestSnapshotSameMatrix(original.ResultTable(CStr(key)), ReadPhysicalResultTable(ThisWorkbook, CStr(key)))
    Next key
    Dim previousReport As String: previousReport = mTestReport
    Dim previousPassed As Long: previousPassed = mTestPassed
    Dim previousFailed As Long: previousFailed = mTestFailed
    Dim result As String: result = TestExcelCurrentResultsRefresh()
    mTestReport = previousReport & mTestReport: mTestPassed = previousPassed + mTestPassed: mTestFailed = previousFailed + mTestFailed
    If InStr(result, "failed=0") = 0 Then Err.Raise 5, , result
    SaveAndDisplayCalculationSnapshot ThisWorkbook, original
    TestSnapshotUpper original
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' File восстанавливает повреждённый вывод; Excel обновляет схему без изменения сводок.
Public Function TestRestoreSnapshotAfterReopen() As String
    Dim store As CCalculationSnapshotStore: Set store = New CCalculationSnapshotStore
    If store.StorageMode(ThisWorkbook) = "File" Then TestSnapshotCorruptUpper
    TestSnapshotSetting "Solver.MaxIterations", "not_a_number"
    Dim solves As Long: solves = SectionEquilibriumSolveCount()
    UpdateSectionResultsForWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    If SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() <> solves Then Err.Raise 5, , "Восстановление повторно вызвало solver."

    If mTestFailed <> 0 Then Err.Raise 5, , mTestReport
    If Not TestCalculationSnapshotReadReleased() Then Err.Raise 5, , "Контекст чтения не освобождён."
    TestRestoreSnapshotAfterReopen = TestSnapshotReopenFingerprint()
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Возвращает все части снимка, данные схемы и экспорта для побитного сравнения после открытия.
Public Function TestSnapshotReopenFingerprint() As String
    Dim snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot: Set snapshot = CurrentCalculationSnapshot(ThisWorkbook)
    Dim keys As Variant
    If snapshot Is Nothing Then
        keys = Array("rngNDMSectionGeometry", "rngNDMSectionProperties", "rngNDMMaterialDiagrams", "rngNDMElementResults", "rngNDMSectionContours", "rngNDMSectionAnnotations")
    Else
        keys = snapshot.keys()
    End If
    Dim key As Variant, values As Variant, row As Long, column As Long, text As String, value As Variant
    Dim lines() As String, line As String
    If Not snapshot Is Nothing Then text = TestSnapshotDouble(snapshot.runID) & "|" & TestSnapshotDouble(snapshot.ElapsedSeconds)
    For Each key In keys
        If snapshot Is Nothing Then values = ReadPhysicalResultTable(ThisWorkbook, CStr(key)) Else values = snapshot.table(CStr(key))
        ReDim lines(0 To UBound(values, 1))
        lines(0) = CStr(key) & "|" & CStr(UBound(values, 1)) & "|" & CStr(UBound(values, 2))
        For row = 1 To UBound(values, 1)
            line = vbNullString
            For column = 1 To UBound(values, 2)
                value = values(row, column)
                If VarType(value) = vbString Or IsEmpty(value) Then
                    line = line & "S" & CStr(Len(CStr(value))) & ":" & CStr(value) & "|"
                Else
                    line = line & "D" & TestSnapshotDouble(CDbl(value)) & "|"
                End If
            Next column
            lines(row) = line
        Next row
        text = text & vbLf & Join(lines, vbLf)
    Next key
    TestSnapshotReopenFingerprint = text & vbLf & TestSnapshotPlot() & vbLf & Audit02ReadExportSnapshotForTests(ThisWorkbook)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет все части одного логического снимка, включая каждое число IEEE 754.
Private Sub TestSnapshotEqual(ByVal label As String, ByVal expected As CCalculationSnapshot, ByVal actual As CCalculationSnapshot)
    Dim key As Variant
    TestSnapshotCheck label & ".run", TestSnapshotDouble(expected.runID) = TestSnapshotDouble(actual.runID)
    TestSnapshotCheck label & ".elapsed", TestSnapshotDouble(expected.ElapsedSeconds) = TestSnapshotDouble(actual.ElapsedSeconds)
    For Each key In expected.keys()
        TestSnapshotCheck label & "." & CStr(key), actual.HasTable(CStr(key))
        If actual.HasTable(CStr(key)) Then TestSnapshotCheck label & ".values." & CStr(key), TestSnapshotSameMatrix(expected.table(CStr(key)), actual.table(CStr(key)))
    Next key
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сверяет физические верхние таблицы с сохранёнными данными, не решая НДС.
Private Sub TestSnapshotUpper(ByVal snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot)
    Dim key As Variant, name As String, values As Variant
    For Each key In Array("Summary", "Strength.Data", "Cracks.Data", "Stability.Data")
        Select Case CStr(key)
            Case "Summary": name = "rngBatchSummary"
            Case "Strength.Data": name = "rngStrengthSummaryAnchor"
            Case "Cracks.Data": name = "rngCrackSummaryAnchor"
            Case "Stability.Data": name = "rngStabilitySummaryAnchor"
        End Select
        values = snapshot.table(CStr(key))
        TestSnapshotCheck "upper." & CStr(key), TestSnapshotSameMatrix(values, ThisWorkbook.names.item(name).RefersToRange.Resize(UBound(values, 1), UBound(values, 2)).value2)
    Next key
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Удаляет значения, чтобы обновление не могло пройти за счёт старого вывода.
Private Sub TestSnapshotCorruptUpper()
    Dim name As Variant
    For Each name In Array("rngStrengthSummaryAnchor", "rngCrackSummaryAnchor", "rngStabilitySummaryAnchor")
        ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(name)).RefersToRange.Resize(30, 3).ClearContents
    Next name
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Числа сравнивает побитно, Empty и пустую строку считает эквивалентным пустым Excel-полем.
Private Function TestSnapshotSameMatrix(ByVal expected As Variant, ByVal actual As Variant) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If UBound(expected, 1) <> UBound(actual, 1) Or UBound(expected, 2) <> UBound(actual, 2) Then Exit Function
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, A As Variant, B As Variant
    For i = 1 To UBound(expected, 1)
        For j = 1 To UBound(expected, 2)
            A = expected(i, j): B = actual(i, j)
            If VarType(A) = vbString Or VarType(B) = vbString Or IsEmpty(A) Or IsEmpty(B) Then
                If CStr(A) <> CStr(B) Then GoTo Different
            ElseIf TestSnapshotDouble(CDbl(A)) <> TestSnapshotDouble(CDbl(B)) Then
                GoTo Different
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
    TestSnapshotSameMatrix = True
    Exit Function
Different:
    mTestReport = mTestReport & "DIFF|row=" & CStr(i) & "|column=" & CStr(j) & "|expected=" & CStr(A) & "|actual=" & CStr(B) & vbCrLf
Failed:
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Формирует точное представление Double без зависимости от локали и десятичных цифр.
Private Function TestSnapshotDouble(ByVal value As Double) As String
    Dim number As TTestSnapshotDouble, bits As TTestSnapshotBits
    number.value = value: LSet bits = number
    TestSnapshotDouble = right$("00000000" & Hex$(bits.high), 8) & right$("00000000" & Hex$(bits.low), 8)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает реальные данные потребителя схемы, а не только наличие ChartObject.
Private Function TestSnapshotPlot() As String
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader: Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Dim reader As CSectionPlotDataReader: Set reader = New CSectionPlotDataReader: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, settings
    Dim text As String, i As Long
    text = reader.LoadCase & "|" & reader.stateType & "|" & reader.lengthUnit & "|" & reader.ResultUnit
    For i = 1 To reader.count
        text = text & vbLf & reader.ElementID(i) & "|" & TestSnapshotDouble(reader.X(i)) & "|" & TestSnapshotDouble(reader.Y(i)) & "|" & _
            TestSnapshotDouble(reader.area(i)) & "|" & TestSnapshotDouble(reader.ResultValue(i)) & "|" & reader.PhysicalState(i)
    Next i
    TestSnapshotPlot = text
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет, что LC-зависимые поля не остались в общей геометрической таблице.
Private Function TestSnapshotCommonOnly(ByVal values As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To UBound(values, 1)
        If CStr(values(i, 2)) <> "ALL" Then Exit Function
        If CStr(values(i, 3)) = "LoadReferenceX" Or CStr(values(i, 3)) = "LoadReferenceY" Or InStr(1, CStr(values(i, 3)), "SP35.Slenderness", vbBinaryCompare) = 1 Then Exit Function
    Next i
    TestSnapshotCommonOnly = True
End Function

End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Устанавливает настройку в частном fixture по ключу и реальному именованному диапазону.
Private Sub TestSnapshotSetting(ByVal key As String, ByVal value As String)
    Dim table As Object, field As String, column As Long: field = key: column = 2
    If left$(key, 6) = "Units." Then
        Set table = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
        field = split(key, ".")(1): column = 4
    Else
        Set table = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    End If
    Dim values As Variant: values = table.value2
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To UBound(values, 1)
        If CStr(values(i, 1)) = field Then table.cells(i, column).value2 = value: Exit Sub
    Next i
    Err.Raise 5, , "Не найдена тестовая настройка: " & key
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет неизменённые исходные числа, включая малые моменты и ошибочную строку.
Private Sub TestSnapshotOriginalLoadMemory()
    Dim batch As CBatchSectionCalculator: Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator
    batch.AddCombination "RAW", -123.456, 1E-20, -2E-20, "PR1", "Исходные числа"
    batch.AddInvalidCombination "BAD", "PR1", "Ошибка", "Некорректная нагрузка"
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.original.available", batch.OriginalLoadsAvailable(1)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.original.force", TestSnapshotDouble(batch.OriginalN(1)) = TestSnapshotDouble(-123.456)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.original.tinyMx", TestSnapshotDouble(batch.OriginalMx(1)) = TestSnapshotDouble(1E-20)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.original.tinyMy", TestSnapshotDouble(batch.OriginalMy(1)) = TestSnapshotDouble(-2E-20)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.invalid.notInvented", Not batch.OriginalLoadsAvailable(2)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает новые исходные числа с фактическим вводом, а рабочие — с таблицей устойчивости.
' Строка worst обязана принадлежать тому же LC, что указан в самом верху снимка.
Private Sub TestSnapshotSummaryLoads(ByVal snapshot As CCalculationSnapshot)
    Dim data As Variant: data = snapshot.table("Summary")
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.width", UBound(data, 2) = 33
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.title", CStr(data(6, 28)) = "Нагрузки в точке приложения"
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.lineBreak", InStr(CStr(data(8, 31)), vbLf & "(если применимо)") > 0
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.originalMxComment", CStr(data(11, 29)) = "Исходный изгибающий момент Mx"
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.originalMyComment", CStr(data(11, 30)) = "Исходный изгибающий момент My"
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.forceNoEta", InStr(CStr(data(11, 31)), ChrW$(&H3B7)) = 0
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.momentsEta", InStr(CStr(data(11, 32)), ChrW$(&H3B7)) > 0
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.workingMxComment", CStr(data(11, 32)) = "Изгибающий момент Mx с учётом " & ChrW$(&H3B7) & " от продольного изгиба (если применимо)"
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.workingMyComment", CStr(data(11, 33)) = "Изгибающий момент My с учётом " & ChrW$(&H3B7) & " от продольного изгиба (если применимо)"
    Dim anchor As Object: Set anchor = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngBatchSummary").RefersToRange.cells(1, 1)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.workingMxSeparate", Not CBool(anchor.cells(11, 32).MergeCells)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.workingMySeparate", Not CBool(anchor.cells(11, 33).MergeCells)
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader: Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Dim units As CUnitSystem: Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.forceUnit", CStr(data(10, 28)) = "N, " & units.OutputForceUnit
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.momentUnit", CStr(data(10, 29)) = "Mx, " & units.OutputMomentUnit
    Dim loads As Variant: loads = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange.value2
    Dim stable As Variant: stable = snapshot.table("Stability.Data")
    Dim row As Long, inputRow As Long, stableRow As Long, column As Long, expected As Double
    For row = 13 To UBound(data, 1)
        If Len(CStr(data(row, 1))) = 0 Then GoTo NextSummaryLoad
        For inputRow = 2 To UBound(loads, 1)
            If CStr(loads(inputRow, 1)) = CStr(data(row, 1)) Then Exit For
        Next inputRow
        If inputRow > UBound(loads, 1) Then Err.Raise 5, , "Ввод тестового сочетания не найден."
        expected = units.InternalForceToOutput(units.InputForceToInternal(CDbl(loads(inputRow, 2))))
        TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.originalN." & CStr(row), TestSnapshotDouble(data(row, 28)) = TestSnapshotDouble(expected)
        expected = units.InternalMomentMxToOutput(units.InputMomentMxToInternal(CDbl(loads(inputRow, 3))))
        TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.originalMx." & CStr(row), TestSnapshotDouble(data(row, 29)) = TestSnapshotDouble(expected)
        expected = units.InternalMomentMyToOutput(units.InputMomentMyToInternal(CDbl(loads(inputRow, 4))))
        TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.originalMy." & CStr(row), TestSnapshotDouble(data(row, 30)) = TestSnapshotDouble(expected)
        For stableRow = 1 To UBound(stable, 1)
            If CStr(stable(stableRow, 1)) = CStr(data(row, 1)) And CStr(stable(stableRow, 3)) = "OK" Then
                For column = 0 To 2
                    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.afterStability." & CStr(row) & "." & CStr(column), TestSnapshotDouble(data(row, 31 + column)) = TestSnapshotDouble(stable(stableRow, 12 + column))
                Next column
            End If
        Next stableRow
        If CStr(data(row, 1)) = CStr(data(1, 1)) Then
            For column = 28 To 33
                TestSnapshotCheck "loads.summary.worst." & CStr(column), TestSnapshotDouble(data(12, column)) = TestSnapshotDouble(data(row, column))
            Next column
        End If
NextSummaryLoad:
    Next row
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Читает прежнюю 26-колоночную сводку без подстановки текущих нагрузок Config.
Private Sub TestSnapshotLegacySummary(ByVal original As CCalculationSnapshot)
    Dim sample As CCalculationSnapshot: Set sample = New CCalculationSnapshot
    sample.runID = original.runID: sample.ElapsedSeconds = original.ElapsedSeconds
    Dim key As Variant, saved As Variant, data() As Variant, row As Long, column As Long
    For Each key In original.keys()
        saved = original.table(CStr(key))
        If CStr(key) = "Summary" Then
            ReDim data(1 To UBound(saved, 1), 1 To 26)
            For row = 1 To UBound(saved, 1)
                For column = 1 To 26: data(row, column) = saved(row, column): Next column
            Next row
            sample.AddTable CStr(key), data
        Else
            sample.AddTable CStr(key), saved
        End If
    Next key
    sample.Validate
    Dim writer As CBatchResultWriter: Set writer = New CBatchResultWriter
    writer.RestoreSummary ThisWorkbook, sample
    Dim target As Object: Set target = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngBatchSummary").RefersToRange.cells(1, 1)
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.legacy.explicitMissing", CStr(target.cells(11, 28).value2) = "Не сохранено в этом снимке"
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.legacy.noCurrentInput", Application.CountA(target.offset(11, 27).Resize(31, 6)) = 0
    saved = original.table("Summary")
    TestSnapshotCheck "loads.legacy.keepsWorst", CStr(target.cells(1, 1).value2) = CStr(saved(1, 1))
    writer.RestoreSummary ThisWorkbook, original
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет заданный горизонтальный порядок, не фиксируя адреса верхних таблиц.
Private Function TestSnapshotLowerOrder() As Boolean
    Dim name As Variant, last As Long, column As Long
    For Each name In Array("rngNDMSectionGeometry", "rngNDMSectionProperties", "rngNDMMaterialDiagrams", "rngNDMElementResults", "rngNDMSectionContours", "rngNDMSectionAnnotations")
        column = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(name)).RefersToRange.column
        If column <= last Then Exit Function
        last = column
    Next name
    TestSnapshotLowerOrder = True
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохраняет компактный итог; успешные числа отдельных ячеек не раздувают журнал.
Private Sub TestSnapshotCheck(ByVal label As String, ByVal value As Boolean)
    If value Then mTestPassed = mTestPassed + 1 Else mTestFailed = mTestFailed + 1
    mTestReport = mTestReport & IIf(value, "PASS ", "FAIL ") & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Линейные материалы позволяют получить точное равновесие при заведомом
' превышении физической деформации, без эвристической оценки несущей.
Private Sub TestUltimateInitialPhysicalRejection(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, strategy As Variant, cap As CCapacitySolver
    Dim request As CLimitSearchRequest, result As CLimitSearchResult, coordinator As CLimitSearchCoordinator
    Dim forceOnly As Variant, prefix As String, nBase As Double, mxOffset As Double, mxBase As Double
    Set section = New CSectionModel
    section.AddConcreteElement -100#, -100#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement 100#, -100#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement -100#, 100#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement 100#, 100#, 10000#
    section.AddRebarElement -80#, -80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
    section.AddRebarElement 80#, 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
    For Each forceOnly In Array(False, True)
    For Each strategy In Array("Auto", "UltimateStrain", "LoadMultiplier")
        nBase = 0#: mxOffset = 0#: mxBase = 1000000#
        If CBool(forceOnly) Then nBase = 100000#: mxOffset = 1000000#: mxBase = 0#
        prefix = "overload.initial." & CStr(strategy) & ".forceOnly=" & CStr(forceOnly)
        Set cap = New CCapacitySolver: TestConfigureCapacity cap
        Set request = New CLimitSearchRequest
        InitializeCapacitySearchRequest request, cap, section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), CStr(strategy), _
            -10000000#, nBase, mxOffset, mxBase, 0#, 0#, CBool(forceOnly), False
        Set coordinator = New CLimitSearchCoordinator
        ResetSectionEquilibriumSolveCount
        Set result = coordinator.ExecuteCapacity(request)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".baseFailure", result.meta.resultCode = rcInitialStateBeyondLimit
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notNumericalFailure", result.meta.internalStatus = rsCheckFailed
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".noInventedLimit", Not result.HasLimitPoint
        TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".zeroLambda", result.LambdaUltimate, 0#, 0#
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".equilibriumChecked", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = 1
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".noUltimateIterations", UltimateStrainIterationCount() = 0
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".reason", Len(result.meta.resultComment) > 0
    Next strategy
    Next forceOnly
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Неподтвержденное равновесие при нагрузке выше плато без продолжения
' не разрешает объявить физический отказ. UltimateStrain вправе искать предел.
Private Sub TestUltimateInitialNumericalFailure(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, cap As CCapacitySolver, request As CLimitSearchRequest, path As CLoadPathVector
    Dim value As Double, state As String, solver As CSectionSolver
    Set section = New CSectionModel
    section.AddConcreteElement -100#, -100#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement 100#, -100#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement -100#, 100#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement 100#, 100#, 10000#
    Set cap = New CCapacitySolver: TestConfigureCapacity cap
    cap.SolverMaxIterations = 1
    cap.MaxRetries = 3
    Set request = New CLimitSearchRequest
    InitializeCapacitySearchRequest request, cap, section, TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), "UltimateStrain", _
        -1000000#, 0#, 0#, 1000000#, 0#, 0#, False, False
    Set path = New CLoadPathVector: path.Initialize -1000000#, 0#, 0#, 1000000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.fixturePrepared", request.problem.Prepare(request)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.fixtureEvaluated", _
        request.problem.EvaluatePoint(request, path, Nothing, 0#, value, state, solver)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.fixtureReallyFailed", request.problem.IsNumericalFailureState(state)
    ResetSectionEquilibriumSolveCount
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.searchStillAllowed", request.problem.PrepareUltimate(request, path)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.notPhysicalFailure", Not cap.LimitSearchInitialLambdaRejected
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.noRepeatedPreflight", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "overload.initial.numerical.noInventedLimit", Not cap.Converged
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' стартовая плоскость внутри физических пределов, включая перенос на 1000 м.
Public Function RunLimitGuessScalingTests() As String
    Dim stats As TCapacityTestStats
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim section As CSectionModel, frame As CSectionNumericalFrame, builder As CStateGuessBuilder
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver, limits As CSectionStrainLimits, shift As Variant, multiplier As Variant
    Dim eps0 As Double, kx As Double, ky As Double, Utilization As Double, prefix As String
    For Each shift In Array(0#, 1000000#, -1000000#)
        Set section = New CSectionModel
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) - 100#, -CDbl(shift) - 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) + 100#, -CDbl(shift) + 100#, 10000#
        section.AddRebarElement CDbl(shift) - 80#, -CDbl(shift) - 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
        section.AddRebarElement CDbl(shift) + 80#, -CDbl(shift) + 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
        Set frame = New CSectionNumericalFrame: frame.Initialize section
        Set builder = New CStateGuessBuilder: Set solver = New CSectionSolver
        Set limits = New CSectionStrainLimits
        limits.Configure -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.001, 0.0025
        For Each multiplier In Array(1#, 1000000#)
            kx = CDbl(multiplier) * 0.00001: ky = CDbl(multiplier) * -0.000006
            eps0 = frame.OriginalStrain(-CDbl(multiplier) * 0.004, kx, ky)
            solver.EvaluatePhysicalStrainPlane section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), eps0, kx, ky
            limits.Evaluate section, solver: Utilization = limits.Utilization
            builder.ScaleToPhysicalLimit section, Utilization, eps0, kx, ky
            solver.EvaluatePhysicalStrainPlane section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), eps0, kx, ky
            limits.Evaluate section, solver
            prefix = "limitGuess." & CStr(shift) & "." & CStr(multiplier)
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".ratio", limits.Utilization, 0.9, 0.000000001
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".center", frame.centerStrain(eps0, kx, ky), _
                -CDbl(multiplier) * 0.004 * 0.9 / Utilization, 0.00000000001
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".kx", kx, CDbl(multiplier) * 0.00001 * 0.9 / Utilization, 0.000000000001
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".ky", ky, CDbl(multiplier) * -0.000006 * 0.9 / Utilization, 0.000000000001
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".coordinates", section.concreteX(1), CDbl(shift) - 100#, 0#
        Next multiplier
        eps0 = 0.0002: kx = 0.000001: ky = -0.000003
        builder.ScaleToPhysicalLimit section, 0#, eps0, kx, ky
        TestAssertClose stats, "limitGuess.zero." & CStr(shift), eps0, 0.0002, 0#
    Next shift
    TestCapacityInitialPlaneBounds stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_LIMIT_GUESS_SCALING: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunLimitGuessScalingTests = stats.report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    RunLimitGuessScalingTests = stats.report & "RUNTIME ERROR: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Старт моментного и общего пути не уходит за физические пределы даже при
' большой перегрузке. Готовое НДС сохраняется дословно, без изменения пути.
Private Sub TestCapacityInitialPlaneBounds(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, frame As CSectionNumericalFrame, shift As Variant, n As Variant, mode As Variant
    Dim cap As CCapacitySolver, path As CLoadPathVector, concrete As Object, steel As Object
    Dim limits As CSectionStrainLimits, initialState As CSectionSolver, supplied As CSectionSolver
    Dim eps0 As Double, kx As Double, ky As Double, prefix As String
    Set concrete = TestLinearConcrete(): Set steel = TestLinearSteel()
    For Each shift In Array(0#, 1000000#, -1000000#)
        Set section = New CSectionModel
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) - 100#, -CDbl(shift) - 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) + 100#, -CDbl(shift) - 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) - 100#, -CDbl(shift) + 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) + 100#, -CDbl(shift) + 100#, 10000#
        section.AddRebarElement CDbl(shift) - 80#, -CDbl(shift) - 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
        section.AddRebarElement CDbl(shift) + 80#, -CDbl(shift) + 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
        Set frame = New CSectionNumericalFrame: frame.Initialize section
        For Each n In Array(-100000#, -1000000000000#, 1000000000000#)
            For Each mode In Array("Moment", "All")
                Set cap = New CCapacitySolver: TestConfigureCapacity cap
                cap.ConcreteTensionLimitEnabled = True: cap.ConcreteTensionLimit = 0.00015
                cap.SteelCompressionLimit = 0.001: cap.SteelTensionLimit = 0.0025
                Set path = New CLoadPathVector
                If CStr(mode) = "Moment" Then
                    path.Initialize CDbl(n), 0#, CDbl(n) * frame.originY, 10000000#, _
                        CDbl(n) * frame.originX, -3000000#
                Else
                    path.Initialize 0#, CDbl(n), 0#, CDbl(n) * frame.originY + 10000000#, _
                        0#, CDbl(n) * frame.originX - 3000000#
                End If
                prefix = "capacityInitialBounds." & CStr(shift) & "." & CStr(n) & "." & CStr(mode)
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".prepared", cap.LimitSearchPrepareCapacityUltimate(section, concrete, steel, path)
                cap.LimitSearchInitializeUltimateGuess section, concrete, steel, path, Nothing, eps0, kx, ky
                Set initialState = New CSectionSolver
                initialState.EvaluatePhysicalStrainPlane section, concrete, steel, eps0, kx, ky
                Set limits = New CSectionStrainLimits
                limits.Configure -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.001, 0.0025, True
                limits.Evaluate section, initialState
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".physical", limits.Utilization <= 1.000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".Nunchanged", path.targetN(1#), CDbl(n), 0#
                Set supplied = New CSectionSolver
                supplied.SetInitialState frame.OriginalStrain(-0.008, 0.000001, -0.000002), 0.000001, -0.000002
                cap.LimitSearchInitializeUltimateGuess section, concrete, steel, path, supplied, eps0, kx, ky
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".suppliedEps", eps0, supplied.Epsilon0, 0#
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".suppliedKx", kx, supplied.KappaX, 0#
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".suppliedKy", ky, supplied.KappaY, 0#
            Next mode
        Next n
    Next shift
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Осевая стратегия не зависит от положения чертежа; реальные моменты
' и постоянная часть траектории не должны ошибочно считаться чистым N.
Private Sub TestCenteredAxialPathClassification(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, frame As CSectionNumericalFrame, shift As Variant
    Dim n As Double, mX As Double, mY As Double, prefix As String
    For Each shift In Array(0#, 1000000#, -1000000#)
        Set section = New CSectionModel
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) - 50#, CDbl(shift) - 100#, 100#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) + 50#, CDbl(shift) + 100#, 100#
        Set frame = New CSectionNumericalFrame: frame.Initialize section
        n = -1000000#: mX = n * frame.originY: mY = n * frame.originX
        prefix = "centeredAxial." & CStr(shift)
        Dim math As CLoadPathMath
        Set math = New CLoadPathMath
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".pureN", math.IsPureAxialLoadPath(0#, n, 0#, mX, 0#, mY, frame.originX, frame.originY)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".Mx", Not math.IsPureAxialLoadPath(0#, n, 0#, mX + 1#, 0#, mY, frame.originX, frame.originY)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".My", Not math.IsPureAxialLoadPath(0#, n, 0#, mX, 0#, mY - 1#, frame.originX, frame.originY)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".constantMoment", Not math.IsPureAxialLoadPath(0#, n, 1#, mX, 0#, mY, frame.originX, frame.originY)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".constantN", Not math.IsPureAxialLoadPath(-1#, n, -frame.originY, mX, -frame.originX, mY, frame.originX, frame.originY)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".emptyBase", Not math.IsPureAxialLoadPath(0#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#, frame.originX, frame.originY)
    Next shift
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Раздельно проверяет четыре ограничения, отключенную растянутую ветвь,
' разные пределы стали и неизменность критерия при переносе координат.
Private Sub TestCommonStrainLimits(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, solver As CSectionSolver, limits As CSectionStrainLimits
    Dim shift As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, state As String, expected As Double
    Dim strain As Double, Utilization As Double, criticalStrain As Double, element As String
    Dim enabled As Variant, plane As Variant, planes As Variant, prefix As String
    Set limits = New CSectionStrainLimits
    planes = Array(Array(0#, 0#, 0#), Array(-0.001, 0#, 0#), Array(0.0001, 0#, 0#), _
        Array(-0.0002, 0.000007, -0.000002), Array(0.0001, -0.000004, 0.000006))
    For Each shift In Array(0#, 1000000#, -1000000#)
        Set section = New CSectionModel
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) - 100#, CDbl(shift) / 2# - 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) + 100#, CDbl(shift) / 2# - 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) - 100#, CDbl(shift) / 2# + 100#, 10000#
        section.AddConcreteElement CDbl(shift) + 100#, CDbl(shift) / 2# + 100#, 10000#
        section.AddRebarElement CDbl(shift) - 80#, CDbl(shift) / 2# - 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
        section.AddRebarElement CDbl(shift) + 80#, CDbl(shift) / 2# + 80#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
        Set solver = New CSectionSolver
        For Each enabled In Array(False, True)
            j = 0
            For Each plane In planes
                j = j + 1
                solver.EvaluatePhysicalCenterPlane section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), _
                    CDbl(plane(0)), CDbl(plane(1)), CDbl(plane(2))
                limits.Configure -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.001, 0.0025, CBool(enabled)
                limits.Evaluate section, solver
                Utilization = 0#: criticalStrain = 0#: element = vbNullString: state = "NumericalFailure"
                ' Независимый тестовый oracle: прямой перебор по известным пределам.
                For i = 1 To section.ConcreteCount
                    strain = solver.StrainAt(section.concreteX(i), section.concreteY(i))
                    expected = 0#
                    If strain < 0# Then expected = strain / -0.0035
                    If strain > 0# And CBool(enabled) Then expected = strain / 0.00015
                    If expected > Utilization Then
                        Utilization = expected: criticalStrain = strain
                        element = section.ConcreteID(i)
                        If strain < 0# Then
                            element = element & ":Compression": state = "ConcreteStrainLimit"
                        Else
                            element = element & ":Tension": state = "ConcreteTensionStrainLimit"
                        End If
                    End If
                Next i
                For i = 1 To section.RebarCount
                    strain = solver.StrainAt(section.RebarX(i), section.RebarY(i))
                    If strain < 0# Then expected = Abs(strain) / 0.001 Else expected = strain / 0.0025
                    If expected > Utilization Then
                        Utilization = expected: criticalStrain = strain
                        element = section.RebarID(i) & ":Steel": state = "SteelStrainLimit"
                    End If
                Next i
                prefix = "commonLimits." & CStr(shift) & "." & CStr(enabled) & "." & CStr(j)
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".ratio", limits.Utilization, Utilization, 0#
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".strain", limits.criticalStrain, criticalStrain, 0#
                TestAssertEquals stats, prefix & ".element", limits.CriticalElement, element
                TestAssertEquals stats, prefix & ".state", limits.limitState, state
            Next plane
        Next enabled
        TestAssertCommonLimitCase stats, "compressionConcrete." & CStr(shift), section, -0.0035, _
            -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.025, 0.025, True, "ConcreteStrainLimit", "сжатие бетона"
        TestAssertCommonLimitCase stats, "tensionConcrete." & CStr(shift), section, 0.00015, _
            -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.025, 0.025, True, "ConcreteTensionStrainLimit", "растяжение бетона"
        TestAssertCommonLimitCase stats, "compressionSteel." & CStr(shift), section, -0.001, _
            -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.001, 0.0025, True, "SteelStrainLimit", "сжатие арматуры"
        TestAssertCommonLimitCase stats, "tensionSteel." & CStr(shift), section, 0.0025, _
            -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.001, 0.0025, False, "SteelStrainLimit", "растяжение арматуры"
        TestAssertCommonLimitCase stats, "tieConcreteFirst." & CStr(shift), section, -0.0035, _
            -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.0035, 0.025, True, "ConcreteStrainLimit", "сжатие бетона"
    Next shift
    TestStrainExtremaOwnership stats
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет принадлежность кэша экстремальных деформаций модели и её ревизии, выбор первого элемента при равенстве и полный поиск при потере точности.
Private Sub TestStrainExtremaOwnership(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, foreign As CSectionModel, solver As CSectionSolver
    Dim limits As CSectionStrainLimits, cMin As Double, cMax As Double, sMin As Double, sMax As Double
    Dim cMinIndex As Long, cMaxIndex As Long, sMinIndex As Long, sMaxIndex As Long
    Set section = New CSectionModel: Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    section.AddConcreteElement 100#, 0#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement -100#, 0#, 10000#
    section.AddRebarElement 80#, 0#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
    section.AddRebarElement -80#, 0#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
    solver.EvaluatePhysicalCenterPlane section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), 0#, 0#, 0.00001
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainExtrema.current", solver.TryGetStrainExtrema(section, cMin, cMax, _
        cMinIndex, cMaxIndex, sMin, sMax, sMinIndex, sMaxIndex)
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainExtrema.concreteMinIndex", CDbl(cMinIndex), 2#, 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainExtrema.concreteMaxIndex", CDbl(cMaxIndex), 1#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainBounds.current", solver.TryGetConcreteStrainBounds(section, cMin, cMax)
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainBounds.minimum", cMin, solver.StrainAt(-100#, 0#), 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainBounds.maximum", cMax, solver.StrainAt(100#, 0#), 0#
    Set limits = New CSectionStrainLimits
    limits.Configure -0.001, 0.001, 0.025, 0.025, True
    limits.Evaluate section, solver
    TestAssertEquals stats, "strainExtrema.tie.firstConcrete", limits.CriticalElement, section.ConcreteID(1) & ":Tension"
    limits.Configure -0.0035, 0.00015, 0.0008, 0.0008, False
    limits.Evaluate section, solver
    TestAssertEquals stats, "strainExtrema.tie.firstSteel", limits.CriticalElement, section.RebarID(1) & ":Steel"
    TestAssertEquals stats, "strainExtrema.tie.firstSteelDirection", limits.description, "растяжение арматуры"

    Set foreign = New CSectionModel
    foreign.AddConcreteElement 100#, 0#, 10000#
    foreign.AddConcreteElement -100#, 0#, 10000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainExtrema.foreign", Not solver.TryGetStrainExtrema(foreign, cMin, cMax, _
        cMinIndex, cMaxIndex, sMin, sMax, sMinIndex, sMaxIndex)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainBounds.foreign", Not solver.TryGetConcreteStrainBounds(foreign, cMin, cMax)
    section.AddRebarElement 200#, 0#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainExtrema.revision", Not solver.TryGetStrainExtrema(section, cMin, cMax, _
        cMinIndex, cMaxIndex, sMin, sMax, sMinIndex, sMaxIndex)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainBounds.revision", Not solver.TryGetConcreteStrainBounds(section, cMin, cMax)
    limits.Evaluate section, solver
    TestAssertEquals stats, "strainExtrema.revision.fullScan", limits.CriticalElement, section.RebarID(3) & ":Steel"
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainExtrema.revision.ratio", limits.Utilization, 2.5, 0#
    solver.ClearResult
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainExtrema.cleared", Not solver.TryGetStrainExtrema(section, cMin, cMax, _
        cMinIndex, cMaxIndex, sMin, sMax, sMinIndex, sMaxIndex)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainBounds.cleared", Not solver.TryGetConcreteStrainBounds(section, cMin, cMax)
    solver.EvaluatePhysicalCenterPlane section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), 0.001, 0#, 5E-21 ' Вклад кривизны теряется рядом с epsilon0: кэш значений допустим, но индексы экстремумов требуют полного поиска.
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainExtrema.rounding.fullScan", Not solver.TryGetStrainExtrema(section, cMin, cMax, _
        cMinIndex, cMaxIndex, sMin, sMax, sMinIndex, sMaxIndex)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "strainBounds.rounding.valuesAvailable", solver.TryGetConcreteStrainBounds(section, cMin, cMax)
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainBounds.rounding.minimum", cMin, solver.minConcreteStrain, 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, "strainBounds.rounding.maximum", cMax, solver.maxConcreteStrain, 0#
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет заданный деформационный предел на однородной плоскости: коэффициент использования, вид предела и понятное описание.
Private Sub TestAssertCommonLimitCase(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats, ByVal name As String, _
        ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal strain As Double, ByVal concreteCompression As Double, _
        ByVal concreteTension As Double, ByVal steelCompression As Double, ByVal steelTension As Double, _
        ByVal tensionEnabled As Boolean, ByVal state As String, ByVal description As String)
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver, limits As CSectionStrainLimits
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver: Set limits = New CSectionStrainLimits
    solver.EvaluatePhysicalCenterPlane section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), strain, 0#, 0#
    limits.Configure concreteCompression, concreteTension, steelCompression, steelTension, tensionEnabled
    limits.Evaluate section, solver
    TestAssertClose stats, name & ".ratio", limits.Utilization, 1#, 0.000000000001
    TestAssertEquals stats, name & ".state", limits.limitState, state
    TestAssertEquals stats, name & ".description", limits.description, description
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Интерфейс и его запрос не должны зависеть от реализующих интерфейс классов.
' Проверяем обе реализации и передачу готового критерия через общую фабрику.
Private Sub TestLimitSearchAdapterInterfaces(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim capacity As CCapacitySolver, formation As CCrackFormationCalculator
    Dim capacityProblem As CCapacityLimitSearchProblem, formationProblem As CCrackLimitSearchProblem
    Dim callback As ILimitSearchProblem, section As CSectionModel, request As CLimitSearchRequest
    Set capacity = New CCapacitySolver
    Set formation = New CCrackFormationCalculator
    Set capacityProblem = New CCapacityLimitSearchProblem
    Set formationProblem = New CCrackLimitSearchProblem
    capacityProblem.Initialize capacity
    formationProblem.Initialize formation
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.capacity.supports", TypeOf capacityProblem Is ILimitSearchProblem
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.formation.supports", TypeOf formationProblem Is ILimitSearchProblem
    If Not TypeOf capacityProblem Is ILimitSearchProblem Then Exit Sub
    If Not TypeOf formationProblem Is ILimitSearchProblem Then Exit Sub
    Set callback = capacityProblem
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.capacity.cast", callback.resultKind = rkCapacity
    Set callback = formationProblem
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.formation.cast", callback.resultKind = rkCrackFormation
    Set section = New CSectionModel
    section.AddConcreteElement 0#, 0#, 10000#
    Set request = New CLimitSearchRequest
    InitializeCapacitySearchRequest request, capacity, section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), _
        "LoadMultiplier", 0#, -100#, 0#, 20#, 0#, 30#, False, False
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.capacity.requestKind", request.problem.resultKind = rkCapacity
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.capacity.requestSection", request.section Is section
    Set request = New CLimitSearchRequest
    InitializeCrackFormationSearchRequest request, formation, section, TestLinearConcrete(), TestLinearSteel(), _
        "Auto", "LambdaMxy", -100#, 20#, 30#, 20#, 30#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.formation.requestKind", request.problem.resultKind = rkCrackFormation
    TestAssertTrue stats, "limitInterface.formation.requestSection", request.section Is section
    TestAssertClose stats, "limitInterface.formation.targetMx", request.targetMx, 20#, 0#
    TestAssertEquals stats, "limitInterface.formation.path", request.CrackFormationPath, "LambdaMxy"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строгий абсолютный допуск не должен ослабляться скрытым относительным минимумом.
Private Sub TestUltimateStrainToleranceNoHiddenFloor(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, cap As CCapacitySolver, path As CLoadPathVector
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver, r1 As Double, r2 As Double, rLimit As Double
    Dim lambdaValue As Double, state As String
    Set section = New CSectionModel
    section.AddConcreteElement 0#, 0#, 10000#
    Set cap = New CCapacitySolver
    cap.ConcreteCompressionLimit = -0.0035
    cap.StrainTolerance = 0.000000001
    Set path = New CLoadPathVector
    path.Initialize 0#, -100000#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "ultimateTolerance.physicalCriterion", _
        cap.LimitSearchEvaluateUltimateResidual(section, TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), _
            path, -0.0035, 0#, 0#, solver, r1, r2, rLimit, lambdaValue, state)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "ultimateTolerance.rejectAboveAbsolute", _
        Not cap.LimitSearchUltimateResidualReached(0#, 0#, 0.0000005)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "ultimateTolerance.acceptBelowAbsolute", _
        cap.LimitSearchUltimateResidualReached(0#, 0#, 0.00000025)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Смена изменяемого пути, ревизии геометрии или допуска не переиспользует
' прежний численный контекст; отдельная оценка совпадает с новым calculator-ом.
Private Sub TestUltimateNumericalContextCache(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, cap As CCapacitySolver, fresh As CCapacitySolver, path As CLoadPathVector
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver, reference As CSectionSolver, phase As Long, prefix As String
    Dim r1 As Double, r2 As Double, r3 As Double, lambda As Double, state As String
    Dim s1 As Double, s2 As Double, s3 As Double, expected As Double, referenceState As String
    Set section = New CSectionModel
    section.AddConcreteElement -25#, -20#, 10000#
    section.AddConcreteElement 25#, 20#, 10000#
    Set cap = New CCapacitySolver: Set path = New CLoadPathVector
    path.Initialize 0#, -100000#, 100#, 30#, -200#, 20#
    For phase = 1 To 4
        If phase = 2 Then path.Initialize 700#, -200000#, -500#, 60#, 300#, -40#
        If phase = 3 Then section.AddConcreteElement 70#, -30#, 5000#
        If phase = 4 Then
            cap.SolverToleranceN = 0.001: cap.SolverToleranceMx = 0.01: cap.SolverToleranceMy = 0.02
        End If
        Set fresh = New CCapacitySolver
        If phase = 4 Then
            fresh.SolverToleranceN = 0.001: fresh.SolverToleranceMx = 0.01: fresh.SolverToleranceMy = 0.02
        End If
        prefix = "ultimateContext." & CStr(phase)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".warm", cap.LimitSearchEvaluateUltimateResidual(section, _
            TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), path, -0.003, 0.000003, -0.000002, solver, r1, r2, r3, lambda, state)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".cold", fresh.LimitSearchEvaluateUltimateResidual(section, _
            TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), path, -0.003, 0.000003, -0.000002, reference, s1, s2, s3, expected, referenceState)
        TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".lambda", lambda, expected, 0#
        TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".path1", r1, s1, 0#
        TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".path2", r2, s2, 0#
        TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".limit", r3, s3, 0#
        TestAssertEquals stats, prefix & ".state", state, referenceState
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".tolerance", _
            cap.LimitSearchUltimateResidualReached(0.00000001, 0#, 0#) = _
            fresh.LimitSearchUltimateResidualReached(0.00000001, 0#, 0#)
    Next phase
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' общая подготовка сверяется с независимым явным переносом,
' включая изменение каждого поля пути, модели, допуска и способа нормировки.
Public Function RunNumericalPathPreparationTests() As String
    Dim stats As TCapacityTestStats

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает подготовленный численный путь с заново вычисленным переносом и масштабированием после изменения каждого значимого входа.
Private Sub TestNumericalPathPreparation(ByRef stats As TCapacityTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, other As CSectionModel, path As CLoadPathVector, transferred As CLoadPathVector
    Dim cached As CLoadPathMath, oracle As CLoadPathMath, frame As CSectionNumericalFrame, solver As CSectionSolver
    Dim mode As Variant, phase As Long, i As Long, commonScale As Boolean, values(1 To 6) As Double
    Dim tn As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, n As Double, mX As Double, mY As Double, forceScale As Double
    Dim actualLambda As Double, actual1 As Double, actual2 As Double, expectedLambda As Double, expected1 As Double, expected2 As Double
    Dim prefix As String, expectedTolerance As Double
    For Each mode In Array(False, True)
        Set section = New CSectionModel: Set other = New CSectionModel
        section.AddConcreteElement 1000100#, -999900#, 2500#
        section.AddConcreteElement 999900#, -1000100#, 2500#
        section.AddConcreteElement 1000100#, -1000100#, 2500#
        other.AddConcreteElement -2000200#, 1999900#, 2300#
        other.AddConcreteElement -1999900#, 2000100#, 2700#
        other.AddConcreteElement -2000100#, 2000150#, 2600#
        section.AddRebarElement 1000000#, -1000000#, 22#, 0#, "A400"
        other.AddRebarElement -2000000#, 2000000#, 28#, 0#, "A400"
        values(1) = -2000#: values(2) = -20000#: values(3) = 2000000000#: values(4) = 20000000000#
        values(5) = -2000000000#: values(6) = -20000000000#
        tn = 0.001: tx = 200#: ty = 150#: commonScale = CBool(mode)
        Set path = New CLoadPathVector: Set cached = New CLoadPathMath
        For phase = 1 To 18
            Select Case phase
                Case 3: section.AddConcreteElement 1000000#, -1000075#, 1700#
                Case 4: Set section = other
                Case 5 To 10: values(phase - 4) = values(phase - 4) + 123.456 ' По очереди меняется каждая из шести компонент: смещение и база N, Mx, My.
                Case 11: tn = 0.007
                Case 12: tx = 345#
                Case 13: ty = 567#
                Case 14, 15: commonScale = Not commonScale
                Case 16: cached.Configure 77#, 88#, 99#
                Case 17: values(2) = 1E-20
            End Select
            path.Initialize values(1), values(2), values(3), values(4), values(5), values(6)
            Set frame = New CSectionNumericalFrame: frame.Initialize section
            Set transferred = New CLoadPathVector
            transferred.Initialize values(1), values(2), _
                frame.CenterMx(values(1), values(3)) / frame.lengthScale, frame.CenterMx(values(2), values(4)) / frame.lengthScale, _
                frame.CenterMy(values(1), values(5)) / frame.lengthScale, frame.CenterMy(values(2), values(6)) / frame.lengthScale
            forceScale = 1#
            For i = 1 To 6
                Select Case i
                    Case 1: n = transferred.nOffset
                    Case 2: n = transferred.nBase
                    Case 3: n = transferred.mxOffset
                    Case 4: n = transferred.mxBase
                    Case 5: n = transferred.myOffset
                    Case 6: n = transferred.myBase
                End Select
                If Abs(n) > forceScale Then forceScale = Abs(n)
            Next i
            Set oracle = New CLoadPathMath
            If commonScale Then oracle.Configure forceScale, forceScale, forceScale Else oracle.Configure tn, tx / frame.lengthScale, ty / frame.lengthScale
            Set solver = New CSectionSolver
            solver.EvaluatePhysicalCenterPlane section, TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -0.0006, 0.000001, -0.0000007
            solver.NumericalEfforts n, mX, mY
            mX = mX / frame.lengthScale: mY = mY / frame.lengthScale
            expectedLambda = oracle.lambda(n, mX, mY, transferred)
            If commonScale Then
                oracle.BuildResiduals n, mX, mY, transferred, expectedLambda, expected1, expected2, forceScale
            Else
                oracle.BuildResiduals n, mX, mY, transferred, expectedLambda, expected1, expected2
            End If
            cached.PrepareNumericalPath section, path, tn, tx, ty, commonScale
            cached.BuildNumericalResiduals solver, actualLambda, actual1, actual2
            prefix = "numericalPreparation." & CStr(mode) & "." & CStr(phase)
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".lambda", actualLambda, expectedLambda, 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".residual1", actual1, expected1, 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".residual2", actual2, expected2, 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".lambdaOnly", cached.NumericalLambda(solver), expectedLambda, 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".forceScale", cached.NumericalForceScale, forceScale, 0#
            expectedTolerance = tn
            If tx / frame.lengthScale < expectedTolerance Then expectedTolerance = tx / frame.lengthScale
            If ty / frame.lengthScale < expectedTolerance Then expectedTolerance = ty / frame.lengthScale
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".pathTolerance", cached.NumericalPathTolerance, _
                expectedTolerance / forceScale, 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".sourceNOffset", path.nOffset, values(1), 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".sourceNBase", path.nBase, values(2), 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".sourceMxOffset", path.mxOffset, values(3), 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".sourceMxBase", path.mxBase, values(4), 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".sourceMyOffset", path.myOffset, values(5), 0#
            TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".sourceMyBase", path.myBase, values(6), 0#
        Next phase
    Next mode
End Sub
