' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет отказ пути при разрыве, повторном имени, неверной дуге, незамкнутости, недопустимой длине или изменении после фиксации.
Private Function TestInvalidPathRejected(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath, edge As TRegionEdge, value As Double, X As Double, Y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Invalid"
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0
            path.AddLine "Duplicate", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.AddLine "Duplicate", 1#, 0#, 2#, 0#
        Case 1
            path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.AddLine "Disconnected", 2#, 0#, 3#, 0#
        Case 2: path.AddArc "NegativeRadius", 0#, 0#, -1#, 0#, 1#
        Case 3: path.AddArc "ZeroSweep", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#
        Case 4: path.AddArc "DoubleTurn", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 4# * GEOM_PI
        Case 5: path.AddLine "Open", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal True
        Case 6: value = path.length
        Case 7: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: path.AddLine "Late", 1#, 0#, 2#, 0#
        Case 8: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: path.AtDistance -1#, X, Y, tx, ty
        Case 9: path.Seal
        Case 10: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: Set part = path.Slice(0.5, 0.5)
        Case 11: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: path.ProjectionBounds 0#, 0#, X, Y
        Case 12: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: value = path.segmentIndex("Missing")
        Case 13: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.CopySegment 1, edge
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    TestInvalidPathRejected = (Err.source = "CGeometryPath" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5520)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает фактическую и ожидаемую величины с заданным в этом наборе допуском, сохраняя числа в протоколе.
Private Sub TestNear(ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    TestCheck name & "; actual=" & format$(actual, "0.000000000000000") & "; expected=" & format$(expected, "0.000000000000000"), _
        Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.0000001
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Учитывает отдельное условие проверки и сохраняет его имя в итоговом протоколе.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1: mReport = mReport & "PASS: " & name & vbCrLf
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub


====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: modTestDiscreteForces
TYPE: 1
LINES: 167
====================================================================================================
Option Explicit

' ==================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ ====================
' Полная прежняя сумма и групповой интеграл одной сетки, затем настоящий Newton.
' Диаграммы синтетические: проверяется алгоритм, а не нормативная калибровка.
Private Declare PtrSafe Function TestCounter Lib "kernel32" Alias "QueryPerformanceCounter" (ByRef value As Currency) As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function TestFrequency Lib "kernel32" Alias "QueryPerformanceFrequency" (ByRef value As Currency) As Long
Private mTestReport As String, mTestPassed As Long, mTestFailed As Long ' Сводный отчёт без построчного вывода миллионов сумм.

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет малые и целевые размеры, неоднородные площади, оба знака и узлы диаграммы.
Public Function RunDiscreteForceTests() As String
    mTestReport = "": mTestPassed = 0: mTestFailed = 0
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim size As Variant, section As CSectionModel, concrete As CMaterialDiagram, steel As CMaterialDiagram
    Dim frame As CSectionNumericalFrame, integrator As CDiscreteForceIntegrator
    Dim i As Long, angle As Double, eps As Double, kx As Double, ky As Double, n As Double, mX As Double, mY As Double
    Dim groupedN As Double, groupedMx As Double, groupedMy As Double, grossN As Double, grossMx As Double, grossMy As Double
    Dim started As Double, buildSeconds As Double, directSeconds As Double, fastSeconds As Double, error As Double, accepted As Boolean
    For Each size In Array(50, 500, 5000, 7500, 10000, 20000, 50000)
        Set section = TestBuildForceModel(CLng(size))
        TestForceDiagrams concrete, steel
        Set frame = New CSectionNumericalFrame: frame.Initialize section
        Set integrator = New CDiscreteForceIntegrator
        started = TestForceNow(): integrator.Initialize section, frame.originX, frame.originY: buildSeconds = TestForceNow() - started
        error = 0#: directSeconds = 0#: fastSeconds = 0#
        For i = 0 To 47
            angle = (i + 0.173) * 2.39996322972865
            eps = -0.0012 + 0.0018 * Sin(i * 0.31): kx = 0.000004 * Cos(angle): ky = 0.000004 * Sin(angle)
            If i = 0 Then eps = 0#: kx = 0#: ky = 0#
            If i = 1 Then eps = -0.0003: kx = 1E-22: ky = 0#
            started = TestForceNow()
            TestDirectForces section, concrete, frame.originX, frame.originY, eps, kx, ky, n, mX, mY, grossN, grossMx, grossMy
            directSeconds = directSeconds + TestForceNow() - started
            started = TestForceNow(): accepted = integrator.TryForces(concrete, eps, kx, ky, groupedN, groupedMx, groupedMy)
            fastSeconds = fastSeconds + TestForceNow() - started
            If accepted Then
                error = TestForceMax(error, Abs(n - groupedN) / TestForceMax(1#, grossN))
                error = TestForceMax(error, Abs(mX - groupedMx) / TestForceMax(1#, grossMx))
                error = TestForceMax(error, Abs(mY - groupedMy) / TestForceMax(1#, grossMy))
            Else
                TestForceCheck "nearKnot.directFallback." & CStr(size), i = 1
            End If
        Next i
        TestForceCheck "allForces." & CStr(size), error <= 0.0000000001
        mTestReport = mTestReport & "FORCE_BENCH|count=" & CStr(size) & "|queries=48|build=" & TestForceText(buildSeconds) & _
            "|directWithErrorScale=" & TestForceText(directSeconds) & "|grouped=" & TestForceText(fastSeconds) & "|maxScaledError=" & TestForceText(error) & vbCrLf
        TestNonlinearForceSolve section, concrete, steel, 1
        TestNonlinearForceSolve section, concrete, steel, 6
        section.AddConcreteElement 700#, 200#, 100#, 1
        TestForceCheck "revisionRejected." & CStr(size), Not integrator.matches(section.revision, frame.originX, frame.originY)
    Next size
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestForceCheck "force.runtime " & CStr(Err.number) & ": " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunDiscreteForceTests = mTestReport & "TOTAL DISCRETE FORCES: passed=" & CStr(mTestPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mTestFailed)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Использует настоящие solve с новой и прежней оценкой проб, включая холодную подготовку.
Private Sub TestNonlinearForceSolve(ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal concrete As CMaterialDiagram, ByVal steel As CMaterialDiagram, ByVal caseCount As Long)
    Dim oracle As CSectionSolver: Set oracle = New CSectionSolver
    Dim loads() As Double, j As Long: ReDim loads(1 To caseCount, 1 To 3)
    For j = 1 To caseCount
        oracle.EvaluateStrainPlane section, concrete, steel, -0.0004 + (j - 1) * 0.000015, 0.000001, -0.0000006
        loads(j, 1) = oracle.Nint: loads(j, 2) = oracle.Mxint: loads(j, 3) = oracle.Myint
    Next j
    Dim enabled As Variant, solver As CSectionSolver, direct As CSectionSolver, started As Double, seconds As Double
    Dim baselines As Collection: Set baselines = New Collection
    For Each enabled In Array(False, True)
        section.TestSetForceIntegrationEnabled CBool(enabled)
        section.BeginForceIntegrationRun caseCount
        seconds = 0#
        For j = 1 To caseCount
            Set solver = New CSectionSolver
            solver.loadSteps = 4: solver.maxIterations = 80
            solver.toleranceN = 0.001: solver.toleranceMx = 0.1: solver.toleranceMy = 0.1
            started = TestForceNow(): solver.solve section, concrete, steel, loads(j, 1), loads(j, 2), loads(j, 3): seconds = seconds + TestForceNow() - started
            TestForceCheck "solve.converged." & CStr(section.ConcreteCount) & "." & CStr(enabled) & "." & CStr(caseCount) & "." & CStr(j), solver.Converged
            If Not CBool(enabled) Then
                baselines.Add solver
            Else
                Set direct = baselines.item(j)
                TestForceCheck "solve.sameStatus." & CStr(section.ConcreteCount), solver.Converged = direct.Converged And solver.failureCode = direct.failureCode And solver.iterations = direct.iterations
                TestForceCheck "solve.sameEquilibrium." & CStr(section.ConcreteCount), Abs(solver.Nint - direct.Nint) <= 0.001 And Abs(solver.Mxint - direct.Mxint) <= 0.1 And Abs(solver.Myint - direct.Myint) <= 0.1
                TestForceCheck "solve.samePlane." & CStr(section.ConcreteCount), Abs(solver.Epsilon0 - direct.Epsilon0) <= 0.0000000001 And Abs(solver.KappaX - direct.KappaX) <= 0.000000000001 And Abs(solver.KappaY - direct.KappaY) <= 0.000000000001
            End If
        Next j
        mTestReport = mTestReport & "SOLVE_BENCH|count=" & CStr(section.ConcreteCount) & "|cases=" & CStr(caseCount) & "|fast=" & CStr(enabled) & "|seconds=" & TestForceText(seconds) & "|probes=" & CStr(section.TestForceProbeCount) & vbCrLf
    Next enabled
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сетка сохраняет реальные переменные площади и исходный порядок элементов.
Private Function TestBuildForceModel(ByVal count As Long) As CSectionModel
    Dim result As CSectionModel: Set result = New CSectionModel
    Dim side As Long, i As Long, Ix As Long, Iy As Long, Width As Double
    side = -Int(-Sqr(count)): Width = 1000# / side
    For i = 1 To count
        Ix = (i - 1) Mod side: Iy = (i - 1) \ side
        result.AddConcreteElement -500# + (Ix + 0.5) * Width, -500# + (Iy + 0.5) * Width, _
            1000000# / count * (1# + 0.2 * Sin(i)), 1, , , "Rectangle", Width, Width
    Next i
    result.AddRebarElement -400#, -400#, 20#, 0#, "Periodic": result.AddRebarElement 400#, -400#, 20#, 0#, "Periodic"
    result.AddRebarElement -400#, 400#, 20#, 0#, "Periodic": result.AddRebarElement 400#, 400#, 20#, 0#, "Periodic"
    Set TestBuildForceModel = result
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Точки заданы явно для проверки нелинейных ветвей без обращения к нормативам.
Private Sub TestForceDiagrams(ByRef concrete As CMaterialDiagram, ByRef steel As CMaterialDiagram)
    Dim e(1 To 7) As Double, s(1 To 7) As Double
    e(1) = -0.004: e(2) = -0.002: e(3) = -0.0003: e(4) = 0#: e(5) = 0.00008: e(6) = 0.00015: e(7) = 0.0003
    s(1) = -17#: s(2) = -17#: s(3) = -9#: s(4) = 0#: s(5) = 1.1: s(6) = 1.5: s(7) = 1.5
    Set concrete = New CMaterialDiagram: concrete.InitializeFromArrays e, s, 7
    Dim se(1 To 4) As Double, ss(1 To 4) As Double
    se(1) = -0.01: se(2) = -0.002: se(3) = 0.002: se(4) = 0.01
    ss(1) = -400#: ss(2) = -400#: ss(3) = 400#: ss(4) = 400#
    Set steel = New CMaterialDiagram: steel.InitializeFromArrays se, ss, 4
    concrete.Freeze: steel.Freeze ' Повторяет неизменяемые рабочие диаграммы и штатное повторное использование точной оценки.
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Независимый исходный проход, дополнительно считающий масштаб ошибки по модулям сил.
Private Sub TestDirectForces(ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal diagram As CMaterialDiagram, ByVal ox As Double, ByVal oy As Double, _
        ByVal eps As Double, ByVal kx As Double, ByVal ky As Double, ByRef n As Double, ByRef mX As Double, ByRef mY As Double, _
        ByRef grossN As Double, ByRef grossMx As Double, ByRef grossMy As Double)
    Dim i As Long, X As Double, Y As Double, area As Double, force As Double
    n = 0#: mX = 0#: mY = 0#: grossN = 0#: grossMx = 0#: grossMy = 0#
    For i = 1 To section.ConcreteCount
        section.ConcreteElementForSolver i, X, Y, area: X = X - ox: Y = Y - oy
        force = diagram.StressAtStrain(eps + kx * Y + ky * X) * area
        n = n + force: mX = mX + force * Y: mY = mY + force * X
        grossN = grossN + Abs(force): grossMx = grossMx + Abs(force * Y): grossMy = grossMy + Abs(force * X)
    Next i
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Монотонный QPC не зависит от перехода через полночь.
Private Function TestForceNow() As Double
    Dim counter As Currency, frequency As Currency
    TestCounter counter: TestFrequency frequency: TestForceNow = counter / frequency
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Машинная запись результата без локальной десятичной запятой.
Private Function TestForceText(ByVal value As Double) As String
    TestForceText = Replace$(CStr(value), ",", ".")
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Положительный масштаб не превращает почти нулевой момент в относительную ошибку.
Private Function TestForceMax(ByVal A As Double, ByVal B As Double) As Double
    If A > B Then TestForceMax = A Else TestForceMax = B
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Фиксирует отдельное условие, сохраняя неуспешный результат для разбора.
Private Sub TestForceCheck(ByVal label As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mTestPassed = mTestPassed + 1: mTestReport = mTestReport & "OK: " & label & vbCrLf
    Else
        mTestFailed = mTestFailed + 1: mTestReport = mTestReport & "FAIL: " & label & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub


====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: modTestGeneralGeometryConfig

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: общие настройки геометрии, сетки и точки нагрузки
' ==========================================================================
' Проверяет девять настроек через обычное построение модели, чтение сохранённого
' импорта, расчёт сочетаний и перенос нагрузки. Не повторяет формулы программы.
' Изменения выполняет в отдельной копии; восстанавливает исходные формулы
' и привязку rngSystemSettings даже при ошибке.

Private Type TGeneralConfigStats
    passed As Long
    Failed As Long
    report As String
    cases As Long ' Число consumer-сценариев отдельно от числа assertions.
End Type

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет поведенческие и адресные проверки в двух положениях таблицы.
' Второе положение специально выявляет сообщения с жестко заданным адресом.
Public Function RunAudit03GeneralGeometryConfigTests(Optional ByRef passed As Long = 0, _
        Optional ByRef Failed As Long = 0) As String
    Dim stats As TGeneralConfigStats, system As Object, unitsRange As Object, profiles As Object, circleRange As Object
    Dim savedSystem As Variant, savedUnits As Variant, savedProfiles As Variant, savedCircle As Variant
    Dim shifted As Object, savedShifted As Variant, originalName As String, position As Long
    On Error GoTo FailedRun
    Set system = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    Set unitsRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    Set profiles = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCalculationProfiles").RefersToRange
    Set circleRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCircleGeometry").RefersToRange
    savedSystem = system.formula: savedUnits = unitsRange.formula
    savedProfiles = profiles.formula: savedCircle = circleRange.formula
    originalName = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersTo
    Set shifted = system.Worksheet.range("CH800").Resize(system.rows.count, system.columns.count)
    savedShifted = shifted.formula
    TestConfigureGeneralFixture system, unitsRange, profiles, circleRange
    TestCheckGeometryAndMesh stats, system
    TestCheckGeneratedMeshUnits stats, system, unitsRange, circleRange
    TestCheckSavedImport stats, system, unitsRange
    TestCheckMomentFilter stats, system, unitsRange
    TestCheckReferenceOffsets stats, system, unitsRange
    TestCheckExtensionConsumer stats, system, profiles
    Dim prepared As Variant: prepared = system.formula
    For position = 0 To 1
        If position = 1 Then
            shifted.formula = prepared
            ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersTo = "='" & shifted.Worksheet.name & "'!" & shifted.address
            Set system = shifted
        End If
        TestCheckInvalidGeneralFields stats, system, position
    Next position
    GoTo Restore
FailedRun:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: generalGeometry.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
Restore:
    On Error GoTo FailedRestore
    If Len(originalName) > 0 Then ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersTo = originalName
    If Not IsEmpty(savedSystem) Then ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange.formula = savedSystem
    If Not shifted Is Nothing Then shifted.formula = savedShifted
    If Not unitsRange Is Nothing Then unitsRange.formula = savedUnits
    If Not profiles Is Nothing Then profiles.formula = savedProfiles
    If Not circleRange Is Nothing Then circleRange.formula = savedCircle
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.restore.name", ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersTo = originalName
    GoTo Finish
FailedRestore:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: generalGeometry.restore; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
Finish:
    passed = stats.passed: Failed = stats.Failed
    TestLogLine stats, "GENERAL_GEOMETRY_CASES: " & CStr(stats.cases)
    TestLogLine stats, "TOTAL_GENERAL_GEOMETRY_CONFIG: passed=" & CStr(passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(Failed)
    RunAudit03GeneralGeometryConfigTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задает малый армированный круг и прямое НДС без устойчивости/несущей.
' Варианты единиц меняются на самом Config, а не в локальных test getters.
Private Sub TestConfigureGeneralFixture(ByVal system As Object, ByVal unitsRange As Object, _
        ByVal profiles As Object, ByVal circleRange As Object)
    Dim row As Long, value As String
    For row = 2 To unitsRange.rows.count
        Select Case CStr(unitsRange.cells(row, 1).value2)
            Case "Length": value = "mm"
            Case "Area": value = "mm2"
            Case "Force": value = "N"
            Case "Moment": value = "N*mm"
            Case "Stress": value = "MPa"
            Case "Curvature": value = "1/mm"
            Case Else: Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4499, "ConfigureGeneralFixture", "Неизвестная строка единиц."
        End Select
        unitsRange.cells(row, 2).value2 = value: unitsRange.cells(row, 4).value2 = value
    Next row
    TestSetValue system, "Geometry.Source", "Generated"
    TestSetValue system, "Geometry.Type", "Circle"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepMode", "User"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepX", 20#: TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepY", 20#
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", 2
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 0#: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", 0#
    TestSetValue system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", 0#
    TestSetValue system, "General.DiagramExtension", "No"
    TestSetValue system, "General.ExecutionReportEnabled", "Yes"
    TestSetValue system, "Solver.ToleranceN", 0.01
    TestSetValue system, "Solver.ToleranceMx", 1#: TestSetValue system, "Solver.ToleranceMy", 1#
    TestSetValue system, "SLS.Crack.PsiMode", "User": TestSetValue system, "SLS.Crack.PsiS", 1#
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Circle.Diameter", 300#
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.AxisDistance", 30#: TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.Count", 12
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.Diameter", 16#
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.StartSetback", 0#: TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.EndSetback", 0#
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.Diameter2", 0#: TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.Diameter3", 0#
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Stability.Enabled", "No", "PR1"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Strength.DirectState", "Yes", "PR1"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Strength.Capacity", "No", "PR1"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Crack.Width", "No", "PR1"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Stability.Enabled", "No", "PR2"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Strength.DirectState", "No", "PR2"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Strength.Capacity", "No", "PR2"
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Crack.Width", "Yes", "PR2"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Каждый тип реально строит бетон/арматуру и собственные semantic-аннотации.
' Изменения шагов проверяются отдельно по фактической площади элементов;
' subdivisions проверяется на кривой границе, где влияет на дискретизацию.
Private Sub TestCheckGeometryAndMesh(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object)
    Dim shape As Variant, model As CSectionModel, firstArea As Double, prefix As String
    For Each shape In Array("Circle", "Rectangles", "PointedSection", "HollowRectangle")
        TestSetValue system, "Geometry.Type", CStr(shape)
        Set model = TestBuildModel(stats)
        prefix = "generalGeometry.Geometry.Type." & CStr(shape)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".concrete", model.ConcreteCount > 0
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".steel", model.RebarCount > 0
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".annotations", model.AnnotationCount > 0
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".generated", model.sourceType = "Generated"
        If firstArea > 0# Then TestCheck stats, prefix & ".differentSection", Abs(TestConcreteArea(model) - firstArea) > 1#
        firstArea = TestConcreteArea(model)
        TestLogLine stats, "GENERAL_MODEL: " & prefix & "|count=" & CStr(model.ConcreteCount) & "|area=" & TestNumberText(firstArea)
    Next shape
    TestSetValue system, "Geometry.Type", "Circle"
    Dim baseline As CSectionModel, changed As CSectionModel, key As Variant
    Set baseline = TestBuildModel(stats)
    For Each key In Array("Mesh.StepX", "Mesh.StepY")
        TestSetValue system, CStr(key), 10#
        Set changed = TestBuildModel(stats)
        prefix = "generalGeometry." & CStr(key)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".moreFibers", changed.ConcreteCount > baseline.ConcreteCount
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".cellArea", TestHasCellArea(changed, 200#)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".steelUnchanged", changed.RebarCount = baseline.RebarCount
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".areaAccuracy", TestConcreteArea(changed), GEOM_PI * 150# ^ 2, 1000#
        TestSetValue system, CStr(key), 20#
    Next key
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepMode", "User"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepX", 55#: TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepY", 55#
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", 1
    Set baseline = TestBuildModel(stats)
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", 4
    Set changed = TestBuildModel(stats)
    ' Независимая квадратура окружности: 22 центра шага 55 мм и 378 центров
    ' шага 13.75 мм внутри x^2+y^2 <= 150^2, включая последние неполные клетки.
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions.coarseArea", TestConcreteArea(baseline), 66550#, 0.00000001
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions.fineArea", TestConcreteArea(changed), 71465.625, 0.00000001
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions.boundaryChanged", _
        Abs(TestConcreteArea(changed) - TestConcreteArea(baseline)) > 1#
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions.accuracy", _
        Abs(TestConcreteArea(changed) - GEOM_PI * 150# ^ 2) < Abs(TestConcreteArea(baseline) - GEOM_PI * 150# ^ 2)
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepMode", "User"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepX", 20#: TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepY", 20#
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", 2
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Перевод всех активных длин Circle и шагов мм -> м сохраняет каждый
' фактический бетонный элемент и стержень. Не сравнивает две неподвижные
' таблицы: обе модели заново собираются штатным Generated-entrypoint.
Private Sub TestCheckGeneratedMeshUnits(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object, _
        ByVal unitRange As Object, ByVal circleRange As Object)
    Dim baseline As CSectionModel, changed As CSectionModel, savedCircle As Variant, i As Long, prefix As String
    savedCircle = circleRange.formula
    Set baseline = TestBuildModel(stats)
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "m"
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Circle.Diameter", 0.3: TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.AxisDistance", 0.03
    TestSetValue circleRange, "Rebar.Diameter", 0.016
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepMode", "User"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepX", 0.02: TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepY", 0.02
    Set changed = TestBuildModel(stats)
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Mesh.StepX.unitsCount", changed.ConcreteCount = baseline.ConcreteCount
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Mesh.StepY.unitsSteelCount", changed.RebarCount = baseline.RebarCount
    If changed.ConcreteCount = baseline.ConcreteCount Then
        For i = 1 To baseline.ConcreteCount
            prefix = "generalGeometry.Mesh.units.C" & CStr(i)
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".x", changed.concreteX(i), baseline.concreteX(i), 0.00000001
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".y", changed.concreteY(i), baseline.concreteY(i), 0.00000001
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".area", changed.concreteArea(i), baseline.concreteArea(i), 0.00000001
        Next i
    End If
    If changed.RebarCount = baseline.RebarCount Then
        For i = 1 To baseline.RebarCount
            prefix = "generalGeometry.Mesh.units.R" & CStr(i)
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".x", changed.RebarX(i), baseline.RebarX(i), 0.00000001
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".y", changed.RebarY(i), baseline.RebarY(i), 0.00000001
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".area", changed.RebarArea(i), baseline.RebarArea(i), 0.00000001
        Next i
    End If
    circleRange.formula = savedCircle
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "mm"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepMode", "User"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepX", 20#: TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepY", 20#
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохранённая геометрия проходит обычные импорт, запись и чтение Results.
' При источнике AutoCAD параметры генерации не используются. Повторный импорт
' и генерация не выполняются; внутренние координаты и площади остаются в мм и мм2.
Private Sub TestCheckSavedImport(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object, ByVal unitRange As Object)
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, importer As CAutoCADSectionModelImporter
    Dim regions As Collection, region As CTestFakeAcadRegion, imported As CSectionModel, restored As CSectionModel
    Dim writer As CNDMResultsWriter, saved As Variant, area As Double
    saved = system.formula
    TestLoadReader settings, units
    Set regions = New Collection
    Set region = New CTestFakeAcadRegion: region.TestInitialize 40000#, 20#, 30#, 133333333#, 133333333#, 0#, "RC_CONCRETE", "CFG_C"
    regions.Add region
    Set region = New CTestFakeAcadRegion: region.TestInitialize 201#, 80#, 90#, 3215#, 3215#, 0#, "RC_REBAR", "CFG_R"
    regions.Add region
    Set importer = New CAutoCADSectionModelImporter
    Set imported = importer.ImportFromModelSpace(regions, "RC_CONCRETE", "RC_REBAR", "Rebar", 0#, units)
    Set writer = New CNDMResultsWriter: writer.WriteGeometryPreview ThisWorkbook, imported, PrepareSectionSnapshot(imported), units
    TestSetValue system, "Geometry.Source", "AutoCAD"
    TestSetValue system, "Geometry.Type", "Unknown"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepMode", "User"
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepX", -1#: TestSetValue system, "Mesh.StepY", -1#
    TestSetValue system, "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", -1
    Set restored = TestBuildModel(stats)
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Geometry.Source.AutoCAD.noGenerator", restored.ConcreteCount = 1 And restored.RebarCount = 1
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Geometry.Source.AutoCAD.x", restored.concreteX(1), 20#, 0.00000001
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Geometry.Source.AutoCAD.area", TestConcreteArea(restored), 40000#, 0.00000001
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "m"
    Set restored = TestBuildModel(stats)
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Geometry.Source.AutoCAD.changedInputUnit", restored.concreteX(1), 20#, 0.00000001
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Geometry.Source.AutoCAD.changedInputArea", TestConcreteArea(restored), 40000#, 0.00000001
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "mm"
    system.formula = saved
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет значения ниже порога, на нём и выше него по действующим моментам
' и рассчитанному НДС. Смена входных единиц не меняет внутренний порог.
' Нулевое значение отключает фильтр малых моментов.
Private Sub TestCheckMomentFilter(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object, ByVal unitRange As Object)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, point As CSectionStateResult
    Dim value As Variant, prefix As String, factor As Double
    Set section = TestBuildModel(stats)
    TestSetValue system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", 10#
    For Each value In Array(2999#, 3000#, 3001#)
        prefix = "generalGeometry.Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth." & TestNumberText(CDbl(value))
        Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, CDbl(value), CDbl(value), "PR1")
        factor = 1#: If CDbl(value) <= 3000# Then factor = 0#
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".mx", batch.mX(1), factor * CDbl(value), 0#
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".my", batch.mY(1), factor * CDbl(value), 0#
        Set point = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".state", point.Converged
    Next value
    TestSetValue system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", 0#
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 2999#, -2999#, "PR1")
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth.disabled", batch.mX(1), 2999#, 0#
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "m": TestSetValue unitRange, "Moment", "kN*m"
    TestSetValue system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", 0.01
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 3000#, 3001#, "PR1")
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth.unitsMx", batch.mX(1), 0#, 0#
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth.unitsMy", batch.mY(1), 3001#, 0#
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "mm": TestSetValue unitRange, "Moment", "N*mm"
    TestSetValue system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", 0#
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Смещения по X и Y независимо меняют моменты от N по принятому правилу знаков.
' Противоположные смещения и ввод тех же длин в метрах сохраняют равновесие.
' Ожидаемые моменты получены отдельно из N*offset, а не чтением результата переноса.
Private Sub TestCheckReferenceOffsets(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object, ByVal unitRange As Object)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, point As CSectionStateResult
    Dim baseline As CSectionStateResult, baselineSolves As Long
    Dim axis As Variant, value As Variant, mX As Double, mY As Double, prefix As String
    Set section = TestBuildModel(stats)
    For Each axis In Array("X", "Y")
        For Each value In Array(-10#, 10#)
            TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffset" & CStr(axis), CDbl(value)
            Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 200000#, 100000#, "PR1")
            Set point = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
            mX = 200000#: mY = 100000#
            If CStr(axis) = "X" Then mY = mY - 10000# * CDbl(value)
            If CStr(axis) = "Y" Then mX = mX - 10000# * CDbl(value)
            prefix = "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffset" & CStr(axis) & "." & TestNumberText(CDbl(value))
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".mx", point.Mxint, mX, 1#
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".my", point.Myint, mY, 1#
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".converged", point.Converged
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".n", point.Nint, -10000#, 0.01
        Next value
        TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffset" & CStr(axis), 0#
    Next axis
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "m"
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 0.01: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", -0.01
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 200000#, 100000#, "PR1")
    Set point = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetX.units", point.Myint, 0#, 1#
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetY.units", point.Mxint, 300000#, 1#
    TestSetValue unitRange, "Length", "mm"
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 0#: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", 0#
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 200000#, 100000#, "PR1")
    Set baseline = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 10#: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", -10#
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 100000#, 200000#, "PR1")
    Set point = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetX.equivalentPlane", point.KappaY, baseline.KappaY, 0.000000000001
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetY.equivalentPlane", point.KappaX, baseline.KappaX, 0.000000000001
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffset.equivalentEps", point.Epsilon0, baseline.Epsilon0, 0.0000000001
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 0#: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", 0#
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, 0#, 20000#, 10000#, "PR1")
    Set baseline = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult: baselineSolves = batch.SolverCallCount
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 10#: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", -10#
    Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, 0#, 20000#, 10000#, "PR1")
    Set point = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetX.inactiveNoN", point.Converged
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetX.inactivePlane", point.KappaY, baseline.KappaY, 0.000000000001
    TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffsetY.inactivePlane", point.KappaX, baseline.KappaX, 0.000000000001
    TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.Load.ReferenceOffset.inactiveSolveCount", batch.SolverCallCount = baselineSolves
    TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", 0#: TestSetValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", 0#
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет продолжение диаграмм в текущем НДС прочности, НДС с трещинами
' и отдельном поиске физической несущей способности. Продолжение может помочь
' найти равновесие, но не должно превращать физическую перегрузку в успешную проверку.
Private Sub TestCheckExtensionConsumer(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object, ByVal profiles As Object)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, normal As CSectionStateResult
    Dim point As CSectionStateResult, profile As Variant, enabled As Variant, prefix As String
    Set section = TestBuildModel(stats)
    For Each profile In Array("PR1", "PR2")
        For Each enabled In Array("No", "Yes")
            TestSetValue system, "General.DiagramExtension", CStr(enabled)
            prefix = "generalGeometry.General.DiagramExtension." & CStr(profile) & "." & CStr(enabled)
            Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 200000#, 100000#, CStr(profile))
            Set point = TestCurrentPoint(batch, CStr(profile))
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".normalConverged", Not point Is Nothing
            If Not point Is Nothing Then
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".normalPhysical", point.Converged And point.withinPhysicalRange
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".normalNoExtension", Not point.ExtensionUsed
                If CStr(enabled) = "No" Then
                    Set normal = point
                Else
                    TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".normalEps", point.Epsilon0, normal.Epsilon0, 0.0000000001
                    TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".normalKx", point.KappaX, normal.KappaX, 0.000000000001
                    TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".normalKy", point.KappaY, normal.KappaY, 0.000000000001
                End If
            End If
            Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000000#, 0#, 0#, CStr(profile))
            Set point = TestCurrentPoint(batch, CStr(profile))
            If CStr(enabled) = "Yes" Then
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".overloadState", Not point Is Nothing
                If Not point Is Nothing Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".overloadConverged", point.Converged
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".overloadExtended", point.ExtensionUsed And Not point.withinPhysicalRange
                End If
                If CStr(profile) = "PR1" Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".overloadFail", batch.ResultAt(1).DirectStateMeta.internalStatus = rsCheckFailed
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".overloadFail", batch.ResultAt(1).CrackCurrentStateMeta.internalStatus = rsCheckFailed
                End If
            Else
                If CStr(profile) = "PR1" Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".offNumFail", batch.ResultAt(1).DirectStateMeta.internalStatus = rsNumericalFailure
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".offNumFail", batch.ResultAt(1).CrackCurrentStateMeta.internalStatus = rsNumericalFailure
                End If
            End If
        Next enabled
    Next profile
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Strength.Capacity", "Yes", "PR1"
    Dim capacity As Double
    For Each enabled In Array("No", "Yes")
        TestSetValue system, "General.DiagramExtension", CStr(enabled)
        Set batch = TestRunGeneralBatch(stats, section, -10000#, 200000#, 100000#, "PR1")
        Set point = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.capacity.stateResult
        TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.General.DiagramExtension.capacityPhysical." & CStr(enabled), point.Converged And point.withinPhysicalRange And Not point.ExtensionUsed
        If CStr(enabled) = "No" Then
            capacity = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.capacity.LambdaCapacity
        Else
            ' Масштаб исходного момента произволен, поэтому абсолютный допуск
            ' lambda не характеризует точность. Две принятые точки сравниваем
            ' в Н*мм с суммой их допусков равновесия (здесь по 1 Н*мм).
            TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.General.DiagramExtension.capacityInvariant.Mx", _
                batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.capacity.LambdaCapacity * 200000#, capacity * 200000#, 2#
            TestCheckClose stats, "generalGeometry.General.DiagramExtension.capacityInvariant.My", _
                batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.capacity.LambdaCapacity * 100000#, capacity * 100000#, 2#
        End If
    Next enabled
    TestSetProfile profiles, "Calculation.Strength.Capacity", "No", "PR1"
    TestSetValue system, "General.DiagramExtension", "No"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Невалидные значения и потерянные строки передаются именно владельцу поля.
' Диагностика обязана содержать текущий адрес/ключ и способ исправления;
' возврат defaults или нечисленный отказ считается отдельным падением.
Private Sub TestCheckInvalidGeneralFields(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal system As Object, ByVal position As Long)
    Dim keys As Variant, key As Variant, values As Variant, value As Variant, saved As Variant
    Dim target As Object, reason As String, prefix As String, index As Long
    keys = Array("General.DiagramExtension", "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", "Geometry.Source", "Geometry.Type", _
        "Mesh.StepX", "Mesh.StepY", "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", "Load.ReferenceOffsetY")
    saved = system.formula
    For Each key In keys
        values = Array(vbNullString, "TODO", "abc", CVErr(2015))
        If CStr(key) = "Mesh.StepX" Or CStr(key) = "Mesh.StepY" Then values = Array(vbNullString, "TODO", "abc", CVErr(2015), 0#, -1#)
        If CStr(key) = "Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions" Then values = Array(vbNullString, "TODO", "abc", CVErr(2015), 0#, -1#, 1.5)
        If CStr(key) = "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth" Then values = Array(vbNullString, "TODO", "abc", CVErr(2015), -1#)
        index = 0
        For Each value In values
            system.formula = saved: Set target = TestCellForKey(system, CStr(key), 2): target.value2 = value
            prefix = "generalGeometry.invalid." & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(key) & "." & CStr(index)
            reason = TestConsumeError(stats, CStr(key))
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".rejected", Len(reason) > 0
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".key", InStr(1, reason, CStr(key), vbTextCompare) > 0
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, target.address(False, False), vbTextCompare) > 0
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".action", InStr(1, reason, "введите", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or _
                InStr(1, reason, "выберите", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or InStr(1, reason, "исправ", vbTextCompare) > 0
            TestLogLine stats, "GENERAL_INPUT: " & prefix & "|" & reason
            index = index + 1
        Next value
        system.formula = saved: Set target = TestCellForKey(system, CStr(key), 1): target.value2 = "Missing." & CStr(key)
        reason = TestConsumeError(stats, CStr(key))
        prefix = "generalGeometry.missing." & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(key)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".rejected", Len(reason) > 0
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".key", InStr(1, reason, CStr(key), vbTextCompare) > 0
        system.formula = saved
        reason = TestConsumeError(stats, CStr(key))
        TestCheck stats, "generalGeometry.recovery." & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(key), Len(reason) = 0
    Next key
    system.formula = saved
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Запускает обычный код, использующий настройку. Ошибка ввода сохраняет свою причину
' и не трактуется как несходимость. Для расчёта сочетаний читает готовый код ошибки результата.
Private Function TestConsumeError(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal key As String) As String
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, model As CSectionModel
    Dim provider As CMaterialModelProvider, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog
    stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    TestLoadReader settings, units
    If key = "General.DiagramExtension" Then
        Set provider = New CMaterialModelProvider: provider.Initialize settings, units
    ElseIf left$(key, 9) = "Geometry." Or left$(key, 5) = "Mesh." Then
        Set model = BuildWorkbookSectionModel(ThisWorkbook, settings, units)
    Else
        Set model = New CSectionModel
        model.AddConcreteElement 0#, 0#, 40000#, 1, ShapeType:="Rectangle", Width:=200#, Height:=200#
        model.AddRebarElement 60#, 60#, 16#, 201#, "A400", 2
        Set provider = New CMaterialModelProvider: provider.Initialize settings, units
        Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: batch.Initialize model, provider
        If key = "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth" Then
            Set profiles = New CCalculationProfileCatalog: profiles.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
            Set batch.ProfileCatalog = profiles
            batch.ApplySettings settings, units
            batch.AddCombination "INVALID_GENERAL", -10000#, 0#, 0#, "PR1", "", "Auto"
            batch.Execute
            If batch.ResultAt(1).WorkflowMeta.internalStatus = rsInvalidInput Then TestConsumeError = batch.ResultAt(1).WorkflowMeta.resultComment
        Else
            Audit03ApplyLoadReferenceForTests model, settings, units, batch
        End If
    End If
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    TestConsumeError = Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет обычный расчёт сочетаний по текущим Config и профилям. Общая проверка
' сопоставляет результаты всех вложенных расчётов, пояснения и подробные таблицы.
Private Function TestRunGeneralBatch(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal section As CSectionModel, _
        ByVal nValue As Double, ByVal mxValue As Double, ByVal myValue As Double, ByVal profileId As String) As CBatchSectionCalculator
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, provider As CMaterialModelProvider
    Dim profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, passed As Long, Failed As Long
    TestLoadReader settings, units
    Set provider = New CMaterialModelProvider: provider.Initialize settings, units
    Set profiles = New CCalculationProfileCatalog: profiles.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: batch.Initialize section, provider
    Set batch.ProfileCatalog = profiles: batch.ApplySettings settings, units
    batch.AddCombination "GENERAL_CONFIG", nValue, mxValue, myValue, profileId, "Общие настройки Config", "Auto"
    Audit03ApplyLoadReferenceForTests section, settings, units, batch
    batch.Execute
    stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
    stats.report = stats.report & TestAudit03ValidateConfigBatchResults(batch, units, passed, Failed)
    stats.passed = stats.passed + passed: stats.Failed = stats.Failed + Failed
    TestLogLine stats, "GENERAL_BATCH: profile=" & profileId & "|N=" & TestNumberText(nValue) & "|Mx=" & TestNumberText(mxValue) & "|My=" & TestNumberText(myValue) & _
        "|status=" & batch.ResultAt(1).status & "|solves=" & CStr(batch.SolverCallCount)
    Set TestRunGeneralBatch = batch
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Получает завершённое сохранённое НДС. Неудачная попытка не должна возвращаться
' как пригодное состояние; причина неудачи прочности хранится отдельно.
Private Function TestCurrentPoint(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal profileId As String) As CSectionStateResult
    If profileId = "PR1" Then
        Set TestCurrentPoint = batch.ResultAt(1).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
    Else
        Set TestCurrentPoint = batch.ResultAt(1).StateRepository.FindState(sstCrackedState)
    End If
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строит модель обычным макросом книги без подстановки готовой тестовой геометрии.
Private Function TestBuildModel(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats) As CSectionModel
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem
    TestLoadReader settings, units
    Set TestBuildModel = BuildWorkbookSectionModel(ThisWorkbook, settings, units)
    stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Читает настоящие именованные таблицы и единицы единственным adapter-ом.
Private Sub TestLoadReader(ByRef settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByRef units As CUnitSystem)
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Независимый суммарный контроль площадей построенных бетонных элементов.
Private Function TestConcreteArea(ByVal model As CSectionModel) As Double
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To model.ConcreteCount: TestConcreteArea = TestConcreteArea + model.concreteArea(i): Next i
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Ищет полную внутреннюю ячейку с заданной площадью, не граничную долю.
Private Function TestHasCellArea(ByVal model As CSectionModel, ByVal area As Double) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To model.ConcreteCount
        If Abs(model.concreteArea(i) - area) < 0.00000001 Then TestHasCellArea = True: Exit Function
    Next i
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Находит настройку по ключу в фактической таблице; явно сообщает об ошибке подготовки теста.
Private Function TestCellForKey(ByVal table As Object, ByVal key As String, ByVal column As Long) As Object
    Dim row As Long
    For row = 2 To table.rows.count
        If CStr(table.cells(row, 1).value2) = key Then Set TestCellForKey = table.cells(row, column): Exit Function
    Next row
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4499, "CellForKey", "Не найден ключ Config " & key
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Меняет только значение найденного поля; восстановление сохраняет Formula.
Private Sub TestSetValue(ByVal table As Object, ByVal key As String, ByVal value As Variant)
    If left$(key, 7) = "Circle." Or left$(key, 6) = "Rebar." Then
        TestFixtureCircleFieldCell(ThisWorkbook, key, table).value2 = value
    Else
        TestCellForKey(table, key, 2).value2 = value
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выбирает столбец профиля по ID и строку по ключу во втором столбце.
Private Sub TestSetProfile(ByVal table As Object, ByVal key As String, ByVal value As String, ByVal profileId As String)
    Dim row As Long, column As Long, targetRow As Long, targetColumn As Long
    For row = 1 To table.rows.count
        If CStr(table.cells(row, 2).value2) = key Then targetRow = row
        For column = 3 To table.columns.count
            If CStr(table.cells(row, column).value2) = profileId Then targetColumn = column
        Next column
    Next row
    If targetRow = 0 Or targetColumn = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4499, "SetProfile", "Не найден параметр профиля " & key
    table.cells(targetRow, targetColumn).value2 = value
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Учет assertions не прекращает набор после первого отрицательного результата.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1: TestLogLine stats, "OK: " & name
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1: TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: " & name
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохраняет actual/expected/tolerance до проверки, без округления допусков.
Private Sub TestCheckClose(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double, ByVal tolerance As Double)
    TestLogLine stats, "GENERAL_NUMBER: " & name & "|actual=" & TestNumberText(actual) & "|expected=" & TestNumberText(expected) & "|tolerance=" & TestNumberText(tolerance)
    TestCheck stats, name, Abs(actual - expected) <= tolerance
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Формат журнала не зависит от десятичного разделителя текущего Windows.
Private Function TestNumberText(ByVal value As Double) As String
    TestNumberText = Replace(CStr(value), ",", ".")
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Отчет и живой progress используют общий принятый путь тестового runner-а.
Private Sub TestLogLine(ByRef stats As TGeneralConfigStats, ByVal line As String)
    stats.report = stats.report & line & vbCrLf
    Dim fileNumber As Integer: fileNumber = FreeFile
    Open ThisWorkbook.path & Application.PathSeparator & "Audit03_Search_Progress.txt" For Output As #fileNumber
    Print #fileNumber, stats.report;
    Close #fileNumber
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
