' Проверяет причину, фактическую привязку полей и отсутствие маскировки ошибки пропусками.
Private Sub TestExpectContourFailure(ByVal definition As CSectionDefinition, ByVal expected As String)
    Dim executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, reason As String
    Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    TestCheck "individual.failure.must.reject", False
    Exit Sub
Rejected:
    reason = Err.description
    TestCheck "individual.failure.reason." & expected, InStr(1, reason, expected, vbTextCompare) > 0
    TestCheck "individual.failure.source", InStr(reason, "IndividualRectangle[Extra,") > 0 Or InStr(reason, "IndividualFailure[Main,") > 0
    TestCheck "individual.failure.not.mass.skip", Not TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
    mReport = mReport & "REJECTED: " & reason & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Верхние 150/200 мм не переносятся на соседние стороны без дополнительных рядов.
' При включении всех сторон крайние позиции проверяются по их собственным отступам.
Private Sub TestRectangle(ByVal allSides As Boolean, ByVal reverse As Boolean, ByVal everySecond As Boolean)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, boundary As CGeometryPath
    Dim options As CRebarRuleOptions, definition As CSectionDefinition, executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout
    Dim i As Long, sign As Double, expected As Long, row2 As Long, row3 As Long, owner As Long, ruleID As String
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "IndividualRectangle"
    Set boundary = facade.RectanglePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 1000#, 800#)
    If reverse Then
        Set boundary = boundary.reversed.WithID("Boundary.Reverse"): facade.AddPath boundary
    End If
    facade.outer "Outer", boundary.id
    For i = 1 To 4
        Select Case i
            Case 1: Set path = facade.LinePath("Top", 50#, 750#, 950#, 750#)
            Case 2: Set path = facade.LinePath("Right", 950#, 750#, 950#, 50#)
            Case 3: Set path = facade.LinePath("Bottom", 950#, 50#, 50#, 50#)
            Case 4: Set path = facade.LinePath("Left", 50#, 50#, 50#, 750#)
        End Select
        sign = -1#
        If reverse Then
            Set path = path.reversed.WithID(path.id & ".Reverse"): facade.AddPath path: sign = 1#
        End If
        ruleID = "Side" & CStr(i)
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.Coincidence = KeepPublishedOwner
        options.SourceReference = "IndividualRectangle[Main," & CStr(i) & "]"
        facade.RebarByCount ruleID & ".Main", path.id, 5, 10#, options
        facade.RebarContour ruleID & ".Main", "Outer", boundary.id, 50#, ruleID & ".Second", ruleID & ".Third"
        If i = 1 Or allSides Then TestAddRows facade, ruleID, sign, 150#, 200#, everySecond
    Next i
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor
    Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    For i = 1 To executor.PositionCount
        owner = executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i)
        If executor.PositionRuleID(i) = "Side1.Second" Then
            row2 = row2 + 1: TestNear "rectangle.row2.y", layout.Y(owner), 600#
        ElseIf executor.PositionRuleID(i) = "Side1.Third" Then
            row3 = row3 + 1: TestNear "rectangle.row3.y", layout.Y(owner), 550#
        End If
    Next i
    expected = 5: If allSides Or everySecond Then expected = 3
    If allSides And everySecond Then expected = 1
    TestCheck "rectangle.top.row2.count", row2 = expected
    TestCheck "rectangle.top.row3.count", row3 = expected
    If allSides Then
        TestCheck "rectangle.excluded.ends.diagnostic", TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
        TestCheck "rectangle.excluded.ends.address", InStr(executor.DiagnosticsText, "IndividualRectangle[Extra,") > 0
    Else
        TestCheck "rectangle.no.false.corner.skip", Not TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Пять позиций верха: оба конца, середины обеих дуг и середина линии.
' Верхние дополнительные ряды имеют 40/70 мм, боковые 60/90 мм, as также различны.
Private Sub TestRoundedCorners(ByVal reverse As Boolean)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, polygon As CPolygonSpec, boundary As CGeometryPath, whole As CGeometryPath, path As CGeometryPath
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, options As CRebarRuleOptions, definition As CSectionDefinition
    Dim executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, stations As Variant, edge As TRegionEdge
    Dim i As Long, sign As Double, distances As Variant, ruleID As String, row2 As Long, row3 As Long
    Dim X As Double, Y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, normal As Double, owner As Long, source As Long, expectedX As Double, expectedY As Double
    Dim parent As TRebarPosition, transfer As TRebarRule, segment As String, parameter As Double, expectedSegment As String
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "IndividualRounded"
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 120#: polygon.AddVertex "BR", 1000#, 0#, 140#
    polygon.AddVertex "TR", 1000#, 800#, 180#: polygon.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 800#, 160#: polygon.Seal
    Set boundary = facade.RoundedPolygon("Boundary", polygon)
    If reverse Then
        Set boundary = boundary.reversed.WithID("Boundary.Reverse"): facade.AddPath boundary
    End If
    facade.outer "Outer", boundary.id
    distances = Array(50#, 65#, 45#)
    For i = 1 To 3
        Set whole = facade.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Whole" & CStr(i), polygon, CDbl(distances(i - 1)))
        Select Case i
            Case 1
                Set path = facade.chain("Top", whole.id, "Edge.BR", 1#, "Edge.TL", 0#)
                path.CopySegment 1, edge: normal = modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(edge) / 2#
                path.CopySegment path.segmentCount, edge
                stations = Array(0#, normal, path.length / 2#, path.length - modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(edge) / 2#, path.length)
            Case 2: Set path = facade.chain("Right", whole.id, "Edge.BR", 0#, "Edge.BR", 1#)
            Case 3: Set path = facade.chain("Left", whole.id, "Edge.TL", 0#, "Edge.TL", 1#)
        End Select
        sign = 1#
        If reverse Then
            Set path = path.reversed.WithID(path.id & ".Reverse"): facade.AddPath path: sign = -1#
            If i = 1 Then stations = Array(0#, path.length - CDbl(stations(3)), path.length - CDbl(stations(2)), path.length - CDbl(stations(1)), path.length)
        End If
        ruleID = "Face" & CStr(i)
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "IndividualRounded[Main," & CStr(i) & "]"
        If i = 1 Then
            facade.RebarAtStations ruleID & ".Main", path.id, stations, 10#, options
        Else
            options.EndMode = ExcludeBoth
            facade.RebarByCount ruleID & ".Main", path.id, 3, 10#, options
        End If
        facade.RebarContour ruleID & ".Main", "Outer", boundary.id, CDbl(distances(i - 1)), ruleID & ".Second", ruleID & ".Third"
        If i = 1 Then TestAddRows facade, ruleID, sign, 40#, 70#, False Else TestAddRows facade, ruleID, sign, 60#, 90#, False
    Next i
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    For i = 1 To executor.PositionCount
        ruleID = executor.PositionRuleID(i)
        If ruleID = "Face1.Second" Or ruleID = "Face1.Third" Then
            If ruleID = "Face1.Second" Then normal = 40#: row2 = row2 + 1 Else normal = 70#: row3 = row3 + 1
            Set path = definition.path(IIf(reverse, "Top.Reverse", "Top"))
            If ruleID = "Face1.Second" Then source = row2 Else source = row3
            path.AtDistance CDbl(stations(source - 1)), X, Y, tx, ty
            If reverse Then normal = -normal
            expectedX = X - normal * ty: expectedY = Y + normal * tx
            owner = executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i)
            TestNear "rounded.retained.x", layout.X(owner), expectedX: TestNear "rounded.retained.y", layout.Y(owner), expectedY
            executor.TestCopyTransfer i, parent, transfer
            TestCheck "rounded.owner.Main", parent.ruleIndex = definition.ruleIndex("Face1.Main")
            path.ResolveAnchor parent.X, parent.Y, segment, parameter
            expectedSegment = "Edge.TR"
            If source < 3 Then expectedSegment = IIf(reverse, "Corner.TL", "Corner.TR")
            If source > 3 Then expectedSegment = IIf(reverse, "Corner.TR", "Corner.TL")
            TestCheck "rounded.owner.segment", path.sourceSegmentID(path.segmentIndex(segment)) = expectedSegment
            mReport = mReport & "CORNER: " & CStr(reverse) & "; " & ruleID & "; source=" & CStr(source) & "; segment=" & expectedSegment & "; x=" & CStr(layout.X(owner)) & "; y=" & CStr(layout.Y(owner)) & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck "rounded.row2.all.five", row2 = 5: TestCheck "rounded.row3.all.five", row3 = 5
    TestCheck "rounded.no.artificial.corner.skip", Not TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' При совпадении Main с серединой сечения исходную сторону однозначно задаёт переданная нормаль.
Private Sub TestMidplaneMetadata(ByVal sign As Double)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, i As Long, count As Long
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "MidplaneMetadata"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 1000#, 800#): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Middle", 100#, 400#, 900#, 400#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "MidplaneMetadata[Main]"
    facade.RebarByCount "Main", path.id, 3, 10#, options
    facade.RebarContour "Main", "Outer", "Boundary", 400#, "Second", "Third", normalSign:=sign
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.normalOffset = sign * 40#: options.ValidateRowOffset = True
    options.SourceReference = "MidplaneMetadata[Extra,2]"
    facade.RebarDependent "Second", "Main", 10#, options
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    For i = 1 To executor.PositionCount
        If executor.PositionRuleID(i) = "Second" Then
            count = count + 1: TestNear "midplane.explicit.normal.y", layout.Y(executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i)), 400# + sign * 40#
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck "midplane.explicit.normal.count", count = 3
    TestCheck "midplane.no.false.skip", Not TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет отдельные области двух наружных границ, двух отверстий и обоих дополнительных рядов.
' У первого отверстия верх смещён дополнительно, у второго остаётся только известный as.
Private Sub TestIndependentContourDomains()
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, contours As CRebarOffsetContours, Rules() As TRebarRule
    Dim i As Long, row As Long, LoopID As String, mainID As String, offsetX As Double
    Dim a2 As Long, a3 As Long, b2 As Long, b3 As Long, hole2 As Long, hole3 As Long
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "IndependentContourDomains"
    For i = 1 To 2
        LoopID = "Outer" & CStr(i): offsetX = CDbl(i - 1) * 2000#
        Set path = facade.RectanglePath(LoopID & ".Boundary", offsetX, 0#, 1000#, 800#)
        facade.outer LoopID, path.id
    Next i
    For i = 1 To 2
        LoopID = "Opening" & CStr(i)
        Set path = facade.RectanglePath(LoopID & ".Boundary", 150# + CDbl(i - 1) * 500#, 250#, 200#, 200#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
        facade.opening LoopID, path.id, "Outer1"
        facade.RebarContourBaseline LoopID, path.id, Array("Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left"), 20#, "DomainScope[Opening.as]"
    Next i
    For i = 1 To 2
        LoopID = "Outer" & CStr(i): mainID = LoopID & ".Main": offsetX = CDbl(i - 1) * 2000#
        Set path = facade.LinePath(LoopID & ".Axis", offsetX + 100#, 750#, offsetX + 900#, 750#)
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "DomainScope[" & mainID & "]"
        facade.RebarByCount mainID, path.id, 3, 10#, options
        facade.RebarContour mainID, LoopID, LoopID & ".Boundary", 50#, LoopID & ".R2", LoopID & ".R3", normalSign:=-1#
        For row = 2 To 3
            Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.ValidateRowOffset = True
            options.normalOffset = -CDbl(IIf(i = 1, 150#, 50#)) - CDbl(row - 2) * 50#
            options.SourceReference = "DomainScope[" & LoopID & ".R" & CStr(row) & "]"
            facade.RebarDependent LoopID & ".R" & CStr(row), mainID, 8#, options
        Next row
    Next i
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Opening1.Axis", 175#, 470#, 325#, 470#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "DomainScope[Opening1.Main]"
    facade.RebarByCount "Opening1.Main", path.id, 3, 10#, options
    facade.RebarContour "Opening1.Main", "Opening1", "Opening1.Boundary", 20#, "Opening1.R2", "Opening1.R3", Array("Top"), 1#
    For row = 2 To 3
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.ValidateRowOffset = True: options.normalOffset = CDbl(row - 1) * 30#
        options.SourceReference = "DomainScope[Opening1.R" & CStr(row) & "]"
        facade.RebarDependent "Opening1.R" & CStr(row), "Opening1.Main", 8#, options
    Next row
    Set definition = facade.Finish
    ReDim Rules(1 To definition.ruleCount)
    For i = 1 To definition.ruleCount: definition.CopyRule i, Rules(i): Next i
    Set contours = New CRebarOffsetContours: contours.Initialize definition, Rules
    a2 = definition.ruleIndex("Outer1.R2"): a3 = definition.ruleIndex("Outer1.R3")
    b2 = definition.ruleIndex("Outer2.R2"): b3 = definition.ruleIndex("Outer2.R3")
    hole2 = definition.ruleIndex("Opening1.R2"): hole3 = definition.ruleIndex("Opening1.R3")
    TestCheck "domain.first.outer.boundary", contours.Accepts(a2, 500#, 600#)
    TestCheck "domain.first.outer.above", Not contours.Accepts(a2, 500#, 650#)
    TestCheck "domain.second.outer.inside", contours.Accepts(b2, 2500#, 650#)
    TestCheck "domain.second.outer.above", Not contours.Accepts(b2, 2500#, 750#)
    TestCheck "domain.first.not.second", Not contours.Accepts(a2, 2500#, 650#)
    TestCheck "domain.second.not.first", Not contours.Accepts(b2, 500#, 550#)
    TestCheck "domain.first.opening.center", Not contours.Accepts(a2, 250#, 350#)
    TestCheck "domain.second.opening.center", Not contours.Accepts(a2, 750#, 350#)
    TestCheck "domain.first.opening.extra.offset", Not contours.Accepts(a2, 250#, 480#)
    TestCheck "domain.second.opening.only.as", contours.Accepts(a2, 750#, 480#)
    TestCheck "domain.opening.shares.outer.limit", Not contours.Accepts(hole2, 500#, 650#)
    TestCheck "domain.opening.own.boundary", contours.Accepts(hole2, 250#, 500#)
    TestCheck "domain.opening.sees.other.hole", Not contours.Accepts(hole2, 750#, 350#)
    TestCheck "domain.first.rows.independent", contours.Accepts(a2, 500#, 575#) And Not contours.Accepts(a3, 500#, 575#)
    TestCheck "domain.second.rows.independent", contours.Accepts(b2, 2500#, 675#) And Not contours.Accepts(b3, 2500#, 675#)
    TestCheck "domain.opening.third.boundary", contours.Accepts(hole3, 250#, 530#)
    TestCheck "domain.opening.rows.independent", contours.Accepts(hole2, 250#, 515#) And Not contours.Accepts(hole3, 250#, 515#)
    mReport = mReport & "DOMAIN_SCOPE: outers=2; openings=2; rows=2,3; independent=True" & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет точные дуги и прямые перемычки, затем сохранение пяти стержней верхнего ряда.
Private Sub TestUserRoundedContour(ByVal reverse As Boolean)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, polygon As CPolygonSpec, boundary As CGeometryPath, whole As CGeometryPath, path As CGeometryPath
    Dim edges() As TRegionEdge, distances() As Double, i As Long, count As Long, connectorCount As Long, arcCount As Long
    Dim offset As CGeometryVariableOffset, region As CConcreteRegion, query As CSectionGeometryQuery, edge As TRegionEdge
    Dim options As CRebarRuleOptions, definition As CSectionDefinition, executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout
    Dim stations As Variant, halfArc As Double, rowCount As Long, sign As Double, parent As TRebarPosition, rule As TRebarRule, owner As Long
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "UserRounded300x500"
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 100#: polygon.AddVertex "BR", 300#, 0#, 100#
    polygon.AddVertex "TR", 300#, 500#, 100#: polygon.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 500#, 100#: polygon.Seal
    Set boundary = facade.RoundedPolygon("Boundary", polygon)
    count = boundary.segmentCount: ReDim edges(1 To count): ReDim distances(1 To count)
    For i = 1 To count
        boundary.CopySegment i, edges(i): distances(i) = 20#
        Select Case boundary.segmentID(i)
            Case "Corner.TR", "Edge.TR", "Corner.TL": distances(i) = 60#
        End Select
    Next i
    Set offset = New CGeometryVariableOffset: Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Set region = offset.Build(edges, distances, count, "UserRounded300x500[Top=60,Sides=20]")
    TestCheck "user.rounded.closed.one.loop", region.loopCount = 1
    region.CopyEdges edges, count
    For i = 1 To count
        edge = edges(i)
        If edge.Sweep <> 0# Then
            arcCount = arcCount + 1
            If Abs(edge.CenterY - 400#) < GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE Then _
                TestNear "user.rounded.upper.radius", Sqr((edge.X1 - edge.CenterX) ^ 2 + (edge.Y1 - edge.CenterY) ^ 2), 40#
        ElseIf Abs(edge.Y1 - 400#) < GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE And Abs(edge.Y2 - 400#) < GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE Then
            connectorCount = connectorCount + 1: TestNear "user.rounded.connector.length", Abs(edge.X2 - edge.X1), 40#
            mReport = mReport & "USER_CONNECTOR: (" & CStr(edge.X1) & "," & CStr(edge.Y1) & ") -> (" & CStr(edge.X2) & "," & CStr(edge.Y2) & ")" & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck "user.rounded.four.exact.arcs", arcCount = 4
    TestCheck "user.rounded.two.connectors", connectorCount = 2
    TestCheck "user.rounded.corner.inside", query.ContainsPoint(region, 200# + 40# / Sqr(2#), 400# + 40# / Sqr(2#), True)
    TestCheck "user.rounded.step.inside", query.ContainsPoint(region, 260#, 390#, True)
    TestCheck "user.rounded.step.outside", Not query.ContainsPoint(region, 260#, 410#, True)
    If reverse Then
        Set boundary = boundary.reversed.WithID("Boundary.Reverse"): facade.AddPath boundary
    End If
    facade.outer "Outer", boundary.id
    Set whole = facade.OffsetRoundedPolygon("MainContour", polygon, 20#)
    For i = 1 To 4
        Select Case i
            Case 1
                Set path = facade.chain("Top", whole.id, "Edge.BR", 1#, "Edge.TL", 0#)
                path.CopySegment 1, edge: halfArc = modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(edge) / 2#
                stations = Array(0#, halfArc, path.length / 2#, path.length - halfArc, path.length)
            Case 2: Set path = facade.chain("Right", whole.id, "Edge.BR", 0#, "Edge.BR", 1#)
            Case 3: Set path = facade.chain("Bottom", whole.id, "Edge.BL", 0#, "Edge.BL", 1#)
            Case 4: Set path = facade.chain("Left", whole.id, "Edge.TL", 0#, "Edge.TL", 1#)
        End Select
        sign = 1#
        If reverse Then
            Set path = path.reversed.WithID(path.id & ".Reverse"): facade.AddPath path: sign = -1#
        End If
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "UserRounded300x500[Main," & CStr(i) & "]"
        If i = 1 Then
            facade.RebarAtStations "Top.Main", path.id, stations, 4#, options
            facade.RebarContour "Top.Main", "Outer", boundary.id, 20#, "Top.Second", "", normalSign:=sign
            Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.normalOffset = sign * 40#: options.ValidateRowOffset = True
            options.SourceReference = "UserRounded300x500[Extra,Top,2]"
            facade.RebarDependent "Top.Second", "Top.Main", 4#, options
        Else
            options.EndMode = ExcludeBoth
            facade.RebarByCount "Side" & CStr(i), path.id, 3, 4#, options
            facade.RebarContour "Side" & CStr(i), "Outer", boundary.id, 20#, "", "", normalSign:=sign
        End If
    Next i
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    For i = 1 To executor.PositionCount
        If executor.PositionRuleID(i) = "Top.Second" Then
            rowCount = rowCount + 1: owner = executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i)
            executor.TestCopyTransfer i, parent, rule
            TestNear "user.rounded.preserved.x", layout.X(owner), parent.X - rule.normalOffset * parent.tangentY
            TestNear "user.rounded.preserved.y", layout.Y(owner), parent.Y + rule.normalOffset * parent.tangentX
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck "user.rounded.all.five.retained", rowCount = 5
    TestCheck "user.rounded.no.false.skip", Not TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
    mReport = mReport & "USER_CASE: reverse=" & CStr(reverse) & "; top.R2=" & CStr(rowCount) & "; R=40; connectors=40" & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Совпадение, частичное пересечение, касание и разные номера R2/R3 у соседних граней.
' Подписи формируются штатным построителем из физического CRebarLayout.
Private Sub TestOffsetNeighborMerge(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal rightFirst As Boolean, ByVal withMain As Boolean)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions, order As Variant
    Dim item As Variant, id As String, ruleID As String, X As Double, Y As Double, Diameter As Double, expectedDiameter As Double
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, i As Long, owner As Long
    Dim labels As CRebarGroupAnnotationBuilder, annotations As CSectionAnnotations, anchors(1 To 2) As TSectionAnnotation
    Dim expectedOwner As String, textTop As String, textRight As String, diagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic, warnings As Long
    Dim expectedTop As String, expectedRight As String, totalArea As Double, expectedArea As Double
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "NeighborMerge"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 1000#, 800#): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
    order = Array("Top", "Right"): If rightFirst Then order = Array("Right", "Top")
    For Each item In order
        id = CStr(item)
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "NeighborMerge[Main," & id & "]"
        If withMain Then options.AnnotationGroup = id
        If id = "Top" Then
            X = 800#: If kind = 1 Or kind = 3 Then X = 795#
            If kind = 2 Then X = 782#
            Set path = facade.LinePath("TopLine", 50#, 750#, 950#, 750#)
            facade.RebarAtStations id & ".Main", path.id, Array(X - 50#), 10#, options
            ruleID = id & ".Second": Diameter = 16#
        Else
            Y = 600#: If kind = 1 Or kind = 3 Then Y = 595#
            Set path = facade.LinePath("RightLine", 950#, 750#, 950#, 50#)
            facade.RebarAtStations id & ".Main", path.id, Array(750# - Y), 10#, options
            ruleID = id & ".Second": If kind = 3 Then ruleID = id & ".Third"
            Diameter = 20#
        End If
        facade.RebarContour id & ".Main", "Outer", "Boundary", 50#, id & ".Second", id & ".Third", normalSign:=-1#
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.normalOffset = -150#: options.ValidateRowOffset = True
        options.AnnotationGroup = id: options.SourceReference = "NeighborMerge[Extra," & id & "]"
        facade.RebarDependent ruleID, id & ".Main", Diameter, options
    Next item
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    TestCheck "neighbor.actual.bar.count", layout.count = IIf(kind = 2, 4, 3)
    TestCheck "neighbor.merged.counter", executor.MergedPositions = IIf(kind = 2, 0, 1)
    TestCheck "neighbor.actual.overlaps", executor.BarOverlaps = 0
    expectedOwner = IIf(rightFirst, "Right", "Top"): expectedDiameter = IIf(rightFirst, 20#, 16#)
    If kind <> 2 Then
        For i = 1 To executor.PositionCount
            If InStr(executor.PositionRuleID(i), ".Main") = 0 Then
                If owner = 0 Then owner = executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i)
                TestCheck "neighbor.same.physical.owner", executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i) = owner
            End If
        Next i
        TestNear "neighbor.first.diameter", layout.Diameter(owner), expectedDiameter
        TestCheck "neighbor.first.annotation.group", layout.BarAnnotationGroupName(owner) = expectedOwner
        If rightFirst Then
            TestNear "neighbor.first.x", layout.X(owner), 800#: TestNear "neighbor.first.y", layout.Y(owner), Y
        Else
            TestNear "neighbor.first.x", layout.X(owner), X: TestNear "neighbor.first.y", layout.Y(owner), 600#
        End If
        TestCheck "neighbor.summary.warning", InStr(executor.DiagnosticsText, "Предупреждение: объединено") > 0
        For i = 1 To executor.DiagnosticCount
            Set diagnostic = executor.DiagnosticAt(i)
            If diagnostic.code = "OFFSET_NEIGHBOR_MERGED" Then
                warnings = warnings + 1
                TestCheck "neighbor.warning.both.rows", InStr(diagnostic.reason, "Top.Second") > 0 And InStr(diagnostic.reason, "Right.") > 0
                TestCheck "neighbor.warning.source", InStr(diagnostic.SourceReference, "NeighborMerge[Extra,") > 0
            End If
        Next i
        TestCheck "neighbor.one.warning", warnings = 1
    End If
    anchors(1).name = "Top": anchors(1).endX = 100#: anchors(1).normalY = 1#
    anchors(2).name = "Right": anchors(2).endY = 100#: anchors(2).normalX = 1#
    Set labels = New CRebarGroupAnnotationBuilder: Set annotations = New CSectionAnnotations
    labels.AddRebarLabels annotations, layout, anchors, 2
    TestCheck "neighbor.label.count", annotations.count = IIf(kind = 2 Or withMain, 2, 1)
    For i = 1 To annotations.count
        If annotations.annotationID(i) = "REBAR_Top" Then textTop = annotations.text(i)
        If annotations.annotationID(i) = "REBAR_Right" Then textRight = annotations.text(i)
    Next i
    If withMain Then expectedTop = "1" & ChrW$(216) & "10": expectedRight = expectedTop
    If kind = 2 Or Not rightFirst Then
        If Len(expectedTop) > 0 Then expectedTop = expectedTop & " + "
        expectedTop = expectedTop & "1" & ChrW$(216) & "16"
    End If
    If kind = 2 Or rightFirst Then
        If Len(expectedRight) > 0 Then expectedRight = expectedRight & " + "
        expectedRight = expectedRight & "1" & ChrW$(216) & "20"
    End If
    TestCheck "neighbor.label.top.exact.physical.count", textTop = expectedTop
    TestCheck "neighbor.label.right.exact.physical.count", textRight = expectedRight
    For i = 1 To layout.count: totalArea = totalArea + layout.area(i): Next i
    expectedArea = GEOM_PI * (2# * 10# ^ 2 + expectedDiameter ^ 2) / 4#
    If kind = 2 Then expectedArea = GEOM_PI * (2# * 10# ^ 2 + 16# ^ 2 + 20# ^ 2) / 4#
    TestNear "neighbor.area.only.physical.bars", totalArea, expectedArea
    If kind <> 2 Then
        TestCheck "neighbor.label.only.kept.diameter", (InStr(textTop & textRight, ChrW$(216) & CStr(expectedDiameter)) > 0)
        TestCheck "neighbor.label.no.discarded.diameter", InStr(textTop & textRight, ChrW$(216) & CStr(IIf(rightFirst, 16, 20))) = 0
        If Not withMain Then TestCheck "neighbor.empty.face.no.label", Len(IIf(rightFirst, textTop, textRight)) = 0
    End If
    mReport = mReport & "NEIGHBOR_MERGE: kind=" & CStr(kind) & "; rightFirst=" & CStr(rightFirst) & "; mainLabels=" & CStr(withMain) & _
        "; physical=" & CStr(layout.count) & "; top=" & textTop & "; right=" & textRight & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Противоположные грани не являются соседними: их пересекающиеся ряды по-прежнему отклоняются.
Private Sub TestNonAdjacentRows()
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, i As Long, id As String, reason As String
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "NonAdjacentRows"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 1000#, 800#): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
    For i = 1 To 2
        id = CStr(i)
        If i = 1 Then Set path = facade.LinePath(id, 50#, 750#, 950#, 750#) Else Set path = facade.LinePath(id, 950#, 50#, 50#, 50#)
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "NonAdjacentRows[Main," & id & "]"
        facade.RebarAtStations id & ".Main", path.id, Array(450#), 10#, options
        facade.RebarContour id & ".Main", "Outer", "Boundary", 50#, id & ".Second", "", normalSign:=-1#
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.ValidateRowOffset = True
        options.normalOffset = -IIf(i = 1, 300#, 390#): options.SourceReference = "NonAdjacentRows[Extra," & id & "]"
        facade.RebarDependent id & ".Second", id & ".Main", IIf(i = 1, 16#, 20#), options
    Next i
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    TestCheck "neighbor.nonadjacent.must.reject", False
    Exit Sub
Rejected:
    reason = Err.description
    TestCheck "neighbor.nonadjacent.physical.overlap.rejected", InStr(reason, "Поперечные сечения стержней пересекаются") > 0
    TestCheck "neighbor.nonadjacent.no.merge", executor.MergedPositions = 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' При отступе 100/120 мм верхние R100 исчезают, а прямые стыкуются в острых углах.
Private Sub TestCollapsedUserCorners(ByVal topOffset As Double, ByVal reverse As Boolean)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, polygon As CPolygonSpec, path As CGeometryPath, query As CSectionGeometryQuery
    Dim offset As CGeometryVariableOffset, region As CConcreteRegion, edges() As TRegionEdge, distances() As Double
    Dim i As Long, count As Long, arcs As Long, upper As Long, direction As Double, segmentID As String
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "CollapsedUserCorners"
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 100#: polygon.AddVertex "BR", 300#, 0#, 100#
    polygon.AddVertex "TR", 300#, 500#, 100#: polygon.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 500#, 100#: polygon.Seal
    Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Boundary", polygon): direction = 1#
    If reverse Then Set path = path.reversed: direction = -1#
    count = path.segmentCount: ReDim edges(1 To count): ReDim distances(1 To count)
    For i = 1 To count
        path.CopySegment i, edges(i): distances(i) = direction * 20#
        segmentID = path.sourceSegmentID(i)
        If segmentID = "Corner.TR" Or segmentID = "Edge.TR" Or segmentID = "Corner.TL" Then distances(i) = direction * topOffset
    Next i
    Set offset = New CGeometryVariableOffset: Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Set region = offset.Build(edges, distances, count, "CollapsedUserCorners[TopOffset]")
    region.CopyEdges edges, count
    For i = 1 To count
        If edges(i).Sweep <> 0# Then arcs = arcs + 1
        If edges(i).Sweep = 0# And Abs(edges(i).Y1 - (500# - topOffset)) < GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE And _
                Abs(edges(i).Y2 - (500# - topOffset)) < GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE Then
            upper = upper + 1
            TestNear "collapsed.top.intersection.left", GeomMin(edges(i).X1, edges(i).X2), 20#
            TestNear "collapsed.top.intersection.right", GeomMax(edges(i).X1, edges(i).X2), 280#
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck "collapsed.only.bottom.arcs", arcs = 2
    TestCheck "collapsed.one.top.line", upper = 1
    TestCheck "collapsed.domain.inside", query.ContainsPoint(region, 150#, 490# - topOffset, True)
    TestCheck "collapsed.domain.outside", Not query.ContainsPoint(region, 150#, 510# - topOffset, True)
    mReport = mReport & "COLLAPSED_CORNERS: top=" & CStr(topOffset) & "; reverse=" & CStr(reverse) & "; top=(20," & CStr(500# - topOffset) & ")..(280," & CStr(500# - topOffset) & "); arcs=2" & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет контактные 2,5 мм, отключённый R2 и сдвиг SideBySide после проверки контура.
Private Sub TestContactVariants(ByVal sideBySide As Boolean, ByVal everySecond As Boolean, ByVal disabledSecond As Boolean)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions, contact As CRebarContactBuilder
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, executor As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, i As Long, count As Long
    Dim owner As Long, station As Long, expectedNormal As Double, expectedTangent As Double, binding As String
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "IndividualContact"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 1000#, 800#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left"): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
    facade.RebarContourBaseline "Outer", "Boundary", Array("Left", "Right"), 50#, "IndividualContact[SideLimits]"
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Top", 50#, 750#, 950#, 750#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.SourceReference = "IndividualContact[Main]"
    facade.RebarByCount "Main", path.id, 5, 10#, options
    facade.RebarContour "Main", "Outer", "Boundary", 50#, "Second", "Third"
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Left", 50#, 50#, 50#, 750#)
    facade.RebarAtStations "LeftMain", path.id, Array(350#), 10#, options
    facade.RebarContour "LeftMain", "Outer", "Boundary", 50#, "", ""
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Right", 950#, 750#, 950#, 50#)
    facade.RebarAtStations "RightMain", path.id, Array(350#), 10#, options
    facade.RebarContour "RightMain", "Outer", "Boundary", 50#, "", ""
    Set contact = New CRebarContactBuilder: contact.Initialize 10#, -1#, -1#, options
    binding = "EachBar": If everySecond Then binding = "EverySecondBar"
    If Not disabledSecond Then
        Set options = contact.AppendRow(10#, "Stacked", binding, "IndividualContact[Extra,2]", 40#)
        facade.RebarDependent "Second", "Main", 10#, options
    End If
    Set options = contact.AppendRow(10#, IIf(sideBySide, "SideBySide", "Stacked"), binding, "IndividualContact[Extra,3]", 40#)
    facade.RebarDependent "Third", "Main", 10#, options
    expectedNormal = 40#: expectedTangent = 0#
    If Not disabledSecond Then
        If sideBySide Then expectedTangent = -12.5 Else expectedNormal = 52.5
    End If
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set executor = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = TestBuildLayout(definition, executor)
    For i = 1 To executor.PositionCount
        If executor.PositionRuleID(i) = "Third" Then
            count = count + 1: owner = executor.PositionPhysicalOwner(i)
            station = count - 1: If everySecond Then station = 2 * station
            TestNear "contact.normal.from.Main", layout.Y(owner), 750# - expectedNormal
            TestNear "contact.tangent.after.check", layout.X(owner), 50# + 225# * station + expectedTangent
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck "contact.selected.count", count = IIf(everySecond, 3, 5)
    TestCheck "contact.no.false.skip", Not TestHasOffsetSkip(executor)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Объявляет оба ряда от Main с независимыми базовыми отступами и прежним контактом.
Private Sub TestAddRows(ByVal facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, ByVal id As String, ByVal sign As Double, _
        ByVal a2 As Double, ByVal a3 As Double, ByVal everySecond As Boolean)
    Dim contact As CRebarContactBuilder, options As CRebarRuleOptions, binding As String
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.Coincidence = KeepPublishedOwner
    Set contact = New CRebarContactBuilder: contact.Initialize 10#, sign, 1#, options
    binding = "EachBar": If everySecond Then binding = "EverySecondBar"
    Set options = contact.AppendRow(10#, "Stacked", binding, "IndividualRectangle[Extra," & id & ",2]", a2)
    facade.RebarDependent id & ".Second", id & ".Main", 10#, options
    Set options = contact.AppendRow(10#, "Stacked", binding, "IndividualRectangle[Extra," & id & ",3]", a3)
    facade.RebarDependent id & ".Third", id & ".Main", 10#, options
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Собирает только геометрию арматуры; бетонная сетка и расчёт НДС в набор не входят.
Private Function TestBuildLayout(ByVal definition As CSectionDefinition, ByVal executor As CRebarRuleExecutor) As CRebarLayout
    Dim geometry As CGeometryRegion, region As CConcreteRegion
    Set region = definition.ConcreteDomain: Set geometry = New CGeometryRegion
    geometry.Initialize region
    Set TestBuildLayout = executor.Build(definition, geometry)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Записывает результат проверки, сохраняя все отказы в итоговом отчёте.
Private Function TestHasOffsetSkip(ByVal executor As CRebarRuleExecutor) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long, diagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic
    For i = 1 To executor.DiagnosticCount
        Set diagnostic = executor.DiagnosticAt(i)
        If diagnostic.code = "OFFSET_POSITION_SKIPPED" Then
            TestHasOffsetSkip = True
            mReport = mReport & "SKIP: " & diagnostic.entityID & "; source=" & diagnostic.relatedEntityID & _
                "; x=" & CStr(diagnostic.detail1) & "; y=" & CStr(diagnostic.detail2) & "; " & diagnostic.reason & "; " & diagnostic.SourceReference & vbCrLf
        End If
    Next i
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Записывает результат проверки, сохраняя все отказы в итоговом отчёте.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal name As String, ByVal success As Boolean)
    If success Then mPassed = mPassed + 1 Else mFailed = mFailed + 1
    If Not success Then mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает координаты с допуском границы 0,000001 мм, без округления исходных значений.
Private Sub TestNear(ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    TestCheck name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE
End Sub


====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: modTestLoadTableConfig
TYPE: 1
LINES: 1000
====================================================================================================
Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: строки таблицы сочетаний Config
' ==========================================================================
' Проверяет все строки rngLoadCombinations через обычное чтение, расчёт
' и запись Results. Профили, комментарии и расположение строк проверяет
' отдельно от усилий и траекторий нагрузки. Временные значения и формулы
' восстанавливает при любом исходе; расчётные формулы программы не меняет.

Private Type TLoadTableStats
    passed As Long
    Failed As Long
    cases As Long ' Отдельные строки LC, а не количество assertions.
    report As String
End Type

Private Const FORCE_FACTOR As Double = 9806.65 ' Независимый эталон tf -> N.
Private Const MOMENT_FACTOR As Double = 9806650# ' Независимый эталон tf*m -> N*mm.
Private Const ROW_COUNT As Long = 30 ' Поадресная приемка штатного шаблона, не ограничение runtime.
Private mDiagnosticRun As Boolean ' Только отдельный диагностический entrypoint включает подробные solver logs.

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет отключение строки пустым ID, точные нули и неизменность исходных усилий.
Public Function RunLoadActivationTests() As String
    Dim stats As TLoadTableStats
    TestLoadActivationRows stats
    RunLoadActivationTests = stats.report & "TOTAL LOAD ACTIVATION: passed=" & stats.passed & "; failed=" & stats.Failed & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет тот же контракт включения LC внутри основного набора таблицы сочетаний.
Private Sub TestLoadActivationRows(ByRef stats As TLoadTableStats)
    Dim source As Object, saved As Variant, data As Variant, blank As Variant
    Dim batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, reader As CLoadCombinationReader, row As Long, column As Long, testCase As Long
    Set source = ThisWorkbook.names("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange: saved = source.formula
    On Error GoTo Failed
    data = source.value2
    For row = 2 To UBound(data, 1)
        For column = 1 To UBound(data, 2): data(row, column) = vbNullString: Next column
    Next row
    blank = data
    Set reader = New CLoadCombinationReader
    For row = 2 To UBound(data, 1): data(row, 2) = CDbl(row): data(row, 5) = "PR1": Next row
    source.value2 = data: Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, batch
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.allDisabled.count", batch.count = 0 And batch.SolverCallCount = 0
    For row = 2 To UBound(data, 1): TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.allDisabled.keepsRow." & CStr(row), CDbl(source.cells(row, 2).value2) = CDbl(row): Next row
    For testCase = 0 To 2
        data = blank: data(2, 2) = 42#: data(2, 3) = CVErr(xlErrNA): data(2, 5) = CVErr(xlErrValue): data(2, 6) = "unknown"
        If testCase = 1 Then data(2, 1) = "   "
        source.value2 = data
        If testCase = 2 Then source.cells(2, 1).formula = "="""""
        Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, batch
        TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.blankID." & CStr(testCase), batch.count = 0
        TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.keepsLoads." & CStr(testCase), CDbl(source.cells(2, 2).value2) = 42# And IsError(source.cells(2, 3).value2)
        If testCase = 2 Then TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.keepsFormula", CStr(source.cells(2, 1).formula) = "="""""
    Next testCase
    data = blank: data(2, 1) = "ZERO": data(2, 2) = 0#: data(2, 3) = -0#: data(2, 5) = CVErr(xlErrNA): data(2, 6) = "unknown"
    source.value2 = data: Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, batch
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.zeroNoValidation", batch.count = 0 And batch.SolverCallCount = 0
    data = blank: data(2, 1) = "ACTIVE_A": data(2, 2) = -1#: data(2, 5) = "PR1"
    data(3, 2) = 100#: data(3, 5) = "PR1"
    data(4, 1) = "ZERO": data(4, 5) = "PR1"
    data(5, 1) = "ACTIVE_B": data(5, 3) = 2#: data(5, 5) = "PR1"
    source.value2 = data: Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, batch
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.sparse.count", batch.count = 2
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.sparse.first", batch.combinationID(1) = "ACTIVE_A" And batch.SourceDataOffset(1) = 1
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.sparse.last", batch.combinationID(2) = "ACTIVE_B" And batch.SourceDataOffset(2) = 4
    data = blank: data(2, 1) = 0#: data(2, 2) = 1E-18: data(2, 5) = "PR1"
    source.value2 = data: Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, batch
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.numericZeroID", batch.count = 1 And batch.combinationID(1) = "0"
    TestCheck stats, "loadActivation.nonzeroNotDiscarded", batch.n(1) <> 0#
    GoTo Restore
Failed:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1: TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: loadActivation.runtime; " & Err.description
Restore:
    source.formula = saved
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ============================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: ПРОФИЛИ И ОШИБКИ LC ==============================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет все 16 сочетаний четырех переключателей каждого PR-профиля.
' Ошибка общей строки не запускает решатели, не активирует отключенные ветви
' и появляется в общем комментарии один раз; подробные блоки получают свою причину.
Public Function RunAudit03ProfileFailureScopeTests(Optional ByRef passed As Long = 0, _
        Optional ByRef Failed As Long = 0) As String
    Dim stats As TLoadTableStats, loads As Object, source As Object, system As Object
    Dim unitRange As Object, signRange As Object
    Dim savedLoads As Variant, savedProfiles As Variant, savedSystem As Variant, data As Variant
    Dim savedUnits As Variant, savedSigns As Variant
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog
    Dim section As CSectionModel, provider As CMaterialModelProvider, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator
    Dim result As CCombinationResult, retained As CCombinationResult, profile As Long, mask As Long
    Dim column As Long, row As Long, prefix As String, reason As String, oldComment As String
    Dim writer As CBatchResultWriter, anchor As Object
    Dim meta As CResultMeta, standalone As CCombinationResult
    On Error GoTo FailedRun
    Set loads = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange
    Set source = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCalculationProfiles").RefersToRange
    Set system = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    Set unitRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    Set signRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSignConventionSettings").RefersToRange
    savedLoads = loads.formula: savedProfiles = source.formula: savedSystem = system.formula
    savedUnits = unitRange.formula: savedSigns = signRange.formula
    ' Нагрузка recovery имеет независимый физический смысл: растяжение 1 tf.
    ' Scope проверяет включение ветвей, а не случайные настройки соседних UI-тестов.
    TestSetSetting unitRange, "Force", "tf", 2
    TestSetSetting unitRange, "Moment", "tf*m", 2
    TestSetSetting signRange, "+N", "Compression", 2
    TestSetSetting signRange, "+Mx", "+Y tension", 2
    TestSetSetting signRange, "+My", "+X tension", 2
    TestSetSetting system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", "0"
    TestSetSetting system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", "0"
    TestSetSetting system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", "0"
    TestSetSetting system, "Solver.ToleranceN", TestFormatNumberInvariant(0.01 / FORCE_FACTOR)
    TestSetSetting system, "Solver.ToleranceMx", TestFormatNumberInvariant(1# / MOMENT_FACTOR)
    TestSetSetting system, "Solver.ToleranceMy", TestFormatNumberInvariant(1# / MOMENT_FACTOR)
    TestSetSetting system, "Stability.Code", "SP63"
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
    TestLogLine stats, "PROFILE_SCOPE_SETUP: force=" & settings.GetString("Units.Force.Input", "") & _
        "; length=" & settings.GetString("Units.Length.Input", "") & _
        "; signN=" & settings.GetString("Sign.N.User", "") & _
        "; strategy=" & settings.GetString("Capacity.SolutionStrategy", "")
    TestBuildPhysicalFixture section, provider, settings.GetBoolean("General.DiagramExtension", False)
    For profile = 1 To 4
        For mask = 0 To 15
            source.formula = savedProfiles
            column = profile + 2
            For row = 1 To source.rows.count
                Select Case CStr(source.cells(row, 2).value2)
                    Case "Calculation.Strength.DirectState": TestSetProfileSwitch source.cells(row, column), mask, 1
                    Case "Calculation.Strength.Capacity": TestSetProfileSwitch source.cells(row, column), mask, 2
                    Case "Calculation.Crack.Width": TestSetProfileSwitch source.cells(row, column), mask, 4
                    Case "Calculation.Stability.Enabled": TestSetProfileSwitch source.cells(row, column), mask, 8
                End Select
            Next row
            Set profiles = New CCalculationProfileCatalog: profiles.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
            data = loads.value2
            For row = 2 To UBound(data, 1)
                For column = 1 To UBound(data, 2)
                    data(row, column) = vbNullString
                Next column
            Next row
            data(2, 1) = "PROFILE_SCOPE": data(2, 2) = CVErr(xlErrNA)
            data(2, 3) = 0#: data(2, 4) = 0#: data(2, 5) = "PR" & CStr(profile)
            data(2, 6) = "Auto": data(2, 7) = "Проверка области ошибки входа"
            loads.value2 = data
            Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
            Set result = batch.ResultAt(1): Set retained = result
            prefix = "profileScope.PR" & CStr(profile) & ".mask" & CStr(mask)
            reason = loads.Worksheet.name & "!" & loads.cells(2, 2).address(False, False)
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".status", result.status = "InputErr"
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".workflowTyped", result.WorkflowMeta.internalStatus = rsInvalidInput And _
                result.WorkflowMeta.resultCode = rcInvalidInput And Not result.WorkflowMeta.calculated
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".noSolve", batch.SolverCallCount = 0
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".noStates", result.StateRepository.stateCount = 0
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".singleCommonReason", TestTextOccurrences(result.OverallMeta.resultComment, reason) = 1
            If (mask And 3) <> 0 Then TestCheck stats, prefix & ".singleStrengthReason", TestTextOccurrences(result.StrengthMeta.resultComment, reason) = 1
            If (mask And 4) <> 0 Then TestCheck stats, prefix & ".singleCrackReason", TestTextOccurrences(result.CrackSummaryMeta.resultComment, reason) = 1
            If (mask And 8) <> 0 Then TestCheck stats, prefix & ".singleStabilityReason", TestTextOccurrences(result.stabilityMeta.resultComment, reason) = 1
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".direct", result.DirectStateMeta, (mask And 1) <> 0, False, reason
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".capacity", result.capacityMeta, (mask And 2) <> 0, False, reason
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".stability", result.stabilityMeta, (mask And 8) <> 0, False, reason
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".formation", result.CrackFormationMeta, (mask And 4) <> 0, False, reason
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".current", result.CrackCurrentStateMeta, (mask And 4) <> 0, True, reason
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".width", result.CrackWidthMeta, (mask And 4) <> 0, True, reason
            TestCheckProfileFailureMeta stats, prefix & ".longitudinal", result.LongitudinalCrackMeta, (mask And 4) <> 0, True, reason
            Set writer = New CBatchResultWriter: writer.WriteSummary ThisWorkbook, batch, units
            Set anchor = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngBatchSummary").RefersToRange
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".batchComment", CStr(anchor.offset(12, 2).value2) = CalculationResultMessage(batch, 1, result.OverallMeta)
            Set anchor = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngStrengthSummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".strengthComment", CStr(anchor.offset(0, 1).value2) = CalculationResultMessage(batch, 1, result.StrengthMeta)
            Set anchor = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCrackSummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".crackComment", CStr(anchor.offset(0, 1).value2) = CalculationResultMessage(batch, 1, result.CrackSummaryMeta)
            Set anchor = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngStabilitySummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".stabilityComment", CStr(anchor.offset(0, 1).value2) = CalculationResultMessage(batch, 1, result.stabilityMeta)
            TestLogLine stats, "PROFILE_SCOPE: " & prefix & "|batch=" & result.OverallMeta.resultComment & _
                "|strength=" & result.StrengthMeta.resultComment & "|crack=" & result.CrackSummaryMeta.resultComment & _
                "|stability=" & result.stabilityMeta.resultComment
            oldComment = retained.OverallMeta.resultComment
            batch.Execute
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".repeatComment", batch.ResultAt(1).OverallMeta.resultComment = oldComment
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".publishedComment", retained.OverallMeta.resultComment = oldComment
            If mask > 0 Then
                data(2, 2) = -1#: loads.value2 = data
                Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
                Set result = batch.ResultAt(1)
                TestLogLine stats, "PROFILE_SCOPE_RECOVERY: " & prefix & "; N=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(batch.n(1)) & _
                    "; overall=" & result.status & "; capacityCode=" & CStr(result.capacityMeta.resultCode) & _
                    "; capacity=" & result.capacityMeta.resultComment & "; stabilityCode=" & CStr(result.stabilityMeta.resultCode) & _
                    "; stability=" & result.stabilityMeta.resultComment
                TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".recoveryTensionN", batch.n(1), FORCE_FACTOR, 0.00000001
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".recoveryInput", result.status <> "InputErr"
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".recoveryComment", InStr(1, result.OverallMeta.resultComment, reason, vbBinaryCompare) = 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".retainedAfterRecovery", retained.OverallMeta.resultComment = oldComment
                If (mask And 1) <> 0 Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".directExecuted", result.DirectStateMeta.calculated And result.StrengthResult.DirectState.StateAvailable
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".directStillOff", result.DirectStateMeta.internalStatus = rsNotRequested
                End If
                If (mask And 2) <> 0 Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".capacityExecuted", result.capacityMeta.calculated And result.StrengthResult.capacity.LambdaCapacity > 0#
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".capacityStillOff", result.capacityMeta.internalStatus = rsNotRequested
                End If
                If (mask And 4) <> 0 Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".formationExecuted", result.CrackFormationMeta.calculated
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".currentExecuted", result.CrackCurrentStateMeta.calculated
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".crackStillOff", result.CrackFormationMeta.internalStatus = rsNotRequested
                End If
                If (mask And 8) <> 0 Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".stabilityExecuted", Len(result.StabilityResult.code) > 0 And result.stabilityMeta.internalStatus = rsNotApplicable
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".stabilityStillOff", result.stabilityMeta.internalStatus = rsNotRequested
                End If
            End If
            stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
        Next mask
    Next profile
    ' Агрегация общей валидации не должна скрывать более тяжелый технический
    ' отказ самостоятельного subtree; причины сохраняются без анализа текста.
    Set standalone = New CCombinationResult
    Set meta = New CResultMeta: meta.SetResult rsInvalidInput, rcInvalidInput, rkGeneric, "Ошибка общего ввода."
    standalone.SetWorkflowMeta meta
    Set meta = New CResultMeta: meta.SetResult rsInternalError, rcInternalError, rkDirectState, "Отдельная ошибка результата.", calculated:=False
    standalone.SetDirectStateMeta meta
    TestCheck stats, "profileScope.aggregate.typedPriority", standalone.status = "CalcErr" And standalone.OverallMeta.resultCode = rcInternalError
    TestCheck stats, "profileScope.aggregate.commonReason", InStr(1, standalone.OverallMeta.resultComment, "Ошибка общего ввода.", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    TestCheck stats, "profileScope.aggregate.ownReason", InStr(1, standalone.OverallMeta.resultComment, "Отдельная ошибка результата.", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    Set meta = standalone.WorkflowMeta: meta.Clear
    TestCheck stats, "profileScope.aggregate.metaIsolation", standalone.WorkflowMeta.internalStatus = rsInvalidInput
    GoTo Restore
FailedRun:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: profileScope.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not loads Is Nothing Then loads.formula = savedLoads
    If Not source Is Nothing Then source.formula = savedProfiles
    If Not system Is Nothing Then system.formula = savedSystem
    If Not unitRange Is Nothing Then unitRange.formula = savedUnits
    If Not signRange Is Nothing Then signRange.formula = savedSigns
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestLogLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_PROFILE_FAILURE_SCOPE: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & _
        "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed) & "; cases=" & CStr(stats.cases)
    passed = stats.passed: Failed = stats.Failed
    RunAudit03ProfileFailureScopeTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' повторяет штатный UI-prefix и scope-проверку в одной книге.
' Это воспроизводит зависимость от оставленного Config без полного восьмичастного прогона.
Public Function RunAudit03ProfileScopePrefixDiagnosticTests() As String
    RunAudit03ProfileScopePrefixDiagnosticTests = modTestWorkbookInterface.RunAudit03PreLoadTableDiagnosticTests() & _
        RunAudit03ProfileFailureScopeTests()
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задает один реальный переключатель профиля по независимой битовой маске.
' Четыре бита соответствуют DirectState, Capacity, Crack и Stability.
Private Sub TestSetProfileSwitch(ByVal cell As Object, ByVal mask As Long, ByVal bit As Long)
    If (mask And bit) <> 0 Then cell.value2 = "Yes" Else cell.value2 = "No"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Различает ошибку обязательного входа, блокировку зависимого этапа и расчет,
' отключенный профилем. Ни одна из этих ветвей не содержит численную попытку.
Private Sub TestCheckProfileFailureMeta(ByRef stats As TLoadTableStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByVal meta As CResultMeta, ByVal requested As Boolean, ByVal dependent As Boolean, ByVal address As String)
    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".notCalculated", Not meta.calculated
    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".applies", meta.Applies = requested
    If requested Then
        If dependent Then
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".internal", meta.internalStatus = rsBlockedByDependency
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".code", meta.resultCode = rcBlockedByDependency
        Else
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".internal", meta.internalStatus = rsInvalidInput
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".code", meta.resultCode = rcInvalidInput
        End If
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".reason", InStr(1, meta.resultComment, address, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    Else
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".internal", meta.internalStatus = rsNotRequested
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".code", meta.resultCode = rcNotRequested
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".noForeignReason", InStr(1, meta.resultComment, address, vbBinaryCompare) = 0
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Считает точные вхождения общей причины только для проверки presentation.
' Расчетная классификация в production не зависит от этого сравнения текста.
Private Function TestTextOccurrences(ByVal text As String, ByVal fragment As String) As Long
    If Len(fragment) > 0 Then TestTextOccurrences = UBound(split(text, fragment, -1, vbBinaryCompare))
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет целиком адресный блок LC. Optional-счетчики позволяют включить
' отчет в штатную suite без второго запуска и без подмены отдельных failures.
Public Function RunAudit03LoadTableTests(Optional ByRef passed As Long = 0, _
        Optional ByRef Failed As Long = 0) As String
    Dim stats As TLoadTableStats
    Dim loads As Object, system As Object, profilesRange As Object, unitRange As Object, signRange As Object
    Dim savedLoads As Variant, savedSystem As Variant, savedProfiles As Variant
    Dim savedUnits As Variant, savedSigns As Variant, baseline As Variant
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem
    Dim profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog, section As CSectionModel, provider As CMaterialModelProvider
    Dim column As Long, row As Long, data As Variant, path As Variant, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator
    On Error GoTo FailedRun
    Set loads = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange
    Set system = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    Set profilesRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCalculationProfiles").RefersToRange
    Set unitRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    Set signRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSignConventionSettings").RefersToRange
    savedLoads = loads.formula: savedSystem = system.formula: savedProfiles = profilesRange.formula
    savedUnits = unitRange.formula: savedSigns = signRange.formula
    If loads.rows.count <> ROW_COUNT + 1 Or loads.columns.count <> 7 Then _
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4499, "RunAudit03LoadTableTests", "Адресный fixture требует штатные 30 строк и семь колонок."

    TestSetSetting system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", "0"
    If mDiagnosticRun Then TestSetSetting system, "General.ExecutionReportEnabled", "Yes"
    TestSetSetting system, "Solver.ToleranceN", TestFormatNumberInvariant(0.01 / FORCE_FACTOR)
    TestSetSetting system, "Solver.ToleranceMx", TestFormatNumberInvariant(1# / MOMENT_FACTOR)
    TestSetSetting system, "Solver.ToleranceMy", TestFormatNumberInvariant(1# / MOMENT_FACTOR)
    TestSetSetting unitRange, "Force", "tf", 2
    TestSetSetting unitRange, "Moment", "tf*m", 2
    TestSetSetting signRange, "+N", "Compression", 2
    TestSetSetting signRange, "+Mx", "+Y tension", 2
    TestSetSetting signRange, "+My", "+X tension", 2
    TestConfigureProfiles profilesRange, False
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader
    settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set units = New CUnitSystem
    units.LoadFromSettings settings
    Set profiles = New CCalculationProfileCatalog
    profiles.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    TestBuildPhysicalFixture section, provider, settings.GetBoolean("General.DiagramExtension", False)
    TestLogLine stats, "LOAD_TABLE_CONFIG: addresses=210; effectiveExtension=" & CStr(provider.diagramExtensionEnabled)
    TestLoadActivationRows stats
    baseline = TestBaselineRows(loads)

    loads.value2 = baseline
    TestLogLine stats, "RUN: loadTable.baseline"
    Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
    TestCheckValidRows stats, loads, batch, units, "baseline", 0, False
    batch.Execute
    TestCheckValidRows stats, loads, batch, units, "repeat", 0, False

    ' Пустая составляющая нагрузки означает ноль. Комментарий и траектория имеют
    ' отдельные правила чтения; их отсутствие не делает ненулевую строку свободной.
    For Each path In Array(2, 3, 4, 6, 7)
        column = CLng(path): data = baseline
        TestLogLine stats, "RUN: loadTable.blank." & CStr(column)
        For row = 2 To ROW_COUNT + 1
            data(row, column) = vbNullString
        Next row
        loads.value2 = data
        Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
        TestCheckValidRows stats, loads, batch, units, "blank." & CStr(column), column, False
    Next path

    TestLogLine stats, "RUN: loadTable.invalid"
    TestCheckInvalidRows stats, loads, baseline, section, provider, profiles, settings, units
    TestLogLine stats, "RUN: loadTable.sparseAndReverse"
    TestCheckSparseAndReverse stats, loads, baseline, section, provider, profiles, settings, units

    ' Траектории используются в настоящем поиске несущей способности и образования
    ' трещины. Проверка не ограничивается чтением названия траектории.
    TestConfigureProfiles profilesRange, True
    Set profiles = New CCalculationProfileCatalog
    profiles.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    For Each path In Array("Auto", "LambdaMx", "LambdaMy", "LambdaMxy", "LambdaN", "LambdaNMxy")
        TestLogLine stats, "RUN: loadTable.path." & CStr(path)
        data = baseline
        For row = 2 To ROW_COUNT + 1
            data(row, 6) = CStr(path)
        Next row
        loads.value2 = data
        Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
        TestCheckActivePaths stats, loads, batch, units, CStr(path)
    Next path
    GoTo Restore
FailedRun:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: loadTable.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not loads Is Nothing Then loads.formula = savedLoads
    If Not system Is Nothing Then system.formula = savedSystem
    If Not profilesRange Is Nothing Then profilesRange.formula = savedProfiles
    If Not unitRange Is Nothing Then unitRange.formula = savedUnits
    If Not signRange Is Nothing Then signRange.formula = savedSigns
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestLogLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_LOAD_TABLE: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed) & "; cases=" & CStr(stats.cases)
    passed = stats.passed: Failed = stats.Failed
    RunAudit03LoadTableTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохраняет реальные заголовки и задает уникальные данные каждой строки.
' Малые физические нагрузки позволяют отличить перестановку компонентов
' и строк от физического отказа; все четыре ProfileId проходят через каталог.
Private Function TestBaselineRows(ByVal source As Object) As Variant
    Dim data As Variant, slot As Long
    data = source.value2
    For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
        data(slot + 1, 1) = "ATL" & format$(slot, "00")
        data(slot + 1, 2) = -1# - CDbl(slot) / 100#
        data(slot + 1, 3) = 0.02 + CDbl(slot) / 1000#
        data(slot + 1, 4) = -0.01 - CDbl(slot) / 2000#
        data(slot + 1, 5) = "PR" & CStr((slot - 1) Mod 4 + 1)
        data(slot + 1, 6) = "Auto"
        data(slot + 1, 7) = "Комментарий строки " & CStr(slot) & "; проверка порядка"
    Next slot
    TestBaselineRows = data
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Готовит один небольшой бетонный mesh и симметричные стержни для всей серии.
' Материальные числа фиксированы независимо от пользовательского ввода;
' Extension сохраняет эффективное значение режима текущего прогона.
Private Sub TestBuildPhysicalFixture(ByRef section As CSectionModel, ByRef provider As CMaterialModelProvider, _
        ByVal extensionEnabled As Boolean)
    Dim geometry As CGeometryRegion, mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder, rebars As CRebarLayout
    Set geometry = TestFixtureBox(300#, 200#)
    Set mesh = New CFiberMeshBuilder
    mesh.BuildMesh geometry, 30#, 20#, 1
    Set rebars = New CRebarLayout
    rebars.AddBar "A", -90#, -60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geometry
    rebars.AddBar "B", 90#, -60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geometry
    rebars.AddBar "C", -90#, 60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geometry
    rebars.AddBar "D", 90#, 60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geometry
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars, "Audit03LoadTable")
    Dim concrete As CConcreteMaterialParameters, steel As CSteelMaterialParameters
    Set concrete = New CConcreteMaterialParameters
    concrete.Initialize 15.5, 1.1, 22#, 1.8, 32500#, 32500#, RbMc2:=14.6
    Set steel = New CSteelMaterialParameters
    steel.Initialize 350#, 350#, 390#, 390#, 200000#, 200000#
    Set provider = New CMaterialModelProvider
    provider.TestInitializeFromParameters concrete, steel, diagramExtensionEnabled:=extensionEnabled
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Читает именованный диапазон Config, выполняет обычный расчёт сочетаний
' и записывает готовые результаты обычным классом без повторного решения НДС.
Private Function TestReadAndExecute(ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal provider As CMaterialModelProvider, _
        ByVal profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As CBatchSectionCalculator
    Dim batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, reader As CLoadCombinationReader
    Set batch = New CBatchSectionCalculator
    batch.Initialize section, provider
    Set batch.ProfileCatalog = profiles
    batch.ApplySettings settings, units
    If mDiagnosticRun Then
        Dim report As CExecutionReport
        Set report = New CExecutionReport
        report.Initialize ThisWorkbook, settings
        Set batch.executionReport = report
    End If
    Set reader = New CLoadCombinationReader
    reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, batch, units
    batch.Execute
    Set TestReadAndExecute = batch
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет единицы/знаки по независимым коэффициентам, target найденного
' НДС и соответствие конкретной строки Config конкретной строке Results.
' Повторный Execute и обратный порядок используют тот же физический oracle.
Private Sub TestCheckValidRows(ByRef stats As TLoadTableStats, ByVal source As Object, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal scenario As String, _
        ByVal blankColumn As Long, ByVal reversed As Boolean)
    Dim writer As CBatchResultWriter, summary As Object, point As CSectionStateResult
    Dim slot As Long, originalSlot As Long, prefix As String, n As Double, mX As Double, mY As Double
    Dim solves As Long, expectedComment As String
    Set writer = New CBatchResultWriter
    solves = batch.SolverCallCount
    writer.WriteSummary ThisWorkbook, batch, units
    Set summary = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngBatchSummary").RefersToRange
    TestCheck stats, "loadTable." & scenario & ".count", batch.count = ROW_COUNT
    TestCheck stats, "loadTable." & scenario & ".writerNoSolve", batch.SolverCallCount = solves
    For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
        stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
        originalSlot = slot
        If reversed Then originalSlot = ROW_COUNT + 1 - slot
        prefix = "loadTable.Slot" & CStr(slot) & "." & scenario
        n = (1# + CDbl(originalSlot) / 100#) * FORCE_FACTOR
        mX = (0.02 + CDbl(originalSlot) / 1000#) * MOMENT_FACTOR
        mY = (-0.01 - CDbl(originalSlot) / 2000#) * MOMENT_FACTOR
        If blankColumn = 2 Then n = 0#
        If blankColumn = 3 Then mX = 0#
        If blankColumn = 4 Then mY = 0#
        expectedComment = "Комментарий строки " & CStr(originalSlot) & "; проверка порядка"
        If blankColumn = 7 Then expectedComment = vbNullString
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".CombinationID", batch.combinationID(slot) = "ATL" & format$(originalSlot, "00")
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".sourceSlot", batch.SourceDataOffset(slot) = slot
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".N", batch.n(slot), n, 0.00000001
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".Mx", batch.mX(slot), mX, 0.00000001
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".My", batch.mY(slot), mY, 0.00000001
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".ProfileId", batch.ResultAt(slot).profileId = "PR" & CStr((originalSlot - 1) Mod 4 + 1)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Comment", batch.CombinationName(slot) = expectedComment
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".directStatus", batch.ResultAt(slot).DirectStateMeta.internalStatus = rsSuccess
        Set point = batch.ResultAt(slot).StrengthResult.DirectState.stateResult
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".stateExists", Not point Is Nothing
        If Not point Is Nothing Then
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".targetN", point.targetN, n, 0.00000001
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".targetMx", point.targetMx, mX, 0.00000001
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".targetMy", point.targetMy, mY, 0.00000001
        End If
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".writerID", CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 1).value2) = batch.combinationID(slot)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".writerComment", CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 2).value2) = expectedComment
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".writerResultComment", CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 3).value2) = CalculationResultMessage(batch, slot, batch.ResultAt(slot).OverallMeta)
        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".writerStatus", CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 4).value2) = batch.ResultAt(slot).status
    Next slot
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Для каждой колонки проверяет ошибку формулы; дополнительно проверяет
' пустой профиль, неизвестный путь, текст и overflow компонент; пустой ID отключает строку.
' Ошибочные строки не решаются и сохраняют собственный адрес/причину в summary.
Private Sub TestCheckInvalidRows(ByRef stats As TLoadTableStats, ByVal source As Object, ByVal baseline As Variant, _
        ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal provider As CMaterialModelProvider, _
        ByVal profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim column As Long, caseIndex As Long, slot As Long, data As Variant, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator
    Dim writer As CBatchResultWriter, summary As Object, prefix As String, reason As String, address As String
    For column = 1 To 7
        For caseIndex = 1 To 3
            If caseIndex = 3 And (column < 2 Or column > 4) Then Exit For
            If caseIndex = 2 And column = 7 Then Exit For
            If caseIndex = 2 And column = 1 Then Exit For ' Пустой ID теперь отключает строку; этот контракт проверяет RunLoadActivationTests.
            data = baseline
            For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
                Select Case caseIndex
                    Case 1: data(slot + 1, column) = CVErr(xlErrNA)
                    Case 2
                        If column = 1 Or column = 5 Then data(slot + 1, column) = vbNullString Else data(slot + 1, column) = "unknown"
                    Case 3: data(slot + 1, column) = 1E+308
                End Select
            Next slot
            source.value2 = data
            Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
            Set writer = New CBatchResultWriter
            writer.WriteSummary ThisWorkbook, batch, units
            Set summary = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngBatchSummary").RefersToRange
            prefix = "loadTable.invalid.col" & CStr(column) & ".case" & CStr(caseIndex)
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".count", batch.count = ROW_COUNT
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".noSolve", batch.SolverCallCount = 0
            For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
                stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
                reason = batch.ResultAt(slot).OverallMeta.resultComment
                address = source.Worksheet.name & "!" & source.cells(slot + 1, column).address(False, False)
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".InputErr", batch.ResultAt(slot).status = "InputErr"
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".address", InStr(1, reason, address, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".sourceSlot", batch.SourceDataOffset(slot) = slot
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".writerComment", _
                    CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 3).value2) = CalculationResultMessage(batch, slot, batch.ResultAt(slot).OverallMeta)
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".writerReason", _
                    InStr(1, CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 3).value2), reason, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".writerSource", _
                    InStr(1, CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 3).value2), batch.SourceReference(slot), vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".writerStatus", CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 4).value2) = "InputErr"
                TestLogLine stats, "LOAD_TABLE_ERROR: " & prefix & ".Slot" & CStr(slot) & "; " & reason
            Next slot
        Next caseIndex
    Next column
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Нулевые и полностью пустые строки пропускаются, но их места в Results
' остаются свободными. Перестановка всех строк не меняет физические ответы.
Private Sub TestCheckSparseAndReverse(ByRef stats As TLoadTableStats, ByVal source As Object, ByVal baseline As Variant, _
        ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal provider As CMaterialModelProvider, _
        ByVal profiles As CCalculationProfileCatalog, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim data As Variant, slot As Long, column As Long, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator
    Dim writer As CBatchResultWriter, summary As Object, index As Long
    data = baseline
    For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
        If slot Mod 3 = 0 Then
            data(slot + 1, 2) = 0#: data(slot + 1, 3) = 0#: data(slot + 1, 4) = 0#
        ElseIf slot Mod 3 = 1 Then
            For column = 1 To 7
                data(slot + 1, column) = vbNullString
            Next column
        End If
    Next slot
    source.value2 = data
    Set batch = TestReadAndExecute(section, provider, profiles, settings, units)
    TestCheck stats, "loadTable.sparse.count", batch.count = 10
    Set writer = New CBatchResultWriter
    writer.WriteSummary ThisWorkbook, batch, units
    Set summary = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngBatchSummary").RefersToRange
    For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
        If slot Mod 3 = 2 Then
            index = index + 1: stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
            TestCheck stats, "loadTable.sparse.Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".sourceSlot", batch.SourceDataOffset(index) = slot
            TestCheck stats, "loadTable.sparse.Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".writerID", CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 1).value2) = "ATL" & format$(slot, "00")
        Else
            TestCheck stats, "loadTable.sparse.Slot" & CStr(slot) & ".emptyOutput", Len(CStr(summary.cells(slot + 12, 1).value2)) = 0
        End If
    Next slot
    data = baseline
    For slot = 1 To ROW_COUNT
        For column = 1 To 7
