                prefix = "audit03.generalPlot.arrow.p" & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(key) & ".bad" & CStr(badIndex)
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, config.name, vbTextCompare) > 0 And InStr(1, reason, cell.address(False, False), vbTextCompare) > 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".preserved", TestAudit03PlotShapeExists(chart, "Audit03Sentinel")
                chart.chart.shapes.item("NDMPlot_Audit03Sentinel").Delete
                cell.value2 = values
            Next bad
        Next key
        For mode = 0 To 2
            For Each bad In Array("", "TODO", CVErr(2015))
                cases = cases + 1: TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.LoadCase", bad: settings.LoadFromWorkbook fixture
                TestAudit03ReadLifecycleLoad reader, fixture, settings, mode, code, reason
                prefix = "audit03.generalPlot.loadCase.p" & CStr(position) & ".mode" & CStr(mode) & ".type" & CStr(VarType(bad))
                If mode = 1 Then
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".inactive", code = 0 And reader.count = 2
                Else
                    Set cell = TestAudit03PlotSettingCell(table, "Plot.LoadCase")
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0 And InStr(1, reason, "Plot.LoadCase", vbTextCompare) > 0
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, config.name, vbTextCompare) > 0 And InStr(1, reason, cell.address(False, False), vbTextCompare) > 0
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".empty", reader.count = 0
                End If
            Next bad
        Next mode
        table.value2 = baseline: annotationTable.value2 = annotationBaseline: settings.LoadFromWorkbook fixture: reader.LoadFromWorkbook fixture, settings
    Next position
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Dimensions.Enabled", "Yes"
    For Each arrow In Array("Triangle", "Stealth", "Diamond", "Oval", "Open")
        Select Case CStr(arrow)
            Case "Triangle": style = 2
            Case "Stealth": style = 3
            Case "Diamond": style = 4
            Case "Oval": style = 5
            Case "Open": style = 6
        End Select
        For Each size In Array("Small", "Medium", "Wide")
            Select Case CStr(size)
                Case "Small": metric = 1
                Case "Medium": metric = 2
                Case "Wide": metric = 3
            End Select
            cases = cases + 1
            TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Dimensions.ArrowType", arrow
            TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Dimensions.ArrowSize", size
            settings.LoadFromWorkbook fixture: plotter.Draw fixture, reader, settings
            Set marker = Nothing
            For Each shape In chart.chart.shapes
                If InStr(1, shape.name, "AnnotationLine", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                    If shape.line.BeginArrowheadStyle > 1 Then Set marker = shape: Exit For
                End If
            Next shape
            prefix = "audit03.generalPlot.arrows." & CStr(arrow) & "." & CStr(size)
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".line", Not marker Is Nothing
            If Not marker Is Nothing Then
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".style", marker.line.BeginArrowheadStyle = style And marker.line.EndArrowheadStyle = style
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".length", marker.line.BeginArrowheadLength = metric And marker.line.EndArrowheadLength = metric
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".width", marker.line.BeginArrowheadWidth = metric And marker.line.EndArrowheadWidth = metric
            End If
        Next size
    Next arrow
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.generalPlot.chart.left", chart.left, 41#, 0.01
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.generalPlot.chart.top", chart.top, 53#, 0.01
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.generalPlot.chart.width", chart.Width, 700#, 0.01
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.generalPlot.chart.height", chart.Height, 480#, 0.01
    actual = sheet.range("A5:AI39").value2
    TestAudit03ComparePlainSnapshot stats, "audit03.generalPlot.ResultsUnchanged", snapshot, actual, 1
    ' На сетке >5000 точек проверяем все 17 уровней градиента. Округление
    ' номера bucket не должно пропускать нечетные целые значения.
    geometry = TestAudit03GeometrySnapshotArray("mm", 1#)
    ReDim grid(1 To 5002, 1 To 15): ReDim gridResults(1 To 5002, 1 To 7)
    For index = 1 To 15: grid(1, index) = geometry(1, index): Next index
    For index = 1 To 7: gridResults(1, index) = elements(1, index): Next index
    For row = 2 To 5002
        For index = 1 To 15: grid(row, index) = geometry(2, index): Next index
        grid(row, 1) = "C" & CStr(row - 1): grid(row, 3) = -90# + (row Mod 19) * 10#: grid(row, 4) = -90# + (row Mod 17) * 10#
        grid(row, 5) = 100#: grid(row, 8) = 10#: grid(row, 9) = 10#: grid(row, 11) = 0#
        For index = 1 To 7: gridResults(row, index) = elements(2, index): Next index
        gridResults(row, 4) = grid(row, 1): gridResults(row, 6) = -CDbl((row - 2) Mod 17)
    Next row
    sheet.range("AF5").Resize(5002, 15).value2 = grid
    sheet.range("AV5").Resize(5002, 7).value2 = gridResults
    fixture.names.item("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersTo = "=Results!$AF$5"
    fixture.names.item("rngNDMElementResults").RefersTo = "=Results!$AV$5"
    table.value2 = baseline: annotationTable.value2 = annotationBaseline
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Color.ConcreteCompression", "0,0,0"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.ResultGradient", "Yes"
    settings.LoadFromWorkbook fixture: reader.LoadFromWorkbook fixture, settings
    plotter.Draw fixture, reader, settings
    Set colors = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each series In chart.chart.SeriesCollection
        colors(CStr(series.MarkerBackgroundColor)) = True
    Next series
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.grouped.colorCount", colors.count = 17
    For index = 0 To 16
        channel = CLng(218# * (1# - CDbl(index) / 16#))
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.grouped.color" & CStr(index), colors.Exists(CStr(RGB(channel, channel, channel)))
    Next index
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.noSolve", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = solveCount
    TestAppendLine stats, "GENERAL_PLOT_CASES: variants=" & CStr(cases) & "; geometryFixtures=2; equilibriumCases=0"
    GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not fixture Is Nothing Then fixture.Close False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Объединяет существующие System/Annotation строки в отдельный стандартный
' Range. Для layout используются явно заданные независимые контрольные
' числа; они не меняют defaults каталога или исходный Config пользователя.
Private Function TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable(ByVal anchor As Object) As Object
    Dim system As Variant, keys As Variant, key As Variant, data() As Variant, row As Long, target As Long
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader
    system = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange.value2
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    keys = Array("Plot.Dimensions.Enabled", "Plot.Dimensions.TextHeight", "Plot.Dimensions.TextUnits", _
        "Plot.Dimensions.Offset", "Plot.Dimensions.LineWeight", "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineWeight", _
        "Plot.Dimensions.TextGap", "Plot.Dimensions.Placement", "Plot.Dimensions.Color", "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineColor", _
        "Plot.Dimensions.ArrowType", "Plot.Dimensions.ArrowSize", "Plot.RebarLabels.Enabled", _
        "Plot.RebarLabels.TextHeight", "Plot.RebarLabels.TextUnits", "Plot.RebarLabels.Offset", _
        "Plot.RebarLabels.LineEnabled", "Plot.RebarLabels.LineWeight", "Plot.RebarLabels.TextGap", _
        "Plot.RebarLabels.Placement", "Plot.RebarLabels.Color")
    ReDim data(1 To UBound(system, 1) + UBound(keys) + 1, 1 To 3)
    data(1, 1) = "Параметр": data(1, 2) = "Значение": data(1, 3) = "Комментарий": target = 1
    For row = 2 To UBound(system, 1)
        target = target + 1: data(target, 1) = system(row, 1): data(target, 2) = system(row, 2)
    Next row
    For Each key In keys
        target = target + 1: data(target, 1) = key: data(target, 2) = settings.GetString(CStr(key))
    Next key
    Set TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable = anchor.Resize(target, 3)
    TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable.NumberFormat = "@"
    TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable.value2 = data
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable, "Plot.LoadCase", "PLOT"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable, "Plot.Dimensions.Enabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable, "Plot.RebarLabels.Enabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable, "Plot.ResultLabelsEnabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable, "Plot.LegendEnabled", "No"
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Копирует настоящие Config-таблицы в собственный presentation fixture.
' Системные настройки не сворачиваются в трехколоночный словарь, а группы
' аннотаций сохраняют исходный компактный формат и свои реальные имена.
' Начальные значения управляют только тестовой схемой, не defaults книги.
Private Function TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable(ByVal fixture As Object, ByVal sheet As Object) As Object
    Dim name As Variant, addresses As Variant, source As Object, target As Object, index As Long
    addresses = Array("A5", "W5", "W20", "W30")
    For Each name In Array("rngSystemSettings", "rngUnitSettings", "rngSignConventionSettings", "rngPlotAnnotationSettings")
        Set source = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(name)).RefersToRange
        Set target = sheet.range(CStr(addresses(index))).Resize(source.rows.count, source.columns.count)
        target.NumberFormat = "@": target.value2 = source.value2
        fixture.names.Add name:=CStr(name), RefersTo:="='" & sheet.name & "'!" & target.address
        index = index + 1
    Next name
    Set TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable = fixture.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.LoadCase", "PLOT"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.Dimensions.Enabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.RebarLabels.Enabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.ResultLabelsEnabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.LegendEnabled", "No"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.LegendMode", "Separate"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.AxisLabelsEnabled", "Yes"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting TestAudit03NamedGeneralPlotSettingsTable, "Plot.AxisLabelsFontSize", 11#
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Возвращает именно текущую ячейку значения, а не жестко заданный адрес.
' В полном Config группы аннотаций находятся в отдельной компактной таблице;
' у автономного scalar fixture сначала используется его собственный ключ.
' Отсутствующий test-key является ошибкой fixture, а не успешной проверкой.
Private Function TestAudit03PlotSettingCell(ByVal table As Object, ByVal key As String) As Object
    Dim row As Long
    For row = 2 To table.rows.count
        If CStr(table.cells(row, 1).value2) = key Then
            Set TestAudit03PlotSettingCell = table.cells(row, 2): Exit Function
        End If
    Next row
    If left$(key, 17) = "Plot.RebarLabels." Or left$(key, 16) = "Plot.Dimensions." Then
        Set TestAudit03PlotSettingCell = TestAudit03NamedAnnotationCell(table.Worksheet.parent.names.item("rngPlotAnnotationSettings").RefersToRange, key)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Err.Raise 5, "Audit03PlotSettingCell", "В fixture нет параметра " & key
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Меняет одну ячейку только внутри собственной временной таблицы теста.
Private Sub TestAudit03SetPlotSetting(ByVal table As Object, ByVal key As String, ByVal value As Variant)
    TestAudit03PlotSettingCell(table, key).value2 = value
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохраняет исходную VBA-ошибку Draw для проверки сообщения и восстановления.
Private Sub TestAudit03CapturePlotDraw(ByVal plotter As CSectionPlotter, ByVal Workbook As Object, _
        ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByRef code As Long, ByRef reason As String)
    code = 0: reason = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    plotter.Draw Workbook, reader, settings
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    code = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Ищет фактический Shape собственного Chart; не обращается к основной книге.
Private Function TestAudit03PlotShapeExists(ByVal chart As Object, ByVal fragment As String) As Boolean
    Dim shape As Object
    For Each shape In chart.chart.shapes
        If InStr(1, shape.name, fragment, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then TestAudit03PlotShapeExists = True: Exit Function
    Next shape
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Возвращает фактическую фигуру для проверки ее цвета или шрифта. Отсутствие
' ожидаемой фигуры остается отдельным провалом assertion, без unsafe dereference.
Private Function TestAudit03PlotShape(ByVal chart As Object, ByVal fragment As String) As Object
    Dim shape As Object
    For Each shape In chart.chart.shapes
        If InStr(1, shape.name, fragment, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then Set TestAudit03PlotShape = shape: Exit Function
    Next shape
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сверяет фактический текст chart-подписи с независимым числом snapshot.
Private Function TestAudit03PlotTextExists(ByVal chart As Object, ByVal expected As String) As Boolean
    Dim shape As Object, text As String
    For Each shape In chart.chart.shapes
        text = vbNullString
        On Error Resume Next
        text = shape.TextFrame.Characters().text
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Replace(text, ",", ".") = expected Then TestAudit03PlotTextExists = True: Exit Function
    Next shape
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет координаты, шрифты, цвета и толщины при мм и pt, внутри и снаружи
' сечения, с отключённой линией арматуры. Эталон в пунктах вычисляется отдельно
' при масштабах 3.2 по X и 2.15 по Y без вызова отрисовки.
Private Sub TestAudit03AnnotationLayoutContracts(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats)
    Dim fixture As Object, sheet As Object, table As Object, settings As CSystemSettingsReader
    Dim layout As CPlotAnnotationLayout, baseline As Variant, key As Variant, bad As Variant, cell As Object
    Dim group As Variant, keys As Variant, index As Long, row As Long, position As Long, code As Long, reason As String, prefix As String
    Dim cases As Long, units As Variant, placement As Variant, sign As Double, font As Double, gap As Double, solveCount As Long
    Dim mutationKeys As Variant, changed As Variant, expected As Variant, item As Variant, metric As Variant, measured As Double
    On Error GoTo Failed
    solveCount = SectionEquilibriumSolveCount()
    Set fixture = Application.Workbooks.Add(-4167): Set sheet = fixture.Worksheets(1): sheet.name = "LayoutConfig"
    Set table = TestAudit03PlotSettingsTable(sheet.range("A5"))
    For Each group In Array("Dimensions", "RebarLabels")
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".Enabled", "Yes"
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".TextHeight", 6#
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".TextGap", 3#
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".Offset", 10#
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".LineWeight", 1.5
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".Color", "0,0,0"
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".TextUnits", "mm"
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".Placement", "Outside"
    Next group
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineWeight", 0.75
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineColor", "1,2,3"
    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.RebarLabels.LineEnabled", "Yes"
    baseline = table.value2: Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: Set layout = New CPlotAnnotationLayout
    keys = Array("Plot.Dimensions.Enabled", "Plot.Dimensions.TextHeight", "Plot.Dimensions.TextUnits", _
        "Plot.Dimensions.Offset", "Plot.Dimensions.LineWeight", "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineWeight", _
        "Plot.Dimensions.TextGap", "Plot.Dimensions.Placement", "Plot.Dimensions.Color", "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineColor", _
        "Plot.RebarLabels.Enabled", "Plot.RebarLabels.TextHeight", "Plot.RebarLabels.TextUnits", _
        "Plot.RebarLabels.Offset", "Plot.RebarLabels.LineEnabled", "Plot.RebarLabels.LineWeight", _
        "Plot.RebarLabels.TextGap", "Plot.RebarLabels.Placement", "Plot.RebarLabels.Color")
    For position = 0 To 1
        If position = 0 Then Set table = sheet.range("A5").Resize(UBound(baseline, 1), 3) Else Set table = sheet.range("CH800").Resize(UBound(baseline, 1), 3)
        table.NumberFormat = "@": table.value2 = baseline
        For Each key In keys
            Set cell = TestAudit03PlotSettingCell(table, CStr(key))
            For Each bad In Array("", "TODO", "INVALID", CVErr(2015))
                cases = cases + 1: cell.value2 = bad: settings.LoadFromRange table
                On Error Resume Next
                Err.Clear: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
                code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
                On Error GoTo Failed
                prefix = "audit03.annotation.p" & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(key) & ".bad" & CStr(VarType(bad))
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".key", InStr(1, reason, CStr(key), vbTextCompare) > 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, sheet.name, vbTextCompare) > 0 And InStr(1, reason, cell.address(False, False), vbTextCompare) > 0
                TestAppendLine stats, "ANNOTATION_ERROR: " & prefix & "|" & reason
                table.value2 = baseline: settings.LoadFromRange table: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
                layout.Initialize -100#, 100#, -100#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
                layout.AddDimension -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "DIM"
                layout.AddRebarLabel -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".recovery", layout.count = 6
            Next bad
        Next key
        mutationKeys = Array("Plot.Dimensions.TextHeight", "Plot.RebarLabels.TextHeight", _
            "Plot.Dimensions.Offset", "Plot.RebarLabels.Offset", "Plot.Dimensions.LineWeight", _
            "Plot.Dimensions.ExtensionLineWeight", "Plot.RebarLabels.LineWeight", "Plot.Dimensions.TextGap", "Plot.RebarLabels.TextGap")
        changed = Array(8#, 8#, 20#, 20#, 2.5, 1.25, 2.5, 5#, 5#)
        expected = Array(17.2, 17.2, 172#, 172#, 2.5, 1.25, 2.5, 182.75, 182.75)
        item = Array(4, 6, 3, 5, 3, 1, 5, 4, 6)
        metric = Array("Font", "Font", "Y", "Y", "Weight", "Weight", "Weight", "CenterY", "CenterY")
        For index = 0 To UBound(mutationKeys)
            cases = cases + 1
            table.value2 = baseline
            TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, CStr(mutationKeys(index)), changed(index)
            settings.LoadFromRange table: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
            layout.Initialize -100#, 100#, -100#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
            layout.AddDimension -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "DIM"
            layout.AddRebarLabel -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
            Select Case CStr(metric(index))
                Case "Font": measured = layout.fontSize(CLng(item(index)))
                Case "Y": measured = layout.Y1(CLng(item(index)))
                Case "Weight": measured = layout.weight(CLng(item(index)))
                Case "CenterY": measured = layout.Y1(CLng(item(index))) + layout.Y2(CLng(item(index))) / 2#
            End Select
            TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.annotation.mutation.p" & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(mutationKeys(index)), measured, CDbl(expected(index)), 0.000000001
            For Each bad In Array(-1#, 0#)
                cases = cases + 1
                TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, CStr(mutationKeys(index)), bad: settings.LoadFromRange table
                On Error Resume Next
                Err.Clear: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings: code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
                On Error GoTo Failed
                prefix = "audit03.annotation.sign.p" & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(mutationKeys(index)) & "." & CStr(bad)
                If CDbl(bad) = 0# And (CStr(metric(index)) = "Y" Or CStr(metric(index)) = "CenterY") Then
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".zeroAllowed", code = 0
                Else
                    Set cell = TestAudit03PlotSettingCell(table, CStr(mutationKeys(index)))
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0 And InStr(1, reason, CStr(mutationKeys(index)), vbTextCompare) > 0
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, cell.address(False, False), vbTextCompare) > 0
                End If
            Next bad
        Next index
        table.value2 = baseline
        For Each units In Array("mm", "pt")
            For Each placement In Array("Outside", "Inside")
                If CStr(placement) = "Outside" Then sign = -1# Else sign = 1#
                If CStr(units) = "mm" Then font = 12.9: gap = 6.45 Else font = 6#: gap = 3#
                For Each group In Array("Dimensions", "RebarLabels")
                    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".TextUnits", units
                    TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".Placement", placement
                Next group
                settings.LoadFromRange table: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
                layout.Initialize -100#, 100#, -100#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
                layout.AddDimension -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "DIM"
                layout.AddRebarLabel -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
                prefix = "audit03.annotation.p" & CStr(position) & "." & CStr(units) & "." & CStr(placement)
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".count", layout.count = 6
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".dimension.x", layout.X1(3), 160#, 0.000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".dimension.y", layout.Y1(3), 193.5, 0.000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".dimension.end", layout.X2(3), 480#, 0.000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".font", layout.fontSize(4), font, 0.000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".textPlacement", layout.Y1(4) + layout.Y2(4) / 2#, 193.5 + sign * gap, 0.000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".rebarPlacement", layout.Y1(6) + layout.Y2(6) / 2#, 215# + sign * (21.5 + gap), 0.000000001
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".black", layout.color(3) = 0 And layout.color(4) = 0 And layout.color(5) = 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".extensionColor", layout.color(1) = RGB(1, 2, 3)
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".lineWeight", layout.weight(3), 1.5, 0#
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".extensionWeight", layout.weight(1), 0.75, 0#
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".rebarWeight", layout.weight(5), 1.5, 0#
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".rebarFont", layout.fontSize(6), font, 0.000000001
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".arrows", layout.Arrowheads(3) And Not layout.Arrowheads(1) And Not layout.Arrowheads(5)
            Next placement
        Next units
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.RebarLabels.LineEnabled", "No"
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.RebarLabels.LineWeight", CVErr(2015)
        settings.LoadFromRange table: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
        layout.Initialize -100#, 100#, -100#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
        layout.AddRebarLabel -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.annotation.noLeader.p" & CStr(position), layout.count = 1 And layout.ItemKind(1) = "TEXT"
        For Each group In Array("Dimensions", "RebarLabels")
            TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot." & CStr(group) & ".Enabled", "No"
        Next group
        For Each key In keys
            If right$(CStr(key), 8) <> ".Enabled" Then TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, CStr(key), CVErr(2015)
        Next key
        settings.LoadFromRange table: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
        layout.Initialize -100#, 100#, -100#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
        layout.AddDimension -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "DIM"
        layout.AddRebarLabel -50#, 0#, 50#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.annotation.groupsOff.p" & CStr(position), layout.count = 0
    Next position
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.annotation.noSolve", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = solveCount
    TestAppendLine stats, "ANNOTATION_CASES: variants=" & CStr(cases) & "; layoutFixtures=1; equilibriumCases=0"
    GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.annotation.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not fixture Is Nothing Then fixture.Close False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет обычное обновление и предварительный просмотр импорта без решения НДС.
' Общее отключение схемы не требует исправления неиспользуемых параметров оформления.
' Ошибочное значение самого переключателя должно давать причину в Config.
Private Sub TestAudit03PlotEnableContracts(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats)
    Dim fixture As Object, config As Object, sheet As Object, source As Object, table As Object, target As Object
    Dim name As Variant, addresses As Variant, index As Long, position As Long, mode As Long, bad As Variant
    Dim baseline As Variant, chart As Object, marker As Object, settings As CSystemSettingsReader
    Dim code As Long, reason As String, prefix As String, solveCount As Long, props(1 To 2, 1 To 4) As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    solveCount = SectionEquilibriumSolveCount()
    Set fixture = Application.Workbooks.Add(-4167): Set config = fixture.Worksheets(1): config.name = "Config"
    Set sheet = fixture.Worksheets.Add: sheet.name = "Results"
    fixture.Worksheets.Add.name = "Расчет"
    addresses = Array("A5", "H5", "P5", "P25"): index = 0
    For Each name In Array("rngSystemSettings", "rngPlotAnnotationSettings", "rngUnitSettings", "rngSignConventionSettings")
        Set source = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(name)).RefersToRange
        Set target = config.range(CStr(addresses(index))).Resize(source.rows.count, source.columns.count)
        target.NumberFormat = "@": target.value2 = source.value2
        fixture.names.Add name:=CStr(name), RefersTo:="=Config!" & target.address
        index = index + 1
    Next name
    Set table = fixture.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange: baseline = table.value2
    sheet.range("A5").Resize(3, 15).value2 = TestAudit03GeometrySnapshotArray("mm", 1#)
    fixture.names.Add name:="rngNDMSectionGeometry", RefersTo:="=Results!$A$5"
    TestAudit03PrepareContourFixture fixture
    props(1, 1) = "LoadCase": props(1, 2) = "Parameter": props(1, 3) = "Value": props(1, 4) = "Unit"
    props(2, 1) = "ALL": props(2, 2) = "Output.LengthUnit": props(2, 3) = "mm": props(2, 4) = "-"
    sheet.range("R5").Resize(2, 4).value2 = props
    fixture.names.Add name:="rngNDMSectionProperties", RefersTo:="=Results!$R$5"
    Set chart = fixture.Worksheets.item("Расчет").ChartObjects.Add(41#, 53#, 700#, 480#): chart.name = "chtNDMSectionPlot"
    Set marker = chart.chart.shapes.AddShape(1, 11#, 17#, 20#, 20#): marker.name = "NDMPlot_Audit03Sentinel"
    For position = 0 To 1
        If position = 0 Then Set table = config.range("A5").Resize(UBound(baseline, 1), UBound(baseline, 2)) Else Set table = config.range("CH800").Resize(UBound(baseline, 1), UBound(baseline, 2))
        table.NumberFormat = "@": table.value2 = baseline: fixture.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersTo = "=Config!" & table.address
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Enabled", "No"
        TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.ContourEnabled", CVErr(2015)
        For mode = 0 To 1
            On Error Resume Next
            Err.Clear
            If mode = 0 Then UpdateSectionPlotForWorkbook fixture Else UpdateSectionGeometryPreviewForWorkbook fixture
            code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
            On Error GoTo Failed
            prefix = "audit03.generalPlot.enable.p" & CStr(position) & ".mode" & CStr(mode)
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".disabled", code = 0
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".preserved", TestAudit03PlotShapeExists(chart, "Audit03Sentinel")
            TestAppendLine stats, "PLOT_DISABLED_ENTRYPOINT: " & prefix & "|" & reason
        Next mode
        table.value2 = baseline
        For Each bad In Array("", "TODO", "INVALID", CVErr(2015))
            TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Enabled", bad
            For mode = 0 To 1
                On Error Resume Next
                Err.Clear
                If mode = 0 Then UpdateSectionPlotForWorkbook fixture Else UpdateSectionGeometryPreviewForWorkbook fixture
                code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
                On Error GoTo Failed
                prefix = "audit03.generalPlot.enable.invalid.p" & CStr(position) & ".mode" & CStr(mode) & ".type" & CStr(VarType(bad))
                Set target = TestAudit03PlotSettingCell(table, "Plot.Enabled")
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0 And InStr(1, reason, "Plot.Enabled", vbTextCompare) > 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, "Config", vbTextCompare) > 0 And InStr(1, reason, target.address(False, False), vbTextCompare) > 0
            Next mode
        Next bad
    Next position
    table.value2 = baseline: TestAudit03SetPlotSetting table, "Plot.Enabled", "Yes"
    UpdateSectionGeometryPreviewForWorkbook fixture
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.enable.recovery", TestAudit03PlotShapeExists(chart, "ElementConcrete") And Not TestAudit03PlotShapeExists(chart, "Audit03Sentinel")
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.enable.noSolve", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = solveCount
    GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.generalPlot.enable.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not fixture Is Nothing Then fixture.Close False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создаёт готовую тестовую геометрию с запретом изменений без сборщика и решателя.
' Дробные координаты и размеры изображений не зависят от текущих единиц ввода и вывода.
Private Function TestAudit03GeometrySnapshotArray(ByVal unit As String, ByVal factor As Double) As Variant
    Dim data(1 To 3, 1 To 15) As Variant, headers As Variant, column As Long
    headers = Array("ElementID", "MaterialType", "X, " & unit, "Y, " & unit, "Area, " & unit & "2", _
        "MaterialID", "GeometryInterpretationStatus", "Width, " & unit, "Height, " & unit, _
        "Diameter, " & unit, "Rotation, rad", "LocalIx, " & unit & "4", "LocalIy, " & unit & "4", "LocalIxy, " & unit & "4", "Comment")
    For column = 1 To 15: data(1, column) = headers(column - 1): Next column
    data(2, 1) = "C1": data(2, 2) = "Concrete": data(2, 3) = -23.125 / factor: data(2, 4) = 17.625 / factor
    data(2, 5) = 10828.125 / factor ^ 2: data(2, 6) = 1: data(2, 7) = "Rectangle"
    data(2, 8) = 123.75 / factor: data(2, 9) = 87.5 / factor: data(2, 10) = 0#: data(2, 11) = 0.3125
    data(2, 12) = 654321.125 / factor ^ 4: data(2, 13) = 987654.375 / factor ^ 4: data(2, 14) = -23456.625 / factor ^ 4
    data(2, 15) = "Дробные параметры Region"
    data(3, 1) = "R1": data(3, 2) = "Rebar": data(3, 3) = 12.375 / factor: data(3, 4) = -8.125 / factor
    data(3, 5) = 117.8581 / factor ^ 2: data(3, 6) = 1: data(3, 7) = "Circle": data(3, 10) = 12.25 / factor
    data(3, 15) = "Дробная арматура"
    TestAudit03GeometrySnapshotArray = data
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохраняет фактическую ошибку публичного чтения. Проверка восстановления
' повторяет чтение на том же объекте без подмены сохранённых данных.
Private Sub TestAudit03ReadLifecycleLoad(ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByVal Workbook As Object, _
        ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal mode As Long, ByRef code As Long, ByRef reason As String)
    code = 0: reason = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case mode
        Case 0: reader.LoadFromWorkbook Workbook, settings
        Case 1: reader.LoadGeometryPreviewFromWorkbook Workbook, settings
        Case 2: reader.LoadGeometryOnlyForMissingState Workbook, settings
    End Select
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    Err.Clear
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет точную сохранность каждого Value2, включая тип. Оформление и
' повторное чтение не должны даже слегка изменять готовые числа Results.
Private Sub TestAudit03ComparePlainSnapshot(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByRef baseline As Variant, ByRef actual As Variant, ByVal firstColumn As Long)
    Dim row As Long, column As Long, same As Boolean
    same = (UBound(baseline, 1) = UBound(actual, 1) And UBound(baseline, 2) = UBound(actual, 2))
    If same Then
        For row = 1 To UBound(baseline, 1)
            For column = firstColumn To UBound(baseline, 2)
                same = (VarType(baseline(row, column)) = VarType(actual(row, column)))
                If same Then same = (baseline(row, column) = actual(row, column))
                If Not same Then Exit For
            Next column
            If Not same Then Exit For
        Next row
    End If
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".exactValue2", same
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Фиксирует одну логическую проверку и не назначает статус расчетному результату.
Private Sub TestAssertTrue(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1: TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1: TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сверяет независимый координатный oracle в points с явно заданным допуском.
Private Sub TestAssertClose(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, _
        ByVal expected As Double, ByVal tolerance As Double)
    TestAssertTrue stats, name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= tolerance
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Добавляет строку только в протокол текущего направленного набора.
Private Sub TestAppendLine(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats, ByVal value As String)
    stats.report = stats.report & value & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет один снимок всеми пятью состояниями через схему и настоящий адаптер чтения экспорта.
' Адрес перенесённого Value проверяется по Name; числа и solver не меняются.
Private Sub TestSnapshotMetadataAdapterParity(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats, ByVal fixture As Object, _
        ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByVal anchor As Object)
    Dim state As Variant, value As Variant, flags As Variant, expected As Variant, statuses As Variant, canonical As Variant
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, row As Long, field As String, prefix As String, code As Long, reason As String, export As String
    Dim originalUnits As Variant
    Dim profiles As Object, cell As Object, parsedFlag As Boolean, parsedStatus As String, accepted As Boolean
    Set profiles = fixture.names.item("rngCalculationProfiles").RefersToRange
    originalUnits = anchor.cells(1, 4).Resize(18, 1).value2
    anchor.cells(2, 4).Resize(6, 1).value2 = "mm"
    anchor.cells(9, 4).Resize(2, 1).value2 = "1/mm"
    anchor.cells(11, 3).Resize(2, 1).NumberFormat = "@" ' Неверные числовые строки должны оставаться строками, а не преобразовываться Excel при записи.

    flags = Array(True, False, "TRUE", "false", "YeS", "nO", "ДА", "Нет", 1, 0, " 1 ", "0")
    expected = Array(True, False, True, False, True, False, True, False, True, False, True, False)
    statuses = Array("OK", "FAIL", "BaseFail", "NumFail", "InputErr", "CalcErr", "N/A", "nUmFaIl", " inputerr ")
    canonical = Array("OK", "FAIL", "BaseFail", "NumFail", "InputErr", "CalcErr", "N/A", "NumFail", "InputErr")
    For Each value In Array(Empty, Null, CVErr(2015), "", "TODO", Array(1, 2))
        parsedFlag = True: parsedStatus = "OK"
        accepted = TryReadSnapshotBoolean(value, parsedFlag)
        TestAssertTrue stats, "snapshot.shared.boolean.invalid", Not accepted And Not parsedFlag
        accepted = TryReadSnapshotStatus(value, parsedStatus)
        TestAssertTrue stats, "snapshot.shared.status.invalid", Not accepted And parsedStatus = ""
    Next value
    For Each state In Array("StrengthState", "CapacityState", "PreCrackState", "PostCrackState", "CrackedState")
        For row = 8 To 12
            field = Choose(row - 7, "Epsilon0", "KappaX", "KappaY", "ExtensionUsed", "Status")
            anchor.cells(row, 2).value2 = "State." & CStr(state) & "." & field
        Next row
        fixture.Worksheets("Results").range("T36:T37").value2 = state
        For row = 2 To profiles.rows.count
            If CStr(profiles.cells(row, 2).value2) = "Visualization.State" Then profiles.cells(row, 3).value2 = state
        Next row
        prefix = "snapshot.parity." & CStr(state) & "." & anchor.address(False, False)
        For i = 0 To UBound(flags)
            anchor.cells(11, 3).value2 = flags(i): anchor.cells(12, 3).value2 = "OK"
            reader.LoadFromWorkbook fixture, settings
            export = TestReadStateMetadataForTests(fixture, "PLOT", CStr(state))
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".boolean." & CStr(i), reader.ExtensionUsed = CBool(expected(i)) And _
                left$(export, InStr(export, "|") - 1) = CStr(expected(i))
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".physicalWarning." & CStr(i), reader.PhysicalDiagramWarningRequired = CBool(expected(i)) And _
                (Len(mid$(export, InStr(export, "|") + 1)) > 0) = CBool(expected(i))
        Next i
        anchor.cells(11, 3).value2 = False
        For i = 0 To UBound(statuses)
            anchor.cells(12, 3).value2 = statuses(i)
            reader.LoadFromWorkbook fixture, settings
            export = TestReadStateMetadataForTests(fixture, "PLOT", CStr(state))
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".status." & CStr(i), reader.DirectStateStatus = CStr(canonical(i))
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".statusWarning." & CStr(i), (Len(mid$(export, InStr(export, "|") + 1)) > 0) = _
                (CStr(canonical(i)) = "FAIL" Or CStr(canonical(i)) = "NumFail")
        Next i
        For j = 11 To 12
            Set cell = anchor.cells(j, 3)
            For Each value In Array(Empty, Null, CVErr(2015), "", "TODO", "INVALID", "1,0", "2")
                If IsNull(value) Or IsEmpty(value) Then cell.ClearContents Else cell.value2 = value
                TestAudit03ReadLifecycleLoad reader, fixture, settings, 0, code, reason
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".invalid.plot." & CStr(j), code <> 0 And _
                    InStr(reason, "Results!" & cell.address(False, False)) > 0
                On Error Resume Next
                Err.Clear
                export = TestReadStateMetadataForTests(fixture, "PLOT", CStr(state))
                code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
                Err.Clear
                On Error GoTo 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".invalid.export." & CStr(j), code <> 0 And _
                    InStr(reason, "Results!" & cell.address(False, False)) > 0 And InStr(reason, CStr(anchor.cells(j, 2).value2)) > 0
            Next value
            anchor.cells(11, 3).value2 = False: anchor.cells(12, 3).value2 = "OK"
        Next j
    Next state
    For row = 8 To 12
        field = Choose(row - 7, "Epsilon0", "KappaX", "KappaY", "ExtensionUsed", "Status")
        anchor.cells(row, 2).value2 = "State.StrengthState." & field
    Next row
    fixture.Worksheets("Results").range("T36:T37").value2 = "StrengthState"
    For row = 2 To profiles.rows.count
        If CStr(profiles.cells(row, 2).value2) = "Visualization.State" Then profiles.cells(row, 3).value2 = "StrengthState"
    Next row
    anchor.cells(1, 4).Resize(18, 1).value2 = originalUnits
    anchor.cells(11, 3).Resize(2, 1).NumberFormat = "General"
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: структура общего описания вершин многоугольника.
' ==========================================================================
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String
Private Type TDoubleValue
    value As Double
End Type
Private Type TDoubleWords
    low As Long
    high As Long
End Type

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' порядок/источники, более шести вершин, ошибки и повторное чтение снимка.
Public Function RunPolygonSpecTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim polygon As CPolygonSpec, n As Variant, i As Long, errorCode As Long, reason As String
    Dim vertices As Variant, radii As Variant, names As Variant, number As TDoubleValue, words As TDoubleWords
    For Each n In Array(4, 5, 6, 9)
        Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
        TestCheck "new.open." & CStr(n), Not polygon.IsSealed And polygon.count = 0
        For i = 1 To CLng(n)
            polygon.AddVertex "V" & CStr(i), i * 10#, -i * 20#, i - 1#, "Config!C" & CStr(i)
        Next i
        TestCheck "count.before.seal." & CStr(n), polygon.count = CLng(n)
        polygon.Seal: polygon.Seal
        TestCheck "sealed." & CStr(n), polygon.IsSealed
        For i = 1 To CLng(n)
            TestCheck "record." & CStr(n) & "." & CStr(i), polygon.VertexID(i) = "V" & CStr(i) And _
                polygon.X(i) = i * 10# And polygon.Y(i) = -i * 20# And polygon.FilletRadius(i) = i - 1# And _
                polygon.SourceReference(i) = "Config!C" & CStr(i)
        Next i
        polygon.CopyKernelData vertices, radii, names
        vertices(0) = Array(-1#, -2#): radii(0) = 999#: names(0) = "Changed"
        TestCheck "kernel.copy.independent." & CStr(n), polygon.X(1) = 10# And polygon.FilletRadius(1) = 0# And polygon.VertexID(1) = "V1"
        On Error Resume Next
        polygon.AddVertex "After", 0#, 0#, 0#, "Config!After"
        errorCode = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo Failed
        TestCheck "reject.after.seal." & CStr(n), errorCode <> 0 And polygon.count = CLng(n) And InStr(reason, "Config!After") > 0
    Next n
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "A", 0#, 0#
    polygon.AddVertex "a", 1#, 0#
    TestCheck "ids.binary.case", polygon.count = 2
    On Error Resume Next
    polygon.AddVertex "A", 0#, 1#, 0#, "Config!Duplicate"
    errorCode = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "reject.duplicate", errorCode <> 0 And polygon.count = 2 And InStr(reason, "Config!Duplicate") > 0
    On Error Resume Next
    polygon.AddVertex " ", 0#, 1#, 0#, "Config!Empty"
    errorCode = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "reject.empty.id", errorCode <> 0 And polygon.count = 2
    On Error Resume Next
    polygon.AddVertex "Negative", 0#, 1#, -1#, "Config!Radius"
    errorCode = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "reject.negative.radius", errorCode <> 0 And polygon.count = 2 And InStr(reason, "Config!Radius") > 0
    On Error Resume Next
    polygon.Seal
    errorCode = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "reject.incomplete", errorCode <> 0 And Not polygon.IsSealed
    words.high = &H7FF00000: LSet number = words
    On Error Resume Next
    polygon.AddVertex "Inf", number.value, 1#
    errorCode = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "reject.infinity", errorCode <> 0 And polygon.count = 2
    words.low = 1: LSet number = words
    On Error Resume Next
    polygon.AddVertex "NaN", 1#, 1#, number.value
    errorCode = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "reject.nan", errorCode <> 0 And polygon.count = 2
    polygon.AddVertex "B", 0#, 1#: polygon.Seal
    TestCheck "recover.after.failed.seal", polygon.count = 3 And polygon.IsSealed
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunPolygonSpecTests = mReport & "TOTAL POLYGON SPEC: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function
' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' явные имена, прежние вызовы, преобразования, происхождение и публикация контуров.
Public Function RunNamedSegmentTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestNamedPolygonInput
    TestNamedPolygonOperations
    TestNamedRectangles
    TestNamedPublication
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunNamedSegmentTests = mReport & "TOTAL NAMED SEGMENTS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' проверяем эффективные имена до геометрии, включая отсутствующие дуги и грани.
Private Sub TestNamedPolygonInput()
    Dim p As CPolygonSpec, code As Long, reason As String
    Dim vertices As Variant, radii As Variant, names As Variant, edges As Variant, corners As Variant
    Set p = New CPolygonSpec
    p.AddVertex "A", 0#, 0#, OutgoingEdgeID:="Bottom", CornerID:="Round.A"
    On Error Resume Next
    p.AddVertex "B", 100#, 0#, 0#, "Config!Duplicate", "Round.A"
    code = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "duplicate.collapsed.corner", code <> 0 And p.count = 1 And InStr(reason, "Config!Duplicate") > 0
    On Error Resume Next
    p.AddVertex "B", 100#, 0#, 0#, "", "X", "X"
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "duplicate.same.vertex", code <> 0 And p.count = 1
    p.AddVertex "B", 100#, 0#, OutgoingEdgeID:="", CornerID:="Round.B"
    On Error Resume Next
    p.AddVertex "C", 100#, 80#, 40#, "", "Edge.B"
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "duplicate.explicit.default", code <> 0 And p.count = 2
    On Error Resume Next
    p.AddVertex "C", 100#, 80#, 40#, "", "Edge.B", "Unused"
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "duplicate.reserved.vanishing.edge", code <> 0 And p.count = 2
    p.AddVertex "C", 100#, 80#, 0#, "", "bottom" ' Регистр имён различается, как и прежде.
    p.AddVertex "D", 0#, 80#, 0#, "", " ", " "
    p.Seal
    TestCheck "partial.names", p.OutgoingEdgeID(1) = "Bottom" And p.CornerID(1) = "Round.A" And p.VertexID(1) = "A"
    TestCheck "empty.names.defaults", p.OutgoingEdgeID(2) = "Edge.B" And p.CornerID(3) = "Corner.C"
    TestCheck "whitespace.names.defaults", p.OutgoingEdgeID(4) = "Edge.D" And p.CornerID(4) = "Corner.D"
    p.CopyKernelData vertices, radii, names, edges, corners
    edges(0) = "Changed": corners(0) = "Changed": names(0) = "Changed"
    TestCheck "kernel.names.independent", p.OutgoingEdgeID(1) = "Bottom" And p.CornerID(1) = "Round.A" And p.VertexID(1) = "A"
    On Error Resume Next
    p.AddVertex "E", 1#, 1#, OutgoingEdgeID:="New"
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "sealed.names.immutable", code <> 0 And p.count = 4 And p.OutgoingEdgeID(1) = "Bottom"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' создаём одинаковую геометрию с автоматическими либо явно объявленными именами.
Private Function TestNamedBoxPolygon(ByVal radius As Double, Optional ByVal named As Boolean = True) As CPolygonSpec
    Dim p As CPolygonSpec, points As Variant, point As Variant, i As Long, id As String, edgeNames As Variant
    Set p = New CPolygonSpec
    points = Array(Array(0#, 0#), Array(100#, 0#), Array(100#, 80#), Array(0#, 80#))
    edgeNames = Array("Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
    For i = 0 To 3
        point = points(i): id = Chr$(65 + i)
        If named Then
            p.AddVertex id, CDbl(point(0)), CDbl(point(1)), radius, "Config!" & id, CStr(edgeNames(i)), "Round." & id
        Else
            p.AddVertex id, CDbl(point(0)), CDbl(point(1)), radius, "Config!" & id
        End If
    Next i
    p.Seal: Set TestNamedBoxPolygon = p
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' имена не меняют точные линии и дуги, а производные пути сохраняют исходные параметры.
Private Sub TestNamedPolygonOperations()
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, named As CPolygonSpec, legacy As CPolygonSpec
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, old As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath, moved As CGeometryPath, reverse As CGeometryPath
    Dim i As Long, radius As Variant, distance As Variant, first As Double, code As Long, A As TRegionEdge, B As TRegionEdge
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    For Each radius In Array(0#, 10#, 40#)
        Set named = TestNamedBoxPolygon(CDbl(radius)): Set legacy = TestNamedBoxPolygon(CDbl(radius), False)
        For Each distance In Array(0#, 5#, -5#, 15#)
            Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Box", named, CDbl(distance))
            Set old = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Box", legacy, CDbl(distance))
            TestCompareNamedGeometry "polygon." & CStr(radius) & ".offset." & CStr(distance), old, path
            TestCheck "polygon.source.unchanged", named.X(1) = 0# And named.FilletRadius(1) = CDbl(radius) And named.OutgoingEdgeID(1) = "Bottom"
        Next distance
        Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Box", named)
        Set old = query.RoundedPolygon("Box", legacy)
        TestCompareNamedGeometry "polygon.base." & CStr(radius), old, path
        If CDbl(radius) = 0# Then
            TestCheck "zero.corner.anchor", path.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.A") And path.AnchorStation("Round.A", 0#) = path.AnchorStation("Round.A", 1#)
            Set moved = query.offsetPath("ExistingOffset", path, 5#)
            TestCheck "offset.keeps.collapsed.corner", moved.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.A") And moved.AnchorStation("Round.B") = moved.AnchorStation("Right")
        ElseIf CDbl(radius) = 40# Then
            TestCheck "zero.edge.anchor", path.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Right") And Not path.HasSegmentID("Right")
            Set moved = query.offsetPath("ExistingOffset", path, 5#)
            TestCheck "offset.keeps.collapsed.edge", moved.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Right") And moved.AnchorStation("Right") = moved.AnchorStation("Round.C")
            TestCheck "zero.edge.no.fake.geometry", moved.segmentCount = path.segmentCount
        Else
            Set moved = query.offsetPath("ExistingOffset", path, 5#)
            TestCheck "offset.name.origin", moved.segmentID(1) = "Round.A" And moved.sourcePathID(1) = "Box" And moved.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Round.A"
        End If
        Set moved = path.transformed(15#, -20#, GEOM_PI / 3#, True)
        Set reverse = moved.reversed
        TestCompareNamedGeometry "transform.named." & CStr(radius), old.transformed(15#, -20#, GEOM_PI / 3#, True), moved
        TestCompareNamedGeometry "reverse.named." & CStr(radius), moved.reversed, reverse
        For i = 1 To path.segmentCount
            TestCheck "transform.name.origin", moved.segmentID(i) = path.segmentID(i) And moved.sourcePathID(i) = path.sourcePathID(i) And moved.sourceSegmentID(i) = path.sourceSegmentID(i)
            path.CopySegment i, A: moved.CopySegment i, B
            TestCheck "reflection.arc.sweep", B.Sweep = -A.Sweep
            TestCheck "reverse.name.origin", reverse.segmentID(path.segmentCount - i + 1) = path.segmentID(i) And reverse.SourceStartParameter(path.segmentCount - i + 1) = path.SourceEndParameter(i)
        Next i
        If path.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Right") Then TestCheck "transform.collapsed.edge", moved.AnchorStation("Right") = path.AnchorStation("Right")
        If path.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.A") Then TestCheck "reverse.collapsed.corner", reverse.AnchorStation("Round.A") = path.length - path.AnchorStation("Round.A")
    Next radius
    Set named = TestNamedBoxPolygon(10#): Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Box", named)
    first = path.AnchorStation("Bottom", 0.25)
    Set part = path.Slice(first, path.AnchorStation("Bottom", 0.75))
    TestCheck "slice.name.origin", part.segmentID(1) = "Bottom" And part.sourcePathID(1) = "Box" And part.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Bottom"
    TestCheck "slice.parameters", Abs(part.SourceStartParameter(1) - 0.25) < 0.000000001 And Abs(part.SourceEndParameter(1) - 0.75) < 0.000000001
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Lap", "Bottom", 0.25, "Bottom", 0.25, True, True)
    TestCheck "full.loop.split", part.IsClosed And part.segmentCount = path.segmentCount + 1 And part.segmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Bottom.Part2"
    TestCheck "full.loop.origin", part.sourceSegmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Bottom" And part.sourcePathID(part.segmentCount) = "Box"
    TestCheck "full.loop.parameters", Abs(part.SourceStartParameter(1) - 0.25) < 0.000000001 And Abs(part.SourceEndParameter(part.segmentCount) - 0.25) < 0.000000001
    Set reverse = part.reversed: Set moved = reverse.transformed(1#, 2#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True)
    TestCheck "parts.transform.origin", moved.segmentID(1) = "Bottom.Part2" And moved.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Bottom" And moved.SourceStartParameter(1) = part.SourceEndParameter(part.segmentCount)
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Backwards", "Top", 0.8, "Bottom", 0.2, False)
    TestCheck "chain.backwards", part.segmentID(1) = "Top" And part.SourceStartParameter(1) > part.SourceEndParameter(1)
    Set named = TestNamedBoxPolygon(0#): Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Sharp", named)
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("SharpSide", "Top", 0.5, "Bottom", 0.5)
    TestCheck "chain.collapsed.inside", part.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.D") And part.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.A")
    TestCheck "chain.collapsed.outside", Not part.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.B") And Not part.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Round.C")
    On Error Resume Next
    i = path.segmentIndex("Round.A")
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "collapsed.not.real.segment", code <> 0
    On Error Resume Next
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Invalid", "Top", 0#, "Top", 0#)
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "full.loop.explicit.required", code <> 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' сравниваем координаты и точные дуги независимо от намеренно разных имён.
Private Sub TestCompareNamedGeometry(ByVal title As String, ByVal old As CGeometryPath, ByVal actual As CGeometryPath)
    Dim i As Long, A As TRegionEdge, B As TRegionEdge
    TestCheck title & ".count", old.segmentCount = actual.segmentCount And old.IsClosed = actual.IsClosed
    TestCheck title & ".length", old.length = actual.length
    For i = 1 To old.segmentCount
        old.CopySegment i, A: actual.CopySegment i, B
        TestCheck title & ".edge." & CStr(i), A.X1 = B.X1 And A.Y1 = B.Y1 And A.X2 = B.X2 And A.Y2 = B.Y2 And A.CenterX = B.CenterX And A.CenterY = B.CenterY And A.Sweep = B.Sweep
    Next i
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' стороны узнаём по фактическим координатам; прежний порядок и начало не меняются.
Private Sub TestNamedRectangles()
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, old As CGeometryPath, named As CGeometryPath, partial As CGeometryPath
    Dim part As CGeometryPath, i As Long, edge As TRegionEdge, code As Long
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "Names"
    Set old = facade.RectanglePath("Legacy", -20#, 30#, 100#, 80#)
    Set named = facade.RectanglePath("Named", -20#, 30#, 100#, 80#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
    Set partial = facade.RectanglePath("Partial", -20#, 30#, 100#, 80#, topEdgeID:="Top")
    TestCompareNamedGeometry "rectangle", old, named
    For i = 1 To named.segmentCount
        named.CopySegment i, edge
        Select Case named.segmentID(i)
            Case "Bottom": TestCheck "rectangle.bottom.direction", edge.Y1 = 30# And edge.Y2 = 30# And edge.X2 > edge.X1
            Case "Right": TestCheck "rectangle.right.direction", edge.X1 = 80# And edge.X2 = 80# And edge.Y2 > edge.Y1
            Case "Top": TestCheck "rectangle.top.direction", edge.Y1 = 110# And edge.Y2 = 110# And edge.X2 < edge.X1
            Case "Left": TestCheck "rectangle.left.direction", edge.X1 = -20# And edge.X2 = -20# And edge.Y2 < edge.Y1
            Case Else: TestCheck "rectangle.unknown.side", False
        End Select
        TestCheck "rectangle.origin.named", named.sourceSegmentID(i) = named.segmentID(i) And named.sourcePathID(i) = "Named"
        If named.segmentID(i) <> "Top" Then TestCheck "rectangle.partial.defaults", partial.segmentID(i) = "Partial." & CStr(i)
        TestCheck "rectangle.legacy.defaults", old.segmentID(i) = "Legacy." & CStr(i)
    Next i
    Set part = facade.chain("Across", named.id, "Top", 0.5, "Bottom", 0.5)
    TestCheck "rectangle.chain.top.bottom", part.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Top" And part.sourceSegmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Bottom"
    Set part = facade.Transform("Turned", named.id, 0#, 0#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True)
    TestCheck "rectangle.transformed.original.meaning", part.HasSegmentID("Top") And part.sourcePathID(part.segmentIndex("Top")) = "Named"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set part = facade.RectanglePath("Duplicate", 0#, 0#, 10#, 10#, "Side", "Side")
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "rectangle.duplicates", code <> 0
    On Error Resume Next
    Set part = facade.RectanglePath("DefaultCollision", 0#, 0#, 10#, 10#, "DefaultCollision.2")
    code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestCheck "rectangle.explicit.default.duplicate", code <> 0
    Set part = facade.RectanglePath("Repeat", 0#, 0#, 100#, 80#, "Side", "Side.Part2", "Top", "Left")
    Set part = facade.chain("RepeatLap", part.id, "Side", 0.5, "Side", 0.5, True, True)
    TestCheck "parts.skip.reserved.suffix", part.segmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Side.Part3" And part.sourceSegmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Side"
    Dim polygon As CPolygonSpec
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "A", 0#, 0#, OutgoingEdgeID:="Bottom", CornerID:="Bottom.Part2"
    polygon.AddVertex "B", 100#, 0#, OutgoingEdgeID:="Right"
    polygon.AddVertex "C", 100#, 80#, OutgoingEdgeID:="Top"
    polygon.AddVertex "D", 0#, 80#, OutgoingEdgeID:="Left"
    polygon.Seal
    Set part = facade.RoundedPolygon("ReservedCorner", polygon)
    Set part = facade.chain("ReservedLap", part.id, "Bottom", 0.5, "Bottom", 0.5, True, True)
    TestCheck "parts.skip.collapsed.name", part.segmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Bottom.Part3" And part.HasCollapsedSegmentID("Bottom.Part2")
    TestCheck "parts.collapsed.origin", part.sourceSegmentID(part.segmentCount) = "Bottom" And part.sourcePathID(part.segmentCount) = "ReservedCorner"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' локальные имена могут повторяться; роли и опубликованные имена их не меняют.
Private Sub TestNamedPublication()
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, A As CGeometryPath, B As CGeometryPath, hole As CGeometryPath
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, contours As CSectionContours, i As Long
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "Publication"
    Set A = facade.RectanglePath("A", 0#, 0#, 100#, 100#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
    Set B = facade.RectanglePath("B", 200#, 0#, 100#, 100#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
    Set hole = facade.RectanglePath("Hole", 20#, 20#, 20#, 20#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
    facade.outer "OuterA", A.id
    facade.outer "OuterB", B.id, namingPolicy:=SequentialByKind, namingPrefix:="B"
    facade.opening "OpeningA", hole.id, "OuterA", namingPolicy:=SequentialByKind, namingPrefix:="H"
    Set hole = facade.RectanglePath("Hole2", 250#, 20#, 20#, 20#, "Bottom", "Right", "Top", "Left")
    facade.opening "OpeningB", hole.id, "OuterB", contourIDs:=Array("H2.1", "H2.2", "H2.3", "H2.4")
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set contours = definition.MaterialContours()
    TestCheck "publication.four.loops", contours.count = 16
    For i = 1 To A.segmentCount
        TestCheck "publication.preserve", contours.contourID(i) = A.segmentID(i)
        TestCheck "publication.sequential", contours.contourID(i + 4) = "B_LINE_" & CStr(i)
        TestCheck "publication.opening.sequential", contours.contourID(i + 8) = "H_LINE_" & CStr(i)
        TestCheck "publication.explicit", contours.contourID(i + 12) = "H2." & CStr(i)
        TestCheck "publication.roles", contours.LoopID(i) = "OuterA" And contours.loopRole(i + 8) = "Opening"
        TestCheck "publication.paths.unchanged", A.segmentID(i) = B.segmentID(i) And B.segmentID(i) = hole.segmentID(i)
    Next i
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "MixedPublication"
    Set A = facade.RoundedPolygon("Mixed", TestNamedBoxPolygon(40#))
    facade.outer "Outer", A.id, namingPolicy:=SequentialByKind, namingPrefix:="Mixed"
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set contours = definition.MaterialContours()
    Dim edge As TRegionEdge, kind As String
    For i = 1 To A.segmentCount
        A.CopySegment i, edge
        If edge.Sweep = 0# Then kind = "LINE" Else kind = "ARC"
        TestCheck "publication.mixed.common.counter", contours.contourID(i) = "Mixed_" & kind & "_" & CStr(i)
        TestCheck "publication.mixed.local.unchanged", A.sourceSegmentID(i) = A.segmentID(i)
    Next i
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' добавляем результат одной независимой проверки в журнал.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1: mReport = mReport & "PASS: " & name & vbCrLf
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: профили и длительные нагрузки устойчивости
' ==========================================================================
' Проверяет ячейки PR1–PR4, выбор материалов и сохранённых результатов схемы.
' Ожидаемые материалы задаёт независимо; равновесие проверяет по элементам.
' Дополнительные нагрузки читает обычным способом. Ошибка строки должна
' сохраняться в результате её устойчивости. Все затронутые таблицы
' восстанавливаются также при ошибке; рабочие допуски не меняются.

Private Type TProfileStats
    passed As Long
    Failed As Long
    cases As Long ' Варианты поля/профиля, не число assertions.
    report As String
End Type

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ============================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ ==============================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет цельную приемку material spec, метаданных и визуализации профилей.
' Optional-счетчики включают те же assertions в штатную workbook suite.
Public Function RunAudit03ProfileConfigTests(Optional ByRef passed As Long = 0, _
        Optional ByRef Failed As Long = 0) As String
    Dim stats As TProfileStats, names As Variant, saved(0 To 4) As Variant
    Dim source As Object, system As Object, unitsRange As Object, signs As Object, loads As Object
    Dim i As Long, section As CSectionModel, provider As CMaterialModelProvider
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem
    On Error GoTo FailedRun
    names = Array("rngCalculationProfiles", "rngSystemSettings", "rngUnitSettings", _
        "rngSignConventionSettings", "rngLoadCombinations")
    For i = 0 To UBound(names)
        saved(i) = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(i))).RefersToRange.formula
    Next i
    Set source = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCalculationProfiles").RefersToRange
    Set system = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    Set unitsRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    Set signs = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSignConventionSettings").RefersToRange
    Set loads = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange
    TestSetTableValue unitsRange, "Length", "mm", 2
    TestSetTableValue unitsRange, "Force", "N", 2
    TestSetTableValue unitsRange, "Moment", "N*mm", 2
    TestSetTableValue unitsRange, "Stress", "MPa", 2
    TestSetTableValue signs, "+N", "Tension", 2
    TestSetTableValue signs, "+Mx", "+Y tension", 2
    TestSetTableValue signs, "+My", "+X tension", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Calculation.ZeroMomentPerDepth", "0", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetX", "0", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Load.ReferenceOffsetY", "0", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Solver.ToleranceN", "0.01", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Solver.ToleranceMx", "1", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Solver.ToleranceMy", "1", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "SLS.Crack.PsiMode", "AlwaysCalc", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Capacity.SolutionStrategy", "Auto", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.Code", "SP35", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.ElementLength", "1000", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.Mu1", "1", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.Mu2", "1", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.AccidentalEccentricityMode", "User", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.AccidentalEccentricityPlanes", "BothPlanes", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.AccidentalEccentricityUser1", "200", 2
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.AccidentalEccentricityUser2", "200", 2
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
    TestBuildFixture section, provider, settings.GetBoolean("General.DiagramExtension", False)
    TestLogLine stats, "PROFILE_CONFIG: effectiveExtension=" & CStr(provider.diagramExtensionEnabled)
    TestMaterialSpecs stats, source, loads, section, provider, settings, units
    TestStabilityValueSets stats, source, loads, section, provider, settings, units
    TestProfileMetadata stats, source, loads, section, provider, settings, units
    TestVisualization stats, source, system, loads, section, provider, settings, units
    TestInvalidProfileCells stats, source
    GoTo Restore
FailedRun:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: profileConfig.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    For i = 0 To UBound(names)
        ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(i))).RefersToRange.formula = saved(i)
    Next i
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestLogLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_PROFILE_CONFIG: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & _
        "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed) & "; cases=" & CStr(stats.cases)
    passed = stats.passed: Failed = stats.Failed
    RunAudit03ProfileConfigTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет смену абсолютных адресов при переадресации именованных таблиц.
' Исходные диапазоны и их формулы остаются на месте; измененные Names и вход
' восстанавливаются до удаления созданного только для теста листа.
Public Function RunAudit03RelocatedInputTests(Optional ByRef passed As Long = 0, _
        Optional ByRef Failed As Long = 0) As String
    Dim stats As TProfileStats, sheet As Object, source As Object, target As Object, cell As Object
    Dim names As Variant, refs() As String, baseline As Variant, field As Variant, fields As Collection
    Dim profiles As Object, loads As Object, savedProfiles As Variant, savedLoads As Variant
    Dim index As Long, position As Long, code As Long, reason As String, prefix As String, savedValue As Variant
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, section As CSectionModel
    Dim provider As CMaterialModelProvider, batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, oldAlerts As Boolean
    Dim caption As String, address As String, oldAddress As String, key As String
    Dim config As Object, savedConfig As Variant
    On Error GoTo FailedRun
    Set config = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Config").UsedRange: savedConfig = TestFixtureSaveInputs(config)
    modTestShapeArchitecture.TestConfigureShapeFixture "Circle"
    modTestShapeArchitecture.TestConfigureShapeFixture "RoundedMixed"
    modTestShapeArchitecture.TestConfigureShapeFixture "HollowCentered"
    modTestShapeArchitecture.TestConfigureShapeFixture "TwoRectangles"
    names = Array("rngSystemSettings", "rngUnitSettings", "rngSignConventionSettings", _
        "rngConcreteMaterialParameters", "rngSteelMaterialParameters", "rngCircleGeometry", _
        "rngPointedSectionGeometry", "rngHollowRectangleGeometry", "rngRectanglesGeometry", _
        "rngPlotAnnotationSettings", "rngCalculationProfiles", "rngLoadCombinations")
    ReDim refs(0 To UBound(names))
    For index = 0 To UBound(names): refs(index) = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(index))).RefersTo: Next index
    Set profiles = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngCalculationProfiles").RefersToRange
    Set loads = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange
    savedProfiles = profiles.formula: savedLoads = loads.formula
    TestConfigureProfiles profiles: TestEnableChecks profiles, 1, "Yes", "Yes", "Yes", "Yes"
    TestSetLoad loads, 1, -50000#, 1000000#, 2000000#, "Auto"
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
    TestBuildFixture section, provider, settings.GetBoolean("General.DiagramExtension", False)
    oldAlerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add: sheet.name = "__AuditMovedInputs"
    For index = 0 To UBound(names)
        Set source = ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(index))).RefersToRange
        baseline = source.value2
        Set fields = TestRelocatedFields(source, CStr(names(index)))
        For position = 1 To 2
            If position = 1 Then Set target = sheet.cells(10, 5) Else Set target = sheet.cells(800, 60)
            Set target = target.Resize(source.rows.count, source.columns.count)
            target.value2 = baseline
            ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(index))).RefersTo = "='" & sheet.name & "'!" & target.address
            For Each field In fields
                Set cell = target.cells(CLng(field(0)), CLng(field(1)))
                key = CStr(field(2)): savedValue = cell.value2
                address = cell.address(False, False)
                oldAddress = source.cells(CLng(field(0)), CLng(field(1))).address(False, False)
                prefix = "relocated." & CStr(names(index)) & ".p" & CStr(position) & "." & key
                TestLogLine stats, "RUN: " & prefix & "; actual=" & sheet.name & "!" & address
                If (index >= 5 And index <= 8) Then
                    Dim inputTable As CSectionInputTable
                    Set inputTable = TestRelocatedRecipeTable(CStr(names(index)), units)
                    reason = inputTable.SourceReference(CLng(field(0)), CLng(field(1)))
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".captured", inputTable.name = CStr(names(index))
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".locationSheet", InStr(1, reason, sheet.name, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".locationAddress", InStr(1, reason, address, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    cell.value2 = CVErr(xlErrDiv0)
                    code = TestRelocatedRecipeError(CStr(names(index)), reason)
                ElseIf index < 10 Then
                    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
                    reason = settings.InputErrorMessage(key, "Контроль адреса.", "Проверьте значение.")
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".registered", settings.HasKey(key)
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".locationSheet", InStr(1, reason, sheet.name, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".locationAddress", InStr(1, reason, "ячейка " & address, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    ' Ошибки геометрических значений хранятся до обращения
                    ' активного потребителя. Проверяем его чтение по тому же
                    ' ключу и сохраненный адрес перемещенной ячейки.
                    cell.value2 = CVErr(xlErrDiv0): code = TestSettingsLoadError(reason, key)
                ElseIf index = 10 Then
                    cell.value2 = "NOT_A_VALID_CHOICE": code = TestCatalogError(reason)
                Else
                    cell.value2 = "abc"
                    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
                    Set batch = TestExecuteFixture(section, provider, settings, units)
                    code = IIf(batch.ResultAt(1).status = "InputErr", 1, 0)
                    reason = batch.ResultAt(1).OverallMeta.resultComment
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".noSolve", batch.SolverCallCount = 0
                    TestCheckComments stats, prefix, batch, units
                End If
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".errorSheet", InStr(1, reason, sheet.name, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".errorAddress", InStr(1, reason, address, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".oldAddressAbsent", InStr(1, reason, "ячейка " & oldAddress, vbBinaryCompare) = 0
                TestLogLine stats, "RELOCATED_INPUT_MESSAGE: " & prefix & "; " & reason
                cell.value2 = savedValue
                If index = 0 And key = "Solver.ToleranceN" Then
                    cell.value2 = "abc"
                    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
                    Set batch = TestExecuteFixture(section, provider, settings, units)
                    reason = batch.ResultAt(1).OverallMeta.resultComment
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".batchInputErr", batch.ResultAt(1).status = "InputErr"
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".batchAddress", InStr(1, reason, "ячейка " & address, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".batchNoSolve", batch.SolverCallCount = 0
                    TestCheckComments stats, prefix & ".batch", batch, units
                    cell.value2 = savedValue
                End If
                stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
            Next field
            If CStr(names(index)) = "rngRectanglesGeometry" Then TestRelocatedRectanglesSelectors stats, target, position
            ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(index))).RefersTo = refs(index)
        Next position
    Next index
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    TestCheck stats, "relocated.recovery.settings", settings.HasKey("Solver.ToleranceN")
    Dim catalog As CCalculationProfileCatalog
    Set catalog = New CCalculationProfileCatalog: catalog.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    TestCheck stats, "relocated.recovery.profiles", catalog.count = 4
    GoTo Restore
FailedRun:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: relocated.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    For index = 0 To UBound(names)
        If Len(refs(index)) > 0 Then ThisWorkbook.names.item(CStr(names(index))).RefersTo = refs(index)
    Next index
    profiles.formula = savedProfiles: loads.formula = savedLoads
    If Not config Is Nothing And IsArray(savedConfig) Then TestFixtureRestoreInputs config, savedConfig
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    If Not sheet Is Nothing Then sheet.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = oldAlerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestLogLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_RELOCATED_INPUT: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & _
        "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed) & "; cases=" & CStr(stats.cases)
    passed = stats.passed: Failed = stats.Failed
    RunAudit03RelocatedInputTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет независимые выборы и ошибки формул обеих физических граней.
' Адрес ввода берется из перемещенной таблицы; другая грань не подменяет
' ошибочное значение, а исходные настройки восстанавливаются после пробы.
Private Sub TestRelocatedRectanglesSelectors(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal source As Object, ByVal position As Long)
    Dim reader As CSectionInputReader, pair As Variant, field As Variant, rowKey As Variant
    Dim first As Object, second As Object, cell As Object, column As Long, row As Long
    Dim savedFirst As Variant, savedSecond As Variant, choices As Variant, code As Long, reason As String
    Dim inputTable As CSectionInputTable, units As CUnitSystem, value As String, prefix As String
