' Символы "-" неприменимых полей не превращаются в пользовательские настройки.
Private Sub TestConfigureAnnotationFixture(ByVal source As Object)
    Dim column As Long, field As Variant
    For column = 2 To 3
        For Each field In Array("Enabled", "LineEnabled"): TestAnnotationCell(source, CStr(field), column).value2 = "Yes": Next field
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "Placement", column).value2 = "Outside"
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "Offset", column).value2 = 50#
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "LineWeight", column).value2 = 2#
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "TextUnits", column).value2 = "pt"
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "TextHeight", column).value2 = 13#
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "TextGap", column).value2 = 9#
        TestAnnotationCell(source, "Color", column).value2 = "20,30,90"
    Next column
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "LineEnabled", 3).value2 = "-"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ExtensionLineWeight", 2).value2 = "-"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ExtensionLineWeight", 3).value2 = 1#
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ArrowType", 2).value2 = "-": TestAnnotationCell(source, "ArrowType", 3).value2 = "Triangle"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ArrowSize", 2).value2 = "-": TestAnnotationCell(source, "ArrowSize", 3).value2 = "Medium"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ExtensionLineColor", 2).value2 = "-"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ExtensionLineColor", 3).value2 = "140,140,140"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Находит действительную входную ячейку аннотации, не используя ее адрес Config.
Private Function TestAnnotationCell(ByVal source As Object, ByVal field As String, ByVal column As Long) As Object
    Dim row As Long
    For row = 2 To source.rows.count
        If CStr(source.cells(row, 1).value2) = field Then Set TestAnnotationCell = source.cells(row, column): Exit Function
    Next row
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4502, "AnnotationCell", "В таблице аннотаций нет " & field
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Независимые численные ожидания: масштаб модели 0.43 pt/mm, visual-scale=1.
' Проверяются настоящий цвет 0, направление Inside, толщина и mm/pt, а также
' повторная инициализация того же layout без накопления старых элементов.
Private Sub TestAnnotationLayoutValues(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal source As Object)
    Dim column As Long, color As Variant, Height As Variant, layout As CPlotAnnotationLayout
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, prefix As String, base As Long
    For column = 2 To 3
        For Each color In Array("0,0,0", "255,0,0", "0,255,0", "0,0,255")
            TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
            TestAnnotationCell(source, "Color", column).value2 = color
            TestAnnotationCell(source, "ExtensionLineColor", 3).value2 = color
            Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
            Set layout = New CPlotAnnotationLayout: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
            layout.Initialize -500#, 500#, -500#, 500#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
            layout.AddDimension -100#, 0#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "DIM"
            layout.AddRebarLabel -100#, 0#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
            Select Case CStr(color)
                Case "0,0,0": base = 0
                Case "255,0,0": base = 255
                Case "0,255,0": base = 65280
                Case "0,0,255": base = 16711680
            End Select
            prefix = "presentationConfig." & CStr(column) & ".Color." & CStr(color)
            If column = 2 Then TestCheck stats, prefix & ".text", layout.color(6) = base Else TestCheck stats, prefix & ".text", layout.color(4) = base
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".extension", layout.color(1) = base And layout.color(2) = base
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".lineWeight", layout.weight(3), 2#, 0#
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".offset", layout.Y1(3), 193.5, 0.000000000001
            layout.Initialize -500#, 500#, -500#, 500#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".reset", layout.count = 0
            stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
        Next color
        For Each Height In Array(13#, 20#)
            TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
            TestAnnotationCell(source, "TextHeight", column).value2 = Height
            TestAnnotationCell(source, "TextUnits", column).value2 = "mm"
            TestAnnotationCell(source, "Placement", column).value2 = "Inside"
            Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
            Set layout = New CPlotAnnotationLayout: layout.ConfigureFromSettings settings
            layout.Initialize -500#, 500#, -500#, 500#, 0#, 0#, 640#, 430#, "mm"
            layout.AddDimension -100#, 0#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "DIM"
            layout.AddRebarLabel -100#, 0#, 100#, 0#, 0#, 1#, "REBAR"
            prefix = "presentationConfig." & CStr(column) & ".TextUnits.mm." & CStr(Height)
            If column = 2 Then base = 6 Else base = 4
            TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".font", layout.fontSize(base), CDbl(Height) * 0.43, 0.000000000001
            If column = 2 Then
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Inside", layout.Y1(6) > 215#
            Else
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".Inside", layout.Y1(4) > 184.5
            End If
            stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
        Next Height
    Next column
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Матрица всех применимых полей: пустота/текст/Excel-ошибка и особые границы.
' Ошибка активного поля должна содержать key, текущую ячейку и исправление;
' тот же ошибочный параметр выключенной группы не должен мешать схеме.
Private Sub TestAnnotationInputMatrix(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal source As Object, ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader)
    Dim column As Long, field As Variant, value As Variant, invalids As Variant, cell As Object
    Dim prefix As String, key As String, code As Long, reason As String, caseIndex As Long, savedKey As Variant
    For column = 2 To 3
        For Each field In Array("Enabled", "Placement", "Offset", "LineEnabled", "LineWeight", "ExtensionLineWeight", _
                "TextUnits", "TextHeight", "TextGap", "ArrowType", "ArrowSize", "Color", "ExtensionLineColor")
            TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
            Set cell = TestAnnotationCell(source, CStr(field), column)
            If CStr(cell.value2) <> "-" Then
                If column = 2 Then key = "Plot.RebarLabels." & CStr(field) Else key = "Plot.Dimensions." & CStr(field)
                invalids = Array(vbNullString, "abc", CVErr(xlErrDiv0))
                Select Case CStr(field)
                    Case "Offset", "TextGap": invalids = Array(vbNullString, "abc", CVErr(xlErrDiv0), -1#)
                    Case "TextHeight", "LineWeight", "ExtensionLineWeight": invalids = Array(vbNullString, "abc", CVErr(xlErrDiv0), -1#, 0#)
                    Case "Color", "ExtensionLineColor": invalids = Array(vbNullString, "abc", CVErr(xlErrDiv0), "-1,2,3", "256,2,3", "1.5,2,3")
                End Select
                caseIndex = 0
                For Each value In invalids
                    TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source: cell.value2 = value
                    prefix = "presentationConfig." & key & ".invalid" & CStr(caseIndex)
                    TestLogLine stats, "RUN: " & prefix
                    code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason)
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".rejected", code <> 0
                    If code <> 0 Then
                        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".controlled", code <> 6 And code <> 13 And code <> 9
                        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".key", InStr(1, reason, key, vbTextCompare) > 0
                        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".address", InStr(1, reason, "ячейка " & cell.address(False, False), vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".repair", InStr(1, reason, "Введите", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or InStr(1, reason, "Выберите", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or InStr(1, reason, "Исправьте", vbTextCompare) > 0
                    End If
                    If CStr(field) <> "Enabled" Then
                        TestAnnotationCell(source, "Enabled", column).value2 = "No"
                        code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason)
                        TestCheck stats, prefix & ".inactive", code = 0
                    End If
                    caseIndex = caseIndex + 1: stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
                Next value
                TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
                savedKey = cell.offset(0, 1 - column).value2: cell.offset(0, 1 - column).value2 = "__MissingAnnotationField"
                If CStr(field) <> "Enabled" Then
                    If column = 2 Then TestAnnotationCell(source, "Enabled", 3).value2 = "No" Else TestAnnotationCell(source, "Enabled", 2).value2 = "No"
                End If
                code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason)
                TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig." & key & ".missing", code <> 0
                If code <> 0 Then TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig." & key & ".missingKey", InStr(1, reason, CStr(field), vbTextCompare) > 0
                cell.offset(0, 1 - column).value2 = savedKey
                TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source: code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason)
                TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig." & key & ".recovery", code = 0
            End If
        Next field
    Next column
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет реальные фигуры Excel: чёрный цвет не подменяется,
' а Enabled и LineEnabled убирают именно соответствующие элементы.
Private Sub TestAnnotationChartValues(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal source As Object, ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader)
    Dim shape As Object, chart As Object, code As Long, reason As String, count As Long, arrows As Long
    TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "Color", 2).value2 = "0,0,0": TestAnnotationCell(source, "Color", 3).value2 = "0,0,0"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "ExtensionLineColor", 3).value2 = "0,0,0"
    code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason): TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.black.draw", code = 0
    If code <> 0 Then Exit Sub
    Set chart = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.item("Расчет").ChartObjects.item("chtNDMSectionPlot").chart
    For Each shape In chart.shapes
        If InStr(1, shape.name, "AnnotationLine", vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then
            count = count + 1: TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.black.line" & CStr(count), shape.line.ForeColor.RGB = 0
            If shape.line.BeginArrowheadStyle <> 1 Then arrows = arrows + 1
        End If
    Next shape
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.black.lines", count = 4
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.black.arrows", arrows = 1
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.black.image", chart.export(ThisWorkbook.path & "\Audit03_presentation_black.png", "PNG")
    TestLogLine stats, "PLOT_IMAGE: " & ThisWorkbook.path & "\Audit03_presentation_black.png"
    TestAnnotationCell(source, "Enabled", 3).value2 = "No": TestAnnotationCell(source, "LineEnabled", 2).value2 = "No"
    code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason): TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.disabled.draw", code = 0
    count = 0
    For Each shape In chart.shapes
        If InStr(1, shape.name, "AnnotationLine", vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then count = count + 1
    Next shape
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.Chart.disabled.lines", count = 0
    TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Перемещает существующий Name и проверяет ошибку активного цвета по новому
' адресу. Отрисовка не должна выдавать старый адрес или молча брать default.
Private Sub TestAnnotationRelocation(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal source As Object, _
        ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByRef sheet As Object)
    Dim target As Object, cell As Object, code As Long, reason As String, oldRef As String
    oldRef = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngPlotAnnotationSettings").RefersTo
    TestConfigureAnnotationFixture source
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add: sheet.name = "__AuditPlotInputs"
    Set target = sheet.cells(25, 60).Resize(source.rows.count, source.columns.count): target.value2 = source.value2
    ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngPlotAnnotationSettings").RefersTo = "='" & sheet.name & "'!" & target.address
    Set cell = TestAnnotationCell(target, "Color", 3): cell.value2 = "256,0,0"
    code = TestPresentationDrawError(reader, reason)
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.relocated.rejected", code <> 0
    If code <> 0 Then
        TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.relocated.sheet", InStr(1, reason, sheet.name, vbBinaryCompare) > 0
        TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.relocated.address", InStr(1, reason, "ячейка " & cell.address(False, False), vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    End If
    ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngPlotAnnotationSettings").RefersTo = oldRef
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строит обычную схему по готовым сохранённым данным.
' Номер ошибки записывает отдельно от текста; статус из пояснения не выводится.
Private Function TestPresentationDrawError(ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByRef reason As String) As Long
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, plotter As CSectionPlotter
    reason = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set plotter = New CSectionPlotter: plotter.Draw ThisWorkbook, reader, settings
    Exit Function
Failed:
    TestPresentationDrawError = Err.number: reason = Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет целостность реальных таблиц Results: недостающая обязательная
' колонка и испорченная аннотация не выдаются за успешно прочитанную схему.
' Принимается единственная текущая шапка геометрии, пустая таблица
' semantic-аннотаций не блокирует саму расчетную геометрию.
Private Sub TestPresentationSnapshotIntegrity(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByRef reader As CSectionPlotDataReader)
    Dim geometry As Object, annotations As Object, oldGeometry As Variant, oldAnnotations As Variant
    Dim data As Variant, code As Long, reason As String, field As Variant, column As Long
    Dim savedNumber As Long, savedReason As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set geometry = TestPresentationSnapshotRange("rngNDMSectionGeometry", 25)
    Set annotations = TestPresentationSnapshotRange("rngNDMSectionAnnotations", 13)
    oldGeometry = geometry.formula: oldAnnotations = annotations.formula
    data = geometry.value2: data(1, 7) = "__MissingGeometryStatus": geometry.value2 = data
    code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason)
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.geometryHeader.rejected", code <> 0
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.geometryHeader.controlled", code <> 9 And code <> 13 And code <> 6
    If code <> 0 Then TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.geometryHeader.reason", InStr(1, reason, "GeometryInterpretationStatus", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    data(1, 7) = "ShapeType": geometry.value2 = data
    code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason): TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.obsoleteShapeType.rejected", code <> 0
    geometry.formula = oldGeometry
    For Each field In Array("StartX", "StartY", "EndX", "EndY", "OutsideNormalX", "OutsideNormalY", "Text")
        data = annotations.value2
        column = TestPresentationColumn(data, CStr(field))
        data(2, column) = CVErr(xlErrValue): annotations.value2 = data
        code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason)
        TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.annotation." & CStr(field) & ".rejected", code <> 0
        If code <> 0 Then
            TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.annotation." & CStr(field) & ".controlled", code <> 9 And code <> 13 And code <> 6
            TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.annotation." & CStr(field) & ".reason", InStr(1, reason, CStr(field), vbBinaryCompare) > 0
            TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.annotation." & CStr(field) & ".address", _
                InStr(1, reason, annotations.cells(2, column).address(False, False), vbBinaryCompare) > 0
        End If
        annotations.formula = oldAnnotations
        code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason)
        TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.annotation." & CStr(field) & ".recovery", code = 0
        stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
    Next field
    data = annotations.value2: column = TestPresentationColumn(data, "Text")
    data(2, column) = "  Подпись с пробелами  ": annotations.value2 = data
    code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason)
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.textWhitespace.reader", code = 0
    If code = 0 Then TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.textWhitespace.preserved", reader.AnnotationText(1) = "  Подпись с пробелами  "
    annotations.formula = oldAnnotations
    data = annotations.value2: data(1, 4) = "__MissingStartX": annotations.value2 = data
    code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason)
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.annotationHeader.rejected", code <> 0
    annotations.formula = oldAnnotations
    annotations.offset(1, 0).Resize(annotations.rows.count - 1, annotations.columns.count).ClearContents
    code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason)
    TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.emptyAnnotations.reader", code = 0
    If code = 0 Then TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.emptyAnnotations.count", reader.AnnotationCount = 0
    GoTo Restore
Failed:
    savedNumber = Err.number: savedReason = Err.description
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not geometry Is Nothing Then geometry.formula = oldGeometry
    If Not annotations Is Nothing Then annotations.formula = oldAnnotations
    On Error GoTo 0
    If savedNumber <> 0 Then stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1: TestLogLine stats, "FAIL: presentationConfig.snapshot.runtime; " & CStr(savedNumber) & "; " & savedReason
    code = TestPresentationReaderError(reader, reason): TestCheck stats, "presentationConfig.snapshot.recovery", code = 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Изменяет только собственный блок от именованной начальной ячейки.
' CurrentRegion не используется из-за соседних служебных строк.
' Число столбцов задано независимо по проверяемой структуре.
Private Function TestPresentationSnapshotRange(ByVal name As String, ByVal columns As Long) As Object
    Dim anchor As Object, rows As Long
    Set anchor = ThisWorkbook.names.item(name).RefersToRange
    rows = 1
    Do While Len(CStr(anchor.offset(rows, 0).value2)) > 0: rows = rows + 1: Loop
    Set TestPresentationSnapshotRange = anchor.Resize(rows, columns)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Находит столбец эталонной таблицы по точному заголовку.
' Проверяемый рабочий ResultColumn для подготовки эталона не вызывается.
Private Function TestPresentationColumn(ByRef data As Variant, ByVal header As String) As Long
    Dim column As Long
    For column = 1 To UBound(data, 2)
        If CStr(data(1, column)) = header Then TestPresentationColumn = column: Exit Function
    Next column
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4503, "PresentationColumn", "В snapshot нет " & header
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Возвращает точную ошибку загрузки на новом reader-е и сохраняет объект для
' проверки последующего восстановления; пользовательские настройки не меняет.
Private Function TestPresentationReaderError(ByRef reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByRef reason As String) As Long
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader
    reason = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set reader = New CSectionPlotDataReader: reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, settings
    Exit Function
Failed:
    TestPresentationReaderError = Err.number: reason = Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' независимо вычисляет выбранную величину каждого элемента
' по сохранённому полю деформаций и его диаграмме. Чтение Results не должно
' подменять напряжение деформацией или брать другое НДС.
Private Sub TestCheckVisualizationValues(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByVal state As CSectionStateResult, _
        ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal provider As CMaterialModelProvider, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim concrete As CMaterialDiagram, steel As CMaterialDiagram, i As Long, bar As Long
    Dim X As Double, Y As Double, expected As Double, strain As Double, diagram As CMaterialDiagram
    ' ExtensionUsed отмечает выход за физическую область, а не выбор диаграммы.
    ' Ожидаемые значения схемы считаем по фактическим диаграммам этого НДС.
    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".materialSnapshot", state.HasMaterialSnapshot
    If Not state.HasMaterialSnapshot Then Exit Sub
    Set concrete = state.ConcreteDiagramSnapshot
    Set steel = state.SteelDiagramSnapshot
    For i = 1 To reader.count
        If i <= section.ConcreteCount Then
            X = section.concreteX(i): Y = section.concreteY(i): Set diagram = concrete
        Else
            bar = i - section.ConcreteCount
            X = section.RebarX(bar): Y = section.RebarY(bar): Set diagram = steel
        End If
        strain = state.Epsilon0 + state.KappaX * Y + state.KappaY * X
        If reader.VisualizationQuantity = "Strain" Then
            expected = strain
        Else
            expected = units.InternalStressToOutput(diagram.GetStress(strain))
        End If
        TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".element" & CStr(i), reader.ResultValue(i), expected, 0.000000000001
    Next i
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' проверяет именно текст растянутого края общей легенды, а не
' случайное совпадение подписи нуля в Chart. Положение определяется
' контрактом оформления; точность формируется независимым test-oracle.
Private Sub TestCheckVisualizationLegend(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByVal reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader)
    Dim plotter As CSectionPlotter, chartObject As Object, shape As Object, i As Long
    Dim maximum As Double, foundValue As Boolean, foundText As Boolean, text As String, pattern As String
    For i = 1 To reader.count
        If reader.PhysicalState(i) = "Tension" Then
            If Not foundValue Or Abs(reader.ResultValue(i)) > Abs(maximum) Then maximum = reader.ResultValue(i)
            foundValue = True
        End If
    Next i
    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".legendFixtureTension", foundValue
    If Not foundValue Then Exit Sub
    pattern = "0": If reader.ResultPrecision > 0 Then pattern = pattern & "." & String$(reader.ResultPrecision, "0")
    text = Replace$(format$(maximum, pattern), ",", ".")
    Set plotter = New CSectionPlotter: plotter.Draw ThisWorkbook, reader, settings
    Set chartObject = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.item("Расчет").ChartObjects.item("chtNDMSectionPlot")
    For Each shape In chartObject.chart.shapes
        If left$(shape.name, Len("NDMPlot_Text")) = "NDMPlot_Text" Then
            If Abs(shape.left - (chartObject.Width - 118#)) < 0.01 And Abs(shape.top - 174#) < 0.01 Then
                foundText = True
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".actualLegendText", CStr(shape.TextFrame.Characters().text) = text
            End If
        End If
    Next shape
    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".actualLegendPresent", foundText
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' короткая проверка обязательного сопоставления номеров сочетаний.
Public Function RunStabilityDurationMatchingTests() As String
    RunStabilityDurationMatchingTests = RunAudit03DurationConfigTests(matchingOnly:=True)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет отсутствие строки отдельно от допустимых пустых и нулевых усилий.
' Для СП 35/63 проверяет статус, изоляцию сочетаний, отключённую устойчивость
' и фактический адрес таблицы после её переноса на другой лист.
Private Sub TestDurationMatching(ByRef stats As TProfileStats, ByVal profiles As Object, ByVal system As Object, _
        ByVal loads As Object, ByVal duration As Object, ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal provider As CMaterialModelProvider, _
        ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByRef sheet As Object)
    Dim standard As Variant, mode As Long, data As Variant, loadValues As Variant, column As Long
    Dim batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, code As Long, reason As String, prefix As String, originalRef As String
    Dim location As String, target As Object, missing As Boolean, inactive As Boolean
    originalRef = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngStabilityDurationLoads").RefersTo
    For Each standard In Array("SP63", "SP35")
        TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.Code", CStr(standard), 2
        settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
        For mode = 1 To 12
            TestPrepareDurationLoads loads, duration, 1
            TestEnableChecks profiles, 1, "Yes", "No", "No", "Yes"
            TestEnableChecks profiles, 2, "Yes", "No", "No", "No"
            data = duration.value2: missing = False: inactive = False
            Select Case mode
                Case 1, 6, 11, 12
                    data(2, 1) = "OTHER_NUMBER": missing = True
                Case 2
                    For column = 2 To 4: data(2, column) = vbNullString: Next column
                Case 3
                    For column = 2 To 4: data(2, column) = 0#: Next column
                Case 4
                    data(2, 1) = vbNullString: missing = True
                    For column = 2 To 4: data(2, column) = CVErr(2015): Next column
                Case 5, 10
                    data(2, 1) = "OTHER_NUMBER": inactive = True
                    For column = 2 To 4: data(2, column) = CVErr(2015): Next column
                    If mode = 5 Then TestEnableChecks profiles, 1, "Yes", "No", "No", "No"
                Case 7
                    For column = 2 To 4: data(2, column) = "=" & Chr$(34) & Chr$(34): Next column
                Case 8
                    data(2, 2) = vbNullString: data(2, 3) = 0#: data(2, 4) = vbNullString
                Case 9
                    data(2, 1) = " duration_1 "
                    For column = 2 To 4: data(2, column) = 0#: Next column
            End Select
            duration.value2 = data
            If mode = 7 Then duration.Calculate
            If mode = 6 Or mode = 10 Then TestAddDurationRecoveryLoad loads, duration, 1
            If mode = 10 Then
                loadValues = loads.value2: loadValues(2, 5) = "PR2": loads.value2 = loadValues
            End If
            location = duration.Worksheet.name & "!" & duration.address(False, False)
            If mode >= 11 Then
                If sheet Is Nothing Then Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add: sheet.name = "__AuditDurationInputs"
                If mode = 11 Then Set target = sheet.cells(10, 5) Else Set target = sheet.cells(800, 60)
                Set target = target.Resize(duration.rows.count, duration.columns.count)
                target.value2 = duration.value2
                ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngStabilityDurationLoads").RefersTo = "='" & sheet.name & "'!" & target.address
                location = sheet.name & "!" & target.address(False, False)
            End If
            prefix = "durationMatching." & CStr(standard) & ".case" & CStr(mode)
            TestLogLine stats, "RUN: " & prefix
            code = TestExecuteDuration(section, provider, settings, units, batch, reason)
            TestCheck stats, prefix & ".readerNoAbort", code = 0
            If code = 0 Then
                If missing Then
                    TestCheckDurationInputError stats, prefix, batch, units, location
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".combinationInReason", InStr(1, batch.ResultAt(1).stabilityMeta.resultComment, "DURATION_1", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".missingReason", InStr(1, batch.ResultAt(1).stabilityMeta.resultComment, "не найдена строка", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".overallInputErr", batch.ResultAt(1).status = "InputErr"
                ElseIf inactive Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".notRequested", batch.ResultAt(1).stabilityMeta.internalStatus = rsNotRequested
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".noInputErr", batch.ResultAt(1).status <> "InputErr"
                    TestCheckComments stats, prefix, batch, units
                Else
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".stabilitySuccess", batch.ResultAt(1).stabilityMeta.internalStatus = rsSuccess
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".calculated", batch.ResultAt(1).stabilityMeta.calculated
                    TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".sustainedNZero", batch.ResultAt(1).StabilityResult.sustainedN, 0#, 0.00000001
                    TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".sustainedMxZero", batch.ResultAt(1).StabilityResult.SustainedMoment1, 0#, 0.00000001
                    TestCheckClose stats, prefix & ".sustainedMyZero", batch.ResultAt(1).StabilityResult.SustainedMoment2, 0#, 0.00000001
                    TestCheckComments stats, prefix, batch, units
                End If
                TestCheck stats, prefix & ".directContinues", batch.ResultAt(1).DirectStateMeta.internalStatus = rsSuccess
                If mode = 6 Or mode = 10 Then
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".recoverySuccess", batch.count = 2 And batch.ResultAt(2).stabilityMeta.internalStatus = rsSuccess
                    TestCheck stats, prefix & ".recoveryNoInputErr", batch.ResultAt(2).status <> "InputErr"
                End If
            End If
            ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngStabilityDurationLoads").RefersTo = originalRef
            stats.cases = stats.cases + 1
        Next mode
    Next standard
    TestEnableChecks profiles, 1, "No", "No", "No", "Yes"
    TestSetTableValue system, "Stability.Code", "SP63", 2
    settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: измерения общего API и сохраненные подписи без повторной сборки.
' ==========================================================================
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' точные привязки при наклонных нормалях и сохранность границы отверстия.
Public Function RunArbitraryAnnotationGeometryTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim degrees As Variant, value As Variant, shape As Variant, angle As Double, nx As Double, ny As Double
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, polygon As CPolygonSpec, options As CRebarRuleOptions, support As Double, mX As Double, mY As Double
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, region As CConcreteRegion, distance As Double, prefix As String
    Dim annotationBuilder As CSectionAnnotationBuilder, repeated As CSectionAnnotations, count As Long
    degrees = Array(0#, 30#, 45#, 90#, 135#, 225#, 315#)
    For Each shape In Array("Circle", "Rounded", "HollowRectangle")
        For Each value In degrees
            angle = CDbl(value) * GEOM_PI / 180#: nx = Cos(angle): ny = Sin(angle)
            prefix = CStr(shape) & "." & CStr(value)
            Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "AngleFixture"
            If shape = "HollowRectangle" Then
                Set polygon = TestAngleRoundedPolygon(500#, 600#, 160#)
                Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("OuterBase", polygon)
                Set path = facade.Transform("Outer", path.id, 0#, 0#, angle)
            Else
                Set path = facade.CirclePath("Outer", 0#, 0#, 800#)
            End If
            facade.outer "OUTER", path.id
            Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.AnnotationGroup = "G"
            If shape = "Circle" Then
                Set path = facade.CirclePath("Axis", 0#, 0#, 150#)
                options.EndMode = ClosedUniform: support = 150#
                facade.RebarByCount "Bars", path.id, 8, 10#, options
            ElseIf shape = "Rounded" Then
                Set polygon = TestAngleRoundedPolygon(200#, 300#, 40#)
                Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Axis", polygon)
                options.EndMode = ClosedUniform
                support = 160# * Abs(nx) + 260# * Abs(ny) + 40#
                facade.RebarByCount "Bars", path.id, 12, 10#, options
            Else
                Set polygon = TestAngleRoundedPolygon(200#, 300#, 80#)
                Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("HoleBase", polygon)
                Set path = facade.Transform("Hole", path.id, 40#, 20#, angle)
                facade.opening "OPENING", path.id, "OUTER"
                Set path = facade.LinePath("AxisBase", -240#, -100#, -240#, 100#)
                Set path = facade.Transform("Axis", path.id, 40#, 20#, angle)
                facade.RebarByCount "Bars", path.id, 2, 10#, options
            End If
            facade.RebarLabel "G", path.id, 2# * nx, 2# * ny
            Set definition = facade.Finish: Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = TestBuildDefinition(definition, builder)
            TestCheck prefix & ".one.group", model.annotations.count = 1
            mX = 0.5 * (model.annotations.startX(1) + model.annotations.endX(1))
            mY = 0.5 * (model.annotations.startY(1) + model.annotations.endY(1))
            If shape = "HollowRectangle" Then
                TestNear prefix & ".anchor.x", mX, 40# - 240# * nx
                TestNear prefix & ".anchor.y", mY, 20# - 240# * ny
                Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery: Set region = query.RegionFromContours(model.contours)
                TestCheck prefix & ".hit", query.LabelBoundaryDistance(region, mX, mY, nx, ny, distance)
                TestNear prefix & ".opening.not.outer", distance, 40#
                TestCheck prefix & ".opening.role", model.contours.loopRole(model.contours.count) = "Opening"
            Else
                TestNear prefix & ".support.x", mX, support * nx
                TestNear prefix & ".support.y", mY, support * ny
            End If
            TestNear prefix & ".line.perpendicular", (model.annotations.endX(1) - model.annotations.startX(1)) * nx + _
                (model.annotations.endY(1) - model.annotations.startY(1)) * ny, 0#
            count = model.RebarCount
            Set annotationBuilder = New CSectionAnnotationBuilder: Set repeated = New CSectionAnnotations
            annotationBuilder.Build definition, builder.rebars, repeated, builder.Rules
            TestCheck prefix & ".repeat", repeated.count = 1 And builder.rebars.count = count
            TestNear prefix & ".repeat.x", repeated.startX(1), model.annotations.startX(1)
            TestNear prefix & ".repeat.y", repeated.startY(1), model.annotations.startY(1)
        Next value
    Next shape
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "arbitrary.geometry.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunArbitraryAnnotationGeometryTests = mReport & "TOTAL ARBITRARY ANNOTATION GEOMETRY: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' симметричный скруглённый прямоугольник с известными проекциями.
Private Function TestAngleRoundedPolygon(ByVal halfWidth As Double, ByVal halfHeight As Double, ByVal radius As Double) As CPolygonSpec
    Dim polygon As CPolygonSpec
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "BL", -halfWidth, -halfHeight, radius
    polygon.AddVertex "BR", halfWidth, -halfHeight, radius
    polygon.AddVertex "TR", halfWidth, halfHeight, radius
    polygon.AddVertex "TL", -halfWidth, halfHeight, radius
    polygon.Seal
    Set TestAngleRoundedPolygon = polygon
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет размеры, радиусы, длину пути, текст и подписи фактически созданной арматуры, а также недопустимые привязки.
Public Function RunRecipeAnnotationTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder
    Dim model As CSectionModel, annotations As CSectionAnnotations, X As Double, Y As Double, i As Long
    Set facade = TestAnnotationFacade
    facade.source "Diagonal", "ProgramInputs.PointB"
    Set definition = facade.Finish
    TestCheck "source.scalar", definition.SourceReference("Diagonal") = "ProgramInputs.PointB"
    definition.AnchorCoordinates "B", X, Y: X = 999#: Y = 999#
    definition.AnchorCoordinates "B", X, Y
    TestNear "anchor.immutable.x", X, 30#: TestNear "anchor.immutable.y", Y, 40#
    Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = TestBuildDefinition(definition, builder): Set annotations = model.annotations
    TestCheck "annotations.count", annotations.count = 11
    For i = 1 To 9: TestCheck "annotation.id." & CStr(i), Len(annotations.annotationID(i)) > 0: Next i
    TestNear "horizontal.projection", annotations.value(1), 30#
    TestNear "horizontal.placement", annotations.endY(1), 0#
    TestNear "vertical.projection", annotations.value(2), 40#
    TestNear "vertical.placement", annotations.endX(2), 0#
    TestNear "diagonal.distance", annotations.value(3), 50#
    TestNear "diagonal.normal.x", annotations.normalX(3), -0.8
    TestNear "diagonal.normal.y", annotations.normalY(3), 0.6
    TestNear "vertical.explicit", annotations.value(4), 100#
    TestNear "extent.full.height", annotations.value(5), 400#
    TestNear "extent.full.width", annotations.value(6), 400#
    TestNear "radius", annotations.value(7), 200#
    TestNear "diameter", annotations.value(8), 400#
    TestNear "radius.endpoint.x", annotations.endX(7), 200#
    TestNear "radius.endpoint.y", annotations.endY(7), 0#
    TestNear "diameter.opposite.x", annotations.startX(8), -200#
    TestNear "length.analytic", annotations.value(9), 400# * GEOM_PI
    TestCheck "length.distinct.extent", annotations.value(9) > annotations.value(5)
    TestCheck "text.unicode", annotations.text(10) = "Проверка привязки"
    TestCheck "text.kind", annotations.AnnotationType(10) = "TEXT_ANNOTATION"
    TestCheck "length.kind.unit", annotations.AnnotationType(9) = "MEASUREMENT_LABEL" And annotations.unit(9) = "Length"
    TestCheck "physical.labels", InStr(annotations.text(11), "2") > 0 And model.RebarCount = 2
    For i = 0 To 4: TestCheck "invalid." & CStr(i), TestInvalidAnnotation(i): Next i
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "annotations.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunRecipeAnnotationTests = mReport & "TOTAL RECIPE ANNOTATIONS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет запись и чтение аннотаций в мм, см и м; последующая смена Config не должна менять сохранённые измерения.
Public Function RunRecipeAnnotationSnapshotTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    Dim config As Object, saved As Variant, events As Boolean, updating As Boolean, calculation As Long
    On Error GoTo Failed
    events = Application.EnableEvents: updating = Application.ScreenUpdating: calculation = Application.calculation
    Application.EnableEvents = False: Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Set config = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Config").UsedRange: saved = TestFixtureSaveInputs(config)
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, builder As CSectionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, model As CSectionModel
    Dim properties As CSectionPropertiesCalculator, units As CUnitSystem, settings As CSystemSettingsReader
    Dim writer As CNDMResultsWriter, reader As CSectionPlotDataReader, outputUnit As Variant, i As Long, found As Long
    Set facade = TestAnnotationFacade: Set definition = facade.Finish
    Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = TestBuildDefinition(definition, builder)
    Set properties = New CSectionPropertiesCalculator: properties.PrepareSnapshot model
    For Each outputUnit In Array("mm", "cm", "m")
        TestSetUnitSetting "Units.Length.Output", CStr(outputUnit)
        Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
        Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
        Set writer = New CNDMResultsWriter: writer.WriteGeometryPreview ThisWorkbook, model, properties, units
        Dim geometryTable As Variant, propertyTable As Variant, row As Long, foundDiagnostics As Boolean
        geometryTable = ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersToRange.Resize(1 + model.ConcreteCount + model.RebarCount, 16).value2
        TestCheck "snapshot.provenance." & CStr(outputUnit), InStr(SectionOptionalText(ReadSectionOptionalJson(CStr(geometryTable(UBound(geometryTable, 1), 16))), "RecipeTrace"), "RuleId=TopBars|PathId=Row|SourcePositionId=TopBars.2") > 0
        propertyTable = ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionProperties").RefersToRange.Resize(46, 6).value2: foundDiagnostics = False
        For row = 2 To UBound(propertyTable, 1)
            If CStr(propertyTable(row, 3)) = "Geometry.RecipeDiagnostics" Then
                foundDiagnostics = True
                TestCheck "snapshot.diagnostics.counts." & CStr(outputUnit), InStr(CStr(propertyTable(row, 4)), "Requested=2; Created=2") > 0
            End If
        Next row
        TestCheck "snapshot.diagnostics.present." & CStr(outputUnit), foundDiagnostics
        TestSetUnitSetting "Units.Length.Input", "m" ' Изменение input и output после сохранения не меняет измерение Results.
        TestSetUnitSetting "Units.Length.Output", "mm"
        settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
        Set reader = New CSectionPlotDataReader: reader.LoadGeometryPreviewFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook, settings
        found = 0
        For i = 1 To reader.AnnotationCount
            If reader.AnnotationType(i) = "MEASUREMENT_LABEL" Then
                found = found + 1
                TestNear "snapshot.length.anchor.x." & CStr(outputUnit), reader.AnnotationStartX(i), 0#
                TestNear "snapshot.length.anchor.y." & CStr(outputUnit), reader.AnnotationStartY(i), -100#
                TestCheck "snapshot.length.text." & CStr(outputUnit) & "; " & reader.AnnotationText(i), InStr(reader.AnnotationText(i), "L=") > 0 And InStr(reader.AnnotationText(i), CStr(outputUnit)) > 0
            ElseIf reader.AnnotationType(i) = "TEXT_ANNOTATION" Then
                found = found + 1
                TestCheck "snapshot.text." & CStr(outputUnit), reader.AnnotationText(i) = "Проверка привязки"
            End If
        Next i
        TestCheck "snapshot.labels." & CStr(outputUnit), found = 2
    Next outputUnit
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "snapshot.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not config Is Nothing And Not IsEmpty(saved) Then TestFixtureRestoreInputs config, saved
    Application.EnableEvents = events: Application.ScreenUpdating = updating: Application.calculation = calculation
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunRecipeAnnotationSnapshotTests = mReport & "TOTAL RECIPE ANNOTATION SNAPSHOT: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Меняет только INPUT или OUTPUT длины по ключу строки именованной таблицы единиц.
Private Sub TestSetUnitSetting(ByVal key As String, ByVal value As String)
    Dim range As Object, table As CSectionInputTable
    Set range = ThisWorkbook.names("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    Set table = New CSectionInputTable: table.Initialize "rngUnitSettings", range.value2
    If key = "Units.Length.Output" Then
        range.cells(table.RowByKey("Length"), 4).value2 = value
    Else
        range.cells(table.RowByKey("Length"), 2).value2 = value
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Включает размеры и подписи программного примера, сохраняет схему и возвращает исходные настройки аннотаций.
Public Function TestDumpRecipeAnnotationPreview(ByVal outputDirectory As String) As String
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel, definition As CSectionDefinition
    Dim range As Object, saved As Variant, table As CSectionInputTable, row As Long, result As String, number As Long, reason As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set range = ThisWorkbook.names("rngPlotAnnotationSettings").RefersToRange: saved = range.formula
    Set table = New CSectionInputTable: table.Initialize "rngPlotAnnotationSettings", range.value2
    row = table.RowByKey("Enabled"): range.cells(row, 2).value2 = "Yes": range.cells(row, 3).value2 = "Yes"
    Set facade = TestAnnotationFacade(True): Set definition = facade.Finish: Set builder = New CSectionBuilder
    Set model = TestBuildDefinition(definition, builder)
    result = modTestShapeArchitecture.TestPreparedPreviewSnapshot("RecipeAnnotations", model, outputDirectory)
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    number = Err.number: reason = Err.description
Finished:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not range Is Nothing And Not IsEmpty(saved) Then range.formula = saved
    On Error GoTo 0
    If number <> 0 Then Err.Raise number, "modTestRecipeAnnotations", reason
    TestDumpRecipeAnnotationPreview = result
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создаёт круг, два стержня и набор независимых измерений; отдельный режим разводит их для наглядной схемы.
Private Function TestAnnotationFacade(Optional ByVal previewPlacement As Boolean = False) As CSectionDefinitionBuilder
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "AnnotationFixture"
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 200#): facade.outer "Concrete", path.id
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Row", -50#, 100#, 50#, 100#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.AnnotationGroup = "Top"
    facade.RebarByCount "TopBars", path.id, 2, 10#, options
    If previewPlacement Then
        facade.anchor "A", -100#, -75#: facade.anchor "B", -70#, -35#
        facade.anchor "LengthNote", -60#, -150#: facade.anchor "TextNote", 50#, -50#
    Else
        facade.anchor "A", 0#, 0#: facade.anchor "B", 30#, 40#: facade.anchor "LengthNote", 0#, -100#
        facade.anchor "TextNote", 200#, 0#
    End If
    facade.PathAnchor "East", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0#
    facade.dimension "Horizontal", "A", "B", "dx", "Horizontal"
    facade.dimension "Vertical", "A", "B", "dy", "Vertical"
    facade.dimension "Diagonal", "A", "B", "s"
    If previewPlacement Then facade.VerticalDistance "VerticalExplicit", "v", -100#, 0#, 150#, 1# Else facade.VerticalDistance "VerticalExplicit", "v", -100#, 0#, -50#
    facade.VerticalExtent "Height", "Boundary", "H", -200#
    If previewPlacement Then
        facade.HorizontalExtent "Width", "Boundary", "B", -200#, -1#
        facade.radius "Radius", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0.75
        facade.Diameter "Diameter", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0.25
    Else
        facade.HorizontalExtent "Width", "Boundary", "B", -200#
        facade.radius "Radius", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0#
        facade.Diameter "Diameter", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0#
    End If
    facade.PathLength "Length", "Boundary", "LengthNote"
    facade.text "Note", "TextNote", "Проверка привязки"
    facade.RebarRowLabel "Top", "TopBars", 0#, 1#
    Set TestAnnotationFacade = facade
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строит модель с фиксированной контрольной сеткой, используя переданный общий сборщик.
Private Function TestBuildDefinition(ByVal definition As CSectionDefinition, ByVal builder As CSectionBuilder) As CSectionModel
    Dim mesh As TSectionMeshOptions
    mesh.stepX = 100#: mesh.stepY = 100#: mesh.MaterialID = 1: mesh.boundarySubdivisions = 2
    Set TestBuildDefinition = builder.Build(definition, mesh)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет отказ при неизвестной привязке, неподдерживаемом измерении и попытке задать радиус прямой.
Private Function TestInvalidAnnotation(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel
    Set facade = TestAnnotationFacade
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0: facade.dimension "Missing", "Unknown", "B", "s"
        Case 1: facade.dimension "UnknownMode", "A", "B", "s", "Unknown"
        Case 2: facade.radius "LineRadius", "Row", "Row"
        Case 3: facade.Diameter "InvalidParameter", "Boundary", "Boundary", 2#
        Case 4: facade.PathAnchor "MissingSegment", "Boundary", "RemovedArc"
    End Select
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = TestBuildDefinition(definition, builder)
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    TestInvalidAnnotation = (Err.number = vbObjectError + 5530 Or Err.number = vbObjectError + 5520): Err.Clear
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Учитывает отдельное условие проверки и сохраняет его имя в итоговом протоколе.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal name As String, ByVal value As Boolean)
    If value Then mPassed = mPassed + 1 Else mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает фактическую и ожидаемую величины с заданным в этом наборе допуском, сохраняя числа в протоколе.
Private Sub TestNear(ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    TestCheck name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000000001 * (1# + Abs(expected))
End Sub

' ==========================================================================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет пример API с составной стороной, независимыми рядами, проекцией и дополнительной арматурой при двух способах задания шага.
Public Function TestRunAdvancedGuideExamples() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, mesh As TSectionMeshOptions, Rules As CRebarRuleExecutor
    Dim useMaxStep As Variant, expected As Long
    mesh.stepX = 100#: mesh.stepY = 100#: mesh.boundarySubdivisions = 4: mesh.MaterialID = 1
    For Each useMaxStep In Array(False, True)
        Set definition = TestAdvancedGuideDefinition(CBool(useMaxStep))
        Set path = definition.path("Side")
        TestCheck "advanced.chain.segments." & CStr(useMaxStep), path.segmentCount = 5
        TestCheck "advanced.chain.namedNose." & CStr(useMaxStep), path.sourceSegmentID(3) = "NoseArc"
        Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = builder.Build(definition, mesh): Set Rules = builder.Rules
        expected = 26: If useMaxStep Then expected = 24
        TestCheck "advanced.physical.count." & CStr(useMaxStep), model.RebarCount = expected
        TestCheck "advanced.projection.skips." & CStr(useMaxStep), Rules.SkippedProjections = 2
        TestCheck "advanced.noOverlap." & CStr(useMaxStep), Rules.BarOverlaps = 0
        TestNear "advanced.verticalExtent." & CStr(useMaxStep), model.annotations.value(1), 800#
        expected = 8: If useMaxStep Then expected = 6
        TestCheck "advanced.actualLabel." & CStr(useMaxStep), InStr(model.annotations.text(2), CStr(expected)) > 0
        TestCheck "advanced.dependentTrace." & CStr(useMaxStep), InStr(Rules.RuleTrace("Extra"), "Created=2") > 0
    Next useMaxStep
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "advanced.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    TestRunAdvancedGuideExamples = mReport & "TOTAL ADVANCED GUIDE EXAMPLES: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' задаёт все данные для коротких примеров API без нового рабочего типа сечения.
Public Function TestAdvancedGuideDefinition(ByVal useMaxStep As Boolean) As CSectionDefinition
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim A As Double, B As Double, c As Double
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "GuideFragments"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Concrete", -300#, -400#, 1000#, 800#)
    facade.outer "Outer", "Concrete"
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Hole", 0#, -250#, 50#)
    facade.opening "Opening", "Hole", "Outer"
    ' Боковая линия состоит из дуги, наклонного отрезка, дуги вершины, наклонного отрезка и
    ' дуги.
    A = 100# / Sqr(2#): B = 300# + 50# / Sqr(2#): c = 50# / Sqr(2#)
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Nose"
    path.AddArc "HeelLow", 0#, 0#, 100#, -GEOM_PI / 2#, GEOM_PI / 4#
    path.AddLine "InclinedLow", A, -A, B, -c
    path.AddArc "NoseArc", 300#, 0#, 50#, -GEOM_PI / 4#, GEOM_PI / 2#
    path.AddLine "InclinedHigh", B, c, A, A
    path.AddArc "HeelHigh", 0#, 0#, 100#, GEOM_PI / 4#, GEOM_PI / 4#
    path.Seal: facade.AddPath path
    Set path = facade.chain("Side", "Nose", "HeelLow", 0#, "HeelHigh", 1#)
    facade.RebarAtStations "SideBars", "Side", Array(50#, 200#, 400#, 600#), 10#
    ' Одна группа объединяет две независимые линии. Количество и шаг задаются для каждой линии
    ' отдельно.
    Set path = facade.LinePath("RowA", -150#, 250#, 50#, 250#)
    Set path = facade.LinePath("RowB", 250#, 200#, 500#, 200#)
    facade.PathGroup "Independent", Array("RowA", "RowB")
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
    options.DistributionScope = PerPath: options.StartSetback = 20#: options.EndSetback = 30#
    options.AnnotationGroup = "RowsLabel"
    options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    If useMaxStep Then
        facade.RebarByMaxStep "Rows", "Independent", 100#, 10#, options
    Else
        facade.RebarByCount "Rows", "Independent", 4, 10#, options
    End If
    ' Внутренний ряд смещается от границы отверстия в бетон без ручного задания координат
    ' стержней.
    Set path = facade.offset("HoleAxis", "Hole", -30#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.EndMode = ClosedUniform
    options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    facade.RebarByCount "Inner", "HoleAxis", 6, 8#, options
    Set path = facade.LinePath("BasePath", -150#, -350#, 150#, -350#)
    facade.RebarByCount "Base", "BasePath", 4, 10#
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.EndMode = ClosedUniform ' Два из четырёх лучей попадают на конечную круговую ось; пропуски явные.
    options.directionY = 1#: options.SkipMissingProjection = True
    options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    facade.RebarProjected "Projected", "HoleAxis", "Base", 6#, options
    ' Дополнительные стержни связываются с каждой второй исходной позицией и смещаются по
    ' нормали.
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.normalOffset = 10#: options.everySecond = True
    options.SourceSuffix = "_Extra": facade.RebarDependent "Extra", "Base", 10#, options
    facade.VerticalExtent "Height", "Concrete", "H", 740#
    facade.RebarRowLabel "RowsLabel", "Rows", 0#, 1#
    Set TestAdvancedGuideDefinition = facade.Finish
End Function

' Проверяет чтение описания, источников и областей, геометрические преобразования и структурированную диагностику ошибок API.
Public Function TestRunApiGeometryReadExamples() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, diagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic, query As CSectionGeometryQuery
    Dim region As CConcreteRegion, opening As CConcreteRegion, frame As CConcreteRegion
    Dim options As CRebarRuleOptions, Rules As CRebarRuleExecutor, model As CSectionModel, mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Dim meshOptions As TSectionMeshOptions, ids As Variant, probes As Variant, X As Double, Y As Double
    Dim X2 As Double, Y2 As Double, cx As Double, cy As Double, Sweep As Double, LoopID As Long, edge As TRegionEdge
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "ApiRead", 2
    Set path = facade.AdjacentRectangles("Concrete", Array(Array(-200#, -200#, 400#, 400#)))
    facade.outer "Outer", "Concrete"
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Row", -150#, 100#, 150#, 100#)
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Row2", -150#, -100#, 150#, -100#)
    facade.PathGroup "Rows", Array("Row", "Row2")
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
    TestCheck "defaults.remainder", options.RemainderPlacement = RemainderCenter
    TestCheck "defaults.tangent", options.TangentOffset = 0#
    TestCheck "defaults.projectionDirection", options.directionX = 0# And options.directionY = 0#
    options.RemainderPlacement = RemainderStart: options.TangentOffset = 0#: options.directionX = 1#
    options.StartSetback = 20#: options.EndSetback = 30#: options.comment = "Guide": options.SourceReference = "ProgramInputs.Row"
    facade.RebarByCount "Bars", "Row", 3, 20#, options
    facade.VerticalExtent "Height", "Concrete", "H", 250#
    Set definition = facade.Finish
    TestCheck "definition.type", definition.typeID = "ApiRead"
    TestCheck "definition.schema", definition.schemaVersion = 2
    TestCheck "definition.annotationCount", definition.AnnotationCount = 1
    ids = definition.TargetPaths("Rows"): TestCheck "group.independent", UBound(ids) - LBound(ids) + 1 = 2
    Set diagnostic = definition.LastDiagnostic: TestCheck "definition.successDiagnostic", diagnostic Is Nothing
    meshOptions.stepX = 100#: meshOptions.stepY = 100#: meshOptions.boundarySubdivisions = 4: meshOptions.MaterialID = 1
    Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = builder.Build(definition, meshOptions)
    Set mesh = builder.mesh: TestCheck "builder.preparedMesh", Not mesh Is Nothing
    Set Rules = builder.Rules
    TestCheck "rules.positionCount", Rules.PositionCount = 3
    TestCheck "rules.diagnosticsText", InStr(Rules.DiagnosticsText, "Created=3") > 0
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery: Set region = definition.ConcreteDomain
    Set opening = query.circleRegion(0#, 0#, 20#): Set frame = query.SubtractContainedRegion(region, opening)
    TestCheck "query.loopRole.outer", Not query.LoopIsOpening(frame, 1)
    TestCheck "query.loopRole.opening", query.LoopIsOpening(frame, 2)
    TestNear "query.subtractedArea", frame.area, 160000# - 400# * GEOM_PI
    probes = query.SampleMaterialIntervals(region, 1#, 0#, 0#, -10#, 10#, 3)
    TestCheck "query.samples.shape", UBound(probes, 1) = 3 And UBound(probes, 2) = 5
    TestCheck "query.samples.hit", probes(2, 1)
    TestNear "query.samples.firstX", probes(2, 2), -200#: TestNear "query.samples.lastX", probes(2, 4), 200#
    region.GetSegment 1, X, Y, X2, Y2, cx, cy, Sweep, LoopID
    TestCheck "region.scalarSegment", LoopID = 1 And Sweep = 0#
    X = 1#: Y = 2#: query.TransformCoordinates X, Y, 10#, 20#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True
    TestNear "isometry.reflectThenRotate.x", X, 12#: TestNear "isometry.reflectThenRotate.y", Y, 21#
    Set path = definition.path("Row")
    Set diagnostic = path.LastDiagnostic: TestCheck "path.successDiagnostic", diagnostic Is Nothing
    On Error Resume Next
    path.CopySegment 0, edge
    TestCheck "path.invalidIndexCode", Err.number = vbObjectError + 5520: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set diagnostic = path.LastDiagnostic: TestCheck "path.reason", Len(diagnostic.reason) > 0
    On Error Resume Next
    Set path = definition.path("Missing")
    TestCheck "definition.missingPathCode", Err.number = vbObjectError + 5530: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set diagnostic = definition.LastDiagnostic: TestCheck "definition.errorDiagnostic", diagnostic.code = "MISSING_PATH"
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "ApiFailure"
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Small", 0#, 0#, 10#): facade.source "Small", "ProgramInputs.Radius"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set path = facade.offset("Lost", "Small", 20#)
    TestCheck "offset.failure", Err.number <> 0: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set diagnostic = facade.LastGeometryDiagnostic
    TestCheck "facade.offsetDiagnostic", Not diagnostic Is Nothing
    If Not diagnostic Is Nothing Then
        TestCheck "facade.offsetReason", Len(diagnostic.reason) > 0
        TestCheck "facade.offsetCode", diagnostic.code = "ROW_OFFSET_COLLAPSED"
        TestCheck "facade.offsetEntity", diagnostic.entityID = "Small"
        TestCheck "facade.offsetSource", diagnostic.SourceReference = "ProgramInputs.Radius"
        TestNear "facade.offsetDistance", diagnostic.detail1, 20#
        TestNear "facade.offsetRadius", diagnostic.detail2, 10#
    End If
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    TestCheck "geometry.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    TestRunApiGeometryReadExamples = mReport & "TOTAL API GEOMETRY EXAMPLES: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Public Function TestRunApiInputAndDataExamples() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""

' Сравнивает фактическую и ожидаемую величины с заданным в этом наборе допуском, сохраняя числа в протоколе.
Private Sub TestNear(ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    TestCheck name, Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000001 * GeomMax(1#, Abs(expected))
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Учитывает отдельное условие проверки и сохраняет его имя в итоговом протоколе.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal name As String, ByVal passed As Boolean)
    If passed Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1: mReport = mReport & "PASS: " & name & vbCrLf
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

' ==========================================================================
