Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: редактируемые отступы таблиц листа «Сечения» и их влияние на общий
' рецепт, включая фильтр проекций Opening. НДС в этом наборе не решается.
' ==========================================================================
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' те же внутренние координаты при вводе отступов в мм/см/м.
Public Function RunRecipeSetbackUnitTests() As String
    Dim values As Variant, baseline As Variant, scaled As Variant, table As CSectionInputReader
    Dim sheet As Object, setting As Object, settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem
    Dim recipe As ISectionRecipe, definition As CSectionDefinition, expected As CRebarLayout, actual As CRebarLayout
    Dim main As Long, extra As Long, row As Long, column As Long, i As Long, item As Variant, factor As Double
    Dim alerts As Boolean, itemColumn As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = "": alerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    values = TestFixtureRecipeValues("rngPointedSectionGeometry")
    TestFixtureSetInput values, "General", "B", "val", 800#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "General", "H", "val", 250#
    TestFixtureSetInput values, "Detail", "W", "left", 0#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "Detail", "W", "right", 150#
    TestFixtureSetInput values, "Detail", "R1", "left", 40#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "Detail", "R1", "right", 40#
    TestFixtureSetInput values, "Detail", "R2", "left", 0#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "Detail", "R2", "right", 80#
    Dim key As Variant, block As Variant, fields As Variant, field As Variant, rowKeys As Variant
    Set table = TestFixtureInput(values)
    For Each key In table.rowKeys("Main")
        TestFixtureSetInput values, "Main", CStr(key), "as", 40#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "Main", CStr(key), "d", 20#
        TestFixtureSetInput values, "Main", CStr(key), "n", 3
        TestFixtureSetInput values, "Main", CStr(key), "s0", 10#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "Main", CStr(key), "s1", 20#
        TestFixtureSetInput values, "Extra", CStr(key), "d2", 0#: TestFixtureSetInput values, "Extra", CStr(key), "d3", 0#
    Next key
    Set recipe = New CSectionRecipePointedSection
    Set expected = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(TestFixtureRecipeDefinition(recipe, "rngPointedSectionGeometry", values))
    baseline = values
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add: Set setting = sheet.range("A1:C2")
    setting.cells(1, 1).value2 = "Key": setting.cells(1, 2).value2 = "Value": setting.cells(1, 3).value2 = "Unit"
    setting.cells(2, 1).value2 = "Units.Length.Input"
    For Each item In Array(Array("mm", 1#), Array("cm", 10#), Array("m", 1000#))
        factor = CDbl(item(1)): scaled = baseline
        For Each block In Array("General", "Main", "Extra")
            Select Case CStr(block)
                Case "General": fields = Array("val")
                Case "Detail": fields = Array("left", "right")
                Case "Main": fields = Array("as", "d", "s0", "s1")
                Case "Extra": fields = Array("d2", "a2", "d3", "a3")
            End Select
            For Each key In table.rowKeys(CStr(block))
                If CStr(block) <> "Detail" Or CStr(key) <> "Type" Then
                    row = table.rowIndex(CStr(block), CStr(key))
                    For Each field In fields
                        column = table.columnIndex(CStr(block), CStr(field))
                        If IsNumeric(baseline(row, column)) Then scaled(row, column) = CDbl(baseline(row, column)) / factor
                    Next field
                End If
            Next key
        Next block
        setting.cells(2, 2).value2 = CStr(item(0))
        Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromRange setting
        Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
        Set definition = TestFixtureRecipeDefinition(recipe, "rngPointedSectionGeometry", scaled, units)
        Set actual = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition)
        TestCheck "setback.units.count." & CStr(item(0)), actual.count = expected.count
        For i = 1 To expected.count
            TestNear "setback.units.x." & CStr(item(0)) & "." & CStr(i), actual.X(i), expected.X(i)
            TestNear "setback.units.y." & CStr(item(0)) & "." & CStr(i), actual.Y(i), expected.Y(i)
        Next i
    Next item
    mReport = mReport & "TOTAL_RECIPE_SETBACK_UNITS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    If Not sheet Is Nothing Then sheet.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = alerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunRecipeSetbackUnitTests = mReport
    Exit Function
Failed:
    mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: units.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description & vbCrLf
    Resume Restore
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' обновление реестра не перестраивает Config и не требует таблиц геометрии.
Public Function RunRecipeTypeListTests() As String
    Dim config As Object, saved As Variant, expected As Variant, list As Object, ids As Variant
    Dim originalList As String, originalCircle As String, brokenCircle As String, i As Long, count As Long, code As Long
    Dim calculation As Long, events As Boolean, updating As Boolean, alerts As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Failed
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    calculation = Application.calculation: events = Application.EnableEvents
    updating = Application.ScreenUpdating: alerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    Set config = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Config").UsedRange: saved = TestFixtureSaveInputs(config)
    originalList = ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo
    originalCircle = ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo
    Set list = ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange
    ids = RegisteredSectionRecipeTypes: count = UBound(ids) - LBound(ids) + 1
    Application.calculation = xlCalculationManual: Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False: Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo = "=#REF!" ' Даже повреждённая чужая таблица не участвует в обновлении списка.
    brokenCircle = ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo
    list.value2 = "stale choice": expected = config.formula
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    TestCheck "types.config.outside.list", TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, list.Resize(count, 1))
    TestCheck "types.current.selection", TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, saved, list.Resize(count, 1))
    TestCheck "types.unrelated.name", ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo = brokenCircle
    For i = 1 To count: TestCheck "types.registered." & CStr(i), list.cells(i, 1).value2 = ids(LBound(ids) + i - 1): Next i
    TestCheck "types.state.success", Application.calculation = xlCalculationManual And Not Application.EnableEvents And Not Application.ScreenUpdating And Not Application.DisplayAlerts
    expected = config.formula: modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    TestCheck "types.idempotent", TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, Nothing)
    list.cells(count, 1).ClearContents ' Сокращённый список расширяется только на свободные ячейки своего столбца.
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=" & list.Resize(count - 1, 1).address(True, True, xlA1, True)
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    TestCheck "types.grow", ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange.rows.count = count And list.cells(count, 1).value2 = ids(UBound(ids))
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=" & list.Resize(count - 1, 1).address(True, True, xlA1, True) ' Занятое продолжение отклоняется до записи значений и имени.
    list.cells(count, 1).value2 = "user data": expected = config.formula
    On Error Resume Next
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes: code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "types.occupied.rejected", code <> 0
    TestCheck "types.occupied.data", TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, Nothing)
    TestCheck "types.occupied.name", ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange.rows.count = count - 1
    TestCheck "types.state.failure", Application.calculation = xlCalculationManual And Not Application.EnableEvents And Not Application.ScreenUpdating And Not Application.DisplayAlerts
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=" & list.Resize(count + 1, 1).address(True, True, xlA1, True) ' Лишняя прежняя запись удаляется только из принадлежащего списку диапазона.
    list.cells(count + 1, 1).value2 = "removed type": modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    TestCheck "types.shrink", ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange.rows.count = count And IsEmpty(list.cells(count + 1, 1).value2)
    expected = config.formula: ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=#REF!": code = 0
    On Error Resume Next
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes: code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "types.missing.rejected", code <> 0
    TestCheck "types.missing.data", TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, Nothing)
    GoTo Restore
Failed:
    TestCheck "types.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Len(originalList) > 0 Then ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = originalList
    If Len(originalCircle) > 0 Then ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo = originalCircle
    If Not config Is Nothing And Not IsEmpty(saved) Then TestFixtureRestoreInputs config, saved
    Application.calculation = calculation: Application.EnableEvents = events
    Application.ScreenUpdating = updating: Application.DisplayAlerts = alerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunRecipeTypeListTests = mReport & "TOTAL RECIPE TYPE LIST: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает весь Config, кроме явно разрешённого служебного списка.
Private Function TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList(ByVal config As Object, ByVal expected As Variant, ByVal list As Object) As Boolean
    Dim actual As Variant, row As Long, column As Long, sheetRow As Long, sheetColumn As Long, skip As Boolean
    actual = config.formula
    For row = 1 To UBound(expected, 1)
        For column = 1 To UBound(expected, 2)
            skip = False
            If Not list Is Nothing Then
                sheetRow = config.row + row - 1: sheetColumn = config.column + column - 1
                skip = sheetColumn = list.column And sheetRow >= list.row And sheetRow < list.row + list.rows.count
            End If
            If Not skip Then
                If VarType(actual(row, column)) <> VarType(expected(row, column)) Then Exit Function
                If CStr(actual(row, column)) <> CStr(expected(row, column)) Then Exit Function
            End If
        Next column
    Next row
    TestSameConfigOutsideTypeList = True
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет влияние редактируемых концевых отступов PointedSection и HollowRectangle на позиции, проекции, адреса ошибок и неизменность бетона.
Public Function RunRecipeSetbackInputTests() As String
    Dim rounded As Object, hollow As Object, savedRounded As Variant, savedHollow As Variant
    Dim table As CSectionInputReader, row As Long, main As Long, def As CSectionDefinition
    Dim original As CRebarLayout, changed As CRebarLayout, region As CConcreteRegion
    Dim face As Variant, faces As Variant, helper As CRebarRuleExecutor, originalHelper As CRebarRuleExecutor, parameters As Variant
    Dim geometryArea As Double, layoutCount As Long, reference As String, reason As String, number As Long
    Dim config As Object, savedConfig As Variant
    Set config = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Config").UsedRange: savedConfig = TestFixtureSaveInputs(config)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    modTestShapeArchitecture.TestConfigureShapeFixture "RoundedMixed"
    Set rounded = ThisWorkbook.names("rngPointedSectionGeometry").RefersToRange
    Set hollow = ThisWorkbook.names("rngHollowRectangleGeometry").RefersToRange
    savedRounded = rounded.formula: savedHollow = hollow.formula
    Set table = TestFixtureInput(rounded.value2)
    row = table.rowIndex("Main", "Top"): main = row - 1
    TestCheck "rounded.start.header", table.columnIndex("Main", "s0") = 6
    TestCheck "rounded.end.header", table.columnIndex("Main", "s1") = 7
    TestCheck "rounded.editable.centered", rounded.cells(row, 6).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter And rounded.cells(row, 7).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    face = Array(40#, 20#, 3, 0#, 0#, "Stacked", "Stacked", "EachBar", "EachBar")
    faces = Array(face, face, Array(40#, 20#, 5, 0#, 0#, "Stacked", "Stacked", "EachBar", "EachBar"), face)
    parameters = Array(800#, 250#, 0#, 150#, 40#, 40#, 0#, 80#)
    rounded.cells(main + 1, 6).Resize(4, 2).value2 = 0#
    Set def = TestFixtureRoundedDefinition(parameters, faces, True): Set original = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(def)
    geometryArea = def.ConcreteDomain.area: layoutCount = original.count
    TestNear "rounded.zero.first", original.X(1), -360#
    rounded.cells(row, 6).value2 = 10#: rounded.cells(row, 7).value2 = 20#
    Set def = TestFixtureRoundedDefinition(parameters, faces, True): Set changed = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(def)
    TestNear "rounded.start.actual", changed.X(1), original.X(1) + 10#
    TestNear "rounded.end.actual", changed.X(5), original.X(5) - 20#
    TestNear "rounded.concrete.unchanged", def.ConcreteDomain.area, geometryArea
    TestCheck "rounded.count.unchanged", changed.count = layoutCount
    TestNear "rounded.opposite.row.unchanged", changed.Y(6), original.Y(6)
    rounded.cells(row, 6).ClearContents
    Set changed = Nothing: number = 0
    On Error Resume Next
    Set changed = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(TestFixtureRoundedDefinition(parameters, faces, True))
    number = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "rounded.active.empty.rejected", number <> 0 And changed Is Nothing
    rounded.cells(row, 6).value2 = -1#
    On Error Resume Next
    Set changed = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(TestFixtureRoundedDefinition(parameters, faces, True))
    number = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "rounded.active.negative.rejected", number <> 0 And InStr(1, reason, "[" & CStr(row) & ",6]", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    rounded.cells(row, 6).value2 = CVErr(xlErrValue)
    faces(2) = Array(40#, 0#, 0, 0#, 0#, "Stacked", "Stacked", "EachBar", "EachBar")
    Set changed = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(TestFixtureRoundedDefinition(parameters, faces, True))
    TestCheck "rounded.inactive.error.ignored", changed.count = layoutCount - 5
    rounded.formula = savedRounded

    modTestShapeArchitecture.TestConfigureShapeFixture "HollowCentered"
    Set table = TestFixtureInput(hollow.value2)
    main = table.rowIndex("Main", "Top") - 1
    row = table.rowIndex("Main", "OpeningTop")
    TestCheck "hollow.start.header", table.columnIndex("Main", "s0") = 6
    TestCheck "hollow.end.header", table.columnIndex("Main", "s1") = 7
    hollow.cells(main + 1, 6).Resize(8, 2).value2 = 0#
    face = Array(40#, 20#, 6, 0#, 0#, "Stacked", "Stacked", "EachBar", "EachBar")
    faces = Array(face, face, Array(40#, 20#, 8, 0#, 0#, "Stacked", "Stacked", "EachBar", "EachBar"), _
        Array(40#, 20#, 8, 0#, 0#, "Stacked", "Stacked", "EachBar", "EachBar"), face, face, face, face)
    parameters = Array(500#, 800#, 0#, 200#, 500#, 0#)
    Set originalHelper = New CRebarRuleExecutor
    Set def = TestFixtureHollowDefinition(parameters, faces, True): Set original = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(def, originalHelper)
    geometryArea = def.ConcreteDomain.area
    TestCheck "hollow.zero.projected.count", TestGroupCount(original, "Opening.B.Top") = 6
    hollow.cells(row, 6).value2 = 75#: hollow.cells(row, 7).value2 = 15#
    Set helper = New CRebarRuleExecutor
    Set def = TestFixtureHollowDefinition(parameters, faces, True): Set changed = TestFixtureAnnotatedLayout(def, helper)
    TestCheck "hollow.projection.filtered", TestGroupCount(changed, "Opening.B.Top") = 4
    TestCheck "hollow.skips.diagnostic", helper.SkippedProjections - originalHelper.SkippedProjections = 2
    TestCheck "hollow.positions.not.redistributed", TestProjectedSubset(changed, original, "Opening.B.Top")
    TestCheck "hollow.other.projections.unchanged", TestGroupCount(changed, "Opening.B.Bottom") = TestGroupCount(original, "Opening.B.Bottom")
    TestNear "hollow.concrete.unchanged", def.ConcreteDomain.area, geometryArea
    hollow.formula = savedHollow
    mReport = mReport & "TOTAL_RECIPE_SETBACK_INPUT: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not rounded Is Nothing Then rounded.formula = savedRounded
    If Not hollow Is Nothing Then hollow.formula = savedHollow
    If Not config Is Nothing Then TestFixtureRestoreInputs config, savedConfig
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunRecipeSetbackInputTests = mReport
    Exit Function
Failed:
    mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description & vbCrLf
    Resume Restore
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Считает физические стержни, которые состоят в указанной группе, включая дополнительные принадлежности.
Private Function TestGroupCount(ByVal layout As CRebarLayout, ByVal group As String) As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To layout.count
        If TestInGroup(layout, i, group) Then TestGroupCount = TestGroupCount + 1
    Next i
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет, что отфильтрованные проекции сохранили исходные координаты и не были равномерно перераспределены заново.
Private Function TestProjectedSubset(ByVal actual As CRebarLayout, ByVal original As CRebarLayout, ByVal group As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, found As Boolean
    For i = 1 To actual.count
        If TestInGroup(actual, i, group) Then
            found = False
            For j = 1 To original.count
                If TestInGroup(original, j, group) Then
                    If Abs(actual.X(i) - original.X(j)) < 0.000001 And Abs(actual.Y(i) - original.Y(j)) < 0.000001 Then found = True
                End If
            Next j
            If Not found Then Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
    TestProjectedSubset = True
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет все принадлежности физического стержня, а не только первую группу публикации.
Private Function TestInGroup(ByVal layout As CRebarLayout, ByVal index As Long, ByVal group As String) As Boolean
    Dim membership As Variant
    For Each membership In layout.BarMemberships(index)
        If CStr(membership) = group Then TestInGroup = True: Exit Function
    Next membership
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Учитывает отдельное условие проверки и сохраняет его имя в итоговом протоколе.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1: mReport = mReport & "OK: " & name & vbCrLf
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает фактическую и ожидаемую величины с заданным в этом наборе допуском, сохраняя числа в протоколе.
Private Sub TestNear(ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    TestCheck name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000001
End Sub


====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: modTestRegressionBaseline
TYPE: 1
LINES: 401
====================================================================================================
Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: Регрессионная проверка численных результатов
' ==========================================================================
' Модуль сравнивает текущие результаты с сохраненным baseline, чтобы правки
' интерфейса, документации или архитектуры не меняли расчетную математику.

Private Type TRegressionStats
    passed As Long
    Failed As Long
    report As String
End Type

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет пять опорных задач круглого сечения и проверки повторяемости,
' изменения геометрии и переноса начала координат. Возвращает численный
' протокол с прежними компонентными допусками и отдельными счетчиками отказов.
Public Function RunRegressionBaselineTests() As String
    On Error GoTo Failed

    Dim stats As TRegressionStats
    Dim t0 As Double
    t0 = Timer

    TestAppendLine stats, "REGRESSION_BASELINE_VERSION: Stage01 TEMPORARY_BASELINE"
    TestRunBaselineCase stats, "pure_compression", 300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, 1, -100000#, 0#, 0#, False
    TestRunBaselineCase stats, "n_plus_mx_my_zero", 300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, 1, -100000#, -4000000#, 0#, True
    TestRunBaselineCase stats, "n_plus_my_mx_zero", 300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, 1, -100000#, 0#, -3000000#, True
    TestRunBaselineCase stats, "full_n_mx_my", 300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, 1, -100000#, -4000000#, -3000000#, True
    TestRunBaselineCase stats, "symmetric_circle", 300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 10#, 1, -220000#, -6000000#, 0#, True
    TestRepeatedRun stats
    TestGeometryChange stats
    TestOriginShift stats

    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_REGRESSION_BASELINE: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & _
        "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed) & "; elapsedSec=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(Timer - t0)
    RunRegressionBaselineTests = stats.report
    Exit Function

Failed:
    RunRegressionBaselineTests = stats.report & "RUNTIME ERROR: " & CStr(Err.number) & _
        "; source=" & Err.source & "; description=" & Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строит заданную круговую модель и решает N+Mx+My опорными материалами.
' Проверяет равновесие, при запросе отдельно ищет lambda и записывает
' плоскость, размеры модели и время в воспроизводимый baseline-протокол.
Private Sub TestRunBaselineCase(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal caseName As String, _
        ByVal Diameter As Double, ByVal CenterX As Double, ByVal CenterY As Double, _
        ByVal axisDistance As Double, ByVal barCount As Long, ByVal barDiameter As Double, _
        ByVal meshStep As Double, ByVal boundarySubdivisions As Long, _
        ByVal nValue As Double, ByVal mxValue As Double, ByVal myValue As Double, _
        ByVal calculateLambda As Boolean)

    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestFixtureDisk(Diameter, CenterX, CenterY)

    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = New CFiberMeshBuilder
    mesh.BuildMesh geom, meshStep, meshStep, 1, boundarySubdivisions

    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder: Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder
    facade.Initialize "BaselineCirclePaths"
    Dim rebars As CRebarLayout
    Set rebars = TestFixtureClosedCountRow(facade.CirclePath("Boundary", CenterX, CenterY, Diameter / 2#), _
        facade.CirclePath("Axis", CenterX, CenterY, Diameter / 2# - axisDistance), barCount, barDiameter, "A400", "Circle", "Круг: основной ряд арматуры")

    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureBaselineSolver solver

    Dim t0 As Double
    t0 = Timer
    solver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), nValue, mxValue, myValue
    Dim elapsed As Double
    elapsed = Timer - t0

    TestAssertTrue stats, caseName & ".converged", solver.Converged
    TestAssertEquilibrium stats, caseName, solver, nValue, mxValue, myValue

    Dim lambdaText As String
    lambdaText = "NA"
    If calculateLambda Then lambdaText = TestCalculateLambdaText(mesh, rebars, nValue, mxValue, myValue)

    TestAppendBaseline stats, caseName, solver, lambdaText, elapsed, mesh.fiberCount, rebars.count
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Дважды решает одинаковое сочетание на круглом сечении разными экземплярами
' решателя. Проверяет равновесие и совпадение epsilon0 и кривизн: предыдущий запуск
' не должен влиять на следующий.
Private Sub TestRepeatedRun(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats)
    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestFixtureDisk(300#)

    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = New CFiberMeshBuilder
    mesh.BuildMesh geom, 20#, 20#, 1, 1

    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder: Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder
    facade.Initialize "BaselineCirclePaths"
    Dim rebars As CRebarLayout
    Set rebars = TestFixtureClosedCountRow(facade.CirclePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 150#), _
        facade.CirclePath("Axis", 0#, 0#, 110#), 8, 20#, "A400", "Circle", "Круг: основной ряд арматуры")

    Dim firstSolver As CSectionSolver
    Set firstSolver = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureBaselineSolver firstSolver
    firstSolver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -100000#, -4000000#, -3000000#

    Dim secondSolver As CSectionSolver
    Set secondSolver = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureBaselineSolver secondSolver
    secondSolver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -100000#, -4000000#, -3000000#

    TestAssertTrue stats, "repeated_run.first.converged", firstSolver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "repeated_run.second.converged", secondSolver.Converged
    TestAssertClose stats, "repeated_run.epsilon0", secondSolver.Epsilon0, firstSolver.Epsilon0, 0.000000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "repeated_run.kappaX", secondSolver.KappaX, firstSolver.KappaX, 0.0000000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "repeated_run.kappaY", secondSolver.KappaY, firstSolver.KappaY, 0.0000000000001
    TestAppendBaseline stats, "repeated_run_first", firstSolver, "NA", 0#, mesh.fiberCount, rebars.count
    TestAppendBaseline stats, "repeated_run_second", secondSolver, "NA", 0#, mesh.fiberCount, rebars.count
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает круги 300 и 360 мм под одинаковыми усилиями. Обе задачи должны
' найти равновесие, а плоскости отличаться: изменение геометрии должно
' действительно доходить до расчетного ядра, а не использовать старую модель.
Private Sub TestGeometryChange(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats)
    Dim smallSolver As CSectionSolver
    Dim largeSolver As CSectionSolver
    Set smallSolver = TestSolveCircleDirect(300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, -100000#, -4000000#, -3000000#)
    Set largeSolver = TestSolveCircleDirect(360#, 0#, 0#, 45#, 8, 20#, 20#, -100000#, -4000000#, -3000000#)

    TestAssertTrue stats, "geometry_change.small.converged", smallSolver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "geometry_change.large.converged", largeSolver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "geometry_change.state_changed", Abs(smallSolver.KappaX - largeSolver.KappaX) > 0.000000000001 Or _
        Abs(smallSolver.KappaY - largeSolver.KappaY) > 0.000000000001 Or _
        Abs(smallSolver.Epsilon0 - largeSolver.Epsilon0) > 0.000000000001
    TestAppendBaseline stats, "geometry_change_d300", smallSolver, "NA", 0#, 0, 0
    TestAppendBaseline stats, "geometry_change_d360", largeSolver, "NA", 0#, 0, 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Переносит модель и усилия к другому началу координат через общий load adapter.
' Кривизны должны сохраняться, epsilon0 и моменты преобразоваться по заданному
' сдвигу; равновесие подтверждается отдельно в смещенной системе.
Private Sub TestOriginShift(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats)
    Dim baseN As Double
    Dim baseMx As Double
    Dim baseMy As Double
    baseN = -100000#
    baseMx = -4000000#
    baseMy = -3000000#

    Dim baseSolver As CSectionSolver
    Set baseSolver = TestSolveCircleDirect(300#, 0#, 0#, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, baseN, baseMx, baseMy)

    Dim shiftX As Double
    Dim shiftY As Double
    shiftX = 75#
    shiftY = -50#

    Dim shiftedMx As Double
    Dim shiftedMy As Double
    Dim shiftedLoad As CSectionLoadState
    Set shiftedLoad = New CSectionLoadState
    shiftedLoad.Initialize baseN, baseMx, baseMy, shiftX, shiftY
    shiftedMx = shiftedLoad.InternalMx
    shiftedMy = shiftedLoad.InternalMy

    Dim shiftedSolver As CSectionSolver
    Set shiftedSolver = TestSolveCircleDirect(300#, shiftX, shiftY, 40#, 8, 20#, 20#, baseN, shiftedMx, shiftedMy)

    TestAssertTrue stats, "origin_shift.base.converged", baseSolver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "origin_shift.shifted.converged", shiftedSolver.Converged
    TestAssertClose stats, "origin_shift.kappaX", shiftedSolver.KappaX, baseSolver.KappaX, 0.00000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "origin_shift.kappaY", shiftedSolver.KappaY, baseSolver.KappaY, 0.00000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "origin_shift.epsilon0", shiftedSolver.Epsilon0, _
        baseSolver.Epsilon0 - baseSolver.KappaX * shiftY - baseSolver.KappaY * shiftX, 0.00000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "origin_shift.N.transform", baseN, -100000#, 0.000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "origin_shift.Mx.transform", shiftedMx, 1000000#, 0.000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "origin_shift.My.transform", shiftedMy, -10500000#, 0.000000001
    TestAssertEquilibrium stats, "origin_shift.shifted", shiftedSolver, baseN, shiftedMx, shiftedMy
    TestAppendBaseline stats, "origin_shift_base", baseSolver, "NA", 0#, 0, 0
    TestAppendBaseline stats, "origin_shift_shifted", shiftedSolver, "NA", 0#, 0, 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создаёт отдельную круговую модель с автоматически размещённой арматурой
' и рассчитывает НДС при заданной нагрузке. Использует фиксированные эталонные
' настройки без изменения Config и повторного использования соседнего решателя.
Private Function TestSolveCircleDirect(ByVal Diameter As Double, ByVal CenterX As Double, ByVal CenterY As Double, _
        ByVal axisDistance As Double, ByVal barCount As Long, ByVal barDiameter As Double, ByVal meshStep As Double, _
        ByVal nValue As Double, ByVal mxValue As Double, ByVal myValue As Double) As CSectionSolver

    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestFixtureDisk(Diameter, CenterX, CenterY)

    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = New CFiberMeshBuilder
    mesh.BuildMesh geom, meshStep, meshStep, 1, 1

    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder: Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder
    facade.Initialize "BaselineCirclePaths"
    Dim rebars As CRebarLayout
    Set rebars = TestFixtureClosedCountRow(facade.CirclePath("Boundary", CenterX, CenterY, Diameter / 2#), _
        facade.CirclePath("Axis", CenterX, CenterY, Diameter / 2# - axisDistance), barCount, barDiameter, "A400", "Circle", "Круг: основной ряд арматуры")

    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureBaselineSolver solver
    solver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), nValue, mxValue, myValue
    Set TestSolveCircleDirect = solver
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет отдельный поиск предельного множителя при ненулевом базовом моменте.
' Возвращает число или служебную отметку файла эталона; пользовательский статус не назначает.
Private Function TestCalculateLambdaText(ByVal mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder, ByVal rebars As CRebarLayout, _
        ByVal nValue As Double, ByVal mxBase As Double, ByVal myBase As Double) As String
    If Sqr(mxBase * mxBase + myBase * myBase) <= 0.000000001 Then
        TestCalculateLambdaText = "NA"
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim cap As CCapacitySolver
    Set cap = New CCapacitySolver
    TestConfigureBaselineCapacity cap
    cap.SolveByLoadMultiplier TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), nValue, mxBase, myBase
    If cap.Converged Then
        TestCalculateLambdaText = TestFormatNumberInvariant(cap.LambdaUltimate)
    Else
        TestCalculateLambdaText = "FAIL:" & cap.limitState
    End If
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Фиксирует численные ограничения baseline независимо от сохраненного Config.
Private Sub TestConfigureBaselineSolver(ByVal solver As CSectionSolver)
    solver.loadSteps = 1
    solver.maxIterations = 60
    solver.toleranceN = 1#
    solver.toleranceMx = 1000#
    solver.toleranceMy = 1000#
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задаёт фиксированные границы поиска, допуски и физические пределы контрольной задачи несущей
' способности.
Private Sub TestConfigureBaselineCapacity(ByVal cap As CCapacitySolver)
    cap.InitialLambdaStep = 1#
    cap.maxLambda = 64#
    cap.LambdaTolerance = 0.01
    cap.MaxRetries = 0
    cap.SolverBaseLoadSteps = 1
    cap.SolverMaxIterations = 60
    cap.ConcreteCompressionLimit = -0.0035
    cap.SteelStrainLimit = 0.025
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Материалы эталона построены по фиксированным физическим точкам без численного продолжения
' диаграмм.
Private Function TestProvisionalConcrete() As CMaterialDiagram
    Dim concrete As CMaterialDiagram
    Set concrete = New CMaterialDiagram
    concrete.TestInitialize -0.0015, -15.5, -0.0035, -15.5
    Set TestProvisionalConcrete = concrete
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создает физическую диаграмму арматуры baseline: 350 МПа, начало плато
' 0.00175 и предельная деформация 0.025; расширение не включается.
Private Function TestProvisionalSteel() As CMaterialDiagram
    Dim steel As CMaterialDiagram
    Set steel = New CMaterialDiagram
    steel.TestInitialize 0.00175, 350#, 0.025
    Set TestProvisionalSteel = steel
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет три компоненты усилий с раздельными силовым/моментными допусками.
Private Sub TestAssertEquilibrium(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByVal solver As CSectionSolver, ByVal nValue As Double, ByVal mxValue As Double, ByVal myValue As Double)
    TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".N", solver.Nint, nValue, 2#, 0.00001
    TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".Mx", solver.Mxint, mxValue, 2000#, 0.00001
    TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".My", solver.Myint, myValue, 2000#, 0.00001
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Около нуля использует абсолютный допуск компоненты, иначе - относительный.
Private Sub TestAssertLoadComponent(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal name As String, _
        ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double, ByVal zeroTolerance As Double, _
        ByVal relTolerance As Double)
    If Abs(expected) <= zeroTolerance Then
        TestAssertClose stats, name, actual, expected, zeroTolerance
    Else
        TestAssertRelative stats, name, actual, expected, relTolerance
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Assertions ниже сохраняют результат каждой проверки, не прерывая остальные кейсы.
Private Sub TestAssertTrue(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Записывает абсолютную разницу и исходные числа, чтобы отказ можно было перепроверить.
Private Sub TestAssertClose(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, _
        ByVal expected As Double, ByVal tolerance As Double)
    Dim diff As Double
    diff = Abs(actual - expected)
    If diff <= tolerance Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; absDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(diff)
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; absDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(diff)
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает относительную разницу; при практически нулевом эталоне не делит на него.
Private Sub TestAssertRelative(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, _
        ByVal expected As Double, ByVal relTolerance As Double)
    Dim relDiff As Double
    If Abs(expected) <= 0.000000001 Then
        relDiff = Abs(actual - expected)
    Else
        relDiff = Abs((actual - expected) / expected)
    End If

    If relDiff <= relTolerance Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; relDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(relDiff)
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; relDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(relDiff)
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сохраняет плоскость, усилия, невязки, счетчики и время одним именованным протоколом.
' Текст lambda передан отдельно: отсутствующая/неуспешная точка не заменяется нулем.
Private Sub TestAppendBaseline(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal caseName As String, _
        ByVal solver As CSectionSolver, ByVal lambdaText As String, ByVal ElapsedSeconds As Double, _
        ByVal fiberCount As Long, ByVal RebarCount As Long)
    TestAppendLine stats, "BASELINE|" & caseName & _
        "|converged=" & TestBoolText(solver.Converged) & _
        "|eps0=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.Epsilon0) & _
        "|kappaX=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.KappaX) & _
        "|kappaY=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.KappaY) & _
        "|Nint=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.Nint) & _
        "|Mxint=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.Mxint) & _
        "|Myint=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.Myint) & _
        "|resN=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.ResidualN) & _
        "|resMx=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.ResidualMx) & _
        "|resMy=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(solver.ResidualMy) & _
        "|lambda=" & lambdaText & _
        "|iterations=" & CStr(solver.iterations) & _
        "|elapsedSec=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(ElapsedSeconds) & _
        "|fibers=" & CStr(fiberCount) & _
        "|rebars=" & CStr(RebarCount)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Однотипные helpers протокола задают устойчивые Boolean/числовые подписи и перевод строки.
Private Function TestBoolText(ByVal value As Boolean) As String
    If value Then
        TestBoolText = "True"
    Else
        TestBoolText = "False"
    End If
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Добавляет строку к контрольному протоколу с явным разделителем строк.
Private Sub TestAppendLine(ByRef stats As TRegressionStats, ByVal text As String)
    stats.report = stats.report & text & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Форматирует число для текстового протокола с десятичной точкой; исходные расчётные значения не меняются.
Private Function TestFormatNumberInvariant(ByVal value As Double) As String
    TestFormatNumberInvariant = Replace$(format$(value, "0.############"), ",", ".")
End Function

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: Проверки общего ридера: перестановки, типы значений, единицы и адреса ошибок.
' ==========================================================================
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создаёт два независимых блока; ошибочное числовое поле остаётся невостребованным.
Private Function TestInputValues() As Variant
    Dim data(1 To 13, 1 To 6) As Variant
    data(1, 1) = "Dimensions": data(1, 2) = "Размеры"
    data(3, 1) = "key": data(3, 2) = "name": data(3, 3) = "val"
    data(3, 4) = "unit": data(3, 5) = "note"
    data(4, 1) = "B": data(4, 2) = "Ширина": data(4, 3) = 60#
    data(5, 1) = "Zero": data(5, 3) = 0#
    data(6, 1) = "Unused": data(6, 3) = CVErr(2015)
    data(8, 1) = "Bars": data(8, 2) = "Армирование"
    data(10, 1) = "key": data(10, 2) = "name": data(10, 3) = "d"
    data(10, 4) = "n": data(10, 5) = "mode": data(10, 6) = "as"
    data(11, 1) = "B": data(11, 3) = 16#: data(11, 4) = 4
    data(11, 5) = "stacked": data(11, 6) = 40#
    data(12, 1) = "Off": data(12, 4) = 0
    data(13, 1) = "Units": data(13, 3) = "мм"
    TestInputValues = data
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строит снимок с адресами, которые зависят от фактической позиции, а не от ключа.
Private Function TestMakeReader(ByVal data As Variant, Optional ByVal units As CUnitSystem = Nothing) As CSectionInputReader
    Dim locations(1 To 13, 1 To 6) As String, row As Long, column As Long
    For row = 1 To 13
        For column = 1 To 6
            locations(row, column) = "Config!" & Chr$(71 + column) & CStr(80 + row)
        Next column
    Next row
    Dim table As CSectionInputTable: Set table = New CSectionInputTable
    table.Initialize "testTable", data, locations
    Set TestMakeReader = New CSectionInputReader: TestMakeReader.Initialize table, units
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет ошибку структуры либо выбранного числового поля и точный адрес её причины.
Private Sub TestReject(ByVal title As String, ByVal data As Variant, ByVal expectedAddress As String, Optional ByVal operation As String = "structure")
    Dim reader As CSectionInputReader, ignored As Double, description As String, keys As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set reader = TestMakeReader(data)
    If Err.number = 0 Then
        Select Case operation
            Case "structure": keys = reader.rowKeys("Dimensions")
            Case "count": ignored = reader.count("Bars", "B", "n")
            Case "diameter": ignored = reader.OptionalDiameter("Bars", "B", "d")
            Case "value": ignored = reader.number("Dimensions", "Unused")
            Case "missing": ignored = reader.number("Dimensions", "Missing")
            Case "column": ignored = reader.number("Dimensions", "B", "Missing")
            Case "block": ignored = reader.number("Missing", "B")
            Case "barKeys": keys = reader.rowKeys("Bars")
        End Select
    End If
    description = Err.description
    TestCheck title, Err.number <> 0 And InStr(1, description, expectedAddress, vbTextCompare) > 0
    Err.Clear: On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Учитывает результат отдельного условия, сохраняя все причины неудач.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByVal title As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & title & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ
' ==========================================================================
' Проверяет независимость чтения от подписей, порядка строк, столбцов и блоков.
Public Function RunSectionInputReaderTests() As String
    Dim data As Variant, copy As Variant, reader As CSectionInputReader, scenario As Long
    Dim row As Long, column As Long, value As Variant, units As CUnitSystem, key As Variant, scoped As CSectionInputReader, scopedTable As CSectionInputTable
    Dim custom(1 To 2, 1 To 2) As Variant, customTable As CSectionInputTable, ignored As Variant, code As Long, description As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.InitializeDefaults
    data = TestInputValues: data(11, 1) = "TypeA.B": data(12, 1) = "TypeB.Off"
    Set scopedTable = New CSectionInputTable: scopedTable.Initialize "sharedInput", data
    Set scoped = New CSectionInputReader: scoped.Initialize scopedTable, units, "typea."
    TestCheck "prefix.count", scoped.count("Bars", "B", "n") = 4
    key = scoped.rowKeys("Bars")
    TestCheck "prefix.keys", UBound(key) = 0 And CStr(key(0)) = "B"
    TestCheck "prefix.column", scoped.columnIndex("Bars", "d") = 3
    Set scoped = New CSectionInputReader: scoped.Initialize scopedTable, units, "Missing."
    key = scoped.rowKeys("Bars")
    TestCheck "prefix.empty", UBound(key) < LBound(key)
    For scenario = 0 To 7 ' Три бита независимо переставляют столбцы, строки данных и целые блоки: проверяются все восемь сочетаний.
        data = TestInputValues
        If (scenario And 1) <> 0 Then
            For row = 1 To 13
                value = data(row, 3): data(row, 3) = data(row, 6): data(row, 6) = value
            Next row
        End If
        If (scenario And 2) <> 0 Then
            For column = 1 To 6
                value = data(4, column): data(4, column) = data(5, column): data(5, column) = value
                value = data(11, column): data(11, column) = data(12, column): data(12, column) = value
            Next column
        End If
        If (scenario And 4) <> 0 Then
            For row = 1 To 6
                For column = 1 To 6
                    value = data(row, column): data(row, column) = data(row + 7, column): data(row + 7, column) = value
                Next column
            Next row
        End If
        Set reader = TestMakeReader(data, units)
        TestCheck "number." & CStr(scenario), reader.number("dimensions", "b") = 60#
        TestCheck "length." & CStr(scenario), reader.PositiveLength("Dimensions", "B") = 60#
        TestCheck "count." & CStr(scenario), reader.count("Bars", "B", "n") = 4
        TestCheck "diameter." & CStr(scenario), reader.OptionalDiameter("Bars", "B", "d") = 16#
        TestCheck "choice." & CStr(scenario), reader.choice("Bars", "B", Array("Stacked", "SideBySide"), "mode") = "Stacked"
        TestCheck "empty.diameter." & CStr(scenario), reader.OptionalDiameter("Bars", "Off", "d") = 0#
        TestCheck "empty.offset." & CStr(scenario), reader.OptionalRowOffset("Bars", "Off", "as") = 0#
        key = reader.rowKeys("Bars"): TestCheck "units.excluded." & CStr(scenario), UBound(key) = 1
        copy = data: data(1, 2) = "Изменённый заголовок"
        TestCheck "snapshot." & CStr(scenario), reader.number("Dimensions", "B") = 60#
    Next scenario
    data = TestInputValues: data(8, 1) = "Dimensions": TestReject "duplicate.block", data, "Config!H88"
    data = TestInputValues: data(5, 1) = "B": TestReject "duplicate.row", data, "Config!H85"
    data = TestInputValues: data(3, 4) = "val": TestReject "duplicate.column", data, "Config!K83"
    data = TestInputValues: TestReject "unused.error.lazy", data, "Config!J86", "value"
    data = TestInputValues: data(11, 1) = CVErr(2015): Set reader = TestMakeReader(data)
    TestCheck "unused.block.key.error.lazy", reader.number("Dimensions", "B") = 60#
    TestReject "requested.block.key.error.address", data, "Config!H91", "barKeys"
    TestReject "missing.row", data, "Config!H81", "missing"
    TestReject "missing.column", data, "Config!H83", "column"
    TestReject "missing.block", data, "Config!H81", "block"
    For Each value In Array(-1, 2.5, True, "text")
        data = TestInputValues: data(11, 4) = value: TestReject "invalid.count", data, "Config!K91", "count"
    Next value
    For Each value In Array(-1, "-", True, "text")
        data = TestInputValues: data(11, 3) = value: TestReject "invalid.diameter", data, "Config!J91", "diameter"
    Next value
    Set reader = TestMakeReader(TestInputValues, units)
    units.CopyState "cm", "m", "mm2", "m2", "N", "N", "N*mm", "N*mm", "MPa", "MPa", "1/mm", "1/mm", "Tension", "+Y tension", "+X tension"
    TestCheck "units.snapshot.unchanged", reader.PositiveLength("Dimensions", "B") = 60#
    Set reader = TestMakeReader(TestInputValues, units)
    TestCheck "units.cm.to.mm", reader.PositiveLength("Dimensions", "B") = 600#
    TestCheck "raw.value.no.conversion", reader.cellValue("Dimensions", "B") = 60#
    TestCheck "text.original.case", reader.text("Bars", "B", "mode") = "stacked"
    TestCheck "signed.length.cm.to.mm", reader.length("Dimensions", "B") = 600#
    TestCheck "nonnegative.zero", reader.NonNegativeLength("Dimensions", "Zero") = 0#
    TestCheck "source.related.fields", reader.SourceReferences("Bars", "B", Array("d", "n")) = "Config!J91; Config!K91"
    reader.Require "Dimensions", "B", "val", True, "Размер допустим."
    TestCheck "require.valid", True
    On Error Resume Next
    reader.Require "Dimensions", "B", "val", False, "Ширина недостаточна."
    description = Err.description: code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "require.actual.address", code <> 0 And InStr(description, "Config!J84") > 0 And InStr(description, "Ширина недостаточна.") > 0
    custom(1, 1) = "Размер": custom(1, 2) = "Значение": custom(2, 1) = "B": custom(2, 2) = 25#
    Set customTable = New CSectionInputTable: customTable.Initialize "Custom", custom
    Set reader = New CSectionInputReader: reader.Initialize customTable, units
    TestCheck "custom.positional.text", reader.ValueAt(1, 2) = "Значение"
    TestCheck "custom.positional.number.raw", reader.ValueAt(2, 2) = 25#
    custom(2, 2) = 99#: TestCheck "custom.positional.snapshot", reader.ValueAt(2, 2) = 25#
    On Error Resume Next
    ignored = reader.ValueAt(3, 1): code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "custom.positional.bounds", code <> 0
    custom(2, 2) = CVErr(2015)
    Set customTable = New CSectionInputTable: customTable.Initialize "Custom", custom
    Set reader = New CSectionInputReader: reader.Initialize customTable
    On Error Resume Next
    ignored = reader.ValueAt(2, 2): code = Err.number: description = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestCheck "custom.positional.formula.error", code <> 0 And InStr(description, "Custom[2,2]") > 0
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "RUNTIME ERROR: " & Err.description & vbCrLf
Finished:
    RunSectionInputReaderTests = mReport & "TOTAL_SECTION_INPUT_READER: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: чтение рецептов, общие правила армирования, проекции и сохранение точных геометрических и расчётных снимков.
