' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Доказывает, что Secant не вызывает Newton: сравнивает плоскости и равновесие,
' проверяет счетчики вычислений, рестарты и собственную диагностику метода.
Private Sub TestSecantIndependentBranch(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestRectangleGeometry(300#, 200#)
    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = TestBuildMesh(geom, 20#)
    Dim rebars As CRebarLayout
    Set rebars = New CRebarLayout
    rebars.AddBar "B1", -90#, -60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geom
    rebars.AddBar "B2", 90#, -60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geom
    rebars.AddBar "B3", -90#, 60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geom
    rebars.AddBar "B4", 90#, 60#, 20#, 0#, "A400", "", geom

    Dim newton As CSectionSolver
    Set newton = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureProvisionalSolver newton
    newton.SolverMethod = "Newton"
    newton.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -300000#, -20000000#, -12000000#

    Dim secant As CSectionSolver
    Set secant = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureProvisionalSolver secant
    secant.SolverMethod = "Secant"
    secant.SecantMaxRestarts = 4
    secant.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -300000#, -20000000#, -12000000#

    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.secant.branch", StrComp(secant.SolverMethod, "Secant", vbTextCompare) = 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.secant.converged", secant.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.secant.noNewtonCalls", secant.TestInternalNewtonCallCount = 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.newton.calls", newton.TestInternalNewtonCallCount > 0
    TestAssertEquilibrium stats, "section.secant.equilibrium", secant, -300000#, -20000000#, -12000000#
    TestAssertRelative stats, "section.secant.eps0MatchesNewton", secant.Epsilon0, newton.Epsilon0, 0.0001
    TestAssertRelative stats, "section.secant.kappaXMatchesNewton", secant.KappaX, newton.KappaX, 0.0001
    TestAssertRelative stats, "section.secant.kappaYMatchesNewton", secant.KappaY, newton.KappaY, 0.0001
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.secant.differentIterations", secant.iterations <> newton.iterations
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.secant.diagnostics", InStr(1, secant.DiagnosticLog, "method=Secant", vbTextCompare) > 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.secant.broydenDiagnostics", secant.TestInternalForceEvaluationCount > secant.iterations
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Передает неизвестный и пустой Solver.Method; оба значения должны дать
' ошибку ввода, а не незаявленное переключение на метод по умолчанию.
Private Sub TestSolverMethodInputErrors(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#)
    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = TestBuildMesh(geom, 20#)

    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureProvisionalSolver solver
    solver.SolverMethod = "Bogus"
    solver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, Nothing), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.invalidInput", Not solver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.invalidMessage", InStr(1, solver.StopReason, "Ошибка настройки Solver.Method:", vbTextCompare) > 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.invalidCode", solver.failureCode = sfcInvalidConfiguration

    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureProvisionalSolver solver
    solver.SolverMethod = vbNullString
    solver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, Nothing), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.emptyInput", Not solver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.emptyMessage", InStr(1, solver.StopReason, "Ошибка настройки Solver.Method:", vbTextCompare) > 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.emptyCode", solver.failureCode = sfcInvalidConfiguration
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.failedSourceKey", solver.FailureSettingKeys = "Solver.Method"
    solver.SolverMethod = "Newton"
    solver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, Nothing), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.recoveryConverged", solver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.recoveryCode", solver.failureCode = sfcNone
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.method.recoverySourceKeyCleared", Len(solver.FailureSettingKeys) = 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Применяет настройки из Config к реальному solver-у и проверяет, что
' выбранный Newton действительно выполняет свою ветвь и находит равновесие.
Private Sub TestSolverMethodFromSystem(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim reader As CSystemSettingsReader
    Set reader = New CSystemSettingsReader
    reader.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    TestAssertTrue stats, "settings.solverMethod.defaultNewton", StrComp(reader.GetRawString("Solver.Method", vbNullString), "Newton", vbTextCompare) = 0

    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#)
    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = TestBuildMesh(geom, 20#)

    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    solver.ApplySettings reader
    solver.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, Nothing), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "section.systemMethod.newtonBranch", solver.Converged And solver.TestInternalNewtonCallCount > 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Решает одну и ту же задачу двумя методами с одинаковыми материалами;
' сохраняет сравнительные iterations/evaluations и проверяет независимый Secant.
Private Sub TestAssertNewtonSecantCase(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByVal mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder, ByVal rebars As CRebarLayout, _
        ByVal n As Double, ByVal mX As Double, ByVal mY As Double)
    Dim newton As CSectionSolver
    Set newton = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureProvisionalSolver newton
    newton.SolverMethod = "Newton"
    newton.maxIterations = 80
    newton.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), n, mX, mY

    Dim secant As CSectionSolver
    Set secant = New CSectionSolver
    TestConfigureProvisionalSolver secant
    secant.SolverMethod = "Secant"
    secant.maxIterations = 80
    secant.SecantMaxRestarts = 6
    secant.solve TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, rebars), TestProvisionalConcrete(), TestProvisionalSteel(), n, mX, mY

    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".newton.converged", newton.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".secant.converged", secant.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".secant.noNewtonCalls", secant.TestInternalNewtonCallCount = 0
    If newton.Converged And secant.Converged Then
        TestAssertRelative stats, prefix & ".eps0", secant.Epsilon0, newton.Epsilon0, 0.001
        TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".N", secant.Nint, n, 1#, 0.000001
        TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".Mx", secant.Mxint, mX, 1000#, 0.000001
        TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".My", secant.Myint, mY, 1000#, 0.000001
    End If
    TestAppendLine stats, "COMPARE_SOLVER|" & prefix & "|NewtonIterations=" & CStr(newton.iterations) & _
        "|SecantIterations=" & CStr(secant.iterations) & _
        "|SecantForceEvaluations=" & CStr(secant.TestInternalForceEvaluationCount) & _
        "|SecantNewtonCalls=" & CStr(secant.TestInternalNewtonCallCount) & _
        "|SecantRestarts=" & CStr(secant.TestMatrixRestartCount)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задает жесткий допуск и короткий бюджет для воспроизведения отказов сходимости.
' Ограничения приращений отключены явно, чтобы тест проверял сам решатель.
Private Sub TestConfigureStrictSolver(ByVal solver As CSectionSolver)
    solver.loadSteps = 1
    solver.maxIterations = 12
    solver.toleranceN = 0.000001
    solver.toleranceMx = 0.001
    solver.toleranceMy = 0.001
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Настраивает контрольные задачи равновесия независимо от текущего Config.
' Допуски заданы во внутренних единицах, шаг нагрузки и ограничения фиксированы.
Private Sub TestConfigureProvisionalSolver(ByVal solver As CSectionSolver)
    solver.loadSteps = 5
    solver.maxIterations = 40
    solver.toleranceN = 1#
    solver.toleranceMx = 1000#
    solver.toleranceMy = 1000#
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создает фиксированную диаграмму бетона для численных контрольных задач.
' Она не использует материал из книги и не включает расширение диаграммы.
Private Function TestProvisionalConcrete() As CMaterialDiagram
    Dim concrete As CMaterialDiagram
    Set concrete = New CMaterialDiagram
    concrete.TestInitialize -0.0015, -15.5, -0.0035, -15.5
    Set TestProvisionalConcrete = concrete
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создает фиксированную симметричную диаграмму арматуры для тех же задач.
' Пределы и модуль не зависят от пользовательских настроек материала.
Private Function TestProvisionalSteel() As CMaterialDiagram
    Dim steel As CMaterialDiagram
    Set steel = New CMaterialDiagram
    steel.TestInitialize 0.00175, 350#, 0.025
    Set TestProvisionalSteel = steel
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Возвращает прямоугольник без скруглений и смещения для контрольного сечения.
' Сетка и арматура затем создаются отдельно, как в обычном расчетном маршруте.
Private Function TestRectangleGeometry(ByVal Width As Double, ByVal Height As Double) As CGeometryRegion
    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion
    Set geom = TestFixtureBox(Width, Height)
    Set TestRectangleGeometry = geom
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Строит бетонную сетку тестового прямоугольника с одинаковым шагом по осям.
' Арматура добавляется отдельно, а ядру затем передается собранный CSectionModel.
Private Function TestBuildMesh(ByVal geom As CGeometryRegion, ByVal stepSize As Double) As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = New CFiberMeshBuilder
    mesh.BuildMesh geom, stepSize, stepSize, 1
    Set TestBuildMesh = mesh
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет все три компоненты равновесия, а не только признак Converged.
' Для нулевой компоненты действует абсолютный допуск, для ненулевой относительный.
Private Sub TestAssertEquilibrium(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal prefix As String, _
        ByVal solver As CSectionSolver, ByVal n As Double, ByVal mX As Double, ByVal mY As Double)
    TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".N", solver.Nint, n, 1#, 0.000001
    TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".Mx", solver.Mxint, mX, 1000#, 0.000001
    TestAssertLoadComponent stats, prefix & ".My", solver.Myint, mY, 1000#, 0.000001
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет наличие диапазона перед тестом, которому требуется схема книги.
' Отсутствие имени означает недоступность fixture, а не отказ численного решателя.
Private Function TestNamedRangeExists(ByVal rangeName As String) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo missing
    Dim target As Object
    Set target = ThisWorkbook.names.item(rangeName).RefersToRange
    TestNamedRangeExists = Not target Is Nothing
    Exit Function
missing:
    TestNamedRangeExists = False
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выбирает допустимую меру ошибки для одной компоненты нагрузки.
' Около нуля не делит на ожидаемое значение и использует его абсолютный допуск.
Private Sub TestAssertLoadComponent(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal name As String, _
        ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double, ByVal zeroTolerance As Double, _
        ByVal relTolerance As Double)
    If Abs(expected) <= zeroTolerance Then
        TestAssertClose stats, name, actual, expected, zeroTolerance
    Else
        TestAssertRelative stats, name, actual, expected, relTolerance
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Группа проверок ведет общий счет и записывает фактические отклонения в отчет.
' Численные сравнения ниже сохраняют отдельные абсолютные и относительные допуски.
Private Sub TestAssertTrue(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает значения по абсолютному допуску и сохраняет обе величины и разность.
Private Sub TestAssertClose(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, _
        ByVal expected As Double, ByVal tolerance As Double)
    Dim diff As Double
    diff = Abs(actual - expected)
    If diff <= tolerance Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; absDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(diff)
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; absDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(diff)
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает относительную ошибку; для почти нулевого эталона избегает деления.
' Используемый допуск передается тестом и не подменяется настройками Config.
Private Sub TestAssertRelative(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, _
        ByVal expected As Double, ByVal relTolerance As Double)
    Dim relDiff As Double
    If Abs(expected) <= 0.000000001 Then
        relDiff = Abs(actual - expected)
    Else
        relDiff = Abs((actual - expected) / expected)
    End If

    If relDiff <= relTolerance Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "OK: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; relDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(relDiff)
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
        TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & name & "; actual=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(actual) & _
            "; expected=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(expected) & "; relDiff=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(relDiff)
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Добавляет строку в протокол; формат чисел ниже одинаков при любой локали Excel.
Private Sub TestAppendLine(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal text As String)
    stats.report = stats.report & text & vbCrLf
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Форматирует число для текстового протокола с десятичной точкой; исходные расчётные значения не меняются.
Private Function TestFormatNumberInvariant(ByVal value As Double) As String
    TestFormatNumberInvariant = Replace$(format$(value, "0.############"), ",", ".")
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' отдельно проверяет передачу кодов отказа через обычные
' CStateProvider, CStateSolutionRunner и CSectionSolver.
Public Function RunAudit03StateTests() As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03TypedStateFailures stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_STATE: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03StateTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' неизвестный метод, вырожденная геометрия, исчерпание итераций
' и отсутствие исходных объектов должны сохранять собственные причины отказа в НДС.
Private Sub TestAudit03TypedStateFailures(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim scenario As Long
    For scenario = 1 To 11
        TestAudit03TypedStateFailureCase stats, scenario
    Next scenario
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' отдельный запуск связывает выбор INPUT-кривизны с реально
' активным ограничителем шага Newton/Secant. Исходные ячейки восстанавливаются.
Public Function RunAudit03InputCurvatureBindingTests() As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03InputCurvatureBinding stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_INPUT_CURVATURE_BINDING: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03InputCurvatureBindingTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' одинаковый физический clamp задается как 1e-7 1/мм либо
' 1e-4 1/м. Сравниваем не только найденное равновесие, но и число итераций:
' без пересчета единиц второй clamp перестает ограничивать шаг. Линейный
' прямоугольник дает независимые аналитические значения обеих кривизн.
Private Sub TestAudit03InputCurvatureBinding(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim unitRange As range, savedUnits As Variant, sheet As Worksheet
    Dim oldAlerts As Boolean, row As Long, column As Long, curvatureRow As Long
    Dim section As CSectionModel, concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial, steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, solver As CSectionSolver
    Dim method As Variant, axis As Long, unitIndex As Long
    Dim mX As Double, mY As Double, expectedKx As Double, expectedKy As Double, prefix As String
    oldAlerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set unitRange = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    savedUnits = unitRange.formula
    For row = 2 To unitRange.rows.count
        Select Case CStr(unitRange.cells(row, 1).value2)
            Case "Force": unitRange.cells(row, 2).value2 = "N"
            Case "Moment": unitRange.cells(row, 2).value2 = "N*mm"
            Case "Curvature": curvatureRow = row
        End Select
    Next row
    If curvatureRow = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4601, "TestAudit03InputCurvatureBinding", "Не найдена INPUT-единица кривизны."
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    sheet.name = "__Audit03Curvature"
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 10#), Nothing)
    Set concrete = New CTestLinearConcreteMaterial: concrete.TestInitialize 30000#
    Set steel = New CTestLinearSteelMaterial: steel.TestInitialize 200000#
    For Each method In Array("Newton", "Secant")
        For axis = 1 To 2
            mX = 0#: mY = 0#: expectedKx = 0#: expectedKy = 0#
            If axis = 1 Then
                mX = 1000000#
                expectedKx = mX / (30000# * 200# * 100# * (100# ^ 2 - 10# ^ 2) / 12#)
            Else
                mY = -1000000#
                expectedKy = mY / (30000# * 200# * 100# * (200# ^ 2 - 10# ^ 2) / 12#)
            End If
            For unitIndex = 0 To 1
                unitRange.cells(curvatureRow, 2).value2 = IIf(unitIndex = 0, "1/mm", "1/m")
                Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
                Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
                Set solver = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.Method", CStr(method), CStr(method), units)
                solver.solve section, concrete, steel, 0#, mX, mY
                prefix = "automaticCurvature." & CStr(method) & ".axis" & CStr(axis) & ".unit" & CStr(unitIndex)
                TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".converged", solver.Converged
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".N", solver.Nint, 0#, 0.001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".Mx", solver.Mxint, mX, 0.001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".My", solver.Myint, mY, 0.001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".epsilon0", solver.Epsilon0, 0#, 0.000000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".kappaX", solver.KappaX, expectedKx, 0.000000000001
                TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".kappaY", solver.KappaY, expectedKy, 0.000000000001
            Next unitIndex
        Next axis
    Next method
    GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticCurvature.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not unitRange Is Nothing Then unitRange.formula = savedUnits
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    If Not sheet Is Nothing Then sheet.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = oldAlerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not unitRange Is Nothing And IsArray(savedUnits) Then
        For row = 1 To unitRange.rows.count
            For column = 1 To unitRange.columns.count
                TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticCurvature.restore." & CStr(row) & "." & CStr(column), _
                    CStr(unitRange.cells(row, column).formula) = CStr(savedUnits(row, column))
            Next column
        Next row
    End If
End Sub



' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' выполняет отдельный обычный расчёт с ожидаемой неудачей.
' Отказ сохраняется для диагностики, но не возвращается как пригодное НДС
' и не запрещает повторное решение.
Private Sub TestAudit03TypedStateFailureCase(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal scenario As Long)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader
    settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Dim materials As CMaterialModelProvider
    Set materials = New CMaterialModelProvider
    materials.Initialize settings
    Dim section As CSectionModel
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 20#), Nothing)
    If scenario = 2 Then
        Set section = New CSectionModel
        section.AddConcreteElement 0#, 0#, 10000#
    ElseIf scenario = 5 Then
        Set section = New CSectionModel
    End If
    Dim repository As CStateRepository
    Set repository = New CStateRepository
    Dim provider As CStateProvider
    Set provider = New CStateProvider
    If scenario <> 4 Then provider.Initialize section, materials, repository
    If scenario = 1 Then provider.SolverMethod = "UnknownMethod"
    If scenario = 3 Then provider.maxIterations = 1
    If scenario = 6 Then provider.maxIterations = 0
    If scenario = 7 Then provider.toleranceN = 0#
    If scenario = 8 Then provider.toleranceMx = 0#
    If scenario = 9 Then provider.toleranceMy = 0#
    If scenario = 10 Then provider.loadSteps = 0
    If scenario = 11 Then provider.SecantMaxRestarts = -1
    Dim spec As CMaterialModelSpec
    Set spec = New CMaterialModelSpec
    spec.Initialize "ULS(I)", "ThreeLine", "Ignore", "TwoLine"
    Dim request As CStateRequest
    Set request = New CStateRequest
    request.Initialize sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, -100000#, 10000000#, 2000000#, False, True
    ' Проверки выполняются при силово допустимых нагрузках: у одного волокна
    ' моменты нулевые, а при малом бюджете существует подходящее равновесие.
    If scenario = 2 Then request.Initialize sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, -100000#, 0#, 0#, False, True
    If scenario = 3 Then request.Initialize sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, _
        -0.95 * materials.ConcreteCompressionResistanceFromSpec(spec) * 20000#, 0#, 0#, False, True
    Dim state As CSectionStateResult
    Set state = provider.GetOrSolve(request)
    Dim prefix As String
    prefix = "audit03.state.failure." & CStr(scenario)
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".exists", Not state Is Nothing
    If state Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Dim expectedStatus As EResultInternalStatus
    Dim expectedCode As EResultCode
    Select Case scenario
        Case 1, 6 To 11: expectedStatus = rsInvalidConfiguration: expectedCode = rcInvalidConfiguration
        Case 2: expectedStatus = rsNumericalFailure: expectedCode = rcSingularTangent
        Case 3: expectedStatus = rsNumericalFailure: expectedCode = rcNumericalFailure
        Case 4: expectedStatus = rsInternalError: expectedCode = rcInternalError
        Case 5: expectedStatus = rsInvalidInput: expectedCode = rcInvalidInput
    End Select
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".status", state.internalStatus = expectedStatus
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".code", state.resultCode = expectedCode
    Dim policy As CResultStatusPolicy
    Set policy = New CResultStatusPolicy
    Dim expectedExternal As String
    expectedExternal = "InputErr"
    If scenario = 2 Or scenario = 3 Then expectedExternal = "NumFail"
    If scenario = 4 Then expectedExternal = "CalcErr"
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".display", policy.ExternalStatus(state.ResultMeta) = expectedExternal
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".comment", Len(Trim$(state.resultComment)) > 0
    TestAppendLine stats, "COMMENT: " & prefix & "; " & state.resultComment
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notConverged", Not state.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notReusable", repository.FindEquivalent(request) Is Nothing
    If scenario = 1 Or scenario = 5 Or scenario >= 6 Then
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".oneAttempt", state.SolverCallCount = 1
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notCalculated", Not state.ResultMeta.calculated
    ElseIf scenario = 4 Then
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".noAttempt", state.SolverCallCount = 0
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notCalculated", Not state.ResultMeta.calculated
    Else
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".attempted", state.SolverCallCount >= 1
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".calculated", state.ResultMeta.calculated
    End If
    If scenario <> 4 Then
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".stored", repository.stateCount = 1
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".snapshotCode", repository.StateAt(1).resultCode = expectedCode
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".snapshotComment", repository.StateAt(1).resultComment = state.resultComment
    End If
    If scenario = 1 Then
        provider.SolverMethod = "Newton"
        request.Initialize sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, -50000#, 0#, 0#, False, True
        Set state = provider.GetOrSolve(request)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".newAttemptSuccess", state.Converged
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notReused", Not provider.LastStateWasReused
        Set state = provider.GetOrSolve(request)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".successReusable", provider.LastStateWasReused
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".successSnapshot", Not provider.SolverSnapshot(state) Is Nothing
    End If
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.state.failure." & CStr(scenario) & ".runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ============================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ ==============================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет различие оценки плоскости и решения равновесия. Подтверждение
' по целевым усилиям не должно менять плоскость или запускать новый solve.
Private Sub TestAudit02EvaluatedPlaneRequiresEquilibrium(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    Set concrete = New CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    concrete.TestInitialize 32500#
    Dim steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    Set steel = New CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    steel.TestInitialize 200000#
    Dim section As CSectionModel
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 20#), Nothing)
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    solver.toleranceN = 1#
    solver.toleranceMx = 1#
    solver.toleranceMy = 1#
    Dim solveCount As Long
    solveCount = SectionEquilibriumSolveCount()
    solver.EvaluateStrainPlane section, concrete, steel, -0.0001, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.plane.evaluationNotSolve", Not solver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.plane.wrongTargetRejected", _
        Not solver.ConfirmEquilibrium(solver.Nint + 100#, solver.Mxint, solver.Myint)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.plane.actualTargetConfirmed", _
        solver.ConfirmEquilibrium(solver.Nint, solver.Mxint, solver.Myint)
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.plane.sameStrain", solver.Epsilon0, -0.0001, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.plane.noHeavySolve", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = solveCount
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет независимость чисел, метаданных и ключа запроса от дальнейшего
' использования рабочего solver-а и изменения выдаваемых spec/meta-копий.
Private Sub TestAudit02StateSnapshotIsolation(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    Set concrete = New CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    concrete.TestInitialize 32500#
    Dim steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    Set steel = New CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    steel.TestInitialize 200000#
    Dim section As CSectionModel
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 20#), Nothing)
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    solver.EvaluateStrainPlane section, concrete, steel, -0.0001, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.equilibrium", _
        solver.ConfirmEquilibrium(solver.Nint, solver.Mxint, solver.Myint)

    Dim spec As CMaterialModelSpec
    Set spec = New CMaterialModelSpec
    spec.Initialize "ULS(I)", "TwoLine", "Ignore", "TwoLine"
    Dim state As CSectionStateResult
    Set state = New CSectionStateResult
    state.InitializeFromSolver sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, solver, False, True
    Dim request As CStateRequest
    Set request = New CStateRequest
    request.Initialize sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, solver.Nint, solver.Mxint, solver.Myint, False
    Dim originalKey As String
    originalKey = request.EquivalenceKey
    Dim OriginalN As Double
    OriginalN = state.Nint

    spec.Initialize "SLS(II)", "ThreeLine", "UseDiagram", "ThreeLine"
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.inputSpec", state.MaterialSpec.SpecKey = "ULS(I)|TwoLine|Ignore|TwoLine"
    Dim copy As CMaterialModelSpec
    Set copy = state.MaterialSpec
    copy.Clear
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.returnedSpec", state.MaterialSpec.IsComplete
    Set copy = request.MaterialSpec
    copy.Clear
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.requestKey", request.EquivalenceKey = originalKey

    Dim meta As CResultMeta
    Set meta = state.ResultMeta
    meta.SetResult rsNumericalFailure, rcNumericalFailure, rkDirectState, "Изменение внешней копии."
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.returnedMeta", state.internalStatus = rsSuccess
    Dim solveCount As Long
    solveCount = SectionEquilibriumSolveCount()
    solver.EvaluateStrainPlane section, concrete, steel, -0.001, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.strain", state.Epsilon0, -0.0001, 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.force", state.Nint, OriginalN, 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.extremum", state.minConcreteStrain, -0.0001, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.noSolve", SectionEquilibriumSolveCount() = solveCount
    Set state = New CSectionStateResult
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.emptyStatus", state.internalStatus = rsInternalError
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit02.stateSnapshot.emptyCode", state.resultCode = rcInternalError
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет линейность невязки постоянной нулевой компоненты траектории.
' Рост пробного момента не должен менять допуск и обнулять его производную.
Private Sub TestAudit02LoadPathResidualScaling(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim math As CLoadPathMath
    Set math = New CLoadPathMath
    math.Configure 0.0001, 0.0001, 0.0001
    Dim path As CLoadPathVector
    Set path = New CLoadPathVector
    path.Initialize 0#, 100000#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#
    Dim firstMx As Double, firstMy As Double
    Dim secondMx As Double, secondMy As Double
    math.BuildResiduals 100000#, 1000000#, -1000000#, path, 1#, firstMx, firstMy
    math.BuildResiduals 100000#, 2000000#, -2000000#, path, 1#, secondMx, secondMy
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.pathResidual.zeroMx", firstMx, 10000000000#, 0.001
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.pathResidual.zeroMy", firstMy, -10000000000#, 0.001
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.pathResidual.mxLinear", secondMx, firstMx * 2#, 0.001
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit02.pathResidual.myLinear", secondMy, firstMy * 2#, 0.001
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
