' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ
' ==========================================================================
' Проверяет общую lambda-математику отдельно от solver tolerance: маленькая
' ненулевая Base-компонента остается частью пути. Ошибка отдельного случая
' сохраняется в отчете, чтобы проверить все знаки и последующее восстановление.
Public Function RunAudit03SmallLoadPathTests() As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03SmallLoadPathComponents stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_SMALL_LOAD_PATH: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03SmallLoadPathTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет N/Mx/My разных масштабов при одних допусках, затем повторяет
' обычный путь на том же helper-е. Полностью нулевой Base остается ошибкой API.
Private Sub TestAudit03SmallLoadPathComponents(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim math As CLoadPathMath, magnitude As Variant, signValue As Variant, component As Long
    Set math = New CLoadPathMath
    math.Configure 5#, 5000#, 5000#
    For Each magnitude In Array(1000000#, 0.001, 0.000001, 0.000000001, 0.000000000001)
        For Each signValue In Array(-1#, 1#)
            For component = 1 To 3
                TestCheckAudit03SmallLoadPath stats, math, component, CDbl(magnitude) * CDbl(signValue), _
                    "audit03.smallPath." & CStr(component) & "." & TestFormatNumberInvariant(CDbl(magnitude)) & "." & CStr(signValue)
            Next component
        Next signValue
    Next magnitude
    TestCheckAudit03SmallLoadPath stats, math, 2, 1000000#, "audit03.smallPath.recovery"
    Dim path As CLoadPathVector, errorNumber As Long, value As Double
    Set path = New CLoadPathVector
    path.Initialize 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#
    On Error Resume Next
    value = math.lambda(0#, 0#, 0#, path)
    errorNumber = Err.number
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.smallPath.zeroBaseControlled", errorNumber = vbObjectError + 3841
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Удвоенные усилия лежат точно на lambda=2; независимые невязки должны быть
' нулевыми, а выбор опоры не может перейти к отсутствующей N-компоненте.
Private Sub TestCheckAudit03SmallLoadPath(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, ByVal math As CLoadPathMath, _
        ByVal component As Long, ByVal baseValue As Double, ByVal prefix As String)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim path As CLoadPathVector, nBase As Double, mxBase As Double, myBase As Double
    Dim lambdaValue As Double, r1 As Double, r2 As Double
    Select Case component
        Case 1: nBase = baseValue
        Case 2: mxBase = baseValue
        Case 3: myBase = baseValue
    End Select
    Set path = New CLoadPathVector
    path.Initialize 0#, nBase, 0#, mxBase, 0#, myBase
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".anchor", math.AnchorComponent(path) = component
    lambdaValue = math.lambda(2# * nBase, 2# * mxBase, 2# * myBase, path)
    TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".lambda", lambdaValue, 2#, 0#
    math.BuildResiduals 2# * nBase, 2# * mxBase, 2# * myBase, path, lambdaValue, r1, r2
    TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".r1", r1, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertClose stats, prefix & ".r2", r2, 0#, 0#
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: " & prefix & ".runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Повторная неудача запоминается только при полном совпадении численной попытки.
' Новые старты, параметры, сечение, материалы, сеанс и успешное решение
' не блокируются прежним отказом.
Public Function RunAudit03RetryAttemptSessionTests() As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03RetryAttemptSession stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_RETRY_SESSION: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03RetryAttemptSessionTests = stats.report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    RunAudit03RetryAttemptSessionTests = stats.report & "RUNTIME ERROR: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Переход между двумя участками диаграммы требует двух поправок.
' Бюджет одной поправки даёт воспроизводимую неудачу для проверки
' запоминания только точно совпавших попыток.
Private Sub TestAudit03RetryAttemptSession(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 20#), Nothing)
    Dim concrete As CMaterialDiagram, steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    Dim strains(1 To 3) As Double, stresses(1 To 3) As Double
    strains(1) = -0.01: stresses(1) = -102.25
    strains(2) = -0.0001: stresses(2) = -3.25
    strains(3) = 0#: stresses(3) = 0#
    Set concrete = New CMaterialDiagram
    concrete.InitializeFromArrays strains, stresses, 3
    Set steel = New CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    steel.TestInitialize 200000#
    Dim runner As CStateSolutionRunner
    Set runner = New CStateSolutionRunner
    runner.maxIterations = 1
    runner.DiagnosticsEnabled = False
    runner.BeginRetryAttemptSession section, concrete, steel
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.firstFailure", Not runner.TestRunRetryAttempt(section, concrete, steel, -100000#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.firstSolve", runner.SolverCallCount = 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.sameFailure", Not runner.TestRunRetryAttempt(section, concrete, steel, -100000#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.sameNoSolve", runner.SolverCallCount = 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.noDisabledDiagnostic", Len(runner.DiagnosticLog) = 0
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#, -0.000001
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.newPlane", runner.SolverCallCount = 2
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -110000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.newTarget", runner.SolverCallCount = 3
    runner.toleranceN = 0.1
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.newTolerance", runner.SolverCallCount = 4
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 2
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.newSteps", runner.SolverCallCount = 5
    runner.SecantMaxRestarts = 3
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.newRestartBudget", runner.SolverCallCount = 6
    runner.BeginRetryAttemptSession section, concrete, steel
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.newSession", runner.SolverCallCount = 7
    runner.maxIterations = 2
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.canRecover", runner.TestRunRetryAttempt(section, concrete, steel, -100000#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.recoverySolve", runner.SolverCallCount = 8
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.successNotFailureCache", runner.TestRunRetryAttempt(section, concrete, steel, -100000#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.successSolvedAgain", runner.SolverCallCount = 9
    runner.maxIterations = 0
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.configurationNotCached", runner.SolverCallCount = 11
    runner.maxIterations = 1
    Dim otherSection As CSectionModel
    Set otherSection = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 20#), Nothing)
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt otherSection, concrete, steel, -100000#
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt otherSection, concrete, steel, -100000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.otherContextClosesSession", runner.SolverCallCount = 13
    runner.BeginRetryAttemptSession section, concrete, steel
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    Dim otherConcrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    Set otherConcrete = New CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    otherConcrete.TestInitialize 30000#
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, otherConcrete, steel, -100000#
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, otherConcrete, steel, -100000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.otherMaterialClosesSession", runner.SolverCallCount = 16
    runner.BeginRetryAttemptSession section, concrete, steel
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    section.Clear
    section.AddConcreteElement 0#, 0#, 20000#
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.revisionClosesSession", runner.SolverCallCount = 19
    runner.BeginRetryAttemptSession section, concrete, steel
    Dim targetIndex As Long
    For targetIndex = 1 To 80
        runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100000# - targetIndex
    Next targetIndex
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.boundedScalarMemory", runner.TestRetryAttemptCount = 64
    Dim calls As Long
    calls = runner.SolverCallCount
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100080#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.lastAttemptRetained", runner.SolverCallCount = calls
    runner.TestRunRetryAttempt section, concrete, steel, -100001#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.retry.evictedAttemptCanRun", runner.SolverCallCount = calls + 1
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ============================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: AUDIT03 EXTREME INPUTS ==============================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' проверяет конечность чисел и код исхода НДС при представимых
' нагрузках около предела Double. Это отдельная проверка численных границ.
Public Function RunAudit03ExtremeStateInputTests() As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03ExtremeStateInputs stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_EXTREME_STATE: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03ExtremeStateInputTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Для Newton/Secant и Extension Off/On проверяет центрированную и смещенную
' модель. Смещение усиливает риск переполнения при исключении связанных
' компонент N/Mx/My, не меняя допустимость самого представимого входного вектора.
Private Sub TestAudit03ExtremeStateInputs(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim method As Variant, shifted As Variant, extended As Variant
    For Each method In Array("Newton", "Secant")
        For Each shifted In Array(False, True)
            For Each extended In Array(False, True)
                TestAudit03ExtremeStateCase stats, CStr(method), CBool(shifted), CBool(extended)
            Next extended
        Next shifted
    Next method
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выполняет реальный solver и строит named-state из его результата. Сверхбольшой
' корректный вектор не обязан сходиться, но численный предел не должен стать
' программным CalcErr или физически допустимым state. Следующий обычный solve
' на том же объекте должен восстанавливаться без утечки предыдущего отказа.
Private Sub TestAudit03ExtremeStateCase(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, _
        ByVal method As String, ByVal shifted As Boolean, ByVal extended As Boolean)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim prefix As String
    prefix = "audit03.extreme." & method & ".shift=" & CStr(shifted) & ".extension=" & CStr(extended)
    Dim geometry As CGeometryRegion
    If shifted Then
        Set geometry = TestFixtureBox(200#, 100#, 125#, 80#)
    Else
        Set geometry = TestFixtureBox(200#, 100#)
    End If
    Dim section As CSectionModel
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(geometry, 20#), Nothing)
    Dim concreteParameters As CConcreteMaterialParameters, steelParameters As CSteelMaterialParameters
    Set concreteParameters = New CConcreteMaterialParameters
    concreteParameters.Initialize 15.5, 1.1, 22#, 1.8, 32500#, 32500#, RbMc2:=14.6
    Set steelParameters = New CSteelMaterialParameters
    steelParameters.Initialize 350#, 350#, 390#, 390#, 200000#, 200000#
    Dim materials As CMaterialModelProvider
    Set materials = New CMaterialModelProvider
    materials.TestInitializeFromParameters concreteParameters, steelParameters, diagramExtensionEnabled:=extended
    Dim spec As CMaterialModelSpec
    Set spec = New CMaterialModelSpec
    spec.Initialize "ULS(I)", "ThreeLine", "Ignore", "TwoLine"
    Dim concrete As CMaterialDiagram, steel As CMaterialDiagram
    Set concrete = materials.ConcreteMaterialForEquilibriumFromSpec(spec)
    Set steel = materials.SteelMaterialForEquilibriumFromSpec(spec)
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    solver.SolverMethod = method
    solver.loadSteps = 1
    solver.maxIterations = 3
    solver.DiagnosticsEnabled = False
    solver.toleranceN = 1#: solver.toleranceMx = 1000#: solver.toleranceMy = 1000#
    solver.solve section, concrete, steel, -1E+308, 1E+308, -1E+308
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notConverged", Not solver.Converged
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".numericCause", solver.failureCode = sfcNumericalFailure Or solver.failureCode = sfcSingularTangent
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".reason", Len(Trim$(solver.StopReason)) > 0
    TestAppendLine stats, "EXTREME_CASE: " & prefix & "|N=-1e308|Mx=1e308|My=-1e308|failureCode=" & _
        CStr(solver.failureCode) & "|comment=" & solver.StopReason
    Dim state As CSectionStateResult
    Set state = New CSectionStateResult
    state.InitializeFromSolver sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, solver, False, False, 1
    Dim policy As CResultStatusPolicy
    Set policy = New CResultStatusPolicy
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".stateNumeric", state.internalStatus = rsNumericalFailure
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".displayNumFail", policy.ExternalStatus(state.ResultMeta) = policy.NumFail
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notPhysical", Not state.withinPhysicalRange
    solver.maxIterations = 80
    If shifted Then
        solver.solve section, concrete, steel, -50000#, -4000000#, -6250000#
    Else
        solver.solve section, concrete, steel, -50000#, 0#, 0#
    End If
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".normalRecovers", solver.Converged And solver.failureCode = sfcNone
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ============================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: AUDIT03 SOLVER SETTINGS ==============================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет действие численных настроек через обычные чтение и Solve.
' Изменённая настройка должна менять ограничение или метод решения,
' а не только значение прочитанного свойства.
Public Function RunAudit03SolverSettingEffectTests() As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03SolverSettingEffects stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_SOLVER_EFFECTS: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03SolverSettingEffectTests = stats.report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    RunAudit03SolverSettingEffectTests = stats.report & "RUNTIME ERROR: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Изолирует каждый ключ на временном листе, затем восстанавливает окружение
' даже после ошибки. Линейная задача дает независимый oracle ограничений;
' кусочно-линейный материал отдельно активирует дробление шага Newton.
Private Sub TestAudit03SolverSettingEffects(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim oldAlerts As Boolean
    oldAlerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    Dim sheet As Worksheet
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    sheet.name = "__Audit03SolverEffects"
    Dim section As CSectionModel
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 10#), Nothing)
    Dim concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial, steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    Set concrete = New CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    concrete.TestInitialize 30000#
    Set steel = New CTestLinearSteelMaterial
    steel.TestInitialize 200000#
    Dim first As CSectionSolver, second As CSectionSolver
    Dim key As Variant, n As Double, mX As Double, mY As Double

    Set first = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.LoadSteps", 1)
    Set second = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.LoadSteps", 4)
    first.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
    second.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.LoadSteps.one", first.Converged And first.TestLoadStepsCompleted = 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.LoadSteps.four", second.Converged And second.TestLoadStepsCompleted = 4
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.LoadSteps.work", second.TestInternalNewtonCallCount = 4 And first.TestInternalNewtonCallCount = 1

    Set first = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.MaxIterations", 1)
    Set second = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.MaxIterations", 4)
    Dim nonlinear As CMaterialDiagram, strains(1 To 5) As Double, stresses(1 To 5) As Double ' Переход через излом диаграммы требует двух поправок, в отличие от линейной задачи.
    strains(1) = -0.01: stresses(1) = -19#
    strains(2) = -0.002: stresses(2) = -11#
    strains(3) = -0.001: stresses(3) = -10#
    strains(4) = 0#: stresses(4) = 0#
    strains(5) = 0.01: stresses(5) = 100#
    Set nonlinear = New CMaterialDiagram: nonlinear.InitializeFromArrays strains, stresses, 5
    first.SetInitialState -0.002, 0#, 0#: second.SetInitialState -0.002, 0#, 0#
    first.solve section, nonlinear, steel, -80000#, 0#, 0#
    second.solve section, nonlinear, steel, -80000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.MaxIterations.one", Not first.Converged And first.iterations = 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.MaxIterations.four", second.Converged And second.iterations <= 4

    For Each key In Array("Solver.ToleranceN", "Solver.ToleranceMx", "Solver.ToleranceMy")
        n = 0#: mX = 0#: mY = 0#
        Select Case CStr(key)
            Case "Solver.ToleranceN": n = -100000#
            Case "Solver.ToleranceMx": mX = 1000000#
            Case "Solver.ToleranceMy": mY = -1000000#
        End Select
        Set first = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, CStr(key), 2000000#)
        Set second = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, CStr(key), 0.001)
        first.solve section, concrete, steel, n, mX, mY
        second.solve section, concrete, steel, n, mX, mY
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect." & CStr(key) & ".loose", first.Converged And first.iterations = 1
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect." & CStr(key) & ".strict", second.Converged And second.iterations > first.iterations
        TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.effect." & CStr(key) & ".looseZero", first.Epsilon0 + first.KappaX + first.KappaY, 0#, 0#
        TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.effect." & CStr(key) & ".strictN", second.Nint, n, 0.001
        TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.effect." & CStr(key) & ".strictMx", second.Mxint, mX, 0.001
        TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.effect." & CStr(key) & ".strictMy", second.Myint, mY, 0.001
    Next key

    Set first = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.Method", "Newton")
    Set second = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.Method", "Secant")
    first.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
    second.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.Method.Newton", first.Converged And first.TestInternalNewtonCallCount = 1
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.Solver.Method.Secant", second.Converged And second.TestInternalNewtonCallCount = 0

    Set first = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.SecantMaxRestarts", 0, "Newton")
    first.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.SecantOptions.inactiveInNewton", first.Converged And first.TestMatrixRestartCount = 0
    TestAudit03InvalidSolverSettingEffects stats, sheet, section, concrete, steel
    TestAudit03LineSearchSettingEffects stats, sheet, section, steel
    TestAudit03NegativeUnsignedUnitSettings stats, sheet, section, concrete, steel
    GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    If Not sheet Is Nothing Then sheet.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = oldAlerts
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задаёт полный численный пример и заменяет один ключ перед чтением диапазона.
' Внутренние допуски фиксированы; пользовательская книга не меняется.
Private Function TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(ByVal sheet As Worksheet, ByVal key As String, _
        ByVal value As Variant, Optional ByVal method As String = "Newton", _
        Optional ByVal units As CUnitSystem = Nothing) As CSectionSolver
    Dim data(1 To 9, 1 To 3) As Variant
    Dim keys As Variant, values As Variant, i As Long
    keys = Array("Solver.Method", "Solver.MaxIterations", "Solver.LoadSteps", _
        "Solver.ToleranceN", "Solver.ToleranceMx", "Solver.ToleranceMy", _
        "Solver.SecantMaxRestarts", "General.DiagramExtension")
    values = Array(method, 80, 1, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 2, "No")
    data(1, 1) = "Параметр": data(1, 2) = "Значение": data(1, 3) = "Ед."
    For i = 0 To UBound(keys)
        data(i + 2, 1) = keys(i): data(i + 2, 2) = values(i): data(i + 2, 3) = "-"
        If CStr(keys(i)) = key Then data(i + 2, 2) = value
    Next i
    sheet.range("A1:C9").value2 = data
    Dim reader As CSystemSettingsReader
    Set reader = New CSystemSettingsReader
    reader.LoadFromRange sheet.range("A1:C9")
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver
    Set solver = New CSectionSolver
    solver.ApplySettings reader, units
    Set TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver = solver
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' пользовательский знак силы не относится к знаку допуска.
' Перевод tf/tf*m и кривизны не должен скрывать отрицательный численный ввод.
' Проверяем отказ до итераций и последующий обычный solve с положительным вводом.
Private Sub TestAudit03NegativeUnsignedUnitSettings(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, _
        ByVal sheet As Worksheet, ByVal section As CSectionModel, _
        ByVal concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial, ByVal steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial)
    Dim units As CUnitSystem
    Set units = New CUnitSystem
    units.InitializeDefaults
    Dim key As Variant, solver As CSectionSolver
    For Each key In Array("Solver.ToleranceN", "Solver.ToleranceMx", "Solver.ToleranceMy")
        Set solver = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, CStr(key), -1#, "Newton", units)
        solver.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.units." & CStr(key) & ".negativeTyped", _
            Not solver.Converged And solver.failureCode = sfcInvalidConfiguration
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.units." & CStr(key) & ".noIterations", solver.iterations = 0
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.units." & CStr(key) & ".reason", _
            InStr(1, solver.StopReason, "Solver.", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
        TestAppendLine stats, "SIGNED_SETTING: key=" & CStr(key) & "|raw=-1|converged=" & CStr(solver.Converged) & _
            "|failureCode=" & CStr(solver.failureCode) & "|iterations=" & CStr(solver.iterations) & _
            "|reason=" & solver.StopReason
        Set solver = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, CStr(key), 1#, "Newton", units)
        solver.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.units." & CStr(key) & ".positiveRecovery", solver.Converged
    Next key
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет диапазоны на публичном ApplySettings -> Solve маршруте. Ошибочная
' конфигурация не должна начинать итерации или превращаться в NumFail.
Private Sub TestAudit03InvalidSolverSettingEffects(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, _
        ByVal sheet As Worksheet, ByVal section As CSectionModel, _
        ByVal concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial, ByVal steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial)
    Dim keys As Variant, values As Variant, i As Long
    keys = Array("Solver.Method", "Solver.MaxIterations", "Solver.LoadSteps", _
        "Solver.ToleranceN", "Solver.ToleranceMx", "Solver.ToleranceMy", "Solver.SecantMaxRestarts")
    values = Array("Unknown", 0, 0, 0#, 0#, 0#, -1)
    For i = 0 To UBound(keys)
        Dim solver As CSectionSolver
        Set solver = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, CStr(keys(i)), values(i))
        solver.solve section, concrete, steel, -100000#, 0#, 0#
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.invalid." & CStr(keys(i)), _
            Not solver.Converged And solver.failureCode = sfcInvalidConfiguration
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.invalid.noIterations." & CStr(keys(i)), solver.iterations = 0
        TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.effect.invalid.reason." & CStr(keys(i)), Len(solver.StopReason) > 0
    Next i
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Старт на пологом участке требует дробления Newton: полный шаг ухудшает
' невязку. Проверяется реальная разница On/Off и нижней границы alpha, а не getter.
Private Sub TestAudit03LineSearchSettingEffects(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats, _
        ByVal sheet As Worksheet, ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial)
    Dim strains(1 To 6) As Double, stresses(1 To 6) As Double
    strains(1) = -0.01: stresses(1) = -100#
    strains(2) = -0.001: stresses(2) = -10#
    strains(3) = 0#: stresses(3) = 0#
    strains(4) = 0.001: stresses(4) = 10#
    strains(5) = 0.002: stresses(5) = 11#
    strains(6) = 0.01: stresses(6) = 19#
    Dim concrete As CMaterialDiagram
    Set concrete = New CMaterialDiagram
    concrete.InitializeFromArrays strains, stresses, 6
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver, method As Variant
    For Each method In Array("Newton", "Secant")
        Set solver = TestAudit03ConfiguredSolver(sheet, "Solver.Method", CStr(method), CStr(method))
        solver.SetInitialState 0.002, 0#, 0#
        solver.solve section, concrete, steel, 100000#, 0#, 0#
        TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticStep." & CStr(method) & ".converged", solver.Converged
        TestAssertClose stats, "automaticStep." & CStr(method) & ".N", solver.Nint, 100000#, 0.001
        TestAssertClose stats, "automaticStep." & CStr(method) & ".Mx", solver.Mxint, 0#, 0.001
        TestAssertClose stats, "automaticStep." & CStr(method) & ".My", solver.Myint, 0#, 0.001
        TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticStep." & CStr(method) & ".reduced", _
            InStr(1, solver.DiagnosticLog, "lineSearchUsed=True", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    Next method
    TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticStep.policy.decreasing", NonlinearStepImproves(1#, 0.5, 1#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticStep.policy.stagnantRejected", Not NonlinearStepImproves(1#, 1#, 1#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "automaticStep.policy.increaseRejected", Not NonlinearStepImproves(1#, 2#, 0.5)
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ==================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: КРАЙНИЕ МАСШТАБЫ СИСТЕМЫ 3x3 ====================

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет конечные большие коэффициенты отдельно от нелинейного НДС.
' Численные expected и допуски штатных инженерных регрессий не меняются.
Public Function RunAudit03ExtremeLinearSystemTests() As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestLinearSystem3x3 stats
    TestAudit03ExtremeLinearSystem stats
    TestAudit03LinearFailureCodes stats
    TestLinearSystemNonFiniteValues stats
    TestAudit03LargeTangentState stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_EXTREME_LINEAR: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    RunAudit03ExtremeLinearSystemTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' IEEE NaN и бесконечности не подтверждают решение даже тогда, когда арифметика
' VBA не выбрасывает исключение. Проверяются матрица, RHS и повтор после отказа.
Private Sub TestLinearSystemNonFiniteValues(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim system As CLinearSystem3x3, kind As Long, position As Long, value As Double, solved As Boolean, prefix As String
    Set system = New CLinearSystem3x3
    For kind = 1 To 3
        value = TestNonFiniteDouble(kind)
        For position = 1 To 2
            If position = 1 Then
                solved = system.solve(value, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 1#, 2#, 3#)
            Else
                solved = system.solve(1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, value, 2#, 3#)
            End If
            prefix = "workingReview.linear.nonFinite." & CStr(kind) & "." & CStr(position)
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notSolved", Not solved And Not system.solved
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".failureCode", system.failureCode = sfcNumericalFailure
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".vectorCleared", system.X1 = 0# And system.X2 = 0# And system.X3 = 0#
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".recovery", system.solve(1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 1#, 2#, 3#)
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".recoveryVector", system.X1 = 1# And system.X2 = 2# And system.X3 = 3#
        Next position
    Next kind
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задаёт quiet NaN или бесконечность точными битами IEEE 754 без переполнения
' в самом тесте. LSet копирует два Long в Double одинакового размера.
Private Function TestNonFiniteDouble(ByVal kind As Long) As Double
    Dim words As TTestDoubleWords, number As TTestDoubleValue
    Select Case kind
        Case 1: words.high = &H7FF80000
        Case 2: words.high = &H7FF00000
        Case 3: words.high = &HFFF00000
        Case Else: Err.Raise 5, "modTestSectionSolver", "Неизвестный вид неконечного тестового значения."
    End Select
    LSet number = words
    TestNonFiniteDouble = number.value
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет причины отказа настоящего линейного решения. Большая сумма
' правых частей допускает нормировку; непредставимая поправка остаётся
' численной ошибкой. Следующий корректный запуск должен очищать прежний код отказа.
Private Sub TestAudit03LinearFailureCodes(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim system As CLinearSystem3x3
    Set system = New CLinearSystem3x3
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.large", system.solve(2#, 1#, 0#, 1#, 2#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 1E+308, 1E+308, 1E+308)
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.linear.typed.large.x1", system.X1 / 1E+308, 1# / 3#, 0.000000000000001
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.linear.typed.large.x2", system.X2 / 1E+308, 1# / 3#, 0.000000000000001
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.large.residual", system.RelativeResidual >= 0# And system.RelativeResidual <= 0.00000001
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.large.code", system.failureCode = sfcNone
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.singular", Not system.solve(1#, 2#, 3#, 2#, 4#, 6#, 3#, 6#, 9#, 1#, 2#, 3#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.singular.code", system.failureCode = sfcSingularTangent
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.overflow", Not system.solve(1E-17, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 1E+308, 1#, 1#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.overflow.code", system.failureCode = sfcNumericalFailure
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.overflow.vector", system.X1 = 0# And system.X2 = 0# And system.X3 = 0# And Not system.solved
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.recovery", system.solve(1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 1#, 2#, 3#)
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.typed.recovery.code", system.failureCode = sfcNone
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет реальный Newton-потребитель с большой, но конечной жесткостью.
' Модуль синтетического линейного материала не является нормативным вводом;
' нагрузки обычного масштаба, проверяется исходное компонентное равновесие.
Private Sub TestAudit03LargeTangentState(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim geom As CGeometryRegion, mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder, section As CSectionModel
    Dim concrete As CTestLinearConcreteMaterial, steel As CTestLinearSteelMaterial, solver As CSectionSolver
    Dim modulus As Variant, code As Long, reason As String, prefix As String
    Set geom = TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#)
    Set mesh = TestBuildMesh(geom, 10#)
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(mesh, Nothing)
    Set concrete = New CTestLinearConcreteMaterial
    Set steel = New CTestLinearSteelMaterial: steel.TestInitialize 200000#
    For Each modulus In Array(1E+110, 1E+200)
        concrete.TestInitialize CDbl(modulus)
        Set solver = New CSectionSolver
        TestConfigureStrictSolver solver
        solver.SolverMethod = "Newton"
        solver.SetInitialState 0#, 0#, 0#
        On Error Resume Next
        Err.Clear: solver.solve section, concrete, steel, 250000#, 120000000#, -80000000#
        code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
        On Error GoTo 0
        prefix = "audit03.linear.largeTangent." & CStr(modulus)
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".noRuntimeError", code = 0
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".converged", solver.Converged
        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".code", solver.failureCode = sfcNone
        If solver.Converged Then TestAssertEquilibrium stats, prefix, solver, 250000#, 120000000#, -80000000#
        TestAppendLine stats, "LARGE_TANGENT_STATE: " & prefix & "|iterations=" & CStr(solver.iterations) & "|" & solver.StopReason
    Next modulus
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Диагональные и переставленные системы имеют точно известный вектор.
' Большой determinant/норма RHS не должны мешать решению. Непредставимая
' поправка и арифметическое переполнение возвращают управляемый отказ;
' последующий обычный solve того же объекта не наследует неудачу.
Private Sub TestAudit03ExtremeLinearSystem(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim system As CLinearSystem3x3, coefficientScale As Variant, direction As Variant
    Dim value As Double, solved As Boolean, code As Long, reason As String, prefix As Variant
    Set system = New CLinearSystem3x3
    For Each coefficientScale In Array(1E+110, 1E+200, 1E+307, 1E+308)
        For Each direction In Array(-1#, 1#)
            value = CDbl(coefficientScale) * CDbl(direction)
            For Each prefix In Array("diagonal", "permuted")
                On Error Resume Next
                Err.Clear
                If prefix = "diagonal" Then
                    solved = system.solve(value, 0#, 0#, 0#, value, 0#, 0#, 0#, value, value, -value, value)
                Else
                    solved = system.solve(0#, 0#, value, value, 0#, 0#, 0#, value, 0#, value, value, -value)
                End If
                code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
                On Error GoTo 0
                Dim label As String
                label = "audit03.linear." & CStr(prefix) & "." & CStr(coefficientScale) & "." & CStr(direction)
                TestAssertTrue stats, label & ".noRuntimeError", code = 0
                TestAssertTrue stats, label & ".solved", solved And system.solved
                If code = 0 And solved Then
                    TestAssertClose stats, label & ".x1", system.X1, 1#, 0#
                    TestAssertClose stats, label & ".x2", system.X2, -1#, 0#
                    TestAssertClose stats, label & ".x3", system.X3, 1#, 0#
                    TestAssertClose stats, label & ".residual", system.RelativeResidual, 0#, 0#
                End If
                TestAppendLine stats, "LINEAR_SCALE: " & label & "|solved=" & CStr(solved) & "|error=" & CStr(code) & "|" & reason
            Next prefix
        Next direction
    Next coefficientScale
    ' Здесь determinant равен 1: воспроизводим отдельно переполнение нормы RHS.
    For Each direction In Array(-1#, 1#)
        value = 1E+308 * CDbl(direction)
        On Error Resume Next
        Err.Clear
        solved = system.solve(1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, value, value, value)
        code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
        On Error GoTo 0
        label = "audit03.linear.rhsNorm." & CStr(direction)
        TestAssertTrue stats, label & ".noRuntimeError", code = 0
        TestAssertTrue stats, label & ".solved", solved And system.solved
        If code = 0 And solved Then
            TestAssertTrue stats, label & ".vector", system.X1 = value And system.X2 = value And system.X3 = value
            TestAssertClose stats, label & ".residual", system.RelativeResidual, 0#, 0#
        End If
        TestAppendLine stats, "LINEAR_SCALE: " & label & "|solved=" & CStr(solved) & "|error=" & CStr(code) & "|" & reason
    Next direction
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    solved = system.solve(1E-17, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 1E+308, 1#, 1#)
    code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.unrepresentable.noRuntimeError", code = 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.unrepresentable.failed", Not solved And Not system.solved
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.unrepresentable.reason", Len(system.StopReason) > 0
    TestAppendLine stats, "LINEAR_OVERFLOW: division|error=" & CStr(code) & "|" & reason & "|" & system.StopReason
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    solved = system.solve(1E+308, 1E+308, 0#, -1E+308, 1E+308, 0#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 1E+308, 1#)
    code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    On Error GoTo 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.elimination.noRuntimeError", code = 0
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.elimination.failed", Not solved And Not system.solved
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.elimination.reason", Len(system.StopReason) > 0
    TestAppendLine stats, "LINEAR_OVERFLOW: elimination|error=" & CStr(code) & "|" & reason & "|" & system.StopReason
    TestAssertTrue stats, "audit03.linear.recovery", system.solve(3#, 2#, -1#, 2#, -2#, 4#, -1#, 0.5, -1#, 1#, -2#, 0#) And system.solved
    TestAssertClose stats, "audit03.linear.recovery.x1", system.X1, 1#, 0.000000000001
    TestAppendLine stats, "LINEAR_CASES: validSystems=18; arithmeticFailures=2; nonlinearCases=0"
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Измеряет только общий линейный шаг на одинаковой известной системе.
' Пять повторов позволяют сравнить старый и исправленный helper отдельно
' от Excel IO и создания геометрии; это не итоговый benchmark всего НДС.
Public Function TestRunAudit03LinearSystemBenchmark() As String
    Dim system As CLinearSystem3x3, repetition As Long, i As Long
    Dim started As Double, elapsed As Double, checksum As Double, report As String
    Set system = New CLinearSystem3x3
    For repetition = 1 To 5
        checksum = 0#: started = Timer
        For i = 1 To 100000
            If Not system.solve(3#, 2#, -1#, 2#, -2#, 4#, -1#, 0.5, -1#, 1#, -2#, 0#) Then
                TestRunAudit03LinearSystemBenchmark = "RUNTIME ERROR: linear benchmark solve failed; " & system.StopReason
                Exit Function
            End If
            checksum = checksum + system.X1 + system.X2 + system.X3
        Next i
        elapsed = Timer - started
        If elapsed < 0# Then elapsed = elapsed + 86400#
        report = report & "BENCHMARK_LINEAR: sample=" & CStr(repetition) & "; iterations=100000; elapsedSec=" & _
            TestFormatNumberInvariant(elapsed) & "; checksum=" & TestFormatNumberInvariant(checksum) & vbCrLf
        If Abs(checksum + 300000#) > 0.000001 Then
            TestRunAudit03LinearSystemBenchmark = report & "RUNTIME ERROR: linear benchmark checksum differs."
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next repetition
    TestRunAudit03LinearSystemBenchmark = report & "TOTAL_AUDIT03_LINEAR_BENCHMARK: passed=5; failed=0"
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' переполнение при линейном продолжении возвращает NumFail,
' сохраняет причину и не мешает следующему обычному расчёту тем же решателем.
Public Function RunUnboundedExtensionArithmeticTests() As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestUnboundedExtensionArithmetic stats
    RunUnboundedExtensionArithmeticTests = stats.report & "TOTAL_UNBOUNDED_ARITHMETIC: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Задаёт заведомо непредставимые напряжения в обоих направлениях продолжения.
' Проверяет штатную обработку переполнения для Newton и Secant.
Private Sub TestUnboundedExtensionArithmetic(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, concreteParameters As CConcreteMaterialParameters
    Dim steelParameters As CSteelMaterialParameters, materials As CMaterialModelProvider
    Dim solver As CSectionSolver, sign As Variant, method As Variant, prefix As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set section = New CSectionModel
    section.AddConcreteElement -50#, -30#, 1000#, 1
    section.AddConcreteElement 50#, -30#, 1000#, 1
    section.AddConcreteElement 0#, 30#, 1000#, 1
    section.AddRebarElement 0#, 0#, 20#, 0#, "A400"
    Set concreteParameters = New CConcreteMaterialParameters
    concreteParameters.Initialize 15.5, 1.1, 22#, 1.8, 32500#, 32500#, RbMc2:=14.6
    Set steelParameters = New CSteelMaterialParameters
    steelParameters.Initialize 350#, 350#, 390#, 390#, 200000#, 200000#
    Set materials = New CMaterialModelProvider
    materials.TestInitializeFromParameters concreteParameters, steelParameters, diagramExtensionEnabled:=True
    For Each method In Array("Newton", "Secant")
        For Each sign In Array(-1#, 1#)
            prefix = "unbounded.arithmetic." & CStr(method) & "." & CStr(sign)
            Set solver = New CSectionSolver: solver.SolverMethod = CStr(method)
            solver.SetInitialState CDbl(sign) * 1E+308, 0#, 0#
            solver.solve section, materials.ConcreteMaterialForEquilibrium(cpStrength), materials.SteelMaterialForEquilibrium(cpStrength), 0#, 0#, 0#
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notConverged", Not solver.Converged
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".numericalFailure", solver.failureCode = sfcNumericalFailure
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".overflowReason", InStr(1, solver.StopReason, "переполнение", vbTextCompare) > 0
            solver.ClearInitialState
            solver.solve section, materials.ConcreteMaterialForEquilibrium(cpStrength), materials.SteelMaterialForEquilibrium(cpStrength), 0#, 0#, 0#
            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".recovers", solver.Converged
        Next sign
    Next method
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    TestAssertTrue stats, "unbounded.arithmetic.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ============================== ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: БОЛЬШИЕ МОМЕНТЫ RUNNER ==============================
' проходит обычный pipeline прямого НДС при N=0, где начальная
' плоскость раньше требовала вычислить Mx^2 + My^2. Конечные нагрузки вне
' возможностей диаграммы должны дать typed численный отказ, а не overflow VBA.
Public Function RunAudit03ExtremeRunnerTests(Optional ByRef passed As Long = 0, _
        Optional ByRef Failed As Long = 0) As String
    Dim stats As TSectionSolverTestStats
    TestAudit03ExtremeRunnerStates stats
    TestAppendLine stats, "TOTAL_AUDIT03_EXTREME_RUNNER: passed=" & CStr(stats.passed) & "; failed=" & CStr(stats.Failed)
    passed = stats.passed: Failed = stats.Failed
    RunAudit03ExtremeRunnerTests = stats.report
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' обе схемы равновесия, Off/On и шесть направлений чистого изгиба.
' Ошибка отдельной попытки сохраняется и не останавливает остальные варианты;
' после большого запроса тот же runner обязан решить обычное сжатие.
Private Sub TestAudit03ExtremeRunnerStates(ByRef stats As TSectionSolverTestStats)
    Dim section As CSectionModel, concreteParameters As CConcreteMaterialParameters
    Dim steelParameters As CSteelMaterialParameters, materials As CMaterialModelProvider
    Dim spec As CMaterialModelSpec, concrete As CMaterialDiagram, steel As CMaterialDiagram
    Dim runner As CStateSolutionRunner, solver As CSectionSolver, state As CSectionStateResult
    Dim extended As Variant, method As Variant, magnitude As Variant, direction As Long
    Dim mX As Double, mY As Double, errorCode As Long, reason As String, prefix As String, magnitudeName As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set section = TestBuildGeneratedSectionModel(TestBuildMesh(TestRectangleGeometry(200#, 100#), 20#), Nothing)
    Set concreteParameters = New CConcreteMaterialParameters
    concreteParameters.Initialize 15.5, 1.1, 22#, 1.8, 32500#, 32500#, RbMc2:=14.6
    Set steelParameters = New CSteelMaterialParameters
    steelParameters.Initialize 350#, 350#, 390#, 390#, 200000#, 200000#
    Set spec = New CMaterialModelSpec
    spec.Initialize "ULS(I)", "ThreeLine", "Ignore", "TwoLine"
    For Each extended In Array(False, True)
        Set materials = New CMaterialModelProvider
        materials.TestInitializeFromParameters concreteParameters, steelParameters, diagramExtensionEnabled:=CBool(extended)
        Set concrete = materials.ConcreteMaterialForEquilibriumFromSpec(spec)
        Set steel = materials.SteelMaterialForEquilibriumFromSpec(spec)
        For Each method In Array("Newton", "Secant")
            For Each magnitude In Array(1E+160, 1E+308)
                If CDbl(magnitude) = 1E+160 Then magnitudeName = "1e160" Else magnitudeName = "1e308"
                For direction = 0 To 5
                    mX = 0#: mY = 0#
                    Select Case direction
                        Case 0: mX = CDbl(magnitude)
                        Case 1: mX = -CDbl(magnitude)
                        Case 2: mY = CDbl(magnitude)
                        Case 3: mY = -CDbl(magnitude)
                        Case 4: mX = CDbl(magnitude): mY = -CDbl(magnitude)
                        Case 5: mX = -CDbl(magnitude): mY = CDbl(magnitude)
                    End Select
                    prefix = "audit03.extremeRunner." & CStr(extended) & "." & CStr(method) & "." & _
                        magnitudeName & "." & CStr(direction)
                    Set runner = New CStateSolutionRunner
                    runner.SolverMethod = CStr(method): runner.loadSteps = 1
                    runner.maxIterations = 3: runner.DiagnosticsEnabled = False
                    On Error Resume Next
                    Err.Clear
                    runner.solve section, concrete, steel, 0#, mX, mY, CBool(extended)
                    errorCode = Err.number: reason = Err.description
                    On Error GoTo Failed
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".noRuntimeError", errorCode = 0
                    Set solver = runner.ResultSolver
                    If errorCode = 0 Then
                        TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".hasAttempt", Not solver Is Nothing
                        If Not solver Is Nothing Then
                            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notConverged", Not solver.Converged
                            Set state = New CSectionStateResult
                            state.InitializeFromSolver sstStrengthState, cpStrength, spec, solver, False, False, runner.SolverCallCount
                            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".numericFailure", state.internalStatus = rsNumericalFailure
                            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".noPhysicalState", Not state.withinPhysicalRange
                            TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".reasonPresent", Len(state.ResultMeta.resultComment) > 0
                        End If
                    End If
                    TestAppendLine stats, "EXTREME_RUNNER: " & prefix & "|error=" & CStr(errorCode) & "|" & reason
                    runner.maxIterations = 80
                    runner.solve section, concrete, steel, -50000#, 0#, 0#, CBool(extended)
                    TestAssertTrue stats, prefix & ".recovers", runner.Converged
                Next direction
            Next magnitude
        Next method
    Next extended
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1
    TestAppendLine stats, "FAIL: audit03.extremeRunner.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: Проверки независимых этапов формирования, расчёта и оформления сечения
' ==========================================================================
' Выполняются только на отдельной тестовой копии книги. Проверяют полный
' снимок модели, неизменность координат и отсутствие скрытой генерации.

Private Type TWorkflowStats
    passed As Long ' Количество успешных проверок.
    Failed As Long ' Количество несовпадений.
    report As String ' Подробный журнал проверок.
End Type

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает условие и добавляет именованный результат в журнал.
Private Sub TestCheck(ByRef stats As TWorkflowStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        stats.passed = stats.passed + 1: stats.report = stats.report & "OK: " & name & vbCrLf
    Else
        stats.Failed = stats.Failed + 1: stats.report = stats.report & "FAIL: " & name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Сравнивает физические величины с допуском значительно меньше расчётного.
Private Sub TestNear(ByRef stats As TWorkflowStats, ByVal name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    TestCheck stats, name, Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000000000001 * (1# + Abs(expected))
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Меняет настройку по ключу в тестовой копии, сохраняя независимость от адресов.
Private Sub TestSetting(ByVal key As String, ByVal value As Variant)
    Dim area As Object, row As Long, values As Variant
    Set area = ThisWorkbook.names("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    values = area.value2
    For row = 1 To UBound(values, 1)
        If CStr(values(row, 1)) = key Then area.cells(row, 2).value2 = value: Exit Sub
    Next row
    Err.Raise 5, "modTestSectionWorkflow", "Не найдена настройка " & key
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Выбирает выходную единицу по строке общей таблицы единиц.
Private Sub TestOutputUnit(ByVal quantity As String, ByVal value As String)
    Dim area As Object, row As Long, values As Variant
    Set area = ThisWorkbook.names("rngUnitSettings").RefersToRange
    values = area.value2
    For row = 1 To UBound(values, 1)
        If CStr(values(row, 1)) = quantity Then area.cells(row, 4).value2 = value: Exit Sub
    Next row
    Err.Raise 5, "modTestSectionWorkflow", "Не найдена единица " & quantity
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Создаёт контрольную модель с исходными материалами, именами и связями.
' Размеры и численные значения заданы независимо от генератора рецептов.
Private Function TestExampleModel() As CSectionModel
    Dim model As CSectionModel: Set model = New CSectionModel
    model.sourceType = "AutoCADImport": model.ConcreteMeshSource = "AutoCADRegions"
    model.AddConcreteElement 0#, 0#, 10000#, 2, "00123", "1E2", "Rectangle", 100#, 100#, 0.25, "Основная область", 0#, 0#, 0#, True
    model.AddConcreteElement 60#, 0#, 2500#, 3, "Бетон 2", "1B", "Region", 0#, 0#, 0#, "Область с реальными инерциями", 100000#, 120000#, 7000#, False
    model.AddRebarElement -20#, -20#, 20#, 314.159265358979, "A500Б", 4, "Стержень 1", "2A", "Главная позиция"
    model.AddRebarElement 20#, 20#, 16#, 201.061929829747, "A400", 5, "Стержень 2", "2B", "Дополнительная позиция"
    model.AppendRebarRecipeTrace 1, "Main|A", "Axis;1", "Main.1"
    model.AppendRebarRecipeTrace 1, "Row2", "Axis;2", "Main.2"
    model.GeometryDiagnosticsText = "Предупреждение: контрольное сообщение." & vbCrLf & "Позиции сохранены."
    model.contours.AddContourLine "B1", -100#, -100#, 100#, -100#, "Низ", "OUTER", "Outer", "SOURCE"
    model.contours.AddContourLine "B2", 100#, -100#, 100#, 100#, "Право", "OUTER", "Outer", "SOURCE"
    model.contours.AddContourLine "B3", 100#, 100#, -100#, 100#, "Верх", "OUTER", "Outer", "SOURCE"
    model.contours.AddContourLine "B4", -100#, 100#, -100#, -100#, "Лево", "OUTER", "Outer", "SOURCE"
    model.annotations.AddDimension "DIM", 0#, 100#, 85#, 100#, 0#, 1#, "B", 123.456789, "Точное значение без округления"
    model.annotations.AddRebarLabel "LABEL", -20#, -30#, 20#, -30#, 0#, -1#, "2" & ChrW$(&H2205) & "20", "Подпись фактической арматуры"
    model.ApplyAverageRotationToEquivalentAreaFallbacks
    Set TestExampleModel = model
End Function

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Записывает и восстанавливает модель при разных выходных единицах.
' Проверяет данные, которые прежнее чтение только изображения теряло.
Private Sub TestCompleteModel(ByRef stats As TWorkflowStats)
    Dim unit As Variant, expected As CSectionModel, actual As CSectionModel
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem, writer As CNDMResultsWriter
    For Each unit In Array("mm", "cm", "m")
        TestOutputUnit "Length", CStr(unit)
        TestOutputUnit "Area", "cm2"
        Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
        Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
        Set expected = TestExampleModel(): Set writer = New CNDMResultsWriter
        writer.WriteGeometryPreview ThisWorkbook, expected, PrepareSectionSnapshot(expected), units
        Set actual = ReadFormedSectionFromResults(ThisWorkbook, True)
        TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".bulkReads", TestSectionSnapshotReadDiagnostics() = "tables=4;released=True"
        TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".counts", actual.ConcreteCount = 2 And actual.RebarCount = 2 And actual.AnnotationCount = 5
        TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".source", actual.sourceType = expected.sourceType And actual.ConcreteMeshSource = expected.ConcreteMeshSource
        TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".diagnostics", actual.GeometryDiagnosticsText = expected.GeometryDiagnosticsText
        TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".contours", actual.contours.count = 4
        Dim i As Long
        For i = 1 To 2
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.x." & i, actual.concreteX(i), expected.concreteX(i)
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.area." & i, actual.concreteArea(i), expected.concreteArea(i)
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.Ix." & i, actual.ConcreteLocalIx(i), expected.ConcreteLocalIx(i)
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.Ixy." & i, actual.ConcreteLocalIxy(i), expected.ConcreteLocalIxy(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.material." & i, actual.ConcreteMaterialID(i) = expected.ConcreteMaterialID(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.name." & i, actual.ConcreteSourceName(i) = expected.ConcreteSourceName(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".concrete.handle." & i, actual.ConcreteSourceHandle(i) = expected.ConcreteSourceHandle(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".steel." & i, actual.RebarSteelClass(i) = expected.RebarSteelClass(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".rebar.name." & i, actual.RebarSourceName(i) = expected.RebarSourceName(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".rebar.handle." & i, actual.RebarSourceHandle(i) = expected.RebarSourceHandle(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".material." & i, actual.RebarMaterialID(i) = expected.RebarMaterialID(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".trace." & i, actual.RebarRecipeTrace(i) = expected.RebarRecipeTrace(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".comment." & i, actual.RebarComment(i) = expected.RebarComment(i)
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".rebar.x." & i, actual.RebarX(i), expected.RebarX(i)
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".rebar.area." & i, actual.RebarArea(i), expected.RebarArea(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".annotation.text." & i, actual.annotations.text(i) = expected.annotations.text(i)
            TestCheck stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".annotation.unit." & i, actual.annotations.unit(i) = expected.annotations.unit(i)
            TestNear stats, "snapshot." & unit & ".annotation.value." & i, actual.annotations.value(i), expected.annotations.value(i)
        Next i
    Next unit
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Проверяет, что оформление ошибок сохраняет причину, слои и отдельные шаги.
Private Sub TestFormationMessages(ByRef stats As TWorkflowStats)
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader: Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader
    settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Dim text As String
    text = SectionFormationFailureText("На слоях импорта не найдена геометрия сечения.", "AutoCAD", settings)
    TestCheck stats, "message.cause", InStr(text, "не найдена геометрия") > 0
    TestCheck stats, "message.layers.paragraph", InStr(text, vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Слои, указанные на Config:" & vbCrLf) > 0
    TestCheck stats, "message.solution.paragraph", InStr(text, vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Возможное решение:" & vbCrLf) > 0
    TestCheck stats, "message.generated", InStr(text, "Geometry.Source = Generated") > 0
    TestCheck stats, "message.sections", InStr(text, vbCrLf & "2. На листе «Сечения»") > 0
    TestCheck stats, "message.retry", InStr(text, vbCrLf & "3. Нажмите «Сформировать сечение».") > 0
    text = WorkbookErrorMessage("Сечение не сформировано", vbObjectError + 4405, "Import", text)
    TestCheck stats, "message.operation.paragraph", left$(text, Len("Сечение не сформировано:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf)) = "Сечение не сформировано:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
End Sub


' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' Повреждённые сведения не заменяются значениями по умолчанию. После ошибки
' кэш очищается, а перенос именованной таблицы не меняет результат чтения.
Private Sub TestSnapshotValidation(ByRef stats As TWorkflowStats)
    Dim model As CSectionModel, writer As CNDMResultsWriter, units As CUnitSystem
    Dim settings As CSystemSettingsReader, table As Object, annotations As Object
    Dim original As Variant, annotationData As Variant, changed As Variant, mode As Long
    Dim code As Long, reason As String, oldReference As String
    Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromWorkbook ThisWorkbook
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
    Set writer = New CNDMResultsWriter: Set model = TestExampleModel()
    writer.WriteGeometryPreview ThisWorkbook, model, PrepareSectionSnapshot(model), units
    Set table = ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersToRange
    Set annotations = ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionAnnotations").RefersToRange
    original = ReadAnchoredResultTable(ThisWorkbook, "rngNDMSectionGeometry")
    annotationData = ReadAnchoredResultTable(ThisWorkbook, "rngNDMSectionAnnotations")
    For mode = 0 To 5
        changed = original
        Select Case mode
            Case 0: changed(2, 6) = 0
            Case 1: changed(3, 2) = changed(2, 2)
            Case 2: changed(2, 1) = "OTHER_SNAPSHOT"
            Case 3: changed(2, 8) = False
            Case 4: changed(2, 14) = "not a number"
            Case 5: changed(4, 10) = -10#
        End Select
        table.Resize(UBound(changed, 1), UBound(changed, 2)).value2 = changed
        Set model = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set model = ReadFormedSectionFromResults(ThisWorkbook)
        code = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo 0
        TestCheck stats, "validation." & mode & ".reject", code <> 0 And model Is Nothing
        TestCheck stats, "validation." & mode & ".action", InStr(reason, "Сформировать сечение") > 0
        TestCheck stats, "validation." & mode & ".released", InStr(TestSectionSnapshotReadDiagnostics(), "released=True") > 0
        annotations.Resize(UBound(annotationData, 1), UBound(annotationData, 2)).value2 = annotationData
    Next mode
    table.Resize(UBound(original, 1), UBound(original, 2)).value2 = original
    oldReference = ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersTo
    Dim moved As Object: Set moved = table.Worksheet.range("QZ156")
    moved.Resize(UBound(original, 1), UBound(original, 2)).value2 = original
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersTo = "=Results!" & moved.address
    On Error GoTo RestoreName
    Set model = ReadFormedSectionFromResults(ThisWorkbook)
    TestCheck stats, "validation.moved.geometry", model.ConcreteCount = 2 And model.RebarCount = 2
RestoreName:
    code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngNDMSectionGeometry").RefersTo = oldReference
    moved.Resize(UBound(original, 1), UBound(original, 2)).ClearContents
    If code <> 0 Then Err.Raise code, "TestSnapshotValidation", reason
End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------

Private Sub TestMissingSnapshot(ByRef stats As TWorkflowStats)

    On Error Resume Next

End Sub

' -------------------- ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ --------------------
' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ
' Быстрая приёмка сохранения полного сечения и понятных сообщений без расчёта НДС.
Public Function RunWorkflowSnapshotTests() As String
    Dim stats As TWorkflowStats, saved As Variant

    TestCompleteModel stats
